releases.title: YunoJuno Named International Contractor Services Provider of the Year
releases.body:
Leader in Freelancer Management Systems recognized for compliant, global contractor engagement at scale at The Contracting Awards 2026.

NEW YORK and LONDON, Oct. 15, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- YunoJuno, the Freelancer Management System (FMS) for global enterprises that powers the entire contingent worker lifecycle, has been named International Contractor Services Provider of the Year at the annual Contracting Awards. The win marks YunoJuno's third consecutive year leading the category, following awards in 2024 and again in 2025 as part of a double win for Best Contractor Innovation.

The award comes as more businesses build international teams of contractors to access specialist flexible skills and move faster than local hiring allows. As these teams operate across numerous jurisdictions, enterprises look for a partner that can carry the compliance responsibility. YunoJuno compliantly engages independent contractors and indemnifies the end client against classification risk, giving enterprises the confidence to scale their global contractor workforce.

"Winning this category three years running reflects a sustained and rapid investment in making international contracting simple for the businesses that depend on it," said Runar Reistrup, CEO of YunoJuno. "Every step in our roadmap this year has been built around removing the operational and legal complexity that enterprises normally face with a global contractor workforce, while managing and eliminating the risks involved."

International Contractor Services Provider of the Year recognizes excellence in supporting contractor engagement across countries, judged on compliance, scale, payment infrastructure and the overall experience delivered to both enterprise clients and the contractors they engage.

The judging panel specifically recognized YunoJuno's:

  • Global Reach and Scale: A network of more than 150,000 pre-vetted contractors across 165+ countries, connecting talent with over 12,000 businesses including numerous Fortune 500 enterprises.
  • Expanded W2 Capabilities: A fully managed US Employer of Record (EOR) solution bringing the US engagement lifecycle in-platform, removing the need for enterprises to navigate employment law, payroll and tax documentation across separate external systems.
  • Built-in Global Compliance: Automated worker classification workflows and indemnification coverage to help enterprises mitigate contractor misclassification risks.
  • Multi-Currency Payments: Auto-generated invoices and real-time status tracking, simplifying payment management for businesses and contractors.

"Managing compliance risk when engaging independent contractors internationally is one of the biggest challenges facing enterprise workforce leaders," said Joao Martires, Chief Operating Officer at YunoJuno. "Our focus has been on building the compliance processes and infrastructure that give enterprises complete visibility and control when engaging contractors globally. This award recognizes the unseen work our teams have put into making that possible."

The latest win follows a significant period of growth for YunoJuno, which achieved its first full year of profitability alongside 45% revenue growth in 2025, driven by international expansion and increasing enterprise demand.

YunoJuno was also recognized as the highest Leader and a Star Performer in Everest Group's 2026 PEAK Matrix® Assessment for Freelancer Engagement and Management Systems (FEMS). In Everest Group's Contractor of Record (CoR) and Contingent Employer of Record (CEoR) Solutions PEAK Matrix® Assessment 2026, YunoJuno was recently named a Leader, further reinforcing its position in the global contractor management market.

About YunoJuno

YunoJuno is the leading global end-to-end Freelancer Engagement and Management System (FEMS) that helps enterprises source, onboard, manage, and pay contractor talent with complete compliance and transparency. YunoJuno's AI-powered technology streamlines the entire contractor engagement process while mitigating compliance risks, currently serving 12,000 businesses and hundreds of thousands of independent contractors and freelancers globally.

For more information, visit www.yunojuno.com

releases.title: TickTalk Introduces TickTalk Radio™: A First-of-Its-Kind, Parent-Controlled Music and Wellness Platform Built for Kids
releases.body:
Built in partnership with Feed.fm, TickTalk Radio™ combines fully licensed popular music, science-backed wellness and thematic age-filtering with total parental oversight.

BREA, Calif., Oct. 15, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- TickTalk, a leading innovator in kids' smartwatches and family communication platforms built around its mission of Communication First. Safety Always., announces the launch of TickTalk 6, its next-generation connected smartwatch for children ages 3 to 12. Designed to keep parents and children seamlessly connected through every drop-off, pickup and after-school moment, TickTalk 6 introduces TickTalk Radio™, a first-of-its-kind, fully parent-controlled music and wellness platform built specifically for kids.

While platforms like Spotify Kids, YouTube Kids, and the iHeartRadio Family app offer kid-focused audio experiences, TickTalk Radio takes a different approach, putting parents in greater control of what their children can access. TickTalk Radio is designed around curated, parent-approved station access, giving families more control over the listening experience. The result is age-appropriate entertainment that gives kids the freedom to enjoy music and audio content while keeping parents firmly in control of the experience.

"Caught in the parenting paradox, we built TickTalk Radio™ to solve a common parenting struggle: how to give kids access to music without opening the door to unrestricted streaming platforms," said Ying Gong, CEO of TickTalk Tech. "This gives children a fun, safe, and age-curated audio experience tailored to their growing independence, while giving parents total peace of mind through complete content controls, zero ads, and no open internet browsing."

Reimagining Kids' Audio: Curated by Age. Filtered by You. Made for Kids.

Unlike unrestricted, general-audience streaming services adapted for younger listeners, TickTalk Radio™ was built from the ground up for kids' devices in partnership with Feed.fm. Feed.fm provides the B2B music infrastructure that powers the end-to-end TickTalk Radio experience by combining pre-cleared, fully licensed major-label and science-backed wellness tracks, expert human curation, age-appropriate filtering, and turnkey streaming technology.

"Kids deserve the joy and discovery that comes with music, without requiring parents to open the door to a full consumer streaming experience," said Lauren Pufpaf, President and COO of Feed.fm. "TickTalk Radio shows what's possible when music is thoughtfully designed for a specific audience, combining licensed music, age-aware curation and parental controls in an experience built specifically for kids."

Key Features of TickTalk Radio™:

  • Built Specifically for Kids & Families: Purpose-built for young listeners rather than retrofitting general consumer streaming apps.
  • Tiered Age Curation & Higher Safety Standards: Developed in partnership with Feed.fm, the parent-approved stations are structured across three distinct developmental tiers: Junior (ages 3–5), Explorer (ages 6–9), and Tween (ages 9–12). Content moderation goes beyond standard clean/explicit labels by filtering for both language appropriateness and thematic maturity. Fresh content added regularly.
  • True Parental Control: Through the redesigned TickTalk Parent App, parents can manage or oversee preferences, preview any station, enable or disable individual channels, set daily listening duration limits, and adjust access as their child grows.
  • Entertainment + Daily Utility: Features popular, fully licensed major-label music alongside science-backed wellness tracks designed to help children cultivate healthy daily routines around calm, focus, sleep, and mindfulness.
  • Focus Mode Guardrails: Parents can activate Focus Mode during homework hours or bedtime, limiting audio access strictly to Wellness Stations so music supports routine without becoming a distraction.
  • Bounded & Ad-Free Experience: Operating in a completely closed system with zero ads, zero algorithmic social feeds, and no open search functionality, ensuring a safe and contained experience.
  • Music Distribution Innovation: Represents a groundbreaking distribution opportunity for the music industry, bringing fully licensed, major-label music to kids' connected wearables in a purpose-built environment, without exposing them to open streaming services.
  • Global Connectivity & Cloud Migration: Built-in eSIM activation and optional global travel connectivity ensure uninterrupted access to wellness streaming content anywhere families go.
  • Complete Family Ecosystem: TickTalk Radio™ operates seamlessly alongside the expanded hardware and software suite of the all-new TickTalk 6, integrating FaceTalk™ video calling, Real SMS, TickTalkie™ walkie-talkie communication, AI SmartPin™ location tracking, global eSIM connectivity, and free T-Cloud™ data migration for a secure, unified experience.

What Parents Are Saying:

"It's so helpful (and reassuring) as a parent to still have total control 'behind the scenes' while letting her explore her independence at a pace I feel comfortable with." — Shanna Wandmacher, Parent Tester

"The music selection is fun, diverse, and all three of my boys found stations they loved. The parental controls also give parents peace of mind and confidence that their children are listening to safe, age-appropriate content." — Samantha Archer, Parent Tester

Pricing and Availability

  • At $169.99, TickTalk 6 is in stock at myticktalk.com and Walmart, now rolling out on Amazon, with Best Buy coming soon.



  • TickTalk Radio™ Subscription: Included as part of the TickTalk Wireless Premium plan, or available as an add-on service for $4.99/month (music availability subject to licensing and territory).



  • Exclusive Press Access & Media Preview Streaming: Members of the press can request access to stream TickTalk Radio™ via dedicated, password-protected web landing pages featuring embedded music players. This enables journalists and reviewers to experience the distinct Junior, Explorer, and Tween age tiers alongside dedicated wellness programming, thus getting the music experience without the need to test the device. 

About TickTalk

TickTalk is a leading kids' smartwatch and family communication platform designed to help children gain independence while helping families stay connected without giving kids a smartphone. 

Built around its mission, Communication First. Safety Always., TickTalk brings together safe calling and messaging, FaceTalk™ video calling, location and safety tools, parental controls, wireless connectivity, age-appropriate content, cloud services, protection, and family support through one connected ecosystem.

TickTalk products are designed specifically for children ages 3 to 12, with no social media, no open internet, and no unnecessary digital distractions. For more information, visit myticktalk.com or follow @myticktalk on Instagram.

About Feed.fm

Feed.fm is a music technology platform that makes it easy for apps and connected devices to offer licensed, curated music. We handle the complexity behind the scenes, including music rights, curation, content delivery, and compliance. Our proprietary five-tier music rating system (Safe, Mild, Teen, Adult, Extreme) evaluates tracks for thematic maturity as well as language. That goes beyond standard clean and explicit labels, so brands can build age-appropriate, family-friendly listening experiences. Feed.fm's Branded Music Service powers white-label, in-app music for companies across kids and family, health, wellness, fitness, and other digital experiences. Learn more at www.feed.fm.

releases.title: World's Largest Flying Digital Screen Makes NYC Debut with Two Flights and New Byron Allen Media Partnership
releases.body:
HELI-D flew over the Hudson River near Chelsea Piers and the Statue of Liberty during the DPAA Global Video Everywhere Summit, followed by an evening flight showcasing Byron Allen's media content

NEW YORK, Oct. 14, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- HELI-D, the company behind the world's largest flying digital screen, made its New York City debut on October 13 with two flights introducing a new form of aerial digital advertising to one of the world's largest media markets. The debut featured an afternoon flight in partnership with the Digital Place Based Advertising Association (DPAA) during its annual Global Video Everywhere Summit, followed by an evening flight showcasing content from media mogul Byron Allen's Allen Media Group as part of a newly secured partnership.

The afternoon flight took place between 1:00 PM and 1:45 PM ET, coinciding with the Summit's lunch break. Launching from Newport Helistop in New Jersey, HELI-D flew along the Hudson River toward Chelsea Piers, where Summit attendees and New Yorkers had an opportunity to see the massive digital screen in action. The aircraft then headed south toward the Statue of Liberty, bringing the display to one of the city's most recognizable landmarks.

HELI-D returned to the skies later that evening for a second flight featuring content from Byron Allen's Allen Media Group. The new agreement marks a significant step in HELI-D's entry into the U.S. advertising market, bringing together its aerial digital display technology and one of the country's prominent media entrepreneurs.

Unlike traditional billboards fixed to buildings or roadside structures, HELI-D's technology takes digital out-of-home advertising into the sky, creating a mobile, large-scale display capable of bringing brand messages directly to high-visibility locations, major events and large audiences.

"New York City is one of the most important advertising markets in the world, and there's no better place to demonstrate what's possible when digital advertising takes to the skies," said Simon Powell, Co-Founder and CEO of HELI-D. "Launching with DPAA and The Ad Council, and now working with Byron Allen and his media company, makes this an incredibly exciting debut for us. These partnerships demonstrate the potential of our technology to bring major brands and media content to audiences in an entirely new way."

The New York debut coincided with the DPAA Global Video Everywhere Summit, which brought together leaders from across the advertising, media and digital out-of-home industries. As a new media partner of DPAA and The Ad Council, HELI-D featured content from both organizations during the afternoon flight, demonstrating how its aerial display can be used for commercial advertising, public awareness campaigns and large-scale brand activations.

With two flights marking its New York City debut and new partnerships spanning the advertising and media industries, HELI-D is positioning its technology as a new addition to the digital out-of-home advertising landscape, offering brands the ability to deliver dynamic content above some of the world's most recognizable destinations and major events.

releases.body:
October 15–25, 2026: Exploring the Present and Future of Korean Independent Cinema

Featuring 10 Feature Films and 5 Shorts in Collaboration with Leading Korean Film Festivals

12 Directors and Film Professionals to Visit New York for Audience Q&As

NEW YORK, Oct. 14, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- The Korean Cultural Center New York (KCCNY) presents the inaugural New York Korean Independent Film Festival (NYKIFF) from October 15 through 25, 2026, at the KCCNY Theater. The festival seeks to expand international screening opportunities for outstanding Korean independent films and foster meaningful exchange between Korean filmmakers and New York's film community.

Korea's independent film community produces outstanding works with the potential to resonate internationally, yet limited exhibition and distribution opportunities have kept many from reaching audiences abroad. The inaugural festival responds to this gap by providing a platform for these films in New York, bringing greater visibility to Korean independent cinema and creating opportunities for its filmmakers to gain recognition on the international stage.

Featuring 10 feature films and 5 shorts, the festival brings together a wide range of cinematic voices through a program developed in collaboration with leading Korean film festivals. 12 directors and other film professionals will visit New York to meet audiences through post-screening Q&As.

The lineup was developed in collaboration with the Seoul Independent Film Festival, Jeonju International Film Festival, Bucheon International Fantastic Film Festival, Muju Film Festival, and Mise-en-scène Short Film Festival in Korea. Spanning fiction, documentary, thriller, and action, the 15-film selection introduces New York audiences to the distinctive perspectives shaping Korean independent cinema today.

Admission is free and open to the public, but pre-registration is required.

Opening and Closing Films

The festival opens with STARS AND SAND, directed by KAM JEONGWON, winner of the Grand Prize at the 51st Seoul Independent Film Festival. KAM JEONGWON and cinematographer CHOI CHANG HWAN will attend the opening screening and participate in a post-screening Q&A. A networking reception will follow, providing an opportunity for exchange with members of the local film community.

The festival closes with THE WORLD OF LOVE, directed by YOON GA-EUN, who received the Best Director award in the film category at the 62nd Baeksang Arts Awards.

Feature Film Highlights

Director LEE WEONYOUNG will visit New York to present THE GLIMMERING, which received the Grand Prize at the Muju Film Festival, while director KIM MYUNWOO will join audiences for KARMA, an award-winning selection from the Jeonju International Film Festival. Both filmmakers will participate in post-screening Q&As.

Additional feature selections include THE ONLY CHILD IN THE BUTCHERY, SAVON, THE FIN, THE LOVE OF TRUMAN, REI'S WINTER BREAK, and THE GORALS, bringing a range of distinctive stories and cinematic approaches to New York audiences.

Mise-en-scène Shorts: Award-Winning Films and Visiting Filmmakers

Co-presented with Korea Creative Content Agency New York (KOCCANY) and Netflix Korea, the special Mise-en-scène Short Film Festival section showcases five award-winning films from the festival's 22nd edition: MY AUNT, WRONG AIM, MIXEDUP SHAMAN, NOISE CANCELLATION, and AFTER SUBMERSION.

Directors WI EUNG-KYOUNG, SON GWANG-MIN, KIM KEUNHO, CHOI JIHYE, and PARK JEONG-SU will attend to meet audiences, joined by JANG YOUNG-YEOP, ceo of Cine21, a leading Korean film magazine.

releases.title: Redwood Public Law Launches Sports, Arts & Entertainment Practice
releases.body:
New interdisciplinary practice brings together the firm's existing experience in public-private development, sports and entertainment transactions, NIL, cultural infrastructure and public law

OAKLAND, Calif., Oct. 14, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Redwood Public Law LLP today announced the formal launch of its Sports, Arts & Entertainment Practice, bringing together existing experience across public-private partnerships, sports and entertainment transactions, Name, Image and Likeness (NIL), cultural infrastructure and public law into a dedicated interdisciplinary practice.

The practice is led by Redwood partners Richard D. Pio Roda, Eric S. Casher and Steve Ngo, working alongside Senior Of Counsels Jade Y. Ramos and Neha Shah, whose sports and entertainment practice includes athlete representation, NIL, sponsorship and endorsement agreements, labor and employment issues, and transactions involving artists, creatives, and culture and entertainment organizations.

Together, the team advises public agencies, athletes, artists, creatives, non-profit organizations, and businesses on matters involving contracts and commercial agreements, stadium and venue development, sponsorships and endorsements, governance, public-private partnerships, cultural initiatives and related strategic initiatives.

"Sports, arts and entertainment are integral to and enhance civic life. They shape how communities see themselves, bring people together and serve as catalysts for economic development and community engagement and investment," said Richard D. Pio Roda, Partner and Co-Leader of Redwood's Sports, Arts & Entertainment Practice. "This practice formalizes work that Redwood and our attorneys are already doing and brings together complementary experience across public law, transactions, land use and development and the sports and entertainment industries to serve clients across the ecosystem."

Experience Across the Sports, Arts & Entertainment Ecosystem

Redwood's approach reflects the increasingly interconnected nature of sports, arts, entertainment and the public sector.

The firm currently serves as special counsel to the Oakland Acquisition Company, formerly the African American Sports & Entertainment Group, in connection with the acquisition and development of the Oakland-Alameda County Coliseum complex. Ramos previously led the legal team advising the Oakland-based development group in its acquisition effort, work Redwood has continued to advance.

Redwood attorneys also bring experience advising on major sports and entertainment developments throughout California, including the Waterfront Ballpark District at Howard Terminal in Oakland, the redevelopment of Hollywood Park in Inglewood, the ocV!BE mixed-use entertainment district and Honda Center in Anaheim, and DisneylandForward.

That experience encompasses public-private negotiations, real estate and land use, environmental review, development agreements, public finance, construction and public contracting, facility operations and other legal issues that arise throughout the lifecycle of major sports, entertainment and cultural projects.

The practice also extends beyond venues and development. Redwood advises athletes, artists, creatives, sports organizations and entertainment businesses on the legal and strategic infrastructure supporting their careers, organizations and ventures.

The Sports, Arts & Entertainment Practice includes:

  • Sports stadiums, entertainment venues and districts, including development, public contracting, land use, environmental review, public finance and facility operations;



  • Public-private partnerships among public agencies, developers, sports and entertainment organizations and nonprofit partners; 



  • NIL and athlete representation, including NIL agreements, institutional and collective arrangements, and strategic matters across collegiate and professional sports; 



  • Professional league and franchise matters, including ownership group representation, league negotiations and expansion bids;



  • Artist and creative representation, including agreements involving music, film, visual art, live performance and digital content; 



  • Contracts and commercial agreements, including talent, event, vendor, production, licensing and distribution agreements; 



  • Sponsorships, endorsements and brand partnerships, including naming rights, venue and event sponsorships, athlete and talent endorsements, brand ambassador agreements, co-branded content;



  • Intellectual property and brand protection, including trademark, copyright, licensing and rights of publicity; 



  • Media and broadcasting matters, including content, distribution and matters for public and community media organizations; 



  • Labor and employment matters for athletes, performers, creative professionals, and the organizations that employ them; 



  • Arts and cultural initiatives, including cultural facilities and districts, public art, murals, exhibitions, creative spaces and creative-economy programs; 



  • Governance, formation and organizational matters for sports, arts, entertainment and nonprofit entities, including foundations and mission-driven ventures;



  • Emerging technology issues affecting athletes, artists and creative businesses, including AI and digital content ownership; and

Government and regulatory matters affecting sports, arts, entertainment and cultural initiatives Ramos brings a distinctive perspective to the practice as both an attorney and former professional and NCAA Division I basketball player. Her experience includes advising collegiate athletes, sports organizations, artists and content creators. She also co-designed and co-instructed the inaugural Name, Image and Likeness legal clinic at UC Berkeley School of Law.

Pio Roda brings extensive experience in transactions, public-private partnerships, governance, public contracting, real estate and land use, while Casher's practice includes complex public agency, development, regulatory and strategic matters. Together with Ramos and attorneys across Redwood's practice areas, the team is structured to address matters that frequently cross traditional legal disciplines.

"Sports and entertainment are changing rapidly, particularly for athletes and creatives who are navigating increasingly complex commercial opportunities," said Jade Y. Ramos, Senior Of Counsel at Redwood Public Law. "Our goal is to help clients understand those opportunities, protect what they are building and create structures that allow their work and ideas to grow."

The launch reflects Redwood's broader commitment to advising clients on complex matters where public investment, private enterprise, culture and community converge.

Redwood will formally celebrate the launch of the Sports, Arts & Entertainment Practice with an event on October 16, 2026 in Oakland at the Historical Rotunda Building located at 300 Frank H. Ogawa Plaza beginning at 5:00pm, PST.

About Redwood Public Law LLP

Redwood Public Law LLP is a California public law firm advising public agencies, nonprofits, businesses and other organizations on complex legal, regulatory, transactional and governance matters. Redwood attorneys collectively serve as City Attorney for 16 California cities and as General Counsel to more than 30 special districts and nonprofit organizations. The firm maintains offices in Oakland and Sacramento and advises clients throughout California.

For more information about Redwood Public Law's Sports, Arts & Entertainment Practice, visit redwoodpubliclaw.com/sports-arts-entertainment.

releases.body:
Texas digital marketing agency introduces a revenue-focused growth system connecting strategy, creative, paid media, SEO, AI visibility, and website performance.

HOUSTON, Oct. 14, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Kreative Media, a full-service digital marketing agency headquartered in Houston with locations across Texas, today announced the launch of the Kreative Velocity System, a performance-driven marketing framework designed to turn business goals and real performance data into smarter marketing decisions, strategic investments, and measurable business growth.

Most brands have marketing. Few have a system.

Rather than operating through disconnected campaigns or fixed strategies, the Kreative Velocity System continuously evaluates results, identifies opportunities, and shifts priorities toward the work with the greatest business potential. Each decision builds on previous performance, creating an adaptable approach to growth.

"Brands want to know what each dollar did," said Krista McDaniel, CEO of Kreative Media. "Our promise has always been bold creative, backed by data and built to produce results. The Kreative Velocity System is how we deliver on that consistently, so brands are built on purpose and every channel works toward the same number."

The methodology operates through four interconnected engines: Ad Velocity, optimizing paid media investment; Social Velocity, connecting audience insights with in-house creative production; SEO Velocity, expanding traditional and AI-powered search visibility through SEO, AEO, and GEO; and Site Velocity, prioritizing website improvements that turn traffic into business outcomes.

"Performance, creative, search visibility, and the website belong on the same page, tied to real revenue," said Karley Pines, Director of Performance Marketing at Kreative Media. "When they share one data foundation, every decision in one channel makes the next one smarter. That is what lets us scale spend with confidence and put creative time into what is proven to work."

As results evolve, the system adapts, using insights across disciplines to guide strategy, resource allocation, and future investments rather than restarting with each campaign.

The Kreative Velocity System is available to new and existing clients. Learn more at http://kreative-media.com/kreative-velocity-system/.

As LE SSERAFIM prepares to take the stage, the group passes around a mobile device, with each member spotlighting a favorite Viki show that reflects her personality – from addictive K-dramas and swoon-worthy C-dramas to variety shows. Each handoff captures the essence of how fan culture spreads: the thrill of discovering something you love and sharing it with your friends.

"Asian entertainment, from K-pop to Korean and Chinese dramas, has found a passionate global audience because of the extraordinary talent behind it, the compelling stories, and the fans who share it with each other," said Karen Paek, vice president of Marketing at Viki. "This campaign is a tribute to those fans, and we're proud to celebrate them alongside LE SSERAFIM."

LE SSERAFIM is a K-pop group formed in 2022 whose members include KIM CHAEWON, SAKURA, HUH YUNJIN, KAZUHA, and HONG EUNCHAE. A Guinness World Record holder, a free exhibition, and 550 young Marylanders under one theme: You Can

BALTIMORE, Oct. 14, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- On Friday, October 30, 550 high school seniors, college students, and early-career professionals will fill the Gordon Center for Performing Arts in Owings Mills for NextGen Summit. Built around the theme "You Can," the one-day event gives young Marylanders what they say they're missing most: funding, connections, and a clear path to their purpose and career goals.

The opportunity is specific. Ten young founders, 25 and under, will pitch live to a panel of business and community leaders, and the top three will share $10,000 to launch their ideas. The public votes one finalist onto the stage. Founders can apply through October 20 at nextgensummit.us. A free exhibition puts young entrepreneurs in front of attendees, customers, mentors, and potential partners.

Speakers:

  • Tisha Edwards, President & CEO of the Maryland Bankers Association and former Chief of Staff on Governor Wes Moore's campaign, on building a career in banking, business, and leadership
  • Tunde Onakoya, Guinness World Record holder and founder of Chess in Slums Africa, who turned a single chessboard into a program that has reached more than 10,000 children
  • Kennedy Ekezie, Forbes 30 Under 30 honoree and founder of Kippa, who started his first organization at 16

The day runs on TED-style talks, podcast-style conversations, and audience discussion and ends with every attendee writing down their next step.

"Every generation is told what is wrong with it. In one day, NextGen Summit will show these young people the greatness already in them. This may be the generation that preserves the future," said Pastor Deji Olubusi, Chairman, NextGen Summit.

Date: Friday, October 30, 2026

Exhibition: 2:00 PM | Main Stage: 4:15 to 7:00 PM

Location: Gordon Center for Performing Arts, Owings Mills, MD

releases.title: Ashes of the Singularity II Launches November 10, 2026
releases.body:
The United Earth Forces take on the Post-Human Coalition and the AI Substrate in Stardock's massive-scale real-time strategy sequel

PLYMOUTH, Mich., Oct. 12, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- The war for the soul of the solar system is nigh as Stardock today announced that Ashes of the Singularity II will release November 10, 2026, on Steam. The sequel to the massive-scale real-time strategy game puts players in the middle of a war over humanity's future, fighting against enemies that have already surpassed it.

Set in the near future, Ashes of the Singularity II puts humanity in a fight for its own survival. The Post-Human Coalition, a faction of humans who have abandoned their physical bodies, has become the most technologically advanced power in the solar system. At the same time, a rogue artificial intelligence has built the AI Substrate, a machine civilization determined to secure its own future at any cost. Caught between them, humanity is losing ground.

The nations of Earth have set aside long-standing rivalries to form the United Earth Forces. Outmatched in technology and weaker unit for unit, the UEF must rely on what humanity still does best: large armies, disciplined infantry, and strategies drawn from thousands of years of military experience.

"We're grateful to every player who jumped in during Next Fest and our playtests. Ashes of the Singularity II is a better game because of them," said Adrian Wright, Vice President of Entertainment at Stardock. "On November 10, the fight to save humanity begins in massive-scale RTS battles we're eager for players to experience."

Players can lead humanity through the singleplayer campaign or take command of any of the three factions in instant action skirmish and multiplayer, each with its own units and unique style of play.

Since the Steam Next Fest demo and September's public multiplayer playtest, the development team has continued to improve gameplay, balance, performance, and multiplayer stability based on player feedback.

Ashes of the Singularity II Key Features:

  • Massive Armies, Vast Battlefields: Command thousands of units in real time across continent-sized maps, with Strategic Zoom letting players move seamlessly from orbital command to frontline combat.
  • Face Enemies of Our Own Making: Take command of the United Earth Forces, the Post-Human Coalition, or the AI Substrate, each with unique units, strategies, and philosophies.
  • Be the Commander: Victory comes from planning and logistics, not speed or reflexes, letting players focus on strategy rather than unit-by-unit control.
  • Unify Humanity Under Your Command: Lead humanity's United Earth Forces against Post-Human expansion and Substrate machinations in a story rooted in a near-future scenario of survival and restoration.
  • Endless Replayability: Generate custom battlefields and take on computer-controlled opponents designed by some of the industry's most experienced RTS developers.
  • Multiplayer, Competitive and Co-Op: Join friends or rivals online in head-to-head matches or team up in cooperative battles.
  • All-Terrain Warfare: Defeat humanity's foes on frozen lakes, treacherous mountain passes, and lava-filled chasms that change with persistent damage as the battle rages on. 

Ashes of the Singularity II will release on November 10, 2026. The standard edition will be available at launch for $39.99; with a premium edition that includes the game, first three DLC packs and soundtrack for $69.99. Both editions will carry a special 20% launch discount from Nov. 10-17 and be available on Steam, directly through Stardock, or via other partners. For more information on Ashes II, visit www.ashesofthesingularity.com.

releases.title: Buldak Celebrates Guinness World Records® Achievement with Original Song and Music Video "Crave the Burn"
releases.body:
Available Now Across Buldak's Official YouTube, TikTok and Instagram Channels

LOS ANGELES, Oct. 14, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Buldak is turning its Guinness World Records® achievement into a soundtrack with the release of "Crave the Burn," an original song and music video celebrating the fans who came together to make history by uploading the most videos of people eating instant noodles to TikTok in one hour. Watch the music video on Buldak's YouTube channel. 

Blending pop energy with Latin flavor and a golden vibe, Buldak's "Crave the Burn" features English and Spanish lyrics that celebrate the brand's bold spirit and the fans who made the world record possible. 

Directed by Weston Allen, the music video features choreography by Brian Esperon, as well as clips from the record-breaking attempt. The song and music video come on the heels of Buldak fans making history on October 1, when 335 qualifying videos were uploaded to TikTok in a single hour as part of the brand's Guinness World Records attempt. The total surpassed the previous record of 250 videos by 85, an increase of 34%.

For Buldak, the song is a celebration not just of the record, but of the people behind it. "'Crave the Burn' and its music video are a way to celebrate our fans, who have played such an important role in making Buldak what it is today and will continue to shape our future," said Abbas Arslan, the Vice President of Marketing at Buldak. "We're incredibly grateful to everyone who enjoys our noodles and helped make this achievement possible."

Since launching in 2012, Buldak has inspired spicy challenges, reaction videos, recipes and countless fan creations across social platforms, connecting fans through a shared love of flavor, heat and pushing their limits.

Fans can watch the "Crave the Burn" music video and follow Buldak's latest content on YouTube, TikTok and Instagram at @buldak_global.

ABOUT BULDAK

Buldak was born from a spicy chicken dish and a simple idea: what if that bold, fiery flavor could become a ramyeon? Rooted in Samyang's rich Korean heritage and launched in Korea in 2012, Buldak quickly became a spicy cult favorite, winning over fans around the world with its intense heat and unmistakable flavor. Today, Buldak has grown into a global cultural phenomenon and a favorite among Gen Z and Gen Alpha, bringing together the signature flavors of OG and Carbonara with playful energy and self-expression. As Korean food and culture continue to influence global trends, Buldak continues to push the boundaries of instant noodles, creating new flavors, experiences, and ways for fans to enjoy the brand. Buldak is part of the portfolio of brands from Samyang Foods, headquartered in Seoul, South Korea. Visit Buldak.com to learn more.

releases.title: MOBILE SUIT GUNDAM SEED FREEDOM Screening & Talk Show Draws Fans and Press to New York's Museum of the Moving Image
releases.body:
IRVINE, Calif., Oct. 14, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Bandai Namco Filmworks Inc. brought MOBILE SUIT GUNDAM SEED FREEDOM to New York audiences on Sunday, October 11 and Monday, October 12 with a two-day screening event at the Museum of the Moving Image (MoMI) in Queens. Kaori Shida, Planning Producer of MOBILE SUIT GUNDAM SEED FREEDOM and MOBILE SUIT GUNDAM SEED FREEDOM ZERO, joined the October 11 program for a live talk, speaking to an audience of fans and members of the press about the GUNDAM SEED series and the upcoming film, which arrives in North American theaters in February 2027.

Assets are available here.

The October 11 program, GUNDAM SEED FREEDOM Screening & Talk Show at the Museum of the Moving Image, opened at 6:30 PM with a talk show hosted by MC Mike Nishimura. Members of the press were in attendance alongside fans who traveled to the Museum for the evening.

Shida joined SUNRISE inc. (Current Bandai Namco Filmworks INC.) in 2001 and worked in setting production on MOBILE SUIT GUNDAM SEED DESTINY before serving as Planning Producer on titles including Gundam Build Fighters and MOBILE SUIT GUNDAM SEED FREEDOM, and was also involved in the stage play adaptation of MOBILE SUIT GUNDAM 00 as well as GUNDAM FACTORY YOKOHAMA, the project built around the moving life-size Gundam in Yokohama.

During the talk show, Shida looked back on the journey of the series from DESTINY to FREEDOM, explaining how production materials for the anime, including mobile suit designs, are developed. She also shared how MOBILE SUIT GUNDAM SEED FREEDOM came to life nearly twenty years after DESTINY. 

The program then turned to the newest chapter in the series. The teaser trailer for MOBILE SUIT GUNDAM SEED FREEDOM ZERO, first unveiled days earlier at New York Comic Con, screened for the room, and Shida pointed audiences toward what the film sets out to show: how the world changed in the years between DESTINY and FREEDOM, what each character lived through in that span, and the mobile suit battle sequences the production has put particular effort into.

"We were able to take advantage of many new technologies developed over the past two decades to create exciting and dynamic mobile suit action. I hope fans will pay close attention to how these new animation techniques have been brought to life in this film."

The talk show was followed at 7:00 PM by a screening of MOBILE SUIT GUNDAM SEED FREEDOM in Japanese with English subtitles. The event continued on Monday, October 12 with a 4:00 PM screening of the film.

Closing the talk, Shida shared a message with the fans in the United States who have followed the SEED series and the Gundam series over the past two decades, saying:

"Without the Gundam fans, we might not have been able to see FREEDOM ZERO become an actual anime. This has become a reality because FREEDOM was loved by fans."

MOBILE SUIT GUNDAM SEED FREEDOM ZERO arrives in theaters across North America in February 2027.

releases.title: Jaguar Promise Expands Access to Higher Education at A&M-San Antonio
releases.body:
SAN ANTONIO, Oct. 14, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- As Texas A&M University-San Antonio's enrollment reached 7,697 students in Fall 2026, including a record 1,322 first-time-in-college students, the University is working to ensure that the cost of higher education does not stand in the way of opportunity.

That commitment is reflected in Jaguar Promise, a scholarship program designed to make college more affordable for eligible Texas residents, including transfer students and adult learners. With 60% of A&M-San Antonio students eligible for federal Pell Grants, the program plays an important role in helping students pursue their degrees with less financial burden.

As a last-dollar scholarship, Jaguar Promise, which launched in 2024, covers remaining tuition and mandatory fees after eligible federal, state and institutional financial aid is applied. Participants also receive a $300-per-semester book stipend.

Participation continues to grow. The number of first-year students receiving Jaguar Promise funding increased 21% over the previous year. Among first-year participants, enrollment grew 48% among Early College High School graduates and 9% among students who graduated in the top 10% to 35% of their high school class.

"Jaguar Promise has made a meaningful difference in my college experience," said Student Body President Caroleena Mancilla. "Knowing that my tuition and fees are covered has allowed me to focus more on my education, leadership opportunities and personal growth instead of constantly worrying about how I will pay for college. That support has opened the door to experiences that are helping me grow both personally and professionally."

Beyond helping students afford college, Jaguar Promise supports the University's broader efforts to promote student persistence and degree completion. Program requirements include maintaining a minimum 12-credit-hour course load each semester and meeting established GPA and academic progress standards.

The University is also working with Alamo Colleges District through its Promise-to-Promise partnership, which helps eligible students transition from an associate degree to a bachelor's degree while pursuing a more affordable, debt-free path to graduation.

"Affordability can make the difference between whether students simply aspire to attend college and whether they can turn that aspiration into a degree," said Brandy McLelland, vice president for enrollment management. "The growing participation in Jaguar Promise reflects the importance of providing students and families with a clear, affordable path to higher education. By reducing financial barriers and supporting students as they progress toward graduation, we are advancing our commitment to access and student success."

That commitment extends to the University's expanding academic offerings, which are designed to connect students with emerging career opportunities across San Antonio and South Texas. In Fall 2026, A&M-San Antonio launched its first doctoral program, the Doctor of Education in Educational Leadership. The University will also introduce a Bachelor of Science in Biomedical Sciences in Fall 2027, with programs in electrical engineering, healthcare administration and management, computer engineering, and construction engineering technology planned for subsequent years.

For President Salvador Hector Ochoa, the University's growth reflects a broader commitment to expanding opportunity while responding to the needs of the region.

"As A&M-San Antonio grows, our responsibility remains the same: to open doors to higher education and help more students achieve their goals," Ochoa said. "We are expanding academic opportunities and strengthening our research enterprise while keeping affordability and student success at the center of our mission. Our true measure of success is when we create lasting opportunities for the students, families and communities we serve."

releases.title: Experience Kissimmee Launches Film Kissimmee
releases.body:
The new Kissimmee Film Commission will promote diverse filming locations, support productions and drive tourism-related economic impact.

KISSIMMEE, Fla., Oct. 14, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Experience Kissimmee announces the launch of Film Kissimmee, the official film commission for Osceola County. The commission is created to attract film, television, commercial and digital media productions, showcase the destination's diverse filming locations and expand opportunities for the local tourism economy.

Film Kissimmee will serve as a central resource for production companies, location managers and digital content creators seeking filming opportunities in Central Florida. The initiative connects industry professionals with a wide range of filming locations, local expertise and production resources to help bring stories to life in Osceola County.

"This initiative reflects the hard work of a team that saw an opportunity and took meaningful steps to bring it to life," said DT Minich, President and CEO of Experience Kissimmee. "Film Kissimmee creates a direct connection between our community and an industry that can drive visitation, support local businesses and introduce new audiences to everything Osceola County has to offer."

Nick Floyd, Experience Kissimmee's Manager of Video Production and the new Director of the Kissimmee Film Commission, will lead Film Kissimmee and oversee efforts to position Osceola County as a premier destination for film, television and commercial productions.

"Just as Osceola County is an excellent place to spend your vacation, we truly believe it is a diverse location for film and television production. And Film Kissimmee is us exploring that intersection between the two," said Floyd. "I'm beyond excited to kick off this new initiative, not just as an opportunity to showcase so many of our incredible partners, but to welcome fresh perspectives on our destination from filmmakers and producers."

One of Film Kissimmee's greatest strengths is the remarkable variety of filming environments available throughout Osceola County. Within a short distance, filmmakers can access a diverse collection of landscapes and settings that capture many sides of Florida, including natural waterways, cypress-lined wetlands, historic downtown streets, ranchlands, hospitality properties and modern innovation centers. Adding to this versatility is Kissimmee's expansive collection of vacation homes, offering filmmakers unique and production-ready settings ranging from luxurious estates and themed properties to contemporary residences and resort-style retreats, each providing distinctive backdrops for film, television and commercial productions.

To support the initiative's launch, Experience Kissimmee partnered with a professional location scout with more than 20 years of experience. The scout identified and documented more than 100 potential filming locations across Osceola County. These locations are being added to an online directory powered by Reel-Scout, an industry-leading location management platform that allows filmmakers to search available properties, review photography and access production-related information.

Beyond attracting film and television projects, Film Kissimmee is expected to create meaningful economic opportunities for local businesses. Production crews often require accommodations, dining, transportation, equipment rentals, supplies and a variety of support services while filming on location.

Those expenditures can generate additional business for hospitality operators and local service providers while supporting Experience Kissimmee's broader mission of driving tourism-related economic impact throughout Osceola County.

Looking ahead, Film Kissimmee plans to continue expanding its location database, developing educational resources for local partners and coordinating familiarization tours for producers and location managers across the United States. These tours will provide industry professionals with firsthand access to Osceola County's filming assets while fostering relationships with local businesses and property owners.

For more information about Film Kissimmee, visit filmkissimmee.com.

About Experience Kissimmee:

Experience Kissimmee, the official tourism authority for Osceola County, Florida, is dedicated to creating economic opportunities by driving tourism to the region. With a vision to be a trailblazer in destination marketing, Experience Kissimmee promotes Central Florida's diverse tourism experiences to the world. By attracting leisure travelers, meetings and conventions and sports events, the destination welcomes more than 10 million visitors annually, generating more than $11 billion in economic impact and supporting more than 41,000 local jobs. Experience Kissimmee helps position the region as a premier global destination. For more information, visit www.experiencekissimmee.com. 

About Kissimmee

Located at the heart of Florida, Kissimmee is 25 minutes from Orlando International Airport (MCO), close to world-famous theme parks and attractions, offers a variety of shopping and dining locations and provides access to natural spaces and outdoor adventures. Also known as the Vacation Home Capital of the World®, Kissimmee has approximately 50,000 options of accommodations, including sprawling hotels and resorts and more than 30,000 vacation homes ranging from two-bedroom condos to 15-bedroom mansions.

releases.title: PlanetiQ Launches GNOMES-10, Expanding High-Precision GNSS Radio Occultation Constellation
releases.body:
New GNSS-RO satellite launch advances PlanetiQ's growing constellation of high-precision atmospheric and ionospheric sensors

GOLDEN, Colo., Oct. 14, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- PlanetiQ's GNOMES-10 satellite successfully launched October 1 at 11:32 a.m. PDT aboard SpaceX's Transporter-18 mission from Vandenberg Space Force Base, marking another major step in the company's expansion of its global GNSS radio occultation (GNSS-RO) constellation. Following launch, PlanetiQ's partner ground stations quickly established first contact with GNOMES-10, and spacecraft commissioning began immediately.

"...our data supports weather applications by measuring Earth's atmospheric and ionospheric state," said Chris McCormick

GNOMES-10 Carries PlanetiQ's Fourth-Generation Pyxis Receiver

GNOMES-10 carries PlanetiQ's fourth-generation Pyxis GNSS-RO receiver, which was built and tested at PlanetiQ's facility in Golden, Colorado. Pyxis is engineered to capture exceptionally high-quality GNSS signals for radio occultation measurements. Its combination of high signal-to-noise ratio (SNR), high-rate signal sampling, precise timing, and advanced antenna design enables PlanetiQ to retrieve highly detailed atmospheric profiles from each radio occultation event.

Pyxis incorporates a high-accuracy oscillator and PlanetiQ's bespoke satellite antenna design, both engineered to maximize the information captured from each GNSS-RO observation. These capabilities provide detailed measurements of atmospheric structure, including in the lower troposphere and ionosphere.

"Experiencing the launch firsthand is a reflection of, and a tremendous appreciation for, all the excellent hard work by everyone involved, including our employees, suppliers, and customers," said Chris McCormick, Founder, President and Chairman of PlanetiQ. "We are proud that our data supports weather applications by measuring Earth's atmospheric and ionospheric state and furthering our knowledge of Earth's dynamic weather patterns."

Simultaneous GNSS Tracking Creates More RO Opportunities

PlanetiQ satellites simultaneously track signals from all four major GNSS constellations: GPS, BeiDou, GLONASS, and Galileo. Each satellite also uses a wide ±75-degree limb-sounding field of view.

By tracking multiple GNSS constellations simultaneously and observing signals across a wide field of view, PlanetiQ satellites can observe more GNSS transmitters at the same time. This creates more opportunities for radio occultation measurements and enables PlanetiQ to produce more GNSS-RO observations per hour than other commercial RO constellations.

The resulting observations provide weather models and other users with highly detailed information about atmospheric structure. PlanetiQ's high-SNR measurements are particularly valuable for resolving features in the lower troposphere, where atmospheric conditions can change rapidly and where conventional satellite observations can be challenging.

GNOMES-11 to Add Lower-Inclination GNSS-RO Observations

PlanetiQ plans to launch GNOMES-11 later this month, carrying the same fourth-generation Pyxis receiver as GNOMES-10. The addition of GNOMES-10 and GNOMES-11 is part of PlanetiQ's ongoing effort to expand the availability, quality, and diversity of commercial GNSS-RO observations for weather forecasting, space weather, and other mission-critical applications.

About PlanetiQ

PlanetiQ provides the highest-quality GNSS radio occultation (RO) data available from a commercial constellation of satellites, offering unmatched temporal and spatial resolution. The data drive accurate, high-impact weather and climate forecast models, helping improve Numerical Weather Prediction and AI forecasts, safeguard lives and property from severe weather. PlanetiQ is a space-tech company that serves the most mission-critical government, defense, and industry leaders, including international weather agencies, enabling more resilient operations across sectors. Founded in 2015 and privately owned, PlanetiQ designs, builds, and operates the preeminent commercial constellation of GNSS-RO satellites, setting the standard for precision and reliability in atmospheric monitoring. For more information, visit PlanetiQ.

California Lutheran University Center for Nonprofit Leadership workshop will provide nonprofit leaders with practical strategies to strengthen engagement, fundraising and mission-driven social media

THOUSAND OAKS, Calif., Oct. 13, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Marketing Maven CEO and president Lindsey Carnett will lead "Strategic Social Media for Nonprofit Growth and Engagement," a three-hour virtual workshop presented by California Lutheran University's Center for Nonprofit Leadership with support from the Santa Barbara Foundation on Wednesday, November 4, 2026 from 9 a.m. to noon.

Designed for nonprofit leaders, communications and marketing staff and board members, the workshop will provide practical strategies for using social media to build awareness, engage supporters and advance organizational missions. Participants will explore how different social media platforms can support organizational objectives, including volunteer recruitment, donor cultivation, event promotion, corporate partnerships and talent acquisition.

"Social media gives nonprofits an incredible opportunity to connect directly with the communities they serve, but being active online is only one piece of an effective strategy," said Carnett. "This workshop is designed to give nonprofit leaders practical tools they can use to create meaningful content, strengthen engagement and turn their social media efforts into measurable support for their missions."

Throughout the workshop, Carnett will guide participants through developing a social media strategy aligned with their organizational priorities and identifying the platforms best suited to reach their audiences. Attendees will learn strategies for creating compelling content, developing an efficient content calendar and using scheduling and analytics tools to maximize their time and impact. The workshop will also address organic and paid social media, current platform trends and ways to integrate social media into broader fundraising and marketing campaigns.

Support from the Santa Barbara Foundation provides nonprofit professionals serving Santa Barbara County access to professional development opportunities through Cal Lutheran's Center for Nonprofit Leadership. The Nov. 4 workshop is part of the Foundation's support for nonprofit learning and development in the region.

Carnett brings more than two decades of marketing and public relations experience to the workshop. As founder and CEO of Marketing Maven, an integrated marketing and public relations agency, her areas of expertise include public relations, social media, reputation management, search engine optimization and digital advertising. A Cal Lutheran alumna, Carnett also serves as a faculty lecturer for the university's Center for Nonprofit Leadership and earned her bachelor's degree in Spanish and communications with an emphasis in public relations and advertising.

releases.title: CPKC Holiday Train begins 182-stop journey of music and giving Nov. 19
releases.body:
CALGARY, AB, Oct. 13, 2026 /CNW/ -- Canadian Pacific Kansas City (CPKC) today announced the 2026 CPKC Holiday Train program will kick off Nov. 19 in Montreal, beginning a 32-day journey in support of local food banks through music, celebration and giving, with stops in 182 communities across Canada and the United States.

"Our railroaders take great pride in bringing the Holiday Train through hundreds of communities across our network to support people facing food insecurity," said CPKC President and CEO Keith Creel. "This year, we are going farther south than we ever have before, visiting 10 communities in Texas, Louisiana, Mississippi and Missouri for the first time.

"Through the generosity of the thousands of families and fans who come out to see the Holiday Train and support local food banks, whether for the first time or as part of a long-running holiday tradition, we can spread the joy of the season and support the giving spirit of the holidays," Creel added.   

Holiday Train Highlights

  • 182 live music shows in six provinces and 13 U.S. states. The Holiday Train will visit 10 communities for the first time, with new stops in Missouri (Blue Springs), Mississippi (Meridian, Jackson), Louisiana (Vicksburg, Monroe, Ruston, DeQuincy, Leesville, Zwolle) and Texas (Port Arthur).
  • Performers include American Authors, Magic!, Maris, Chase Rice, Madeline Edwards, Allen Stone, Jamie Fine, Shawnee Kish, Rafaëlle Roy, Tyler Shaw, Sam Roberts Band, and Owen Riegling.
  • Since 1999, more than $28.3 million and over 5.6 million pounds of food for community food banks have been collected in Canada and the U.S.

For 28 years, the CPKC Holiday Train has brought communities together to support neighbours facing food insecurity. Today, millions of people across Canada and the U.S. continue to rely on food banks for assistance, making community support more important than ever. CPKC encourages attendees to bring a cash donation or non-perishable food item, with all contributions staying in the local community to help families in need.

"There's nothing quite like the magic of the CPKC Holiday Train arriving in Edmonton, bringing our community together for great music and a great cause, and ultimately helping our neighbours in need," said Marjorie Bencz, executive director of Edmonton's Food Bank, where the Holiday Train will stop Dec. 13. "As the train lights up the night, every donation of food and funds helps us give food to our neighbours. We are so grateful for the warmth and generosity of Edmontonians who bundle up, show up, and make a real difference. Thank you, CPKC Holiday Train, for visiting and helping our community." 

For the musicians taking part, the CPKC Holiday Train represents more than a performance. It is a chance to connect with communities, share holiday cheer and support families experiencing food insecurity.

"The CPKC Holiday Train is one of the most special events of the holiday season! Not only are the lights and music spectacular, but it brings people together to give back to their communities and support friends, family, neighbours and those in need," said Zac Barnett of American Authors. "We feel so fortunate to take part in the celebration that makes such a meaningful impact."

"We are so grateful to be invited back on the CPKC Holiday Train," said Nasri Atweh of Magic!. "Not only do we get to see so many beautiful parts of the world, but we get to see all the smiling faces every time they open up the train doors and give everybody that came out there in the cold a little bit of warmth and some holiday cheer. It's always been my favorite time of year."

Follow the 2026 CPKC Holiday Train journey using #CPKCHolidayTrain and join the conversation online. For the latest tour updates, event information and announcements, visit CPKC's official social media channels on X, Instagram, Facebook, and LinkedIn. Be aware of fake accounts impersonating CPKC or the CPKC Holiday Train, and rely on CPKC's verified channels for trusted information.

CPKC reminds all music and rail fans to keep safety top of mind and stay 15 metres or 50 feet back from the tracks when taking photos/videos or viewing the Holiday Train. Never take a picture or video standing on the track or the ballast rock and always stand back from the locomotive and rail cars.

About CPKC

With its global headquarters in Calgary, Alta., Canada, CPKC is the first and only single-line transnational railway linking Canada, the United States and México, with unrivaled access to major ports from Vancouver to Atlantic Canada to the Gulf Coast to Lázaro Cárdenas, México. Stretching approximately 20,000 route miles and employing approximately 20,000 railroaders, CPKC provides North American customers unparalleled rail service and network reach to key markets across the continent. CPKC is growing with its customers, offering a suite of freight transportation services, logistics solutions and supply chain expertise. Visit cpkcr.com to learn more about the rail advantages of CPKC.

releases.title: Local Media Consortium Launches SMB AI Study
releases.body:
Research initiative under LMC's AI Accelerator will provide benchmarking insights for small and mid-sized businesses, help local media companies strengthen relationships with local advertisers

NEW YORK, Oct. 13, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- The Local Media Consortium (LMC) today announced the launch of its SMB AI Benchmarking Study, a research initiative presented by its Digital On-Demand Services (DODS) division in partnership with Borrell Associates. The second initiative under LMC's recently launched AI Accelerator for Local Media program, the study will examine how small and mid-sized businesses are using artificial intelligence and navigating a rapidly changing business environment. Findings will provide participating SMBs with valuable benchmarking data while helping local media organizations better understand and support local advertisers.

The research comes at a pivotal moment for local media organizations. Data from the 2026 LMC Industry Insights Survey found that the percentage of publishers identifying agency services as a top priority  declined by 80% year over year, highlighting the need for new ways to serve local advertisers and build sustainable revenue streams. The study is designed to help publishers better understand how businesses perceive, adopt and invest in AI while identifying opportunities to provide more valuable guidance, services and support.

Participating businesses from industries ranging from healthcare and professional services to retail, hospitality and home services will gain access to benchmarking insights that compare local findings with broader regional and national trends. Depending on participation levels, businesses may also be able to compare results within specific industries and local markets. Initial aggregated findings are expected in November 2026.

"Small and mid-sized businesses are being asked to make important decisions about marketing, technology and AI at a pace that is often difficult to keep up with," said Fran Wills, CEO of the LMC. "Research suggests concerns about the accuracy of AI-generated information remain widespread among small businesses, reinforcing the need for trusted local partners who understand their markets and can help separate hype from reality. This study will help us better understand what local businesses need most and identify new ways local media organizations can support their growth and success."

The study is expected to identify opportunities for local media organizations to expand the services and expertise they provide to advertisers while deepening their role as trusted advisors. Findings will help publishers better understand how businesses are navigating AI, how AI impacts marketing and technology decisions and where they need additional support.

"I don't think anyone will disagree that AI is already having a profound effect on the way we conduct business. What's still a mystery is how deep the seismic shift is being felt among those very busy, very practical SMBs," said Gordon Borrell, CEO of Borrell Associates. "Past surveys have shown they're yearning for a trusted advisor to help them navigate the complex marketing world. This survey will help us learn whether AI has begun filling that role, and how deeply AI may already be embedded in their marketing activities. I'm confident it will uncover early opportunities for local media companies to complement their migration toward AI adoption."

Participating businesses will have the opportunity to receive a summary of the findings and contribute to one of the most comprehensive studies examining the intersection of AI, advertising and local business growth. The findings will help inform future products, services, educational resources and support programs that strengthen relationships between local media organizations and the businesses they serve.

The SMB AI in Benchmarking Study is part of the Local Media Consortium's AI Accelerator, a broader effort by the LMC and its Digital On-Demand Services (DODS) division to help local media organizations identify new opportunities for growth, strengthen advertiser relationships and develop solutions that meet evolving market needs. The initiative is supported through funding from the John S. and James L. Knight Foundation as part of the News Media Help Desk, an online resource created by the LMC and the Reynolds Journalism Institute to support the long-term sustainability of local media.

About the Local Media Consortium

The Local Media Consortium delivers more than $60 million in annual economic value through digital partnerships and strategic initiatives on behalf of more than 150 local media companies in top markets across the United States, Canada and Puerto Rico, and includes more than 5,000 newspaper, radio, TV and online-only news outlets. By harnessing the combined volume and scale of its members, the LMC reduces costs and increases revenue with technology and service providers. The aggregated LMC audience footprint spans 200 million unique monthly visitors, and its member companies serve more than nine billion pageviews to consumers.

releases.title: MOBILE SUIT GUNDAM SEED FREEDOM ZERO Hits North American Theaters in February 2027; Teaser Trailer, Teaser Visual, and More Unveiled at New York Comic Con 2026
releases.body:
IRVINE, Calif., Oct. 13, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- At New York Comic Con 2026, Bandai Namco Filmworks Inc. took a trip down memory lane and provided insight into the upcoming installment of the GUNDAM SEED franchise during the "GUNDAM Showcase 2026 @ NYC - Feat. SEED FREEDOM ZERO" panel with the Japanese production staff and English voice casts of MOBILE SUIT GUNDAM SEED. Gundam series Executive Producer Naohiro Ogata and MOBILE SUIT GUNDAM SEED FREEDOM ZERO Planning Producer Kaori Shida were joined on stage by Matt Hill, Sam Vincent, and Matthew Erickson, the English voices of Kira Yamato, Athrun Zala, and Shinn Asuka. Those in the audience were the first to see a brand new teaser trailer for MOBILE SUIT GUNDAM SEED FREEDOM ZERO, announced to hit theaters across North America in February 2027.

Watch the teaser trailer: https://youtu.be/FEeahlHaGyk 

Assets are available here.

Executive Producer Naohiro Ogata took the stage first to briefly discuss the worldwide growth and fanbase of the Gundam series. Ogata commented on the many ways Gundam is being delivered to fans around the world, inviting fans to "enjoy Gundam life," with the new productions and events coming up to celebrate the upcoming 50th Anniversary of Gundam.

Next, Matt Hill, Sam Vincent, and Matthew Erickson greeted Gundam fans with a reenactment of a scene from the MOBILE SUIT GUNDAM SEED series. When asked to take a look at Gundam SEED Gunpla kits, Matt Hill mentioned becoming a fan of the toys later on, saying, "This is one of the coolest things I've ever seen."

Sam Vincent added, "I remember seeing the Justice Gundam and saying, 'That's me!' And these take me back."

Matthew Erickson is a self-proclaimed "Gunpla nerd," and went on to say that he spends a lot of time building and painting them.

The lights went down after the talk, and fans got a first look at an all-new teaser trailer for MOBILE SUIT GUNDAM SEED FREEDOM ZERO. The room filled with cheering Gundam fans excited about the film, set to premiere in North America in February 2027. Planning Producer Kaori Shida dove deeper into the plot of the film, explaining that the story is set between DESTINY and FREEDOM.

GUNDAM SEED FREEDOM ZERO was written by the late Chiaki Morosawa, and Shida mentioned that the script was created to dive deeper into the characters' feelings when FREEDOM was in production.

A new teaser visual was revealed, placing Shinn Asuka at the forefront, with Kira Yamato and Athrun Zala appearing behind him. Kaori Shida described the importance of the visual, saying that the focus on the red is a testament to Shinn's concept color. She expressed that this offers fans a look into what Shinn is feeling after the events of DESTINY.

All-new SEED FREEDOM ZERO products were unveiled. Four new Gunpla, including the Infinite Justice Gundam and Booster Unit, Murasame Kai, Gouf Ignited Custom, and Infinite Justice Gundam (SEED FREEDOM ZERO Vers.), were revealed along with figures of Shinn Asuka, Lunamaria Hawke, Leonard Valway, and Lacus Clyne.

Additionally, it was announced that Matt Hill, Sam Vincent, and Matthew Erickson will be back to reprise their roles in the English dub of MOBILE SUIT GUNDAM SEED FREEDOM ZERO. Each expressed their excitement in returning to the beloved characters.

Matthew Erickson said, "I am overwhelmed, you know? I feel amazing and I'm so thankful to all of the fans." Matt Hill agreed, also thanking the fans for making their return possible, and explaining that, "When a show ends, you think you may not get to do this again." Sam Vincent cheered, yelling, "It's an honor!"

releases.title: First Entertainment Credit Union and Nymbus Named 2026 Credit Union Times Luminaries Finalists
releases.body:
First Entertainment recognized for technology innovation with CineFi; Nymbus for consulting excellence

JACKSONVILLE, Fla., Oct. 13, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- First Entertainment Credit Union and Nymbus have both been named finalists in the 2026 Credit Union Times Luminaries Awards, which honor standout leadership and innovation across the credit union industry. First Entertainment is a finalist in the Innovation in Technology: Technology Project/Rollout category for launching CineFi, the first fully digital credit union built exclusively for entertainment industry professionals, in partnership with Nymbus. Nymbus is a finalist in the Consulting Excellence: Organizations category for helping credit unions turn growth strategy into live digital brands.

Since 1967, First Entertainment has served the people behind film, television and music. The credit union saw an opportunity in Atlanta, where the entertainment industry has grown rapidly but many of the professionals who power it still bank with institutions that weren't built around their work. Through CineFi, First Entertainment is bringing financial services designed for the industry to Atlanta's growing creative workforce. Nymbus delivered the technology, market strategy, and execution to bring the brand live, and co-developed tools that help members manage variable, freelance, and project-based income, along with a prospect portal that offers financial education before a person opens an account.

CineFi runs as a sidecar brand on the cloud-native Nymbus Banking Platform, parallel to First Entertainment's existing systems, so the credit union entered a new market with no branches, no disruption to current operations and no core replacement. Since launch, CineFi has acquired over 1,700 members with over $61M in deposits.

"Our members build careers project by project, and CineFi gives them a credit union designed around how they actually earn," said Stephen Owen, CEO of First Entertainment Credit Union. "Nymbus helped us move from idea to a live brand in a new market without disrupting the members we already serve. Sharing this recognition with them makes it even more meaningful."

CineFi is one of several brands Nymbus has taken from strategy to launch through vertical banking, a growth model that helps institutions go deeper into specific communities with purpose-built digital brands. Through Nymbus Labs, the company provides market research, segmentation, brand development and go-to-market execution, then supports each brand live on its own platform.

Nymbus is also preparing its clients for AI-ready banking. In April 2026, the company launched one of the first Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers purpose-built for core banking, giving AI a single, standardized and auditable connection to core functions with role-based access controls, PII masking and full audit logging, so institutions decide which tools are enabled and where human review is required.

"Being named finalists alongside First Entertainment reflects what we set out to prove: credit unions can grow by going deeper into the communities they know best," said Jeffery Kendall, chairman and CEO of Nymbus. "CineFi shows that the right platform and strategy, delivered together, can produce measurable results in weeks. We congratulate First Entertainment on this well-deserved recognition."

The CU Times Luminaries Awards winners will be announced Nov. 5 at the Luminaries Awards gala in Orlando, Fla.

About Nymbus

Nymbus delivers a cloud-based, highly extensible, full-stack banking platform, empowering community banks and credit unions to accelerate their growth and market positioning. Founded in 2015, Nymbus modernizes legacy core systems that support both brick-and-mortar operations and digital-first institutions, and facilitates the launch of vertical banking strategies or subsidiary brands with a sidecar Core alternative.

The Nymbus Banking Platform solution delivers the technology, people, and processes to scale as your financial institution grows. For more information, visit nymbus.com.

About CineFi

Launched in 2026 by First Entertainment Credit Union, CineFi is the first fully digital credit union created for film industry professionals and aspiring talent in Atlanta, Ga. With more than 50 years of entertainment industry expertise, CineFi delivers a future-ready banking experience designed to simplify financial management for those who live and breathe the craft. Offering premium financial products, competitive rates, and tailored financial education, CineFi empowers filmmakers—above and below the line—to achieve long-term success. Beyond banking, CineFi is committed to strengthening the entertainment and creative community by supporting industry nonprofits, schools, organizations, festivals, and events that advance the art and business of filmmaking. Visit www.cinefi.com.
