releases.title: CORUS SUCCESSFULLY COMPLETES RECAPITALIZATION TRANSACTION; ANNOUNCES NEW BOARD APPOINTMENTS
releases.body:
TORONTO, Oct. 8, 2026 /CNW/ -- Corus Entertainment Inc. ("CEI") (TSX: CJR.B) announced today that it has successfully completed its previously announced recapitalization transaction (the "Recapitalization Transaction"), pursuant to a plan of arrangement under the Canada Business Corporations Act (the "Plan"). As a result, CEI has become a wholly-owned subsidiary of Corus Entertainment Holdings Inc. ("Corus" or the "Company").

"We are very pleased to complete this Recapitalization Transaction. Our new capital structure provides a platform that positions Corus for new opportunities and future growth," said John Gossling, Corus' Chief Executive Officer.  "As Canada's largest independent broadcaster, we will continue to create and deliver premium content that Canadians want, and we will continue to invest in national and local news that Canadians depend on."

In addition, as contemplated in the Plan, the Company has appointed a new Board of Directors, as follows:

  • Maryann Turcke has been appointed as a director and Chair of the Board of Directors. She is an experienced North American media executive who most recently was Chief Operating Officer of the National Football League, and prior to that was President of Bell Media. Ms. Turcke has deep public board experience, serving on the board of directors of Royal Bank of Canada (TSX:RY) and Skyworks Solutions (NASDAQ:SWKS), and also serves as an advisor for a number of private companies in the emerging sport, media, and technology spaces. She has been recognized by Adweek, WXN, and Women in Communications and Technology for her leadership and professional achievements.
  • Stuart Garvie has been appointed as a director and Chair of the Operating Committee. He has held senior leadership roles in media and advertising, including as the former CEO of GroupM (now WPP) Canada, and as the President of media sales and marketing at Bell Media. Mr. Garvie has been involved in a number of media industry organizations, such as Numeris, and provides consulting and leadership services to clients in and around the industry.
  • Erin O'Toole has been appointed as a director and Chair of the Human Resources and Governance Committee. He is currently the President and Managing Director of ADIT North America, and one of Canada's most respected thought leaders on geopolitical and domestic policy issues. He has over a decade of service in the Canadian Parliament, including as Leader of the Official Opposition and as a Cabinet Minister, and currently serves as a member of the Prime Minister's Advisory Council on Canada-U.S. Economic Relations. He was also a commissioned officer in the Royal Canadian Air Force. Mr. O'Toole holds a law degree and has deep public and private company transactional and governance experience.
  • Jeremy Walker has been appointed as a director and Chair of the Audit Committee. He is the former Deputy Chair and Global Head, TD Securities, for the communications, telecommunications and media sectors, where he led a global team providing strategic advice and capital markets execution services to cable, broadcasting, and digital infrastructure companies. In addition to significant financial expertise, Mr. Walker brings nearly 35 years of industry, transactional and strategy experience, as well as governance knowledge, from his service as a director on several non-profit boards and private companies in the health sector.

In addition, John Gossling, Chief Executive Officer and (Interim) Chief Financial Officer of Corus, has been appointed to the Board of Directors. Since joining Corus in 2016, he has provided strategic direction to the Company and brings over 35 years of business experience in the media and communications industries, including at TELUS and Rogers. Mr. Gossling was also a partner at KPMG LLP.

"The new directors and I are excited to join Corus at this important time for the Company and for our industry," said Ms. Turcke, Chair of the Board of Directors. "Our priority is to continue to strengthen Corus' leadership position in Canada by delivering news that Canadians trust and entertainment that Canadians love. We want to build a business that is resilient and will grow into the future, and look forward to working with all of our stakeholders to build a world class, sustainable, and independent media and broadcast industry in Canada, with Corus as a strong and successful player."

"As Canada's largest independent broadcaster, Corus plays a vital role not just in the media industry but also in the fabric of Canadian culture and democracy," added Mr. O'Toole, Chair of the Human Resources and Governance Committee. "Corus creates and delivers independent, high-quality journalism and Canadian programming to millions across the country. I look forward to advancing work to modernize an investment and regulatory ecosystem that truly benefits independent media in Canada."

The Company thanks the prior board of directors for their service. The Company was represented by Osler, Hoskin & Harcourt LLP, Jefferies, and KPMG LLP for legal, transactional, and financial advice, respectively. Canaccord Genuity Corp. acted as financial advisor to the ad hoc group of bondholders. Bennett Jones LLP acted on behalf of the ad hoc group of bondholders and Thornton Grout Finnigan LLP acted on behalf of the lenders under the Company's credit facilities.

Additional information regarding securities and approval

CEI Class B Non-Voting Shares are expected to be delisted from the Toronto Stock Exchange at the close of trading on October 9, 2026 and the new Corus Common Voting Shares and Variable Voting Shares will begin trading on the Toronto Stock Exchange at the market open on October 13, 2026 under the stock ticker "CORS".  As described in the CEI management information circular ("Circular") issued on January 2, 2026 in connection with the Recapitalization Transaction, Corus adopted a capital structure intended to provide for compliance with Canadian ownership requirements under the Broadcasting Act. In connection with the Recapitalization Transaction, Corus applied for and has obtained exemptive relief from the Ontario Securities Commission and other Canadian securities regulators from certain requirements under applicable Canadian securities laws to ensure that the new Common Voting Shares and Variable Voting Shares issued pursuant to the Recapitalization Transaction are treated for these purposes on a combined basis. These include, among others, applicable take-over bid and related early warning reporting requirements under Canadian securities laws. Also, details of delivery of new securities can be found in the Circular (see Issuances and Distributions and Payments to Securityholders).

In light of the fact that it is now a wholly-owned subsidiary of the Company, CEI intends to apply to cease to be a reporting issuer under applicable Canadian securities laws.

Pursuant to the decision: (i) for purposes of applicable take-over bid requirements, those requirements would only apply to an offer to acquire 20% or more of the outstanding Common Voting Shares and Variable Voting Shares of Corus on a combined basis, (ii) for purposes of applicable early warning reporting requirements and alternative monthly reporting requirements, those requirements would only apply to an acquirer who acquires or holds beneficial ownership of, or control or direction over, 10% or more of the outstanding Common Voting Shares and Variable Voting Shares of Corus on a combined basis (or 5% in the case of acquisitions during a take-over bid). Corus has also obtained similar relief in respect of any normal course issuer bid. Further, Corus is exempt from certain management information circular disclosure requirements that would require disclosure of 10% shareholders on a class basis, provided that disclosure is made on an aggregate basis.

Details of the exemption will be included in certain of Corus' continuous disclosure documents.

releases.body:
The Rare Impact Fund Benefit: A Night of Radiance & Reflection, which will support youth mental health organizations, will take place on October 14 in Los Angeles

LOS ANGELES, Oct. 8, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- The Rare Impact Fund today announced the special musical guests set to take the stage at its fourth annual Benefit on October 14 at The Hollywood Palladium in Los Angeles. Artist Leon Bridges and artist and songwriter Bella Kay will perform at the event, hosted by Selena Gomez and emceed by Emmy and Tony Award-winning actor and comedian Sean Hayes. The Rare Impact Fund also announced this year's inaugural host committee and Rare level sponsors in support of the Fund's mission to mobilize $100 million for organizations that increase access to youth mental health services and education around the world.

Since launching in 2020, the Rare Impact Fund has raised over $30 million and supports 30 nonprofit partners across five continents, reaching 3.5 million young people annually. Last year's Benefit raised more than $2 million from over 20 sponsors and guests and was hosted by Jimmy Kimmel with performances from alternative pop band The Marias and Grammy-winning singer Laufey.

"I'm deeply grateful to every one of our amazing sponsors and to the extraordinarily talented Leon Bridges and Bella Kay for supporting our fourth annual Rare Impact Fund," said Selena Gomez, Founder and Creator of Rare Beauty and the Rare Impact Fund. "Shining a light on youth mental health is something we cannot do alone, and having their support not only inspires me, but directly touches the lives of millions of young people around the world."

The 2026 host committee brings together leaders, advocates and friends of the Rare Impact Fund who champion its mission of supporting youth mental health, including Brieane Olson, Chief Executive Officer at Pacsun; Johnese Spisso, Chief Executive Officer, UCLA Hospital System; Anne Wintroub, Head of Social Impact and Engagement at lululemon; Cindy Citrone, Founder and Chief Executive Officer at Citrone 33; Courtney Ciciora, Horejsi Charitable Foundation; Raquelle Stevens, author and producer; Becky G, singer, songwriter, and activist; benny blanco, Grammy Award–nominated producer, artist, actor and New York Times bestselling author; Matty Matheson, NYTimes Best-selling author and producer; Jay Shetty, a #1 New York Times Bestselling Author, Award winning host of On Purpose, and a purpose driven entrepreneur; and Radhi Devlukia, author, host of A Really Good Cry podcast and co-founder of Juni.

"Mental health advocacy is crucial and taking part in an event that creates real, tangible access to help for young people is an absolute privilege. Selena is setting a standard for how artists can use their platforms to drive real change, and I'm deeply honored to be a part of it," said artist Leon Bridges.  

"I'm honored to share the stage at Selena's Rare Impact Fund Benefit this year," shared artist and songwriter Bella Kay. "Music has always been an outlet for making sense of my own mental health and vulnerabilities so being part of an evening dedicated to expanding youth mental health support hits very close to home."

Thank you to this year's Rare level Sponsors who are supporting this year's Rare Impact Fund Benefit, including Rare Beauty, Afterpay, Batch & Box, lululemon, Pacsun, UCLA Health, and Ulta Beauty. For a full list of event sponsors who are helping make the evening possible, please visit the event site here.

To bid on online auction items, visit the link here.

ABOUT THE RARE IMPACT FUND

The Rare Impact Fund was launched by Selena Gomez as part of her focus on addressing mental health. One percent of all Rare Beauty by Selena Gomez sales are donated to the Rare Impact Fund. releases.title: OMNICOM MEDIA AND REMBRAND PARTNER TO SCALE IN-CONTENT ADVERTISING ACROSS PREMIUM STREAMING
releases.body:
First-to-market capability brings together Acxiom, Omni, and Rembrand's VISTA platform, with access to premium inventory from major media partners

NEW YORK, Oct. 8, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Omnicom Media, an Omnicom (NYSE: OMC) Connected Capability, and in-content advertising platform Rembrand are partnering to bring in-content advertising into the mainstream media mix with a first-to-market capability that enables brands to identify, plan, and activate in-content placements across first-look premium streaming inventory from multiple major media companies.

The partnership provides OM's Content Collective – the group's branded content center of excellence - first-mover access to Rembrand's AI-powered VISTA platform, which scans publisher content to identify scenes that can be monetized by insertion of in-content advertising. Using AcxiomRealID™ and direct integrations with major streamers, brands can identify the most relevant content for a given audience. Pairing this intelligence with Rembrand's VISTA platform, brands unlock a more systematic and scalable way to find relevant programming and activate against those opportunities across participating streaming partners.

Historically, in-content advertising has been managed through bespoke partnerships and individual content integrations. The new capability brings those opportunities into a common planning framework, giving media teams visibility across participating publishers and allowing in-content placements to be considered alongside broader media investments.

The collaboration is rooted in a fundamental shift in consumer behavior. Omnicom Media's recent research, From Tuned Out to Leaned In: How to Combat Ad Avoidance, found that 65% of U.S. consumers avoid advertising to some degree, whether by skipping, scrolling, muting, or ignoring ads. As consumers use subscriptions, apps, AI, and other tools to exert greater control over their media experiences, brands need new ways to reach people without creating another interruption.

Additionally, commissioned research conducted by Omnicom Media's Partner Intelligence team in collaboration with Rembrand evaluated the effectiveness of in-content advertising, finding that, when paired with traditional video ads, perceptions of premium content amplify the performance of ICAs, driving a 5.5 times impact on message recall, and a 4x increase in both purchase intent and perceptions of the brand as premium.

"Our research identified how quickly consumers actively or passively disengage when advertising feels intrusive or overly repetitive," said Megan Pagliuca, Chief Product Officer, Omnicom Media. "To address this, we have launched new capabilities in streaming to address negative reach, improve relevance and measurability of traditional brand experiences, and now we are complementing these with a first of its kind data driven, scalable approach to in-content advertising."

How It Works

The capability connects four stages:

  • Audience matching: Acxiom audience segments are matched with streaming viewership data to identify shows, movies, and genres that best index with a target audience.
  • Inventory mapping: Relevant programming is matched against in-content advertising opportunities available through VISTA.
  • Inventory expansion: Additional content can be onboarded through established processes with participating streaming partners when relevant opportunities are not yet available.
  • Activation: Brands deploy in-content placements against selected audiences and programming across participating publishers.

The result is a way to put brands directly into content consumers have chosen to watch, while providing greater visibility into in-content supply across publishers.

"In-content advertising has always offered brands the opportunity to show up within content people have actively chosen to watch," said John Sedlak, Chief Revenue Officer, Rembrand. "Our collaboration with Omnicom Media makes those opportunities easier to identify, plan and activate across premium streaming, bringing a new level of scale and consistency to the category."

Applications range from an automaker placing a new model in relevant programming across a streamer, using Acxiom in-market auto segments to reach shoppers who routinely avoid traditional ads, to a beverage brand appearing in top-indexing summer programming during key seasonal purchase periods. Retail brands can similarly use in-content placements to directly connect exposure to the path to purchase.

Summing up the response to-date from clients who have been briefed on the new capability, Jillian Davis, Director of Marketing Technology for Auto Trader and Kelly Blue Book parent company Cox Automotive said, "We're always eager to leverage new, scalable and organic ways to reach our customers within premium content."

Omnicom Media, an Omnicom (NYSE: OMC) Connected Capability, is the world's largest global media management network. Powered by the Omni Intelligence Platform, Omnicom Media agencies leverage $75.6 billion in billings, 47,000+ specialists across 70+ markets, and the industry's most powerful portfolio identity, commerce, and intelligence assets to design dynamic Growth Ecosystems that enable the world's most ambitious businesses to grow faster and smarter. The Omnicom Media portfolio includes global media agency brands OMD, PHD, Initiative, Hearts United and UM; core Omnicom Integrated Media offerings Acxiom, the world's premier identity solution, and the Flywheel end-to-end commerce solution; and specialty services across the cloud consulting, creator, financial, healthcare, and sports & entertainment categories.  For more information visit omnicommedia.com

Rembrand is the leading In-Content Advertising platform, using AI to seamlessly integrate brands into video content. The company's technology provides a non-intrusive and engaging advertising experience for viewers while delivering increased brand awareness and improved engagement for advertisers. Rembrand works with a vast network of global content owners and media companies to deliver unparalleled reach and scale for its brand partners.  For more info, visit www.rembrand.com.

releases.body:
IRVINE, Calif., Oct. 8, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Bandai Namco Filmworks Inc. today announced that MOBILE SUIT GUNDAM SEED FREEDOM ZERO, the newest film in the GUNDAM SEED series and a prequel to MOBILE SUIT GUNDAM SEED FREEDOM, is scheduled to open in North American theaters in February 2027. Matthew Erickson, Matt Hill and Sam Vincent will voice Shinn Asuka, Kira Yamato and Athrun Zala, respectively, in the English-language version.
 

The North American theatrical release window and English voice cast were announced during the GUNDAM Showcase 2026 @ NYC panel at New York Comic Con 2026, held at the Jacob K. Javits Convention Center in New York. A recording of the panel is available on the Popverse YouTube channel.

The film is a prequel to MOBILE SUIT GUNDAM SEED FREEDOM, which earned more than 5 billion yen and drew 3 million admissions to become the highest-grossing theatrical release in Gundam history. The teaser visual centers on Shinn Asuka, one of the main characters of MOBILE SUIT GUNDAM SEED DESTINY. Its screenplay was written during the production of SEED FREEDOM by series composition writer Chiaki Morosawa, Shigeru Morita and director Mitsuo Fukuda.

  • North American theatrical release scheduled for February 2027.
  • English voice cast announced: Matthew Erickson as Shinn Asuka, Matt Hill as Kira Yamato and Sam Vincent as Athrun Zala.
  • Teaser visual and new trailer released, together with comments from the Japanese cast and director Mitsuo Fukuda.
  • The MOBILE SUIT GUNDAM SEED Series Grand Prix 2026 fan vote opens Oct. 8, 2026 (PDT).

Watch the teaser here: https://youtu.be/FEeahlHaGyk

Assets are available here.

Story
After the collapse of the Destiny Plan proposed by Dullindal, which would have decided people's fates based on genetics, Cagalli, the chief representative of the Orb United Emirates, has been working to bring about a peaceful new order by establishing a global peace monitoring agency called COMPS (Pronounced Compass).

C.E.74. The great war is over, but Shinn has yet to decide what course he should follow. Then a mobile suit which has survived many past battlefields is transferred from ZAFT to COMPS's temporary base on Onogoro Island. That night, however, the Strike Freedom Gundam is stolen by persons unknown.

To stop the situation from escalating, to recover the stolen machine, and for the sake of everything they must protect, Shinn and his comrades once again throw themselves into battle...

Characters
Joining Shinn Asuka are Lunamaria Hawke, his academy classmate, and Agnes Giebenrath, who made her debut in GUNDAM SEED FREEDOM. Leonard Valway, who makes his first appearance in an animated work in this title, also joins the story.

Kira Yamato, Athrun Zala and Yzak Jule also return.

Shinn Asuka
Shinn joined ZAFT after losing his family during the invasion of Orb. He was used by Dullindal to oppose Kira and his comrades, but they were reconciled after the war. Shinn decided to join COMPS to seek a world without war, and is now training in Orb alongside the Archangel.

Lunamaria Hawke
A ZAFT pilot who was Shinn's academy classmate, and fought alongside him aboard the Minerva. Lunamaria is a reliable person with a strong personality. After the previous war, she decided to join COMPS along with Shinn. She still continues to watch over him closely as they train aboard the Archangel.

Agnes Giebenrath
A ZAFT pilot who was Shinn's classmate and Lunamaria's friend during their academy days. Known as the "Moonlight Valkyrie," Agnes plays a public relations role for the military. She visits Orb on a mission to transport the Strike Freedom and Infinite Justice.

Leonard Valway
One of the "Reds" who ranked in the top ten at military academy, Leonard is known as the "Raging Lion." He accompanies Agnes to Orb on a mission to transport the Strike Freedom and Infinite Justice.

Kira Yamato
Caught up in a war, Kira fought for the Earth Alliance Forces, but then became an independent force fighting alongside Lacus to end the conflict. He rejected the Destiny Plan and helped defeat Dullindal, but is now wondering what he should do to help a world which is still in chaos.

Athrun Zala
As a ZAFT soldier, Athrun found himself enemies with his childhood friend Kira, but came to realize the emptiness of hatred and chose to fight by Kira's side. After the war, he remained with the Orb forces. He also supports Cagalli with activities such as intelligence gathering as part of Terminal.

Yzak Jule
A ZAFT pilot who was Athrun's academy classmate, as well as his rival. Yzak is currently an intelligence officer at PLANT staff headquarters. He visits Orb on a mission to transport the Strike Freedom and Infinite Justice.

Mobile Suits
The Strike Freedom and Infinite Justice Gundam return from DESTINY, joined by a new mobile suit, the GOUF Ignited Custom. Further character and mecha details are available on the MOBILE SUIT GUNDAM SEED FREEDOM ZERO website: https://en.gundam-official.com/seed/freedom/

Japanese Voice Cast and Staff Comments

Kenichi Suzumura (Japanese Voice of Shinn Asuka):
To everyone who's loved and supported the Gundam SEED series for so long, thank you so much!
I'm really happy that we get to bring you a new story again after "SEED FREEDOM."

This time, it's the story of the time leading up to that one.
If you've seen "FREEDOM," I think you'll enjoy the characters' words and relationships all over again, from a different angle.
Personally, I'd still really love for you to keep an eye on Shinn! I did my best to put his earnest feelings and inner conflict into his voice.

Watch "ZERO" and you'll want to watch "FREEDOM" again. I'd be happy if that kind of fun spreads. Please go take in their story in theaters!

Soichiro Hoshi (Japanese Voice of Kira Yamato):
We had the recording sessions around the time "SEED FREEDOM" was in theaters, so I'm excited that it's finally getting released.
I felt nervous in all sorts of ways during "FREEDOM," but strangely, I'm feeling pretty relaxed this time.
I hope all the fans who've been waiting can enjoy it soon.

Akira Ishida (Japanese Voice of Athrun Zala):
Alright, everyone, now it's time for "ZERO"!
Thank you for the warm reception of "FREEDOM."
I'm sure some of you were left wondering what on earth happened between "DESTINY" and "FREEDOM." Well, "SEED FREEDOM ZERO" is here to answer all of that and put those nagging questions to rest. Don't miss it!

Daisuke Ono (Japanese Voice of Leonard Valway):
My connection to "GUNDAM SEED" goes back exactly 20 years, to "STARGAZER." Back then, I voiced Sven, a Natural in the Earth Alliance. This time, I'm playing Leonard, a Coordinator in ZAFT. Having experienced both sides, there's a perspective I can see now that I couldn't before. I'm so happy to be part of "GUNDAM SEED" again after all this time!

Director Mitsuo Fukuda:
"With 20 Years of Yearnings"
This is the final work completed by my late wife Chiaki Morosawa, the series composition writer. Until not long ago, I was halfway resigned to the idea that the screenplay might forever remain on the shelf, but now it has been actually made into a film thanks to the ardent support of all the fans. This story shows the characters' yearnings that Chiaki was so eager to depict, and links together "DESTINY" and "FREEDOM." I sincerely hope that everyone will enjoy it.

To mark the release of MOBILE SUIT GUNDAM SEED FREEDOM ZERO, the "MOBILE SUIT GUNDAM SEED Series Grand Prix 2026" opens Oct. 8, 2026 (PDT). This year's Grand Prix ranks memorable character moments. releases.body:
Recognition highlights Full Sail's industry-focused approach to preparing the next generation of music business professionals

WINTER PARK, Fla., Oct. 8, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Full Sail University has been named to Billboard Magazine's 2026 Top Music Business Schools list, recognizing the university's Music Business program for its hands-on approach to preparing students for careers across the evolving global music industry.

Recognition highlights Full Sail's industry-focused approach preparing next generation of music business professionals

For more than a decade, Billboard has highlighted institutions that are educating the next generation of music industry leaders, as well as artists and producers who recognize the importance of the business skills these schools teach. Billboard's 2026 list includes schools whose programs span areas such as music business, management, production, performance, publishing, and related fields.

"Being recognized by Billboard Magazine among its 2026 Top Music Business Schools list is a tremendous honor and a reflection of the exceptional talent, innovation and dedication of our students, faculty and alumni," said Garry Jones, President, Full Sail University. "Our university is committed to preparing the next generation of music industry leaders with the knowledge and skills they need to thrive in a rapidly evolving global entertainment industry. This recognition affirms the strength of our music business program and the extraordinary work happening across our university community."

Full Sail University's Music Business Bachelor of Science is designed around a project-based approach to learning and is available both on campus and online. The program prepares students to pursue opportunities throughout the music business, including artist development and management, music marketing, publishing, live events, streaming, and emerging music ventures. Students develop skills in areas including music business management, copyright and publishing, rights and royalties, artist development, marketing, distribution, data analysis, fan engagement, finance, leadership, and entrepreneurship. Coursework and projects are designed to place these concepts in practical, industry-oriented contexts.

As the music business continues to evolve through changes in technology, distribution, audience engagement, data, and emerging tools such as artificial intelligence, Full Sail's Music Business program combines foundational business knowledge with specialized music industry education. The program's curriculum is intended to help students understand both the creative and commercial sides of the music ecosystem while developing practical skills that can be applied across artist development, management, marketing, publishing, live events, and other areas of the industry.

Billboard Magazine's 2026 Top Music Business Schools list appears in the publication's October 2026 print issue and online. For more information about Full Sail University and its Music Business degree program, visit Full Sail University's official website.

About Full Sail University:

Full Sail University is an award-winning educational leader for those pursuing careers in entertainment media and emerging technologies. Founded in 1979, Full Sail has received numerous accolades throughout its over 45-year history, including most recently being named a 2026 "Top Game Design School" by The Princeton Review and one of "The 30 Best Film Schools in the U.S. and Canada" in 2026 by MovieMaker Magazine. Full Sail University is a graduate and undergraduate degree-granting institution offering on-campus and online degree programs in areas related to Art & Design, Business, Film & Television, Games, Media & Communications, Music & Recording, Sports, and Technology. With over 100,000 graduates worldwide, Full Sail alumni have worked on countless award-winning projects with individual recognition including Oscar®, Emmy®, Grammy®, Addy® and The Game Award honors.

releases.title: Live Entertainment Expert Dino Hall Explains Live Event Planning in HelloNation
releases.body:
The Article Outlines How Organizers Can Coordinate Performers, Venues, Production, Logistics, and Audience Needs When Planning a Concert.

ALBUQUERQUE, N.M., Oct. 8, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- What should organizers consider when planning a concert? A HelloNation article answers that question, featuring insights from Dino Hall of DSH ENTERTAINMENT, INC.®️in Albuquerque, New Mexico.

The article explains that live event planning begins well before performers arrive at a venue. Organizers first need to define the event's purpose, expected audience, available budget, and desired experience. These early decisions shape artist selection, production needs, scheduling, and other program elements.

According to the article, artist booking requires more than selecting performers who fit the event concept. Organizers should consider audience expectations, venue size, schedules, and technical needs. Contracts should also address performance times, payment terms, travel arrangements, production requirements, and responsibilities for everyone involved.

The HelloNation article notes that venue selection directly affects concert production and audience experience. Capacity should fit expected attendance while leaving appropriate space for staging, equipment, staff, and guests. During planning, also review accessibility, parking, transportation, security, sound restrictions, and venue requirements.

Technical coordination is another important part of live event planning. The article explains that performers may require specific sound systems, lighting, staging, electrical service, dressing rooms, or other equipment. Reviewing these requirements early helps production teams determine whether the venue and vendors can support each performance.

Scheduling brings the separate parts of concert production together. Load-in, sound checks, rehearsals, performances, vendor setup, security briefings, and cleanup all require defined time periods. The article recommends building enough flexibility into the schedule to address delays without disrupting the entire event.

Clear communication also supports effective event logistics. The article describes the importance of assigning responsibilities for artist needs, technical production, venue operations, security, guest services, and schedule changes. Centralized information can help artists, vendors, production teams, and organizers work from the same instructions.

The article also emphasizes audience experience throughout the planning process. Entry procedures, seating, signage, restrooms, food service, accessibility, and crowd movement can shape the guest experience. Careful planning in these areas can help prevent operational problems from distracting from the performances.

For cultural event planning, the article advises organizers to consider traditions, history, and community representation. Artists, speakers, food, activities, and visual elements should reflect the culture with appropriate care. Consultation with knowledgeable community members can help identify concerns before the event reaches the public.

Live Entertainment Expert Dino Hall's insights also inform the article's discussion of promotion and contingency planning. Event descriptions should accurately represent performers, cultural elements, schedules, and venue details. Organizers should also prepare procedures for weather problems, artist delays, equipment failures, medical situations, crowd concerns, and transportation disruptions.

The article concludes that successful event logistics depend on coordination across every part of the program. When purpose, programming, concert production, communication, and audience experience align, organizers can create a more cohesive event for performers and guests.

"Businesses want to grow revenue from the customer relationships they've worked hard to build. One of the week's most anticipated moments came on Wednesday, when Humphrey joined NHL Hall of Famer Wayne Gretzky and Tucker Kain, Chief Strategy & Growth Officer at Fanatics, Inc., on the Great Minds Stage for a conversation about leadership. releases.title: Palmetto Publishing Releases Peaches McKnight's Debut Romance Novel Be True to Yourself
releases.body:
The newly published novel from Palmetto Publishing follows eighteen-year-old Mo'Nikko Kohle through a first love complicated by family secrets, divided loyalties and a past that refuses to stay buried.

CHARLESTON, S.C., Oct. 8, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Palmetto Publishing has released Be True to Yourself, a novel by Peaches McKnight. The book is a work of romance fiction centered on a young woman's first love and the family and friendships that surround it. It is available now in print and online. McKnight, a Kansas City, Missouri native who now lives in Shawnee Mission, Kansas, writes both fiction and poetry.

The story opens on a Saturday morning. Mo'Nikko Fayon Heaven Kohle, eighteen and in her last month of high school, wants nothing more than her chaise and the paperback love story she is halfway through. Her best friend since kindergarten, Phalisha, has other plans, and they involve the six young men working on a canary yellow 1967 Camaro across the street. One of them catches Nikko by the waist mid fight, calls her Cupcakes, and holds her attention from that moment forward. His name is Ocean.

Nikko is church raised, a virgin by conviction and nobody's easy yes. Ocean is patient, maddening and certain of what he wants. What neither of them can outrun is the life Ocean walked away from, a life that has not finished with him. Closer to home, Nikko's mother Amethyst runs the house with a look that stops a lie in the throat, her sister Kyla sits one bad decision from disaster, and Phalisha keeps a plan tucked behind her smile.

Peaches McKnight stated, "This is a story of love, mystery, murder and loyalty, and I wanted readers to sit with characters who feel like people they already know. Ocean is a loving son and a dedicated partner. Nikko is a loving and all too trusting friend. I hope readers walk away asking who they have been trusting, and whether they have been true to themselves."

Be True to Yourself is written for adult readers of Black urban romance, particularly those drawn to protective heroes, first love heroines and stories where Sunday morning church and criminal history share the same block. Told through multiple points of view, the novel moves between romance, family drama and suspense. Its themes of sisterly rivalry, friendship betrayal and holding to personal conviction under pressure place it alongside contemporary African American romance titles that treat community and consequence as seriously as attraction.

McKnight credits three teachers with putting books in her hands early: Mrs. E. White, Mrs. Tuley and Mrs. Shepherd. She has said the novel exists because those three women got there first.

Be True to Yourself is available for purchase online at Amazon.com and BarnesandNoble.com. For more information about the author, please visit any of their social media platforms.

Instagram: @marilyn330335

TikTok: @marilynmcknight43

About the Author: Three teachers get the credit, and Peaches McKnight names them without hesitation. Mrs. E. White, her English teacher, and Mrs. Tuley, who taught her British literature, put books in her hands at an age when that still changes a person. Mrs. Shepherd believed in her and treated her with kindness from their very first meeting. Be True to Yourself exists because those three women got there first.

Born in Kansas City, Missouri, and a graduate of Southwest High School there, McKnight now lives in Shawnee Mission, Kansas. She writes fiction and poetry, and she reads widely; the romance novels her heroine Nikko hides behind are treated in these pages with affection rather than apology. Travel appeals to her, but so does a gym full of noise on a weeknight, since a good portion of her calendar belongs to her three children and their college basketball games.

Her debut is a story of love, mystery, murder and loyalty, told in the rhythms of real speech, full of banter, eye rolling, and characters who say exactly what they mean the second they think it. Ocean is a loving son and a dedicated partner. Nikko is a loving and all too trusting friend. Denim is loyal and kind hearted. Phalisha is the life of the party, and she knows it. McKnight moves among them in short, quick chapters, and she is unembarrassed by tenderness or by heat.

The book closes with a tribute to mothers, which is where its title finally lands. Be true to yourself is advice Ocean's father gave him as a small child, and McKnight hands it to her readers the same way, plainly, as something worth keeping.

releases.body:

EDISON, N.J., Oct. 8, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Supercharged Entertainment New Jersey, the world's largest indoor, multi-level karting track and premier entertainment destination, yesterday launched its newest attraction — Time Mission — a high-energy, immersive adventure where participants race through the past, present, and future to complete a series of interactive challenges. Yesterday's dedicated media day was filled with dignitaries, press, and local influencers an in-depth look at this mind-blowing attraction within Supercharged New Jersey's 125,000-square-foot venue.

Time Mission already thrills guests at venues across Pennsylvania, New York, Rhode Island, Virginia, and Texas, with two more locations coming soon to Chicago and Ohio. The Edison launch marks the brand's first foothold in New Jersey and its latest expansion into what many fans already consider one of the Northeast's premier entertainment destinations, Supercharged Entertainment, located at 987 Route One in Edison.

Within Time Mission, teams of two to five compete across 30+ fast-paced missions – there are no headsets, no controllers, no sitting on the sidelines. Players choose their session length, pick their missions, and dive into a rotating mix of brain-bending puzzles and full-body physical challenges, each lasting just a few minutes to keep the adrenaline pumping. It's the ultimate lineup for birthdays, team outings, field trips, bachelorette parties, corporate events, or any crew ready to settle who's really the best.

Time Mission slots in perfectly alongside Supercharged New Jersey's other incredible attractions: a two-story Arcade & Gaming Area complete with 180+ games and multiple VR experiences, the thrill-a-minute, two-story Drop & Twist Tower, and Burgers and Brews, the venue's full-service restaurant and bar.

"Time Mission completes the loop — we already bring the world's best racing thrills, and now we're adding a one-of-a-kind adventure experience to match," said Cody Browning, Chief Operating Officer, Supercharged Entertainment New Jersey. "This is the missing piece. Supercharged NJ now has something for everyone: couples, families, kids, groups, companies, you name it. New Jersey and New York City are about to find out just how much mind-blowing fun is waiting for them at our Edison location with the addition of Time Mission."

Guests race the clock through a glitch matrix, crack codes, dodge lasers, solve riddles, and uncover hidden tunnels — a mind-bending blend of physical action and mental challenge that keeps every team on their toes from start to finish. As demand for location-based entertainment continues to surge across urban and suburban markets alike, Time Mission gives Supercharged Entertainment New Jersey a dynamic new blend of physical activity, problem-solving, and all-ages fun, reflecting a growing shift toward immersive, connection-driven group experiences.

"Bringing Time Mission to Supercharged Entertainment New Jersey is a great example of how we want to grow: alongside partners who share our obsession with the guest experience," said Pieter Martens, CEO and Founder of Time Mission. releases.body:

PROVIDENCIALES, Turks and Caicos Islands, Oct. 8, 2026 /CNW/ -- KuCoin, a leading global crypto platform built on trust, today launched "Trust, Built-in.", a new global brand initiative under its enduring brand proposition, "Trust First. Trade Next." The launch is accompanied by a new global brand film featuring KuCoin global brand ambassador and major champion Adam Scott, and is brought to life through KuCoin 5.0, a comprehensive upgrade across the platform.

When KuCoin introduced "Trust First. Trade Next.," Scott appeared alongside the company to help establish trust as the principle that comes before every trade, product and decision. His appearance in the new film continues that story. "Trust, Built-in." takes the idea forward by showing how trust can move beyond a guiding principle and become part of the technology, safeguards, tools and experiences that users interact with every day. At the center of the initiative is a simple belief: trust is not claimed; it is built.

KuCoin 5.0 is the product expression of "Trust, Built-in." Rather than a single product update, it represents a platform-wide evolution spanning six dimensions: compliance, technology, asset security, user experience, AI and wealth management.

Together, these upgrades are designed to build trust into every layer of the KuCoin experience:

  • Trust is built into the foundation: stronger technology, asset security, compliance and operational resilience designed to support users over the long term.
  • Trust is built into the experience: a smoother, more consistent experience across devices--simple when users want it, with greater control when they need it.
  • Trust is built for what's next: AI-powered tools, wealth management capabilities and broader opportunities across decentralized and traditional finance, developed around evolving user needs.

Through KuCoin 5.0, users will be able to bring more of their assets together, trade, manage and earn through a more connected experience, and choose how they build their portfolios across devices. The upgrade reflects KuCoin's ambition to create a platform that is not only ready for how users participate today, but built for how digital finance will continue to evolve.

"'Trust First. Trade Next.' remains the long-term brand proposition that defines KuCoin. 'Trust, Built-in.' focuses that commitment on what users should be able to see and experience across the platform," said BC Wong, CEO of KuCoin. "KuCoin 5.0 is how we put that idea into practice. It is not a single product release, but a comprehensive upgrade across the systems, safeguards, tools and experiences that support our users. By building trust into every layer of the platform, we are creating a stronger foundation for how people engage with digital finance today and in the future."

In the new global brand film, Scott draws on the values that have shaped his career--preparation, discipline and consistency--to express why trust must be built through action over time. His role is to bring the initiative's central message to life while continuing the trust story he previously shared with KuCoin.

"Over the course of a long career, you learn that real confidence comes from strong foundations and a commitment to keep improving, even under pressure," said Adam Scott. "What I respect about KuCoin is how it brings that same mindset to the foundation of its platform--building with care, maintaining high standards and creating an experience users can rely on over time. I'm proud to continue this journey with KuCoin."

"Trust, Built-in." will roll out across KuCoin's global communications and market activities alongside KuCoin 5.0. KuCoin will share further details on each of the six upgrade areas in a separate product announcement.

About KuCoin

Founded in 2017, KuCoin is a leading global crypto platform built on trust and security, serving over 45 million users across 200+ countries and regions. Known for its reliability and user-first approach, the platform builds trust into every layer of the user experience, combining advanced technology, deep liquidity, and strong security safeguards to deliver a seamless trading experience. KuCoin provides access to 1,000+ digital assets through a broad product suite and remains committed to building a compliant and user-centric ecosystem for the future of finance, backed by SOC 2 Type II, ISO/IEC 27001:2022, ISO/IEC 27701:2019, ISO 22301:2019 and ISO/IEC 42001:2023 certifications. In recent years, KuCoin has continued to strengthen its global compliance foundation, marked by key milestones including AUSTRAC registration in Australia, a MiCA license in Europe, and regulatory progress in other markets.

Learn more at www.kucoin.com.

releases.title: NETEASE CLOUD MUSIC AND gamma. ANNOUNCE NEW STRATEGIC PARTNERSHIP IN CHINA FOR MUSIC FROM YE, MARIAH CAREY, SEXYY RED, USHER, SNOOP DOGG AND MORE
releases.body:
HANGZHOU, China and LOS ANGELES, Oct. 8, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- NetEase Cloud Music and gamma., the global media and technology company founded by Larry Jackson and Ike Youssef, today announced a multi-year strategic partnership that will expand opportunities for gamma.'s global artist roster in China while deepening NetEase Cloud Music's connection to international music and culture.

Under the new agreement, NetEase Cloud Music will serve as a key launch platform for licensed recordings from gamma.'s roster of leading artists, including Ye, Mariah Carey, Sexyy Red, Usher, Snoop Dogg, and more. Beyond music distribution, the partnership will create opportunities for collaboration across artist promotion, cultural exchange, original music content, and other initiatives designed to connect global artists with audiences in China.

The partnership builds on gamma.'s broader strategy of creating new pathways for artists to reach audiences, grow their businesses, and participate in culture across markets, while expanding NetEase Cloud Music's access to a diverse roster of internationally recognized and emerging artists. Together, the companies will explore new opportunities to amplify artists and music across borders, deepen connections between global artists and Chinese audiences, and foster greater cultural exchange.

In September 2025, Mariah Carey's latest album, Here For It All, made its China debut on NetEase Cloud Music, generating more than four times the volume of Carey's 2018 album Caution during its first two weeks. The album also delivered record-setting first-day streams and, by day 14, had surpassed every studio album Carey released in the previous decade in the China market.

The success of Here For It All demonstrates the potential of combining gamma.'s artist platform with NetEase Cloud Music's reach and market expertise. The expanded partnership formalizes that collaboration and establishes a broader framework for bringing gamma.'s artists to new audiences while creating new opportunities for NetEase Cloud Music to participate in the larger music ecosystem.

Vivian Wei, Vice President of Copyrights at NetEase Cloud Music, said: "We are delighted to build on our successful past cooperation and enter into a new strategic partnership with gamma., continuing to bring the works of international artists to music fans across China. We look forward to working closely with gamma. and leveraging our respective strengths in streaming platforms and copyright content to further enhance the visibility and influence of international artists in the Chinese market, while injecting new momentum into the diversity and development of China's music industry."

Larry Jackson, Founder and CEO of gamma., said: "I've been so deeply impressed by the imagination that NetEase has brought to every single gamma. release by way of their intent to maximize the commercial results in ways that we had never initially conceived of. Their footprint and success in China coupled with their passion for our repertoire made a partnership in this regard an obvious move. Going back to my time at Apple Music, I have always strongly believed that aligning with a company that is willing to go the extra step on treating your company's release as if it is their release is something that will truly move the needle in this commodified time of music streaming."

About NetEase Cloud Music 

NetEase Cloud Music ("Cloud Music Inc.," HKEX: 9899) is one of the leading online music platforms in China with over 200 million monthly active users, featuring an interactive content community for music enthusiasts in terms of user scale and engagement. NCM has built a large-scale, robust and rapidly growing business to provide community-centric online music services to its users. NCM empowers music enthusiasts with a wide variety of technology-driven tools to discover, enjoy, share and create diverse music and music-inspired content and to interact with each other.

About gamma. 

Founded by CEO Larry Jackson and President Ike Youssef, gamma. is a global media, technology and creative agency company built to empower artist-entrepreneurs to create, distribute, and monetize culture on their own terms. With eight global offices and more than 10,000 monthly releases powered by its Vydia platform, gamma. partners with some of the world's most influential artists, including Mariah Carey, Ye, Snoop Dogg and Death Row Records, USHER, Rick Ross' Maybach Music Group, and Sexyy Red, alongside emerging talent including MOLIY, October London, JayDon, Loe Shimmy, and honestav.

releases.title: Founder-Led Personalized Story Group Acquires International Consumer Publishing Brand, Hooray Heroes
releases.body:
Company expands its personalized publishing platform following consecutive years of triple-digit growth

WILMINGTON, Del. and LJUBLJANA, Slovenia, Oct. 8, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Personalized Story Group (PSG) today announced it has acquired Hooray Heroes, an established international personalized-book company that has sold more than three million personalized books to customers worldwide.

The acquisition represents the latest step in PSG's strategy to build a global portfolio of personalized publishing and gifting brands supported by shared technology, product development, marketing and fulfilment infrastructure.

Hooray Heroes will join PSG's existing portfolio of Story Bug, My Story Tale and Wall Art Prints. The transaction is PSG's second brand acquisition and expands the group's international customer base, publishing catalogue and capabilities in multi-character and family-focused personalization.

PSG has recorded consecutive years of triple-digit growth while maintaining profitability without institutional funding by using a disciplined focus on customer experience, product quality, and operational efficiency, supported by continued investment in the group's personalized technology platform.

"Hooray Heroes is a highly recognized international brand with an extensive creative catalogue, a loyal customer base and more than a decade of experience in personalized publishing," said Brendon Watson, CEO of Personalized Story Group. "This acquisition is a strong strategic fit for PSG as it gives Hooray Heroes access to our technology, marketing and operating capabilities, while allowing the brand to retain the identity and customer proposition that made it successful." said Watson.

Founded in Slovenia in 2013 with an international customer base across the US, Europe and other global markets, Hooray Heroes developed into one of the personalized-book category's most established independent brands. Its catalogue includes illustrated personalized books featuring children, parents, grandparents, couples, siblings and pets across birthdays, holidays and other milestone occasions.

"From the beginning, our objective was to build a brand that helped families celebrate the relationships that matter most," said Rado Daradan, co-founder and former CEO of Hooray Heroes. "PSG understands both the creative and commercial requirements of personalized publishing; its technology, operating capabilities and commitment to preserving the Hooray Heroes brand make it the right owner to support the next phase of the company's development," Daradan added.

Hooray Heroes will continue operating under its existing brand name. PSG expects to migrate the brand onto its shared technology and operating platform within two weeks of completion, reflecting the group's established ability to rapidly integrate acquired businesses.

PSG will continue evaluating complementary acquisition opportunities involving established consumer brands that can benefit from its technology, ecommerce, performance marketing and international fulfilment capabilities.

Terms of the transaction were not disclosed.

About Personalized Story Group (PSG)

Founded in 2023, Personalized Story Group is a technology-enabled personalized publishing and gifting company operating Story Bug, My Story Tale, Wall Art Prints and Hooray Heroes. Its brands create personalized children's books, adult books, family gifts and custom wall art for customers across the United States, United Kingdom, Australia, Canada, New Zealand and other international markets. For more information, visit https://personalizedstorygroup.com/

releases.title: Mersive Collaboration Suite Is Now Mersive Polaris
releases.body:
New name retires the Gen 4 and MCS labels to better reflect where Mersive is steering collaboration next.

DENVER, Oct. 8, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Mersive Technologies today announced that its collaboration platform, previously known as Gen 4 and the Mersive Collaboration Suite (MCS), is now Mersive Polaris. Its website and visual identity have been updated to match.

Mersive Solstice defined its category, showing that a room could share wirelessly, simply and reliably. But what rooms are asked to do has changed. Meetings now span more platforms, more networks and more devices than any one room was designed for.

Answering that took more than new hardware. Drawing on fourteen years of deployments and feedback from IT and AV teams, Mersive rebuilt the platform with software at its core, so rooms keep improving long after install day.

"Gen 4" made that sound like the next step in a hardware sequence. It isn't. It's built for the landscape rooms work in now, and it needed its own name.

Every generation of this line has looked up: Mersive Sol in 2012, then Solstice Gen 1 in 2013, Gen 2 in 2015, Gen 2i in 2017 and Gen 3 in 2019. While a solstice marks a turning point, Polaris is the fixed point the northern sky turns around, the star navigators steer by, and the role Mersive intends to play in customers' spaces for the next decade.

"Solstice showed the market what wireless collaboration could be," said Damian Blazy, CEO of Mersive. "Calling what came next a fourth generation undersold it."

"Polaris isn't the next Solstice with a new label," said Ryan Lee, Vice President of Product at Mersive. "It's a different way of building, and the name signals that."

Mersive Polaris includes Polaris Essentials, Polaris Pro and Polaris Host. Gen 4 and MCS customers are using the same products, now under the Polaris name.

Solstice Gen 3 is supported into 2029, with a mapped transition path and a trade-in program. It runs side by side with Polaris, so customers can upgrade room by room at their own pace.

To learn more, visit the Mersive website.

Media Contact

Skyler Bowden, sbowden@mersive.com

About Mersive Technologies

Mersive Technologies helps people connect and collaborate in meeting rooms, huddle spaces and classrooms. Today's meetings span more platforms, networks and devices than any one room was designed for, with people joining from anywhere. Mersive Polaris, the successor to its Solstice line, was built for that hybrid reality. With software at its core, Polaris lets anyone in the room share content wirelessly from their own device and connect with remote participants on any conferencing platform. Rooms keep improving long after install day, and IT teams can centrally manage, monitor and update deployments of any size. Mersive is headquartered in Lakewood, Colorado. To learn more, visit www.mersive.com.

releases.body:
Key Takeaways:

  • Capacity LLC has acquired a majority stake in Core Fulfilment, a UK-based ecommerce fulfillment provider serving consumer brands across personal care, household goods and other fast-growing categories, creating one fulfillment partner operating across both the U.S. and UK.
  • The deal gives U.S. brands a consistent foothold in the UK, helping them manage the cost of shipping to UK customers and the fast delivery those customers expect.
  • Core Fulfilment customers gain access to Capacity's warehouse technology and engineering-led operations, while the combined company's greater scale strengthens carrier leverage for both sides amid rising cross-border logistics costs.

NORTH BRUNSWICK, N.J., Oct. 8, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Capacity LLC, a fulfillment provider specializing in beauty, fragrance, wellness and other fast-growing consumer product companies, today announced it has acquired a majority stake in Core Fulfilment, a UK-based ecommerce fulfillment company with more than 15 years of experience serving consumer brands across personal care, household goods and other categories. The acquisition creates a single fulfillment partner operating in both the U.S. and UK.

The announcement comes as cross-border fulfillment has grown more operationally complex for consumer brands, with rising shipping costs and shrinking delivery windows making international growth harder to execute without the right infrastructure in place. For brands shipping orders to UK customers from the US, longer delivery times can be a disadvantage in a market where consumers expect things fast. By combining Capacity's beauty-industry expertise, management, technology and infrastructure with Core Fulfilment's UK operational knowledge, the acquisition gives Capacity's existing customers a faster, more cost-efficient way to reach consumers on both sides of the Atlantic. Brands no longer have to rebuild logistics infrastructure from scratch in a market where speed and cost have become increasingly difficult to manage.

"This is about building the unified fulfillment operation brands will need for the next phase of their growth," said Jeff Kaiden, CEO of Capacity. "As consumer brands expand across channels and borders, they need partners that can enable them to enter new markets without added complexity."

What does this mean for customers? Capacity's U.S.-based brands expanding into the UK now gain immediate access to Core's established operation and existing carrier relationships. Core Fulfilment's customers, in turn, gain access to systems built to manage promotional spikes and seasonality, along with Capacity's engineering-led approach to continuous improvement, including throughput analysis and pick-route optimization. For UK beauty and fragrance brands looking to expand into the U.S., the combination also adds a capability few partners can offer: Capacity's DOT-SP 21015 hazmat permit, one of only 31 held by fulfillment providers in the U.S., which allows regulated products like fragrance and aerosols to move through the U.S. market as brands scale.

"Our customers have grown alongside us for years, and the question they always come back to is 'what comes next,'" said Paul Burns, co-founder of Core Fulfilment. "Partnering with Capacity means we can answer that with technology, engineering resources and scale that would have taken us much longer to build on our own."

Moving Forward. This marks a strategic milestone for Capacity as it expands its footprint through an established UK operation and local leadership team. Core Fulfilment will continue to operate from its existing UK sites under its current leadership; there will be no immediate changes to customer accounts, service teams or day-to-day operations. Terms of the transaction were not disclosed.

"This acquisition is a first for Capacity, giving us immediate network expansion in the UK with an established operating team with deep local market knowledge," said Jocelyn Petersen, CFO of Capacity. "Bringing our technology and operations together is expected to strengthen fulfillment services and add value for customers in both the U.S. and UK markets."

About Capacity

Capacity LLC is a third-party logistics provider specializing in fulfillment for beauty, wellness, and fragrance brands. Founded in 1999, the privately owned company operates facilities in New Jersey, California, and Indiana, with UK operations through partners in Cheshire and European fulfillment support through its partner Widem in Belgium. Capacity combines operational expertise with modern technology to help brands scale fulfillment across retail and direct-to-consumer channels.

About Core Fulfilment

Core Fulfilment is a specialist ecommerce order fulfilment provider based in Crewe, Cheshire, England. The company serves direct-to-consumer brands across fashion, fitness, health and beauty, and pet products, offering multichannel fulfilment with integrations to major platforms.

releases.title: Canela Media Brings Its Six Hispanic Culture Cohorts to Life with New Audience Segments Available Through Canela Audience Solutions
releases.body:
New audience segments allow marketers to reach Hispanic consumers based on cultural identity, behaviors and affinity

NEW YORK, Oct. 8, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Canela Media, a leading technology and innovation multicultural media company, today announced that its proprietary Hispanic Culture Cohorts are now available as targetable audience segments through Canela Audience Solutions. Marketers can activate the segments directly with Canela Media or through the major DSPs and SSPs they already use, giving them a new way to reach U.S. Hispanic consumers based on how they live, express and navigate their culture.

The segments build on Canela Media's Hispanic Culture Cohorts Study, released in August, which identified six cohorts defined by how people live, express and navigate their culture. To create the segments, Canela matched each cohort's demographic and behavioral profile to its Canela Audience Solutions data. This lets marketers move from the study's insights to activating them in campaigns.

"Reaching Hispanic consumers isn't about picking one audience and one message," said Paula Baldwin, VP of Brand Partnerships at Canela Media. "The real opportunity is in how you use the cohorts together, with different creative environments and timing for each, all within the same campaign."

The six cohorts, their share of study respondents, and the segment names marketers will find in each platform:

  • Cultural Preservers (27%), available as Canela Media Preservers — Highly expressive and deeply rooted in their heritage, with content serving as a way to preserve and celebrate culture. 94% feel a responsibility to preserve and pass on their culture.
  • Cultural Navigators (20%), available as Canela Media Navigators — Internally anchored and increasingly bilingual, moving comfortably between cultures on their own terms. 92% say they move easily between cultures.
  • Cultural Remixers (17%), available as Canela Media Remixers — Deliberately bicultural, connecting two worlds and code-switching with intention. 98% identify as both American and Hispanic/Latino.
  • Culturally Fluid (15%), available as Canela Media Fluid — Effortlessly bicultural, moving between cultures as a natural part of everyday life and scoring highest on bicultural measures.
  • Culturally Adjacent (12%), available as Canela Media Adjacent — Engaging with culture selectively through influences such as music, food and aesthetics, with 58% remaining proud of their heritage.
  • Cultural Reactors (9%), available as Canela Media Reactors — Carrying cultural connection through memory, nostalgia and emotional familiarity, creating opportunities for brands to re-engage cultural affinity.

Whether buying direct with Canela Media or programmatically, marketers can now select the cohort, or combination of cohorts, that best aligns with a campaign's objectives. All six segments can be found under the Canela Media name in each platform. The offering enables brands to develop more intentional strategies around three broad approaches identified by Canela's research:

  • SERVE: Connect with Cultural Preservers and Culturally Fluid audiences through culturally rooted content that celebrates identity and representation.
  • ENGAGE: Reach Cultural Navigators and Cultural Remixers with timely, shareable and expressive content that participates in the cultural conversation.
  • RECONNECT: Reconnect with Culturally Adjacent and Cultural Reactors through emotional triggers such as nostalgia, family, community and familiarity.

"Now marketers can decide not just who to reach, but how and when," Baldwin added. "They can serve heritage-driven creative to Cultural Preservers, put timely, shareable content in front of Remixers and Navigators, and reach Culturally Adjacent audiences and Cultural Reactors in the moments when nostalgia hits hardest."

The Culture Cohorts segments add a new dimension to Canela Audience Solutions, which already moves beyond standard demographic definitions by incorporating cultural nuance, content consumption patterns and behavioral insights. With the cohorts, brands can now plan around how their audiences relate to culture, not just who they are or what they watch.

The Culture Cohorts Study was conducted in May 2026 among 1,975 respondents and is proprietary research from Canela Media. The full report is available here for free download, and the white paper Canela Media's Hispanic Cultural Cohorts Study: How Culture, Content and Identity Shape Hispanic Brand Connection, published with Ad Age on September 15, is available here.

About Canela Media

Canela Media is an innovation and technology-driven media company connecting brands with U.S. Hispanic audiences through a portfolio of streaming, content, data, creative and audience engagement solutions. Its ecosystem includes Canela.TV, Canela Audience Solutions, Canela Studios and Club Canela, giving marketers multiple ways to reach and engage Hispanic audiences with scale, relevance and precision across and beyond Canela's platforms.

For more information, visit: https://www.CanelaMedia.com

releases.title: FouAnalytics and fraud0 Partner to Bring Automated Google Ads Refunds to the World's Largest Advertisers
releases.body:
Longtime partners in independent ad-quality measurement add an AI agent that automatically recovers wasted Google Ads spend for brand advertisers, globally.

NEW YORK and MUNICH, Oct. 7, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- FouAnalytics, the independent analytics platform for digital ads, websites and mobile apps, today announced a deeper partnership with fraud0 to bring their world-first AI agent for automated ad refunds to the world's largest advertisers.

FouAnalytics and fraud0 have been providing independent traffic and ad quality analytics to advertisers for their websites and programmatic ads, respectively. But Google Ads remained a black box, because Google's policies prohibited all third party measurement instrumentation on their platforms – e.g. search ads, YouTube ads, PMax, etc. Other legacy verification vendors, that claimed to do measurement on these platforms, were just given data on invalid traffic, viewability, and brand safety by Google, without actually having javascript tags instrumented on the platforms to collect data themselves.

"This partnership marks a milestone in advancing greater transparency and accountability in Google Ads, enabling advertisers to recover losses from invalid traffic, false clicks, out-of-compliance ads, billing errors and platform overcharges," said Dr. Augustine Fou. "fraud0's AI for Google Ads Refunds makes this easy for advertisers to activate, and is the first to recover advertisers' refunds at scale."

"Pharmaceutical company Uriach used fraud0 AI for Google Ads Refunds to recover $28,000 in Google Ads spend in just three months."

Large advertisers spend billions of dollars every year on Google Ads. A portion of that investment is known to be lost to invalid clicks. Identifying these losses is one challenge. Recovering them is another. fraud0's AI for Google Ads Refunds has already audited more than $2 billion in digital advertising spend and is trusted by businesses across every industry, including leading advertisers such as HelloFresh, Condor, ABOUT YOU and the Otto Group. As a Google-certified Click Tracker, fraud0 works closely with Google's Click Quality team to investigate suspicious activity and resolve refund claims, while its AI agent builds the required evidence and manages the process from start to finish.

To activate, advertisers simply add a JavaScript tag to their website and connect their Google Ads account. The fraud0 AI for Google Ads Refunds runs continuously in the background, monitoring traffic and handling the refund workflow automatically. Beyond recovery, fraud0 helps advertisers prevent future waste through placement blocking, audience exclusions and the continuous identification of recurring invalid traffic sources.

"Such a pleasure to be working with Dr. Augustine Fou, who has been on the frontlines of fraud detection for decades. We're excited to roll out this new capability to even more customers globally." said Tilman Pfeiffer, CEO of fraud0.

Advertisers interested in activating Google Ads refunds can contact FouAnalytics or fraud0 at the address below.

Created by Dr. Augustine Fou, FouAnalytics is the most trusted, and the only truly independent analytics platform for digital ads, websites, and mobile apps. The platform provides detailed analytical data so practitioners can "see Fou themselves"™ why something is "high humanness," and troubleshoot what is not good quality. Today FouAnalytics is used globally by advertisers like Microsoft, Inuvo, Viant, Beiersdorf and Georgia Pacific, independent agencies and every agency holding company on behalf of clients, as well as more than 10,000 SMBs and site owners. More details at www.fouanalytics.com.

fraud0 is a leading bot detection and invalid traffic (IVT) prevention platform, trusted by some of Europe's largest banks, insurance companies, e-commerce businesses, and leading brands. releases.title: EMCO Industries Brings Automated Heavy-Duty Plant Online, Names Wayne Sornberger to Lead Sales
releases.body:
Oklahoma manufacturer, EMCO, dedicates its new 30,000-square-foot facility exclusively to heavy-duty trailer springs and adds a 35-year industry veteran to serve OEMs seeking domestic supply and predictable lead times.

TULSA, Okla., Oct. 7, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- EMCO Industries, a leading manufacturer of leaf springs for trailers, agricultural equipment, recreational vehicles and specialty vehicles, announced that its new 30,000-square-foot automated manufacturing facility in Claremore, Oklahoma, is online and in production. The plant is dedicated exclusively to the heavy-duty trailer market. The company also announced the appointment of Wayne Sornberger as director of business development.

The facility represents a multimillion-dollar investment in automation and more than doubles EMCO's production capacity. Twelve robots work in tandem across the line, taking raw bars of American steel through shearing, tapering, forming, heat treating and quenching. The plant is expected to support approximately 20 new jobs in Claremore and the surrounding area.

Roughly a dozen heavy-duty spring configurations are now being produced on the automated line, including the High-Performance Mono-Leaf Spring EMCO introduced in January. That 22,400-pound gross-axle-weight-rated spring reduced component weight 25 percent, from 53 pounds to 40 pounds, and exceeds Truck Trailer Manufacturers Association B-10 fatigue life requirements.

"Bringing this plant online and appointing Wayne to lead our HD sales efforts are two key components of our strategy," said Marcus Hester, president of EMCO Industries. "We built capacity specifically for heavy-duty trailer springs, and we brought in someone who has spent his career in that segment and knows what those buyers need. The plant gives us the room to grow. Wayne gives us the relationships to fill it."

Sornberger joined EMCO on July 13 after 35 years in the spring industry. He will cover the heavy-duty trailer market across North America and works from Alberta, Canada. Over three decades he has served many of North America's largest and most demanding trailer manufacturers.

"Customers stay with people who solve their problems, and that starts with getting product on the dock when you say you will," Sornberger said. "What EMCO gives me to sell is a spring built in Oklahoma from American steel, an eight-week lead time instead of 16 or 20, and a supply line that isn't exposed to import tariffs. Those are the three things buyers ask me about first."

EMCO's domestic manufacturing footprint has become a competitive advantage as trailer manufacturers work to reduce exposure to offshore supply. Because the company produces its springs in Oklahoma using domestic steel, customers avoid the tariff costs and the shipping variability attached to imported components. Lead times average eight weeks from order to delivery.

The company has expanded its share of business with leading OEMs, in a market that moved toward dual sourcing and domestic supply following the pandemic-era shortages that left mid-sized manufacturers waiting behind larger accounts. EMCO's focus on leaf springs allows the company to commit production capacity and engineering attention to those customers.

"Quality and price are table stakes in this business. If you can't deliver, none of it matters," Hester said. "That is what has earned us the business we have won over the last several years, and it is what the new facility protects as volume grows. We are not asking customers to take that on faith. Our record is on their receiving docks."

Every EMCO heavy-duty spring is manufactured to the company's proprietary steel specification and heat-treating process, then individually dipped and painted for corrosion resistance. The company is ISO 9001:2015 certified and has received multiple OEM Supplier of the Year awards. Its engineering team brings more than 120 years of combined leaf spring experience.

EMCO is accepting orders for its full heavy-duty trailer spring line.

To access a high-resolution image of Wayne Sornberger and the company's new manufacturing facility, please click here.

About EMCO Industries, LLC

For more than 35 years, EMCO Industries has manufactured leaf springs and heat-treated products for the trailer, agricultural and specialty vehicle industries. The company produces springs with capacities ranging from 250 pounds to 14,000 pounds, serving OEM and aftermarket customers globally from its facilities in Claremore, Oklahoma. As a U.S. manufacturer using American steel, EMCO has built its reputation on delivering quality products on time, every time. For more information, visit https://emcoind.com/.

The episode provides restaurant operators, license holders, developers, lenders, and municipal officials with an authoritative breakdown of New Jersey's major liquor license statutory overhauls.
