releases.title: Bielat Santore & Company Releases Episode 7 of the Owner's Edge Podcast Series: "New Jersey Liquor Licenses Part 2: Reforms to Inactive Licenses"
releases.body:
ALLENHURST, N.J., Oct. 7, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Commercial real estate brokerage firm Bielat Santore & Company has released Episode 7 of its Owner's Edge Podcast Series. The episode provides restaurant operators, license holders, developers, lenders, and municipal officials with an authoritative breakdown of New Jersey's major liquor license statutory overhauls.

New Jersey recently reformed its retail alcoholic beverage licensing framework twice within less than three years. These legislative updates ended the long-standing practice of indefinite dormancy for inactive "pocket" licenses, established structured activation timelines, and opened new intermunicipal transfer mechanisms designed to drive economic redevelopment.

Key Highlights Covered in Episode 7 (Part 2):

  • Ending Indefinite 12.39 Relief (P.L. 2023, c.290): Historically under N.J.S.A. 33:1-12.39, inactive Class C license holders could repeatedly petition the Director of the Division of Alcoholic Beverage Control (ABC) for good-cause "12.39 relief" to maintain dormant licenses across consecutive terms.
  • The 2026 Reset & Revised Quartile Timetable (P.L. 2026, c.46): Enacted on July 23, 2026, P.L. 2026, c.46 superseded key portions of the 2024 law, resetting the four-group inactive license quartile schedule to run one, two, three, and four years from July 23, 2026.
  • Municipal Extensions & 30-Day ABC Appeals: Under the 2026 law, municipal issuing authorities possess expanded discretion to grant extensions beyond two consecutive inactive terms when a licensee demonstrates documented good-faith efforts to activate or transfer the license.
  • Three Distinct Intermunicipal Transfer Pathways: P.L. 2026, c.46 replaced the earlier contiguous municipality restrictions with three flexible transfer procedures to serve qualifying redevelopment, revitalization, or improvement areas[6]:
  1. Municipal Sale of a Newly Authorized License: Allows a municipality authorized to issue a new license to offer it at public sale to private bidders or to the highest bidding municipality statewide[14][15].
  2. Owner-Initiated Transfer: Permits an inactive license holder or contract purchaser to transfer a license to a qualifying redevelopment premises located in the same county or a contiguous municipality in an adjoining county[14][16].
  3. Receiving Municipality RFP: Enables a population-capped receiving municipality to solicit statewide RFPs to acquire an inactive license from the lowest qualified bidding owner for a designated redevelopment project[14].
  • Impact on License Asset Value & Market Strategy: While the 2026 reforms expand market potential across municipal and county borders, asset valuation now heavily relies on documented marketing history, active project pipelines, municipal alignment, and strict adherence to statutory deadlines rather than passive scarcity.

About Bielat Santore & Company

Bielat Santore & Company is a New Jersey commercial real estate brokerage specializing in restaurants, hospitality properties, business enterprises, and liquor licenses. For more than 45 years, the firm has advised hospitality operators, buyers, developers, lenders, and municipalities on the acquisition, sale, valuation, and regulatory transfer of commercial assets throughout New Jersey.

releases.body:
From chart-topping songwriters to the acclaimed screen composers behind Lioness: Special Ops, Landman and Heated Rivalry, this year's achievement winners exemplify the impact of Canadian music.

TORONTO, Oct. 7, 2026 /CNW/ -- SOCAN today revealed the exceptional songwriters, composers and music publishers who will be celebrated with Special Achievement Awards at the 2026 SOCAN Awards, taking place October 26, 2026, at Toronto's REBEL nightclub. The annual event, hosted by Arisa Cox and Andrew Phung, will honour over 100 music creators and publishers shaping Canadian music at home and around the world.

The 2026 honourees reflect the diversity and global reach of Canadian musical creativity and will be celebrated with an evening of standout performances and special guests including Shawn Desman, Jamie Fine, Hailey Benedict and the 2025 Breakout Composers the Chan brothers. Also awarded will be 2025 Songwriter of the Year, Evan Blair, Lowell and the composer team behind Daniel Tiger's Neighborhood and PAW Patrol.

2026 SOCAN Special Achievement Award Winners

  • International Achievement Award – Jessie Reyez

    With over 4 billion streams globally, the GRAMMY nominated, and multiple JUNO winner, Jessie Reyez is representing Canada on the global stage, influencing music and culture with her talent, and collaborations with artists like Dua Lipa, Beyoncé and Eminem.
  • Cultural Impact Award – "Let Your Backbone Slide" by Maestro Fresh Wes, Anthony Davis, Peter Davis; published by BMG Rights Management Canada o/b/o BMG Rights Management (US), Warner Chappell Music Canada Ltd.

    A global success story, this is one of the most groundbreaking and culturally significant recordings in hip hop and Canadian music history.
  • Global Impact Award – Peter Peter 

    Celebrated for elevating Canadian talent on the world stage through his work on the international hit series "Heated Rivalry."
  • Screen Composer of the Year – Andrew Lockington

    A standout year that includes multiple major wins across film and serialized drama for "Atlas," "Landman," "Mayor of Kingstown" and "Special Ops: Lioness".
  • Songwriter of the Year – Non‑Performer – Jenna Andrews

    Recognized for an exceptional year, including "Free" and "What It Sounds Like" from the global hit soundtrack KPop Demon Hunters, Andrews is one of Canada's most sought-after songwriters.
  • Songwriter of the Year – Performer – Drake

    Honoured once again for his unmatched influence on music worldwide.
  • Breakout Songwriter Award – Jade LeMac

    With a fresh, authentic perspective and growing fanbase, Jade is one of the most exciting new voices in Canadian music.
  • Breakout Composer Award – Nathan Micay

    The electronic music producer made waves with his foray into screen composing on the hit HBO series "Industry."

"Every year, the SOCAN Awards shine a light on the songwriters, composers and music publishers who define and elevate Canadian music," said Jennifer Brown, SOCAN CEO.  "The 2026 honourees show the extraordinary range of talent shaping our culture, from global hitmakers to groundbreaking composers and exciting new voices. We can't wait to celebrate them on October 26."

SOCAN Achievement Award winners receive "The SOCAN" – the world's first and only music industry trophy that is also a musical instrument, incorporating five custom bronze crotales, tuned this year with notes from "Let Your Backbone Slide" by Maestro Fresh Wes. 

The full list of this year's SOCAN Award winners will be released on the evening of October 26. 

SOCAN proudly acknowledges its legal counsel of 75+ years, Gowling WLG as the official sponsor of the 2026 SOCAN Awards, with the SOCAN Foundation and the Unison Benevolent Fund serving as official charity partners.

About SOCAN   

SOCAN is Canada's largest member-owned music rights organization, championing the fundamental value of music and the people who create it. SOCAN collects license fees for the public performance and reproduction of music, matches them to rights holders, and distributes them as royalties to songwriters, composers and music creators and publishers in Canada and around the world. With more than a century of expertise and innovation, SOCAN stands for respect and fair compensation for creative work – protecting, recognizing, and celebrating its over 200,000 songwriter, composer, and music publisher members. For more information: www.socan.com.

releases.body:
Country Songwriter of the Year, Country Song of the Year and Country Publisher of the Year to be Revealed During Celebration of  the Year's 50 Most-Performed Country Songs

NASHVILLE, Tenn., Oct. 7, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- BMI will celebrate one of the ultimate architects of modern Country music, Jeffrey Steele, by naming him a BMI Icon during the 74th annual BMI Country Awards. The two-time BMI Country Songwriter of the Year will be recognized for his significant songwriting and contributions to Country music. The invitation-only event will be held at BMI's Nashville office on Nov. 17th and will be hosted by BMI's CEO, Mike O'Neill, Executive Vice President, Chief Revenue & Creative Officer, Mike Steinberg and BMI's Nashville VP of Creative, Clay Bradley.

Throughout the evening, BMI will also reveal the Country Songwriter of the Year, Country Song of the Year and Country Publisher of the Year, while celebrating the top songwriters and music publishers behind this past year's 50 most-performed songs in Country music.

"Jeffrey Steele is a titan of modern storytelling whose catalog has shaped the sound of Country music over the last three decades," BMI's Nashville VP of Creative, Clay Bradley said. "When you hear one of his anthems that has become the soundtrack to millions of lives, you can feel the emotion behind every lyric. As a two-time BMI Country Songwriter of the Year and an intentional mentor to the next generation of creators, Steele has earned a permanent place among the greats."

Since Steele's affiliation with BMI in 1981, the multi-Platinum songwriter, singer and producer has shaped the modern Country music landscape with over 60 chart-topping hits. The prolific songwriter has received more than 34 BMI Country and Pop Awards for his extensive catalog that includes iconic songs like Tim McGraw's "The Cowboy in Me" along with Rascal Flatts' "What Hurts the Most," "My Wish," and "These Days" as well as Keith Urban's "Raise 'Em Up" featuring Eric Church, Zac Brown Band's "Knee Deep," Van Zant's "Help Somebody," Montgomery Gentry's "Something to Be Proud Of" and "My Town." The seven-time GRAMMY® nominee has earned critical recognition for his creative impact with an induction into the Nashville Songwriters Hall of Fame, and Steele has been honored by the Country Music Hall of Fame as a "Poet and Prophet."

The BMI Icon Award is given to exceptional songwriters in recognition of their unique and indelible influence on music makers over many generations. In receiving this award, Steele joins an impressive list of Country legends including Bill Anderson, Matraca Berg, Clint Black, Toby Keith, Loretta Lynn, Willie Nelson, Merle Haggard, Dolly Parton, Kris Kristofferson, Dean Dillon, Vince Gill and Hank Williams, Jr., as well as multi-genre creative/songwriting royalty Stevie Nicks, Little Richard, Carole King, Patti LaBelle, Brian Wilson, James Brown, Janet Jackson, Bo Diddley, Holland-Dozier-Holland, Peter Gabriel, Al Green, Van Morrison, Sting, Bryan Ferry, Carlos Santana, Los Lobos, and more.

ABOUT JEFFREY STEELE:

Jeffrey Steele continues to shape American music with songs that connect people across generations. With more than 65 million radio and television airplays, his songwriting has produced major hits for artists including Keith Urban, Eric Church, Zac Brown Band, Jimmy Buffett, Montgomery Gentry, Lynyrd Skynyrd, Cher, .38 Special, Faith Hill, Tim McGraw, Trace Adkins, LeAnn Rimes, Rascal Flatts, Van Zant, Joe Cocker, Little Feat ft. Bob Seger, Joe Bonamassa, Cascada, and many more. A member of the Nashville Songwriters Hall of Fame, Steele has been recognized by the Country Music Hall of Fame as a "Poet and Prophet," named BMI Songwriter of the Year twice, and awarded NSAI Songwriter of the Year three times. He is also a two-time CMA Triple Play Award recipient for penning three No. 1 hits in a single year. His extensive list of chart-topping songs includes: "Raise 'Em Up," "Knee Deep," "Here," "My Wish," "The Cowboy in Me," "These Days," "My Town," "Something to Be Proud Of," "Everyday," and the landmark "What Hurts the Most," which earned a GRAMMY® nomination for Best Country Song. Steele has received a Golden Globe and Critics' Choice nominee for Best Original Song for "I Thought I Lost You" (from Disney/Pixar's Bolt). He has been named one of Billboard's Top 5 Writers for eight consecutive years and MusicRow Magazine's Songwriter of the Year. Continuing to use his voice to reflect the times, Steele released his new single "A Voice" in January - a song rooted in hope, unity and shared humanity. Written as a reminder of what connects us in a world often marked by division and uncertainty, the song underscores Steele's enduring belief in music as a force for healing and togetherness. The song debuted at #4 on the Billboard Digital Sales charts. A full-length American Storyteller album of new music will follow. Fore more information visit www.JeffreySteele.com.

ABOUT BMI:

Celebrating over 80 years of service to songwriters, composers, music publishers and businesses, BMI® is a global leader in music rights management, serving as an advocate for the value of music. BMI represents the public performance rights in over 25 million musical works created and owned by more than 1.5 million songwriters, composers, and music publishers. The Company negotiates music license agreements and distributes the fees it generates as royalties to its affiliated writers and publishers when their songs are performed in public. In 1939, BMI created a groundbreaking open-door policy becoming the only performing rights organization to welcome and represent the creators of blues, jazz, country, and American roots music. Today, the musical compositions in BMI's repertoire, from chart toppers to perennial favorites, span all genres of music and are consistently among the most-performed hits of the year. For additional information and the latest BMI news, visit bmi.com, follow us on X, TikTok, and Instagram @BMI or stay connected through BMI's Facebook page. Sign up for BMI's The Weekly™ and receive our e-newsletter every week to stay up to date on all things music.

releases.title: The House of Suntory's Yamazaki 25 Years Old Awarded Trophy in the Japanese Whisky Category at International Spirits Challenge 2026 and Suntory Spirits Named Japanese Whisky Producer of the Year
releases.body:
This marks the fourth consecutive year Yamazaki has earned a Trophy in the Japanese Whisky category

NEW YORK, Oct. 7, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Suntory Global Spirits, a world leader in premium spirits, today announced that The House of Suntory's Yamazaki Single Malt Whisky 25 Years Old has been awarded a Trophy at the International Spirits Challenge (ISC) 2026, the competition's highest honor in the Japanese Whisky category. The award marks the fourth consecutive year a Yamazaki whisky has received this accolade.

Why is Yamazaki 25 Years Old's International Spirits Challenge 2026 win significant?

  • This latest achievement marks the fourth consecutive year that Yamazaki has earned the competition's honor in the Japanese Whisky category: Yamazaki 25 Years Old in 2023, Yamazaki 12 Years Old in 2024, and Yamazaki 18 Years Old in 2025.
  • This achievement reinforces Yamazaki's position among the world's premier spirits and underscores Suntory Global Spirits' leadership in exceptional whisky.
  • The recognition also reinforces the importance of upholding the Japanese Whisky standards set by the Japan Spirits & Liqueurs Makers Association, standards that help protect the authenticity, heritage and craftsmanship behind the category. As the association's logo begins to roll out across The House of Suntory's authentic Japanese Whisky products, consumers will have an easier way to identify whiskies that meet these standards.

"Yamazaki 25 Years Old was first introduced in 1999, and in 2021 we evolved the whisky to more intentionally express Tsukuriwake — the diversity of our whisky‑making — and Tsukurikomi — the refinement and mastery behind our craft." said Suntory Chief Blender, Shinji Fukuyo. "Seeing Yamazaki 25 Years Old receive this prestigious recognition today is profoundly meaningful for our entire team. It affirms the continuity of our craftsmanship across generations and our unwavering commitment to creating whiskies that honor Yamazaki's legacy while continuing to evolve."

What is the International Spirits Challenge and how are its awards judged?

The International Spirits Challenge is one of the industry's most prestigious competitions, judged by a panel of world-renowned experts who assess spirits for quality, balance, and character.

International Spirits Challenge judges noted: "There's a reason Yamazaki is so widely accepted as a global benchmark in quality whisky. The combination of texture and fruitiness, the multiple layers - it has everything happening within it to make me want just a little bit more."

What does Yamazaki 25 Years Old taste like?

  • Color: Amber
  • Nose: Mizunara smoky notes of incense, followed by a complex bouquet of mature kaki persimmon and ume plum notes.
  • Palate: A smoky first sip of Mizunara sandalwood notes that open and deepen into complex layers of kaki persimmon subtle sweetness, tart ume plum notes and gentle shoga ginger spicy notes.
  • Finish: Profound long finish with Mizunara smokiness and lingering subtly sweet wood notes that remain.

What other notable awards did The House of Suntory win?

  • In addition to this top accolade, Hakushu 18 Years Old Peated Malt and Hakushu 25 Years Old each earned Double Gold medals, further underscoring the exceptional quality and strength of The House of Suntory portfolio.
  • Suntory Spirits also earned recognition as Producer of the Year in the Japanese Whisky category for the seventh consecutive year.
  • All other awards can be seen below:

Trophy

  • The Yamazaki Single Malt Whisky 25 Years Old

Double Gold

  • The Hakushu Single Malt Whisky Peated Malt 18 Years Old
  • The Hakushu Single Malt Whisky 25 Years Old

  • Suntory Whisky Ao Irish Edition

  • Suntory Whisky Hibiki 30years Old

  • The Yamazaki Single Malt Whisky Smoky Batch The Fourth
  • The Hakushu Single Malt Whisky Japanese Forest Bittersweet Edition
  • The Yamazaki Single Malt Whisky
  • The Yamazaki Single Malt Japanese Whisky Mizunara Japanese Oak Cask 25 Years Old

About The House of Suntory 

Suntory is renowned as the founding house of Japanese Whisky, beginning with Shinjiro Torii's creation of Japan's first malt whisky distillery in Yamazaki in 1923 and carried forward by his son, Keizo Saji, founder of the Hakushu and Chita Distillery. As the generations of Suntory's master blenders carry on, Suntory Whisky remains committed to heritage and innovation.

Today, the House of Suntory continues to craft award-winning spirits, including Yamazaki®, Hakushu®, Chita®, Kakubin®, Hibiki®, and Suntory Whisky Toki™. All 100% distilled, matured, and bottled in Japan, in full compliance with the Japan Spirits & Liqueurs Makers Association (JSLMA) standards. The House of Suntory also includes Roku™ Japanese Gin, Haku™ Japanese Vodka, and Kanáde Japanese Liqueur, reflecting the same dedication to craftsmanship, quality, and innovation that have defined Suntory for over a century.

In 2025, Yamazaki® made history at the International Spirits Challenge as the first brand to win Supreme Champion Spirit three years in a row, and in 2024, Chief Blender Shinji Fukuyo was named Master Blender of the Year. Furthering this legacy of excellence, the Osaka Spirits & Liqueurs Craft Distillery, home to Roku Gin, Haku Vodka and Kanáde Japanese Liqueur was awarded the 2025 Liqueur Producer Trophy by the International Wine & Spirit Competition (IWSC). The House of Suntory will open the Osaka Craft Distillery to the public for the first time in 2026.

About Suntory Global Spirits 

As a world leader in premium spirits, Suntory Global Spirits inspires the brilliance of life, by creating rich experiences for people, in harmony with nature. Known for its craftsmanship of premium American whiskeys, including Jim Beam® and Maker's Mark®; Japanese whiskies, including Yamazaki® and Hibiki®; and leading Scotch brands including Laphroaig®, Suntory Global Spirits also produces leading brands such as El Tesoro® and Hornitos® tequilas and Roku® gin, and is a world leader in Ready-To-Drink cocktails, with brands like -196™ (minus one-nine-six) and On The Rocks™ Bartender Created Cocktails.

A global company with approximately 6,000 employees in nearly 30 countries, Suntory Global Spirits is driven by its core values of Growing for Good, Yatte Minahare and Giving Back to Society, and aims to have a positive impact on the planet, consumers and communities. Headquartered in New York City, Suntory Global Spirits is a subsidiary of Suntory Holdings Limited of Japan. For more information, visit www.suntoryglobalspirits.com and www.drinksmart.com.

releases.title: OptiSigns Expands Secure TV Dashboard Apps for Power BI, Salesforce, Tableau, Grafana, Databricks and More
releases.body:
Secure, centrally managed dashboard apps bring business data to the TVs teams already look at.

HOUSTON, Oct. 7, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- OptiSigns, a digital signage company powering more than 200,000 screens worldwide, today announced expanded and enhanced dashboard apps, which now work with Microsoft Power BI, Salesforce, Tableau, Grafana, Databricks and more. Businesses can now show automatically updating  live dashboards on TV screens in offices, factories and operations centers.

Companies spend more than $70 billion a year on business intelligence software, according to HG Insights, yet research from BARC and Eckerson Group found only about a quarter of employees actively use BI tools. A 2016 meta-analysis of 138 studies published in Psychological Bulletin found that monitoring progress helps people achieve their goals, with greater benefits when progress is recorded or shared publicly. Getting dashboards onto shared screens can mean relying on manual screenshots, leaving account credentials on devices or publishing sensitive reports publicly.

With OptiSigns, companies connect their dashboard accounts once, pick a dashboard and assign it to one screen or many. The apps work with cloud and self-hosted platforms, personal or company accounts, and any number of teams. In Power BI, a single report can also show each location its own figures. For example, a retailer can use screen-specific filters to display each store's sales figures while managing one report centrally.

Dashboards rotate in playlists, run on schedules or share a split screen like any other OptiSigns content. Screens never hold the account's password or long-lived secrets, which stay encrypted on OptiSigns' servers.

"When the numbers are on the wall, everyone sees the same picture at the same time," said Henry Le, chief executive officer at OptiSigns. "Companies put real money into their dashboards, and then those dashboards sit on a few laptops. We made it simple to get that information in front of the whole team."

Dashboard apps are available today on the Pro Plus plan and higher. Plans start at $10 per screen per month. For more information, visit optisigns.com.

About OptiSigns

OptiSigns is a Houston, Texas-based digital signage company that helps more than 36,000 businesses run content across over 200,000 screens worldwide. Its catalog of 160+ apps turns any TV into a live display for menus, schedules, social feeds and dashboards. Learn more at optisigns.com.

releases.body:
Experience every turn, overtake, and roar of the track with stunning picture and immersive sound, beginning with the Formula 1® MSC Cruises United States Grand Prix™ 2026

SAN FRANCISCO, Oct. 7, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Today, Dolby Laboratories (NYSE: DLB) and Apple announced that Dolby Atmos is coming to Formula 1® on Apple TV1 beginning with the 2026 U.S. Grand Prix™, joining Dolby Vision to deliver an even more immersive viewing experience. For the first time, fans in the U.S. with an Apple TV subscription will be able to experience every Formula 1 race weekend in both Dolby Vision and Dolby Atmos.

Dolby Atmos puts fans at the heart of the action, surrounding them with the energy, drama, and emotion of Formula 1. From team radio communications and race commentary to the roar of the engines, on-track battles, and the intensity of the pit lane, Dolby Atmos brings the unmistakable sounds that define the sport to life.

Paired with Dolby Vision, fans can take in every detail of race weekend through richer colors, greater contrast, enhanced brightness, and lifelike clarity. From the vibrant liveries of each team to the atmosphere and character of Formula 1's most iconic circuits, Dolby Vision is the ultimate complement to the spectacular visuals that define Formula 1. Together, Dolby Vision and Dolby Atmos deliver a more immersive Formula 1 experience, bringing exceptional picture and sound together to capture the full intensity of the sport.

Formula 1 in Dolby Vision and Dolby Atmos is available through the Apple TV app on supported Apple devices and compatible Dolby-enabled TVs, soundbars, and home theater systems.

"Formula 1 is one of the most captivating sports in the world, where every circuit, team, and race weekend has its own visual and sonic identity," said John Couling, Senior Vice President of Entertainment, Dolby Laboratories. "Together, Dolby and Apple have redefined how audiences experience entertainment, from music to movies and TV. Now, with Dolby Atmos joining Dolby Vision for Formula 1 on Apple TV, we're setting a new bar for how fans experience the sights and sounds of the sport."

"We're always looking for new ways to make Formula 1 on Apple TV even better for fans," said Oliver Schusser, Apple's vice president of Music, Sports, Apple TV, and Beats. "The sound of Formula 1 is such an important part of what makes the sport so exciting, and with Dolby Atmos joining Dolby Vision, fans can experience the energy and intensity of every Grand Prix in a whole new way. It's another example of how we're continuing to innovate across the viewing experience to bring fans closer to the action."

For decades, Dolby has brought fans closer to the sports they love through innovations that make every moment more immersive and engaging. By capturing the emotion, excitement, and intensity of the action, Dolby helps recreate the feeling of being at a race. With Dolby Vision and Dolby Atmos, Formula 1 on Apple TV delivers an even more immersive race weekend, bringing the sights and sounds of the track to life in a whole new way.

Apple TV is the exclusive U.S. home of Formula 1, delivering every practice, qualifying, Sprint session, and race live and on demand. Subscribers get comprehensive coverage and analysis, expansive programming, exclusive original content, and every Grand Prix in stunning 4K with Dolby Vision, which launched at the start of the season. Viewers can also personalize how they follow the action with Multiview, including one-tap team layouts featuring the main broadcast and onboard feeds, as well as dedicated Podium and Data Multiviews with real-time race information. Fans can learn more about Formula 1 on Apple TV and subscribe HERE.

Experience Formula 1 in Dolby Atmos and Dolby Vision for the first time with the 2026 U.S. Grand Prix beginning Friday, October 23, exclusively on Apple TV.

releases.summary: NEW YORK, Oct. 7, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Conversations around suicide and mental health are often brushed off in our culture, leaving many with feelings of isolation and helplessness and fears around being judged. The American Foundation for Suicide Prevention (AFSP) addresses this head-on, launching a new season of its podcast channel where mental health experts and those with their own personal experiences related to mental health and suicide have honest, authentic, and open conversations, sharing insights from real people and communities, as well as the field's latest scientific developments and research.
releases.title: Raw, Real, and Research-Informed Podcasts Tackle the Science and Hard Conversations Around Suicide and Mental Health
releases.body:
NEW YORK, Oct. 7, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Conversations around suicide and mental health are often brushed off in our culture, leaving many with feelings of isolation and helplessness and fears around being judged. The American Foundation for Suicide Prevention (AFSP) addresses this head-on, launching a new season of its podcast channel where mental health experts and those with their own personal experiences related to mental health and suicide have honest, authentic, and open conversations, sharing insights from real people and communities, as well as the field's latest scientific developments and research.

Officially launched in December 2025, the AFSP Podcast Channel is entering its second season. In new episodes of Ask Dr. Jill, Strong Talk, and Elevating Voices, listeners can expect to learn about the latest research in the field, hear from changemakers who are reshaping mental healthcare, and have their real mental health and suicide-related questions answered by researchers, advocates, and licensed mental health professionals.

Season two's kickoff episodes in October:

  • Ask Dr. Jill, "What Can We Do to Prevent Physician Suicide?": Host Dr. Jill Harkavy-Friedman and Corey Feist, co-founder & CEO of the Dr. Lorna Breen Foundation, discuss the problem of physician suicide: the causes, the impact, and what we can do to prevent it
  • Strong Talk, next episode airing Oct. 21: Host Vic Armstrong has a candid conversation with Gemma Correll, bestselling author and graphic novelist (Anxietyland), known for integrating humor into their story of living with and navigating anxiety and depression

What's in store this season:

  • Dr. Lynnette A. Averill, a researcher specializing in psychedelics and their potential applications in mental health, on what research says about mental health and the use of psychedelics
  • Megan McCoy, CFT™, LMFT, and PhD, on the connection between personal finances and mental health – and how people can manage their emotions related to financial stress
  • Faye Seidler, LGBTQ+ suicide prevention advocate, on trans and LGBTQ+ suicide prevention and access to care in local communities
  • Vikram Patel, co-director of Harvard's Mental Health for All Lab, on what must be done to provide mental healthcare support care in low-resource settings
  • Dr. Ellie Foster, the co-director of Education for the Kevin Love Fund, on the role public figures and athletes play in empowering youth to explore vulnerability and have honest mental health conversations
  • Cultural considerations of mental health and suicide prevention in diverse communities

"We will be having conversations that combine real world experiences and research findings and offer our audience actionable content," said Dr. Jill Harkavy-Friedman, the host of Ask Dr. Jill and AFSP senior vice president of Research. "The new season invites listeners to meet and learn from interesting people who are changing the way we access mental health resources, making them more accessible to all," said Vic Armstrong, the host of Strong Talk and Elevating Voices and AFSP VP for Health Equity and Engagement.

The AFSP Podcast Channel houses the following shows:

Strong Talk is hosted by Vic Armstrong, AFSP's vice president for Health Equity and Engagement. Each episode features conversations with experts, advocates, and changemakers about how they're reshaping mental healthcare to make it accessible to all. The show covers topical issues that affect the mental health of various communities.

Elevating Voices is a roundtable discussion series where we bring together leaders from diverse communities to understand the unique mental health experiences they face and explore the ways we can all help to support and amplify progress.

Ask Dr. Jill features Dr. Jill Harkavy-Friedman, AFSP's senior vice president of Research, answering urgent and real mental health questions with the latest scientific research and conversations with fellow experts in the field.

Visit afsp.org/podcasts to learn more.

The American Foundation for Suicide Prevention is dedicated to saving lives and bringing hope to those affected by suicide, including those who have experienced a loss. AFSP creates a culture that's smart about mental health through public education and community programs, develops suicide prevention through research and advocacy, and provides support for those affected by suicide. Led by CEO Robert Gebbia and headquartered in New York, with its Policy and Advocacy Office in Washington, D.C., AFSP has local chapters in all 50 states, D.C., and Puerto Rico, with programs and events nationwide. Learn more about AFSP in its latest Annual Report and join the conversation on suicide prevention by following AFSP on Facebook, X, Instagram, YouTube, LinkedIn and TikTok.

The American Foundation for Suicide Prevention and The Jed Foundation (JED) intend to merge as equals to form AFSP/JED, the nation's largest nonprofit dedicated to preventing suicide across the lifespan, and bringing hope to those affected by suicide loss or risk. The AFSP/JED mission would reflect a commitment to bring together AFSP's research, advocacy, chapter network, and loss-support expertise with JED's comprehensive approach to suicide prevention and evidence-informed youth mental health programs, creating greater scale, reach, and impact at a time of urgent national need. Read more about our recent announcement.

NEW YORK, Oct. 7, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Great American Media announced that Harry Lang has joined the company as Senior Vice President of Product. Lang will lead product strategy and development for the company's subscription streaming services, Great American Pure Flix and GFam+, with responsibility for enhancing the viewer experience and supporting the continued growth of both platforms.

Great American Media welcomes Harry Lang as SVP of Product, leading strategy and growth for Pure Flix and GFAM+.

releases.title: GET ENGAGED JOINS SAMY, CREATING A POWERFUL GLOBAL PLATFORM AT THE INTERSECTION OF SOCIAL, CREATORS, ENTERTAINMENT AND CULTURE
releases.body:
Partnership combines Get Engaged's deep U.S. relationships and culture-driven expertise with SAMY's global social-first scale and data, strategy and creative capabilities.

NEW YORK, Oct. 6, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Get Engaged, a leading U.S. social-first agency specializing in creators, talent, entertainment and culture, today announced that it is joining SAMY, a global independent social-first agency. The combination brings together two social specialists to create one of the largest independent social-first influencer/creator agencies in the world, expanding the capabilities both organizations can offer brands globally.

For Get Engaged clients, the combination provides access to greater global reach and international activation capabilities, complemented by deeper social-first expertise across data and insights, strategy, creative, content production, social commerce, and product and technology development. At the same time, Get Engaged will retain its founders, leadership, culture, client-first approach and hands-on service model.

Alex Dermer, CEO of Get Engaged said, "We built Get Engaged to help brands connect with culture in ways that move their businesses forward. Joining SAMY gives us the global reach, technology and talent to take that vision further. What excites me most is our shared ambition for where this industry is going and the role we can play in shaping it. As I step into the CEO role of Get Engaged, I'm proud of what we've built and energized by what this partnership makes possible for our clients and our team."

"The next era of marketing will belong to brands that create moments people want to be part of. We see a huge opportunity to bring brands, creators and talent together in ways that go well beyond a single campaign. With SAMY, we can take bigger swings and turn bold ideas into experiences and partnerships that reach audiences around the world." - Cam Fordham (Co-Founder)

Juan Andres Elhazaz, CEO of SAMY said, Joining forces with Get Engaged consolidates SAMY as an independent, global leader in social and creator marketing. Having established a proven track record as a leader in Europe and Latin America scaling our U.S. footprint was one of SAMY's primary growth objectives and Get Engaged is the ideal partner to lead that expansion. We now bring our data and insight- driven Influencer and Social capabilities, powered by tech and AI, to maximize strategy and creative output, allowing leading brands to resonate authentically with today's audiences.

Founded in 2016 by Alex Dermer, Cam Fordham and Ben Hiott, Get Engaged drives culture with the power of influence and cross-platform orchestration, building genuine connections between celebrities, creators and brands through engaging content. The company has grown to more than 120 employees across Atlanta, New York, Nashville and Los Angeles, serving clients including Sephora, Raising Cane's, DoorDash, Live Nation, NBCUniversal, EA Games, Sazerac, Universal Music Group, and Perplexity.

SAMY is a global, social-first agency that builds brand relevance by seamlessly integrating intelligence, creativity, and technology. Headquartered in Madrid, the agency operates with over 1,200 specialists across 20 offices and 55 markets worldwide, driving high-impact campaigns for leading global brands including L'Oréal, Barilla, The North Face, Diageo, Microsoft, Red Bull, Grindr and Unilever.

"Get Engaged has been a valued partner of Raising Cane's since 2018 and has helped the Brand reach new audiences in fun and engaging ways that feel authentic and genuine to both the Brand and our Customers," said Raising Cane's owner and founder Todd Graves. "The team at GE is collaborative, resourceful, and skilled at helping identify opportunities for Brands to capitalize on cultural moments and maintain that momentum through fresh ideas and industry-leading insight."

The partnership also expands opportunities for Get Engaged's existing clients, who will gain access to SAMY's global organization and the ability to activate campaigns across Europe, Asia and Latin America. Get Engaged will anchor SAMY's operations in the United States, with its founders, leadership and teams continuing to lead the business and its client relationships.

Beyond combining services, the combination will result in one of the largest independent social-first marketing organizations globally, built around how modern audiences discover and engage with brands across creators, entertainment and social ecosystems.

For employees, the combination creates new opportunities to collaborate internationally, work alongside a larger network of specialists, operate across additional markets and participate in building the next phase of a growing global organization.

"We've spent years developing a deep understanding of what captures attention, what people choose to share, and what makes content move across the internet. Joining SAMY gives us the global infrastructure, resources, and reach to build on that expertise at a much greater scale, helping more clients earn a meaningful place in the conversations shaping culture." Ben Hiott (Co-founder, Get Engaged)

The combined business will also benefit from the proprietary technology and AI-powered tools already in use across SAMY, as well as further developments to be brought to market together, enabling greater speed, intelligence and scale for clients. By pairing this technology with Get Engaged's access to talent and creators, cultural understanding and local-market expertise, the two agencies will help brands participate meaningfully in culture rather than simply advertise around it.

Héctor Pérez, Deputy Managing Partner of Bridgepoint Europe said "This is another important milestone in SAMY's global growth journey, bringing together two highly complementary social first businesses and significantly strengthening the group's presence in the US. Together, SAMY and Get Engaged will create a leading social first agency globally, with the scale, capabilities and local expertise to support clients across markets. We are pleased to continue supporting the team as they deliver on that ambition."

The Raine Group served as exclusive financial advisor to Get Engaged.

About Get Engaged

Founded in 2016 by Alex Dermer, Cam Fordham and Ben Hiott, Get Engaged is a social-first marketing company operating at the intersection of brands, entertainment, creators, talent and culture. With more than 100 employees and offices in Atlanta, New York, Nashville and Los Angeles, the company's capabilities include campaign ideation, social media management, influencer marketing, celebrity partnerships, content production and paid media. Get Engaged works with leading brands, platforms, labels, studios, creators and talent.

About SAMY

SAMY is a global social-first marketing organization with approximately 1,200 employees and operations across North America, Europe, Asia and Latin America. The company brings together social-first strategy, technology, research and market intelligence, content and production, creator marketing and international operating infrastructure to help brands connect with audiences globally and execute effectively in local markets.

releases.body:
TORONTO, Oct. 6, 2026 /CNW/ -- Asian Television Network International Limited (ATN) (TSXV: SAT), Canada's largest South Asian broadcaster and pioneer broadcaster of cricket is pleased to announce that it has acquired the Canadian broadcast rights to the National Cricket League GT20 (NCLGT20), bringing the exciting new T20 cricket league to audiences across Canada.

The NCLGT20 features some of the biggest names in international cricket, combining established cricket legends with leading international and emerging talent in a fast-paced T20 format.

Through this agreement, ATN will air live coverage of NCLGT20 matches across its sports channels in Canada, making the tournament accessible to cricket fans across the country.

"We are delighted to bring a lot more exciting Live Cricket to the Canadian audiences," said Dr. Shan Chandrasekar, President and CEO of ATN. "Cricket continues to be one of the most important sports for Canada's Commonwealth Communities, and ATN is committed to bringing our viewers the best cricket from around the world. NCLGT20 provides an exciting new platform featuring some of the most recognizable names in the game, and we look forward to making this tournament available to cricket fans throughout Canada."

The NCL GT20 Canada tournament has formed a historic partnership with Cricket West Indies (CWI) to host its 2026 season in the Caribbean. The professional T20 franchise tournament will take place in St. Vincent and the Grenadines from October 23 to November 1, 2026, before returning to Canada for its 2027. Organized in direct collaboration with Cricket Canada and CWI, the temporary relocation aims to strengthen cricketing, developmental, and commercial links between North America and the Caribbean.

Chris Dehring, Chief Executive Officer of Cricket West Indies, said: "NCL GT20 Canada, together with the deep cricketing tradition of the West Indies, creates an exciting opportunity for collaboration. Hosting the 2026 tournament in the Caribbean before its return to Canada next year marks the beginning of a partnership that can facilitate the continued development of Canadian cricket while showcasing our region as one of the great cricketing regions of world cricket. As the only full member of the ICC in the hemisphere, we believe it is important to forge mutually beneficial relationships with ICC Associate Members across the region, for the health of the game and, indeed, for the continued development of West Indies cricket."

"Every ball, every six, every wicket -- live, coast to coast," said Malini Basu, Chief Global Communications Officer for NCL GT20. "This league was built for Canada, and with cricket headed to the 2028 Olympics, Canadian fans deserve a front-row seat to the players who will shape the sport's next chapter. We're excited to work with ATN to bring NCL GT20 to cricket fans across Canada" she added.

All the 18 NCLGT20 matches will be available LIVE across Canada on ATN Cricket Plus, CBN, & ATN Sports.

Adding to the NCLGT20 lineup, ATN will also air the New Zealand vs. India series LIVE from October 22 through November 30, 2026. The highly anticipated series will feature: 5 - T20 Internationals, 5 - One-Day Internationals (ODIs) & 2 - Test Matches. The 12-match series will showcase two of the world's leading cricket nations competing across all three formats of the game.

About ATN-Asian Television Network International Limited

ATN serves Canada's diverse cultural communities with over 50 specialty television channels. The Company offers its flagship ATN-HD general interest service along with 7 other general interest channels, 3 sports Channels, 7 news Channels, 5 Bollywood movie channels and a variety of channels that include music, lifestyle, and several regional language channels that includes Hindi, Punjabi, Tamil, Bengali, Urdu, Gujarati & Marathi. ATN has been a pioneer in the Production of Multicultural Television Programming in Canada. ATN has programming alliances with leading international broadcasters like Sony Entertainment Television, Disney/Reliance- JioStar, CNN News 18, Zee Network, Times Television, B4U, NDTV (Good Times), Republic TV, ABP News Network, Jaya TV, ARY, FOOD FOOD Network and many more.. ATN is also a pioneer broadcaster of Cricket in Canada and has exclusive broadcast rights for various International Cricket Boards. ATN was the first to bring the ICC World Cup of Cricket live across Canada in 1987 and since have exclusively broadcast a large number of Test Matches, One Day Internationals, limited over T-20 games including the Premier of IPL & various T-10 leagues. ATN's content is also available on Amazon Prime in USA & UK, ATN has its own State Of The Art Production and Digital Broadcast facilities which have also been used by various production companies associated with Netflix, CBC and others. ATN Channels are distributed through TELUS, Rogers, BELL, Cogeco, Videotron, V Media, MTS, Eastlink, FUBO & Canadian cable systems alliance.

releases.title: Qorvis Welcomes Veteran Media Executive Victor Shiblie
releases.body:
Washington Diplomat President and Publisher Brings More Than Three Decades of Media, International Business, and Diplomatic Experience to Qorvis

WASHINGTON, Oct. 6, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Qorvis today announced that veteran media executive and international business strategist Victor Shiblie has joined the firm as Senior Advisor, bringing more than three decades of experience spanning media, international affairs, global business, and diplomatic engagement.

Shiblie joins Qorvis after a career at the center of Washington's diplomatic and international community. For more than 25 years, he has served as President and Publisher of The Washington Diplomat, one of the capital's leading publications serving the diplomatic community.

Under Shiblie's leadership, The Washington Diplomat built relationships across more than 180 foreign embassies, U.S. government institutions, multinational corporations, and international organizations. He also produced high-level policy forums, international conferences, and economic-development programs bringing together ambassadors, senior government officials, corporate executives, and international leaders.

"Victor understands the power of media, relationships and communications in international affairs because he has spent more than 30 years working at their intersection," said Matt Lauer, Chief Executive Officer of Qorvis. "Few people in Washington have built the breadth of relationships across the diplomatic, media and international business communities that Victor has. He brings extraordinary experience, judgment and connectivity to Qorvis and, most importantly, to our clients."

At Qorvis, Shiblie will advise clients on strategic communications, international business development, market access, and engagement with diplomatic, government, media, and business stakeholders, while helping expand the firm's international network and global business opportunities.

Beyond his media career, Shiblie has extensive experience in international trade and cross-border investment, including connecting investors, developers, government stakeholders and commercial partners on international energy and infrastructure opportunities. He has also advised foreign investors pursuing opportunities in the United States and foreign governments seeking to attract American investment and strengthen commercial ties with the United States.

"Qorvis has built a unique platform combining communications, geopolitical insight, international business, and access to decision-makers around the world," said Shiblie. "I am excited to join a team that understands how these disciplines increasingly intersect and to put my experience and relationships to work for Qorvis clients."

Earlier in his career, Shiblie led marketing and operations for KENO Electronics, an international import-export company serving government, embassy and commercial clients. He has also held civic and international leadership roles with organizations including the Ambassadors Ball Host Committee, Passport DC, the World Affairs Council, and the Arab American Business & Professional Association Institute.

Shiblie holds a B.B.A. in Marketing from Radford University and a certification in export management from the Government of the District of Columbia. He is conversant in Arabic.

About Qorvis 

Qorvis is a global advisory and strategic communications firm headquartered in Washington, D.C., with primary offices in Geneva, Brussels, and Dubai. Founded in 2000, Qorvis has guided multinational corporations, sovereign nations, ultra-high net worth individuals, and global institutions through every major global shift of the last 25 years. We serve clients in sectors of strategic importance: energy, aerospace and defense tech, critical minerals, healthcare and biopharma, and sovereign funds and state entities. Many operate in politically sensitive, legally complex, or reputationally exposed environments.

For more information, visit www.qorvis.com.

releases.title: Long Island University's Roc Nation School of Music, Sports & Entertainment Earns Third Consecutive Recognition on Billboard's Top Music Business Schools List
releases.body:
Recognition highlights the School's industry-driven curriculum, career opportunities, and connections to leading music and entertainment professionals

NEW YORK, Oct. 6, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Today, the Roc Nation School of Music, Sports & Entertainment at Long Island University (LIU) has been recognized by Billboard as part of its 2026 Top Music Business Schools List, marking the third consecutive year the Brooklyn-based School has earned the distinction. 

The annual list recognizes colleges and universities preparing the next generation of music business leaders. This year, Billboard highlighted the Roc Nation School's industry-focused curriculum, access to professional resources and continued connections to leading music and entertainment executives. 

Since beginning enrollment in 2021, the School has continued to expand opportunities for students pursuing careers across the music business, including artist management, marketing, publishing, touring, entrepreneurship and more. Billboard highlighted how students have access to industry professionals and events and industry-standard resources, including the School's 2,400-square-foot Dolby Atmos studio.

Billboard also acknowledged how the School's curriculum continues to evolve alongside the industry, including coursework through its continued relationship with JPMorgan Chase, assisting aspiring music executives with money management.

Recent alumni have launched careers with organizations including Roc Nation, 508 Productions and Vevo, while other students have secured competitive opportunities with Universal Music Publishing Group, Interscope Records, iHeartMedia, Live Nation, SiriusXM and Sugar Mountain Records, among others. 

The latest recognition comes as select students from the School were invited to attend the world premiere of HBO's JAŸ-Z In 8 documentary at The Metropolitan Opera House at Lincoln Center. The costs of the students' gowns and tuxedos were covered by the Shawn Carter Foundation and other organizations, allowing the students to experience a historic night in music in culture alongside some of the biggest names in entertainment.  

Additionally, the School recently announced a four-year, full-tuition scholarship for a first-time freshman, established by Grammy Award-winning engineer and producer Young Guru, who also serves as Director of the Music Technology, Entrepreneurship & Production program at the Roc Nation School.  

About The Roc Nation School of Music, Sports & Entertainment 

The Roc Nation School of Music, Sports & Entertainment at Long Island University (LIU) is a globally renowned destination for world-class education, exceptional career development, cultural initiatives and philanthropic endeavors. The school prepares students for careers spanning entrepreneurship, music, sports business, management, performance and more through an esteemed faculty of university professors, adjunct industry leaders and special guest lecturers.  

 The Roc Nation School began enrolling students at LIU in Fall 2021 and combines academic instruction with immersive opportunities designed to help students build practical experience and professional networks. Located in Shawn "JAY-Z" Carter's hometown of Brooklyn, the school also provides Roc Nation Hope Scholarships to 25 percent of enrolled students, enabling recipients to graduate with a four-year full-tuition scholarship. Hope Scholars are selected from a pool of academically competitive, New York-based, first-time freshmen with the highest financial need.

releases.title: OLG DEBUTS CASH POP: A NEW WAY TO PLAY LOTTERY
releases.body:
TORONTO, Oct. 6, 2026 /CNW/ -- A new lottery experience officially landed in Ontario today. Ontario Lottery and Gaming Corporation (OLG) is the first lottery jurisdiction in Canada to debut CASH POP™, an innovative draw-based game that brings a new level of customization to lottery play.

CASH POP offers players flexibility in how they build their ticket by choosing their number(s) and selecting their wager amount. After purchase, each selected number is assigned a randomly generated prize amount. Players only need to match one number to win.

How to Play CASH POP:

  • Choose one or more numbers, known as POPs, from 1 to 15, or select Quick Pick
  • Choose a wager amount:
    • $2, $5, $10, or $20 per POP
  • After purchase, each selected POP is assigned a randomly generated prize amount:
    • Prizes range from 5 to 250 times the selected wager
  • One winning number is drawn
  • Players whose selected POP matches the winning number will win the corresponding prize displayed on their ticket
  • Five daily draws
  • Win up to $5,000

"CASH POP is a great addition to OLG's lottery lineup and reflects our ongoing efforts to bring new and engaging experiences to customers," said Andrew Darley, VP Lottery Product. "As the first lottery jurisdiction in Canada to offer the game, we're excited to provide players with more ways to play while continuing to give back to communities across the province."

As part of the launch, OLG is also introducing a new digital selection slip option. The new feature allows players to build their CASH POP ticket in the OLG App and scan it at a participating retailer to complete their purchase and receive a printed ticket.

Ontario players can purchase CASH POP tickets at any of OLG's 10,000 retail locations, on OLG.ca, the OLG app, or self-serve lottery terminals. Visit www.olg.ca/CASHPOP for more information about how to play, prizing details and odds of winning.                          

OLG promotes safer gambling and empowers players to make informed decisions at every step of their play. PlaySmart provides tools and information that help players stay in control and enjoy games on their terms.    

OLG is where gaming entertainment drives benefits beyond the game. As an Ontario Crown Agency, OLG offers casino, lottery, digital and charitable gaming to millions of players - with a commitment to safe and responsible play at the heart of everything it does. Since 1975, its operations have generated approximately $64 billion to fund key provincial priorities, while creating significant economic benefits for casino host communities, Ontario First Nations, lottery retailers, local charities and the horse racing sector.

releases.title: Meekah and Dove Celebrate All the Amazing Things Our Bodies Can Do With New "My Body Is Amazing" Music Video
releases.body:
Moonbug and the Dove Self-Esteem Project are back with a new Meekah music video encouraging kids to move, express themselves and celebrate what their bodies can do.

LOS ANGELES, Oct. 6, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Get ready to move with Meekah! Moonbug Entertainment and the Dove Self-Esteem Project (DSEP) are partnering with Meekah for a new "My Body Is Amazing" music video celebrating movement, self-expression and the amazing things our bodies can do. Designed to protect body confidence1 from an early age, the music video encourages children to focus on everything their bodies help them experience, explore and enjoy, rather than how they look.

Premiering today, ahead of International Day of the Girl, "My Body Is Amazing" is set to protect body confidence1 in a way that feels fun, engaging and accessible for young children and their caregivers. Set to an energetic pop track, the song takes kids on a playful journey through the senses and the many ways we experience the world, from smelling and tasting to seeing, moving and expressing ourselves. Together, Meekah and her friends celebrate the unique ways each of them can move, play and experience the world around them.

The collaboration builds on Moonbug and Dove's partnership in 2024, when the two brands joined forces on a collection of Blippi episodes and music videos focused on body confidence and self-esteem, including the Blippi "Wonderful Talent Show" special. This time, the partnership brings Meekah's signature energy, creativity and love of movement to a song all about celebrating the incredible ways our bodies help us experience and explore the world.

"Meekah is all about encouraging kids to jump in, try something new and find their own way to experience the world," said Liz Katz, Associate General Manager of Blippi who leads the Meekah franchise at Moonbug Entertainment. "Movement and self-expression are such a natural part of who she is, and this partnership with Dove gives us a wonderful opportunity to celebrate that. We want kids to feel excited to move, try things, express themselves and, most importantly, have fun being exactly who they are."

"For more than 20 years, the Dove Self-Esteem Project has been helping young people build body confidence and self-esteem. And we know that work needs to start early. If we want to reach more children, we need to take body confidence education beyond the classroom and into the things they love to watch and listen to. 'My Body Is Amazing' with Meekah does exactly that, celebrating bodies for everything they can do, not simply how they look," said Marcela Melero, Chief Growth Marketing Officer, Dove.

The partnership builds on the Dove Self-Esteem Project's multi-decade mission to provide body confidence and self-esteem education so the next generation can grow up with a positive relationship with their bodies and reach their full potential. Research shows that body image concerns start to manifest as early as 4-years-old, with 1 in 4 girls aged 4-6 years disliking something about their appearance2. That's why it's never too early to start teaching kids about body confidence to help minimize self-esteem issues, now and in the future.

"My Body Is Amazing" is now available on YouTube.

About Meekah

Meekah makes learning about the world fun by inviting kids to jump in and try things for themselves. She ignites curiosity by doing, making and expressing herself, using creativity and movement to explore the world in her own way. With her signature big-sister energy, Meekah jumps in alongside kids, cheers them on and makes trying something new feel fun and achievable. As part of the Blippi franchise, Meekah brings a distinct point of view that complements Blippi: Blippi opens kids' eyes to what's out there, while Meekah encourages them to jump in.

The Blippi brand averages more than one billion monthly YouTube views and reaches more than 100 million fans worldwide, with Meekah related content averaging more than 200 million monthly YouTube views. Available in 25+ languages, including ASL, across 65+ distribution platforms, the franchise spans streaming, live experiences, products, music, publishing and gaming.

About Moonbug Entertainment

Moonbug is an award-winning global entertainment company inspiring kids everywhere to laugh, learn and grow. The company is behind some of the biggest kids' entertainment brands in the world, including CoComelon, Blippi and Little Angel. Moonbug believes every child should have access to entertaining and enriching content, making its shows available on more than 150 video platforms globally including Netflix, Disney+, BBC iPlayer and YouTube Kids. The company is also a global leader in pre-school music and audio experiences, available on 100+ audio platforms globally. Moonbug brands extend far beyond the screen to include streaming music, games and interactive, consumer products, and live events.

Moonbug is part of Candle Media, an independent, creator-friendly home for cutting-edge, high-quality, category-defining brands and franchises. By bringing together elite talent operating at the intersection of content, community, and commerce, it helps to position leading entertainment businesses for accelerated, sustainable growth in the current market and beyond. Candle is run by its Co-Chairmen and Co-CEOs, leading entertainment executives Kevin Mayer and Tom Staggs, and backed by investment capital from funds managed by Blackstone's flagship private equity business.

About the Dove Self-Esteem Project

The Dove Self-Esteem Project (DSEP) is the world's largest provider of body confidence education. For more than 20 years, it has helped over 160 million young people across 150+ countries build body confidence and self-esteem through academically validated resources. DSEP's mission is to empower the next generation through body confidence education, helping young people reach their full potential.

About Dove

Dove started its life in 1957 in the US, with launch of the Beauty Bar, with its patented blend of mild cleansers and ¼ moisturising cream. Dove's heritage is rooted in care – proof, not promises grew Dove from a Beauty Bar into one of the world's most beloved beauty brands. 

Real women have always been our inspiration, and since the beginning, Dove has been wholly committed to providing superior care to all, and to championing real representations of beauty in our advertising, communications, and campaigns. Dove believes that beauty is for everyone, and the Dove mission is to ensure a positive experience with beauty is universally accessible to all.

For 69 years, Dove has been committed to broadening the narrow definition of beauty in the work they do. This includes the 'Dove Real Beauty Pledge,' and commitment to:

  1. Portray women as they are in real life with honesty, diversity, and respect. We feature women of different ages, sizes, ethnicities, hair colour, type, and style. 
  2. Represent individuals with zero digital distortion, with all images approved by the women they feature.
  3. Help young people build body confidence and self-esteem through the Dove Self-Esteem Project, the biggest provider of self-esteem education in the world with a goal to educate 250 million young people by 2030.

1 Craddock, N., Garbett, K. M., Smith, H. G., Anquandah, J., White, P., & Williamson, H. (2025). "My body is amazing from the bottom to the top"-An RCT study testing two positive body image media micro-interventions for young children aged 4–6 years. Body Image, 52, 101851.

2Hayes, S., & Tantleff‐Dunn, S. (2010). Am I too fat to be a princess? Examining the effects of popular children's media on young girls' body image. British Journal of Developmental Psychology, 28(2), 413-426.

releases.title: Personalized Story Group Acquires Hooray Heroes, Expanding Its Global Personalized Publishing Portfolio
releases.body:
Acquisition brings one of the personalized-book category's most established independent brands into its growing publishing group

WILMINGTON, Del. and LJUBLJANA, Slovenia, Oct. 6, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Personalized Story Group (PSG) today announced that it has acquired Hooray Heroes, the established international personalized book publisher known for creating illustrated stories featuring children, parents, grandparents, siblings and pets.

Founded in Slovenia in 2013, Hooray Heroes has grown into an internationally recognised personalized publishing brand, serving customers across the United States, Europe, Australia, and other global markets. Its extensive catalogue includes books for birthdays, holidays, new babies, family milestones, and other meaningful occasions, with more than three million personalized books created for customers worldwide.

Hooray Heroes joins Personalized Story Group's growing portfolio of publishing and gifting brands, which includes Story Bug, My Story Tale, and Wall Art Prints. The acquisition significantly expands the group's creative catalogue, international customer base and capabilities in multi-character and family-focused product personalization.

"Hooray Heroes has built an outstanding publishing brand with a loyal global audience and a catalogue that has helped millions of families see themselves represented in the stories they share," said Brendon Watson, CEO of Personalized Story Group.

"Its strength in family-focused and multi-character storytelling is highly complementary to the books we have developed through Story Bug and My Story Tale. We see an exciting opportunity to preserve what customers already love about Hooray Heroes, while investing in new stories, enhanced personalization, and the brand's next stage of international growth."

Personalized Story Group has recorded its second consecutive year of triple-digit growth as market demand continues to increase for highly personalized books and gifts. The addition of Hooray Heroes forms part of PSG's strategy to build a leading independent global group of personalized publishing brands, while allowing each brand to retain its own creative identity and customer proposition.

"From the beginning, our goal was to create books that made children and families feel seen, celebrated and connected," said Rado Daradan, co-founder and former CEO of Hooray Heroes.

"Personalized Story Group understands both the creative and technological sides of personalized publishing. Its commitment to preserving the Hooray Heroes brand, combined with its publishing capabilities and international reach, makes PSG the right home for the company's next chapter."

Hooray Heroes will continue operating under its existing brand name. Personalized Story Group plans to invest in the development of new titles, expanded personalization capabilities and the continued international growth of the brand.

Terms of the transaction were not disclosed.

About Personalized Story Group (PSG)

Founded in year 2023, Personalized Story Group is a technology-enabled personalized publishing and gifting company operating Story Bug, My Story Tale, Wall Art Prints and Hooray Heroes. Its brands create personalized children's books, adult books, family gifts, and custom wall art for customers across the United States, UK, Australia, and other international markets.

The group operates a shared technology, publishing and fulfilment platform designed to support rapid product development, international growth, and the integration of complementary consumer brands.

For more information, visit https://personalizedstorygroup.com/

releases.title: PARAMOUNT COMPLETES ACQUISITION OF WARNER BROS. DISCOVERY, CREATING A NEW GLOBAL ENTERTAINMENT LEADER, SKYDANCE
releases.body:
• The combination builds on the storied history of two of the world's most recognizable entertainment companies, forming a single creative powerhouse.
  • The combined company, Skydance, brings together two major film studios, two global streaming services, premier television assets including CBS, HBO, and Paramount's and WBD's cable networks, two of the industry's most recognized news networks, CBS News and CNN, and a leading content portfolio that includes live sports, a deep programming library and expansive collection of iconic brands and franchises.
  • Together, Paramount and WBD will deliver enhanced output commitments, including a minimum of 30 high-quality theatrical films per year and 180+ television shows and series.  
  • Skydance aims to build the next-generation global media and entertainment company powered by creativity and technology. We are creative-first, audience focused, tech-forward, globally scaled.
  • Storytelling anchors the combined company's growth strategy – expanding opportunities for the world's leading creative talent and widening choice for consumers across every entertainment vertical. 
  • Disciplined execution and an owner-operator model underpin the strategy, targeting at least $6 billion in run-rate synergies within three years.

LOS ANGELES and NEW YORK, Oct. 6, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Skydance Corporation (f/k/a Paramount Skydance Corporation) (NYSE: SKYD) ("Paramount") today announced the completion of its acquisition of Warner Bros. Discovery, Inc. (NASDAQ: WBD) ("WBD"), creating a combined company, named "Skydance." The company brings together two major film studios, two global streaming services, a premier television portfolio including CBS, HBO, and Paramount's and WBD's cable networks, two of the industry's most recognized news networks, CBS News and CNN, and a portfolio of live sports including CBS Sports and TNT Sports, as well as a deep programming library and expansive collection of brands and franchises. The transaction closed following receipt of all required regulatory approvals under the merger agreement and satisfaction of other customary closing conditions. Skydance Class B shares will begin trading today on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE) under the new ticker symbol "SKYD."

Under the terms of the agreement, WBD shareholders received an amount in cash equal to $31.01666668 per share. WBD shares have ceased trading on NASDAQ, effective today. 

The completed transaction unites two of media and entertainment's most storied companies, each with a history spanning more than a century, giving the combined business a rare legacy to build on. The aim of the combined company is to build the next-generation global media and entertainment company powered by creativity and technology.

Storytelling will drive the combined company's growth, bringing creative visions to life for audiences in more than 200 countries and territories and creating greater opportunities for workers across the entertainment industry. Skydance starts from a position of strength: the most diverse film and television library of any studio, the largest theatrical output in the industry, 200+ million streaming subscribers across platforms, an iconic broadcast network, an unmatched sports portfolio, and a franchise portfolio spanning Top Gun and Harry Potter to White Lotus and SpongeBob SquarePants. From this foundation, Skydance is committed to delivering for the creative community and consumers, with at least 30 theatrical films annually, each with a minimum 45-day theatrical window, and already boasts 180+ television shows. Across TV and streaming, Skydance will also continue to support the independent production sector by commissioning content from independent studios and licensing its own content to third parties, creating more opportunities and more jobs for creatives, both in front of and behind the camera.

David Ellison, Chairman and CEO of Skydance, said: "Today is a historic day, not just for Skydance but for our entire industry. From the start, our ambition was to bring these two storied studios together and create a stronger competitor, with the talent, resources, and reach to tell great stories in every genre, on every platform, for audiences everywhere. Now that ambition is a reality. We're grateful to everyone who made this possible – the employees, creative talent, and production teams of both companies, who worked tirelessly to get us here and inspire audiences around the world every day, as well as the advisors and partners who guided this transaction to completion. Our focus now turns to the future: building a company that empowers creatives, entertains audiences and rewards shareholders. We couldn't be more excited to get to work."

Gerry Cardinale, Founder and Managing Partner of RedBird Capital and a Skydance Board Director, said: "This is a defining moment for the industry. By applying our owner-operator model to Paramount and WBD's unmatched portfolio of iconic franchises, premium original programming, and live sports rights, we can protect that legacy while building for a media landscape that's undergoing transformational change. David, our Co-CEO Ynon Kreiz, and the rest of our world-class Skydance team have the vision and track record to lead through this change. We're proud to back them as we build a stronger Hollywood, expand opportunities for talent, and create long-term value for our shareholders."

At the same time, consumers can expect greater innovation from a company built with technology at its core, including significant improvements to its direct-to-consumer streaming products, which will unify into a single service over time.

The transaction received unanimous approval from competition authorities covering nearly 70 jurisdictions worldwide, reflecting recognition of the deal's pro-competitive nature and the benefits it brings to consumers and creatives alike. The combination will strengthen competition and expand consumer choice, both on Skydance's own platforms and across the broader industry.

The combined company is built on a strong financial foundation that positions it to capitalize on growth opportunities, deliver on its commitments, and drive shareholder value. Skydance is one of the largest media and entertainment companies in the world, with nearly $70 billion in revenue. We are targeting $6 billion-plus in run-rate synergies over the next three years. Applying the same operational playbook that allowed Paramount to exceed its synergy targets following the Skydance-Paramount merger, the synergy savings will come primarily from technology, integration and procurement, marketing and real estate rationalization. That will make the company leaner and more nimble, freeing it to grow its investment in the stories, creators and technology that matter most while reducing net leverage to its 3.0x target by the end of 2029.

Powered by best-in-class content, streaming scale and technological edge, the combined company expects to generate more than $10 billion in free cash flow by 2030 – reducing leverage while funding growth and investment. Its pro forma content spend of more than $30 billion for the last twelve-month period will be disciplined and strategic, prioritizing audience reach and long-term value creation. 

WBD's common stock has ceased trading on the Nasdaq Exchange, effective today. The Ellison Family holds the largest equity stake in Skydance (NYSE: SKYD), and the Ellison Family and RedBird Capital Partners ("RedBird") together are the sole holders of Paramount Class A Common Stock, including 100% of the combined company's voting shares.

As previously stated, the transaction included $47 billion of new equity investment in Class B Common Stock, led by the Ellison Family, RedBird, Public Investment Fund (PIF), L'IMAD, Qatar Investment Authority (QIA) and LionTree, which was priced at $12.00 per share. The debt financing for the transaction was led by Bank of America, Citigroup and Apollo.

Advisors

Centerview Partners LLC and RedBird Advisors acted as lead financial advisors to Paramount, and Bank of America Securities, Citi, M. Klein & Company and LionTree Advisors also acted as financial advisors. Cravath, Swaine & Moore LLP and Latham & Watkins LLP acted as legal counsel to Paramount. Latham & Watkins LLP also acted as legal counsel to the investor consortium, including the Ellison Family.

Allen & Company, J.P. Morgan and Evercore served as financial advisors to WBD and Wachtell Lipton, Rosen & Katz and Debevoise & Plimpton LLP served as legal counsel.

Barclays Capital acted as financial advisors to the Special Committee of the Board of Directors of Paramount and Cleary, Gottlieb, Steen & Hamilton LLP served as legal counsel.

About Skydance

Skydance is a next-generation global media and entertainment company, composed of three business segments: Studios, Direct-to-Consumer, and TV Media. Skydance's portfolio unites legendary brands, including Paramount, Warner Bros., HBO and HBO Max, Paramount+, Pluto TV, CBS, CNN, CBS Sports, TNT Sports, Nickelodeon, Cartoon Network, MTV, Food Network, BET, HGTV, and Comedy Central.
