releases.title: "MITANI - The Mariage of Sushi" Celebrates Acclaimed, Sold-Out World Premiere at the San Sebastián International Film Festival
releases.body:
MITANI New York Brings the "Mitani Mariage" to a Global Audience

NEW YORK, Oct. 2, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- " MITANI – The Mariage of Sushi", a feature documentary chronicling sushi chef Yasuhiko Mitani's culinary philosophy and the opening of MITANI New York, was officially selected to compete in the Culinary Zinema section of the 74th San Sebastián International Film Festival. The film celebrated its acclaimed, sold-out world premiere on September 23, 2026.

Following the premiere, Mitani and the MITANI New York team presented a sold-out culinary experience for only 16 guests. The evening brought the film's world to life through the "Mitani Mariage"—Mitani's distinctive pairing of sushi and seasonal dishes with Champagne, wine, and sake. By bringing cinema and gastronomy together, the event offered guests an intimate, multisensory expression of Mitani's culinary philosophy.

On September 24, the documentary was screened at the Basque Culinary Center, one of the world's leading institutions for culinary education. Following the screening, Mitani took the stage to discuss his journey, his culinary philosophy, and his profound gratitude for every ingredient and the life it represents. The program included a lively exchange with students aspiring to careers in the culinary world.

Competing for the prestigious Culinary Zinema Award, the film received an enthusiastic response from its international audience. Its directors, producers, and members of the MITANI team were subsequently invited to attend the festival's official Closing Ceremony.

A Message from Yasuhiko Mitani / Owner, MITANI New York

"The people we met from around the world, the connections we formed through food, and the opportunity to share what we have always valued with a global audience have given us memories and experiences that we will treasure for the rest of our lives.

We will carry everything we have gained from this experience with us while remaining steadfast in the principles at the heart of Team Mitani. We hope you will continue to follow and support us as we carry forward this 'relay of life.'"

From a Four-Year Waiting List in Tokyo to a New Stage in New York

MITANI New York, the setting for Mitani's latest chapter as portrayed in the documentary, opened in Manhattan in May 2026.

Located inside the historic luxury hotel Lotte New York Palace, the restaurant features two dining rooms, each centered around a six-seat sushi counter. This intimate setting allows the team to devote its full attention to each guest and every element of the dining experience.

Mitani's story began with a six-seat restaurant in Yotsuya, Tokyo, which became renowned for its four-year waiting list. MITANI New York now brings his culinary philosophy, craftsmanship, and spirit of hospitality to a new international stage.

The "Mitani Mariage": A Culinary Philosophy Rooted in a Relay of Life

Yasuhiko Mitani began training as a sushi chef at the age of 15 and has devoted nearly half a century to his craft.

His signature concept is the "Mitani Mariage"—a distinctive approach that pairs sushi and seasonal dishes with Champagne, wine, sake, and tea.

Mitani approaches the bounty of the sea and the land with profound respect and gratitude. He honors the life of every ingredient and gives it renewed expression through each dish and every piece of sushi he creates.

He carefully considers each ingredient's condition, freshness, temperature, aroma, umami, and finish, composing every course so that each dish, piece of sushi, and accompanying beverage enhances the others.

The finest ingredients, from Japan, sourced each day are prepared as seasonal dishes and sushi, accompanied by rare Champagnes, Burgundy wines and other fine wines, exceptional Japanese sake, and tea.

Cuisine, beverages, tableware, surroundings, hospitality, and the time shared at the counter come together as one complete expression: THE MITANI EXPERIENCE.

MITANI New York is available by reservation only. Each course is composed according to the season and the availability and condition of the ingredients on the day.

releases.title: CRTC takes action to improve information about cellphone coverage
releases.body:
GATINEAU, QC, Oct. 2, 2026 /CNW/ -- The CRTC is helping Canadians better understand where cellphone coverage is available and where there may be gaps.

Following a public consultation, the CRTC is introducing a new approach for how service providers report on their cellphone networks. This will give Canadians more detailed information about cellphone coverage in a specific area, making it easier to compare service options.

Canadians will also be able to report locations where coverage maps do not reflect their experience. This feedback will help improve the accuracy of information over time and provide a clearer picture of connectivity needs across Canada.

The CRTC collects data from service providers on their coverage and provides this information to Innovation, Science and Economic Development Canada (ISED), which uses it for its National Broadband Map. Better data will help service providers and governments identify areas where there are gaps, supporting planning and investments that improve connectivity.

The CRTC is also making it easier for Canadians to find, compare and choose the Internet and cellphone services that meet their needs. Recent measures include eliminating extra fees on Internet and cellphone plans, improving how Canadians are notified about expiring contracts and discounts, giving Canadians more ways to change or cancel their plans and making it easier to compare Internet plans.

Quotes

"Better information leads to better decisions. By improving how cellphone coverage is reported and giving Canadians a way to flag gaps, we can build a clearer picture of connectivity across the country and help support better investment where it is needed."

- Vicky Eatrides, Chairperson and Chief Executive Officer, CRTC

Quick facts

  • The CRTC is an independent quasi-judicial tribunal that regulates the Canadian communications sector in the public interest. The CRTC holds public consultations on telecommunications and broadcasting matters and makes decisions based on the public record.
  • The new standard will be phased in beginning with the next Annual Facilities Survey in early 2027.
  • The Consumer Protections Action Plan sets out the actions the CRTC is taking to protect and empower Canadians.

releases.title: Concerns about Protecting the National Film Board's Mandate
releases.body:
MONTREAL, Oct. 2, 2026 /CNW/ -- The Syndicat général du cinéma et de la télévision (General Union of Film and Television Workers – SGCT–CUPE 4835) is concerned that discussions about the future of our audiovisual cultural institutions are being held behind closed doors. The Honourable Marc Miller, Minister of Canadian Identity and Culture and Minister responsible for Official Languages, has announced the composition of an advisory panel on support for Canada's audiovisual sector. The panel is tasked with providing recommendations this fall regarding the potential merger of the National Film Board of Canada, Telefilm Canada and the Canada Media Fund.

"The NFB's mandate is sacrosanct. Period. Not only does the Board produce, distribute and preserve its works, but it also serves as a laboratory for creativity and innovation within the audiovisual ecosystem. The force that binds these three pillars of Canadian audiovisual culture together is, in large part, the invaluable contribution of unionized staff working alongside industry stakeholders, --foremost among them, the creators themselves. Amidst existential threats to Canadian sovereignty, the union will not hesitate to mobilize all its allies to protect the integrity of the NFB's mandate, ensuring that Canadian culture continues to flourish and the NFB pursues its unique mission," added Olivier Lamothe, president of SGCT–CUPE 4835.

CUPE deplores the fact that that advisory panel members were required to sign a non-disclosure agreement, shutting out directly affected stakeholders. It should be noted that for several years, SGCT-CUPE 4835 has been actively campaigning for increased and sustainable funding for the NFB, whose budget has not been indexed to inflation since 2002, with an estimated minimum loss of $16.6 million. Without a sufficient and recurring increase in its budget, the NFB risks compromising its in-house expertise, which is inseparable from its ability to support creation, foster innovation and engage with the audiovisual industry.

CUPE is the largest union in Canada, with over 800,000 members working in health care, education, universities, municipalities, libraries, social services, public services, ground and air transportation, emergency services and communications.

releases.body:
ALBUQUERQUE, N.M., Oct. 2, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Prominently featured in The Inner Circle, Dr. Joseph G. R. Martinez is acknowledged as a Pinnacle Professional of The Year for his contributions to Mathematics Education and Student Success.

Dr. Joseph G. R. Martinez has built a distinguished career in higher education, dedicating nearly four decades to teaching and advancing mathematics education. As a retired faculty member of the University of New Mexico, he is recognized for his commitment to student success and his ability to make complex mathematical concepts accessible to learners at all levels.

Dr. Martinez specialized in mathematics education, graduate statistics, calculus, and algebra, with a particular focus on reducing math anxiety. His teaching approach emphasized patience and step by step instruction, helping students build confidence and develop a deeper understanding of mathematical principles. His methods have inspired many students to pursue further studies and careers in mathematics.

He earned a Doctor of Philosophy in Education and Mathematics, with concentrations in mathematics education and educational psychology, from the University of New Mexico in 1980. His academic background provided a strong foundation for his work in both teaching and research design.

Throughout his career, Dr. Martinez taught at the University of New Mexico until his retirement in 2012 and also held earlier teaching roles at the University of Albuquerque. Over the years, he became widely respected for his engaging teaching style and dedication to supporting student achievement.

In addition to his work in the classroom, Dr. Martinez is an accomplished author, having written eight books and more than 200 published articles. His book Math Without Fear, along with other works including those coauthored with his late wife Nancy, reflects his mission to make mathematics more approachable and less intimidating for students.

Dr. Martinez credits his wife, Nancy, as a key influence in refining his teaching philosophy and instructional methods. Her support and insight played an important role in shaping his approach to education.

Looking ahead, Dr. Martinez is exploring opportunities to expand his educational outreach, particularly within Orthodox Jewish communities. Guided by a philosophy that anyone can learn mathematics with the right support and instruction, he remains committed to sharing his knowledge and helping others overcome challenges in learning.

ENGLEWOOD CLIFFS, N.J., Oct. 2, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- LG Electronics (LG) announced a partnership with digital games leader Miniclip to launch the global hit mobile game 8 Ball Pool on LG Smart TVs, marking its first availability on the big screen. Recognized by Guinness World Records as the most downloaded mobile pool game, with more than 1 billion downloads worldwide, 8 Ball Pool will be available free-to-play on LG Smart TVs and monitors running webOS 6.0 and above in 165 countries, starting this week.

Bringing 8 Ball Pool to TV Screens

For its big-screen at-home debut, 8 Ball Pool has been optimized for the webOS platform with a dynamic user interface, allowing players to aim, adjust power and shoot with intuitive precision using the LG Magic Remote. The game also offers optional in-game items for purchase, adding opportunities for fun and personalization.

Recognizing the TV's unique role as the centerpiece of living room entertainment, LG and Miniclip are introducing the all-new Couch Play Mode, an exclusive feature for this release. This specialized mode adds 1-on-1 multiplayer gameplay, allowing two users to compete head-to-head on the same screen and bringing family and friends together for shared, competitive fun from the comfort of the sofa. To celebrate the launch, LG and Miniclip are offering exclusive items specially designed for LG TV users.

The game can be accessed via LG Apps or the LG Gaming Portal. In the Gaming Portal, users can also collect special rewards, such as badges in My Page, by completing tasks.

Advancing High-Quality Free Gaming to TV Screens

The launch of 8 Ball Pool further reinforces LG's continued momentum in TV gaming, bringing one of the most recognizable casual gaming experiences to the connected TV screen. With high-quality graphics, intuitive gameplay and free access, the title is expected to help drive stronger engagement across LG's gaming platform and support the continued evolution of CTV gaming into a more mainstream entertainment experience.

LG has tripled the number of web-based gaming titles available across its platform over the last two years1, expanding its library to more than 1,000 free-to-play games. This expanded library has contributed to stronger user engagement, with overall gaming usage increasing by 67 percent year over year2. Total hours played grew by 71 percent, while individual gaming sessions rose by 50 percent, underscoring the growing role of LG Smart TVs as an entertainment and gaming destination.

Delivering a Life-Size Experience at Home

On LG's screens over 100 inches, including LG's latest QNED evo and Micro RGB TVs, 8 Ball Pool comes to life at real-world scale3, creating an immersive at-home experience that players can enjoy with just a remote controller.

"Through this partnership, LG continues to expand its free premium gaming ecosystem on the webOS platform," said Chris Jo, head of the webOS Platform Business Center at the LG Media Entertainment Solution Company. "With new hit titles customized for big-screen players, LG is transforming the traditional TV into an interactive hub for home entertainment."

LG remains committed to enhancing LG Gaming Portal with compelling, new titles and convenient features, enabling users to enjoy the excitement of big-screen gaming directly on LG Smart TVs and Smart Monitors. To learn more, visit LG.com.

1 Based on internal data for Jan 2024 ~ May 2026.

2.Based on internal data for June 2025 ~ June 2026.

3 Real-life size measurements based on 7-foot ball pool

LG Electronics USA Inc., based in Englewood Cliffs, N.J., is the North American subsidiary of LG Electronics Inc., a smart life solutions company with annual global revenues of more than $60 billion. In the United States, LG sells a wide range of innovative home appliances, home entertainment products, commercial displays, air conditioning systems and vehicle components. LG is an 11-time ENERGY STAR® Partner of the Year. www.LG.com.  For more news and stories about LG products and innovations, please visit the LG USA Newsroom at www.lg.com/us/newsroom.

The webOS platform has powered LG TVs for over a decade, earning acclaim for its user-friendly interface that allows for easy navigation and customization. With a growing ecosystem of global partners and audience-centric content delivered via services such as free ad-supported streaming TV LG Channels, LG Gallery+, LG Gaming Portal, LG Sports Portal and more, webOS is set to drive LG's future growth across multiple devices and out-of-home experiences. releases.title: MEDIA ADVISORY - 2026 provincial election: practical information on voter turnout, counting of the votes and publication of results
releases.body:
QUÉBEC CITY, Oct. 2, 2026 /CNW/ -- On October 5, Élections Québec will release several statistics eagerly awaited by the media.

Recording images at polling places

Media representatives may visit polling places to take photos and videos, but they must comply with the established rules. Election officers are not authorized to grant interviews.

Preliminary voter turnout

We will update the preliminary voter turnout twice. We will do so first around noon and a second time around 5 p.m.

In 2022, the preliminary turnout reported at noon was 29.20%. The turnout reported at 5 p.m. was 44.63%.

The final voter turnout was 66.15%.

Preliminary results on election night

Preliminary results will be released as the counting of the votes progresses on our website and in our open data. Data will be updated every two to five minutes.

The counting of the votes begins when all electors present in a polling place at closing time (8 p.m.) have voted and left the premises. Election officers count the votes cast manually at the polling station for which they are responsible. The pace of reporting depends on several factors, including the volume of ballots to count; we therefore cannot determine at what time the counting of the votes will end.

Advance poll

The counting of the votes cast at advance polls may begin as early as 6 p.m. That is why we can release the first results within an hour of the polling stations closing. But even if the votes in some ballot boxes have already been counted, between 6 p.m. and 8 p.m., no results can be released until the polling stations close at 8 p.m. because the election is not ended yet.

Thus, the results for most votes cast before election day will be released early in the evening. However, because some ballot boxes will be counted later, we cannot guarantee that all advance poll results will be disclosed early in the evening.

Given the high popularity of advance polling in certain electoral divisions, their first results might be released later than those of electoral divisions where advance polling is less popular.

Îles-de-la-Madeleine

Results for the Îles-de-la-Madeleine electoral division will be released at the same time as results for the rest of Québec, starting at 8 p.m., Eastern Time.

In Îles-de-la-Madeleine, polling stations are open from 9:30 a.m. to 8 p.m., Atlantic Time. They therefore close at 7 p.m., Eastern Time. However, because voting is not over elsewhere in Québec, the returning officer for this electoral division will wait until 9 p.m., Atlantic Time, before transmitting any results.

Voting by mail

During Québec elections, voting by mail is reserved for electors who are located in certain remote regions, in correctional institutions or outside Québec, temporarily. These ballot papers are all counted at the head office of Élections Québec.

Generally speaking, the number of votes by mail is low. In 2022, it represented 0.11% of the total number of votes cast in the general election.

Addition of the votes

On election night, the results are preliminary. They will be confirmed during the addition of the votes, which usually takes place the following morning, around 9 a.m., or when all ballot boxes have been returned to the office of the returning officer for each electoral division.

During the addition of the votes, the returning officer examines the statements of votes for each ballot box. They make sure that the results entered on the statements correspond to the results released on election night. If the returning officer notes a discrepancy between the information released on election night and the copies of the statement, they correct the results. The contents of the ballot boxes are not counted again.

At the end of the addition, the results are official. The ballot boxes are then closed and sealed.

Judicial recount

Generally, the results make it very clear who has been elected. But in certain contexts, ballot papers must be recounted during a judicial recount. 

Élections Québec cannot, on its own initiative, open a ballot box to validate the outcome of an election.

The Election Act provides for a four-day period following the addition of the votes during which a person may file a request for a judicial recount with the Court of Québec. The four-day period is calculated excluding any Saturday, Sunday or holiday. A judge must then grant or deny the request based on the grounds presented.

In electoral divisions where the addition of the votes takes place on October 6, the deadline to request a judicial recount will be October 13.

Three scenarios can lead to a judicial recount following a provincial election:

  • It takes place automatically if the first-place candidates have the same number of votes at the end of the addition of the votes.
  • The second-place candidate may request one if the difference in votes separating them from first place is less than 1/1000 of the votes cast.
  • Any person may file a request if they have reasonable grounds to believe that a deputy returning officer or the returning officer has unlawfully counted or rejected ballot papers or drawn up an incorrect statement of votes.

When a request for a judicial recount is filed and granted by the court, a judge oversees the recount of the votes. The counting of the votes must begin within four days of the judgment granting the request.

Declaration of election and final results

Following the four-day period, or once the court confirms the result of the votes, the returning officer declares that the candidate who received the most votes has been elected.

In most electoral divisions, the declaration of election will take place on Wednesday, October 14, due to the Thanksgiving holiday on Monday, October 12.

We retain all ballot papers, statements of votes and poll books for one year. They remain under seal; no one can access them, except the courts, if necessary.

Other statistics

  • Voter turnout history
  • Statistics on candidates – October 5, 2026

About Élections Québec

Élections Québec is a non-partisan and independent institution striving to ensure the integrity, transparency, and reliability of elections and to contribute to the vitality of the Québec democracy.

In practical terms, the institution organizes provincial elections in cooperation with the returning officers of Québec's 127 electoral divisions. In addition, it designs and offers several democracy education programs; it ensures compliance with the rules on political financing; and it acts as a public prosecutor to ensure compliance with Québec's electoral laws.

Our website includes a section for the media.

To receive our press releases by email, subscribe to our newsletter.

SOURCE Élections Québec

releases.title: Mally Mall Produces Five Tracks on Seyi Vibez's SWAGUU, Spotify's No. 1 Global Album Debut
releases.body:
Mally Mall Produces Five Tracks on Seyi Vibez's SWAGUU, No. 1 on Spotify's Top Albums Debut Global Chart. Led by "Back 2 U," the producer's contributions bring personal storytelling and shared purpose to Seyi Vibez's chart-topping album.

LAS VEGAS, Oct. 1, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Mally Mall's collaboration with Seyi Vibez spans five songs on the 14-track album SWAGUU, connecting Africa and America through music.

On Spotify's daily Nigeria songs chart, "Back 2 U" reached No. 1, "Diamonds" No. 4, "Melanin" No. 8, "SWAGUU" (ft. Quavo) No. 10, and "Alafia" No. 13. The album reached No. 1 on Apple Music's Top Albums chart in Nigeria and debuted at No. 1 on Spotify's Top Albums Debut Global chart.

Responding to "Back 2 U," Seyi Vibez told Mally Mall:

"Big Mall, I love this. I need this. This connects to my people. Let's do this for the kids in Africa."

For Mally Mall, the song means more than chart success. He says a special woman inspired it and reminds him that wherever life takes him, his soul will lead him back to her.

His idea for the children's melody represents the heart, innocence and future of Africa, grounding the record in family, culture and connection.

"I'm grateful to Seyi for trusting me with music that means so much to him and his people," said Mally Mall. "He heard 'Back 2 U' and immediately understood the feeling behind it. I'm proud of the team who helped bring these records to life—KT, Kyle, Swam and Christopher—and grateful to Burna Boy for the vision he brought to the album. Seeing the songs connect in Nigeria means a lot to all of us. We made this together."

Mally Mall produced "SWAGUU" with KT and Kyle, and "Back 2 U" alongside Swam, with Christopher Dotson credited as a writer. He also produced "Diamonds," "Melanin," and "Alafia." Burna Boy served as executive producer.

Calling Seyi "the Champion," Mally envisions a bridge between Africa and America. His relationship with humanitarian Daphna Ziman also inspires his interest in connecting music and artists with a greater purpose. Ziman founded Justice for Women International. No joint project has been announced.

SWAGUU was released in September 2026 by NSNV INC / EMPIRE. "Back 2 U" was released as a single in August 2026.

releases.body:
• With losses hitting $406 million a day, 30+ groups launch United to Stop Online Scams with a National Day of Action livestream and events in seven states.



  • New Motion Picture & Television Fund PSA featuring scam survivor Kate Kleinert debuts



  • Coalition letter calls on Congress to shift the burden from consumers to platforms

LOS ANGELES, Oct. 1, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- While tech leaders warn AI could someday threaten humanity, online scams turbocharged by AI are draining Americans' savings today. United to Stop Online Scams, a new coalition of consumer, older adult, and tech accountability groups, says it's time to hold the platforms accountable.

The kickoff livestream, viewed by over 20,000 Americans, featured scam survivor Kate Kleinert, Senator Mark Kelly (D-Ariz.), Representative Valerie Foushee (D-N.C.), California Business and Consumer Services Secretary Rohit Chopra, and consumer policy experts.

Americans lost an estimated $148.2 billion nationally in 2025, an average of $406 million a day, to online scams and crimes in 2025, according to the Consumer Federation of America. The FBI reported that losses for Americans 60 and over rose 59%, averaging $38,500 per complaint.

The broader call for action is closely aligned with StopScamsTogether.org, the Motion Picture & Television Fund (MPTF) initiative in partnership with the Entertainment Industry Foundation (EIF), including a PSA featuring Kleinert, which demonstrates how AI voice cloning and deepfake video can make deception more convincing and harder to detect (video clips and shareable graphics here).

"So many of us scam survivors carry so much shame," said Kleinert, a Pennsylvania widow who lost $39,000 to a Facebook romance scammer. "I am here to tell you: It is not on you. It is on them. Meta and the AI companies are counting on survivors being quiet. We can't be."

"AI is making scams more sophisticated, and older Americans are particularly vulnerable, losing hard-earned retirement savings to criminals online," said Senator Kelly. "Older Americans shouldn't be an afterthought as this technology evolves. I'll keep fighting to keep them safe."

More than 30 organizations signed a letter to Congress urging lawmakers to examine how platforms profit from scams and to make fraud prevention a legal obligation rather than a voluntary one.

Fans Can Vote for the Award-Winning Podcast in Science, Interview or Talk Show, Thought Leadership and Best Video Podcast Co-Host Team Categories

LOS ANGELES, Oct. 1, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Science of Perception Box™, the award-winning podcast produced by Unlikely Collaborators in partnership with Pod People, has been named a finalist in four categories at the 2026 Signal Awards, which recognize excellence and innovation in podcasting.

Science of Perception Box earns four 2026 Signal Awards finalist nominations.

The weekly video and audio series, produced by Unlikely Collaborators in partnership with Pod People and hosted by neuroscientist and clinical psychologist Dr. Heather Berlin and consciousness researcher Dr. Christof Koch, is nominated in the following categories:

  • Genre – Interview or Talk Show: Vote for Science of Perception Box
  • Genre – Science: Vote for Science of Perception Box
  • Genre – Thought Leadership: Vote for Science of Perception Box
  • Video Podcast – Best Video Podcast Co-Host Team: Vote for Science of Perception Box

The nominations come during the podcast's second season, which features conversations with leading scientists, thinkers and authors including Mel Robbins, Andrew Huberman, Sam Harris, Michio Kaku, Lisa Feldman Barrett, Scott Barry Kaufman, Anil Seth, Steven Pinker, Elissa Epel and Camilo Ortiz.

Through these conversations, Science of Perception Box explores the science behind how beliefs, expectations, past experiences and neural wiring shape the way we experience ourselves and the world around us. The series is inspired by the Perception Box framework developed by Elizabeth R. Koch, Founder and CEO of Unlikely Collaborators.

Public voting for the Signal Awards Listener's Choice honors is open now through October 15, 2026. Fans of Science of Perception Box are encouraged to cast their votes in all four categories. Winners will be announced October 20.

Science of Perception Box is available on YouTube, Spotify, Apple Podcasts, Amazon Music and all major podcast platforms.

About Science of Perception Box

Join Dr. Heather Berlin and Dr. Christof Koch on the award-winning, top-ranked Science of Perception Box. Through engaging conversations with leading experts, the show explores how perception shapes reality and how expanding awareness can transform the way we live.

Each episode dives into the groundbreaking Perception Box™ framework, developed by Elizabeth R. Koch, which explores how our internal and external worlds interact to shape our lived experience. The series reveals how our Perception Box expands in states like awe, curiosity, and love, and contracts under fear, anxiety, and anger.

From mindfulness and emotional awareness to parenting and peak performance, Science of Perception Box equips audiences with actionable, science-backed insights to challenge assumptions and expand awareness.

releases.title: Horizon Media Expands HorizonOS Labs with Third Cohort, Bringing New Partners into its Open Ecosystem to Tackle Marketers' Growth Challenges
releases.body:
Cohort 3 Reflects Market Acceleration and Client Priorities as Marketing Technology Shifts From Insight to Action

NEW YORK, Oct. 1, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Horizon Media today unveiled 11 companies named to the third cohort of HorizonOS Labs, the agency's structured innovation accelerator. With more than 50 partners having gone through the program, Horizon serves as a curator of emerging technology, simplifying the often time-consuming process of identifying, testing and scaling solutions so clients can build bespoke operating platforms around their unique business challenges. The program is designed to distinguish viable innovation from vendor promises through a transparent, client-centric process focused on real-world application.

"The market is moving faster than annual technology reviews can accommodate," said John Koenigsberg, EVP and Head of Platform Partnerships at Horizon Media Holdings. "One clear shift emerged from Cohort 3: the vast majority of partners are focused on growth, closing the loop between surfacing, modeling and finding – and actually driving action. What makes these capabilities valuable isn't any one of them alone, but what happens when they connect with each other and with what a brand already knows."

Cohort 3 is organized around three Growth Frontiers. They include: 

  • Unlocking Growth from the Customers You Already Know. Brands can now understand the people already connected to them far more deeply than before, and act on that understanding in the same motion, across the channels they own and the media they buy. 



  • Creative Supply at the Speed of Everything Else. Precision in targeting and measurement has raised what creative can be asked to do, and production has caught up—generating, versioning and governing at the volume a channel actually requires. 



  • Winning Customers When Machines Shape Discovery. More of the journey now runs through machines: search that answers rather than lists, assistants that shop, screens that decide what comes next. Presence in those spaces is earned differently, and it can now be measured, shaped and acted on. 

Each frontier unifies what was once fragmented: paid, owned and consumer insight; media and creative; and human strategy and intelligent workflows. The 11 Cohort 3 partners, chosen from more than 600 RFI submissions, reflect Horizon's commitment to an open ecosystem where clients can access best fit technologies without vendor lock-in or proprietary constraints.

The 11 were selected on what they can do: how readily they connect to the systems a client already operates, their willingness to work alongside other companies in the cohort, and concrete evidence that the work drives business outcomes.

"AI is changing the rules for how brands grow," said Bob Lord, President of Horizon Media Holdings. "The brands that will drive growth aren't looking for a better way to buy media. They're solving for customer value by building an operating platform that brings their data, customers, technology and people together around the problems that matter most to their business. There's no off-the-shelf answer to that. Horizon is committed to bringing the open ecosystem together to build the right capabilities for each customer."

The Cohort 3 Partners — Grouped by Growth Frontier — Include:

Unlocking Growth from the Customers You Already Know

  • SQREEM: SQREEM is a behavioral intelligence platform that builds real‑time, predictive audience and intent models from massive volumes of unstructured digital data (web, app, social, video) rather than relying on predefined segments or static taxonomies. 



  • Aaru: Aaru is a statistical simulation engine for predicting human behavior. Our platform enables organizations to test products, messaging, and strategies with simulated respondents to understand how people will react before making real-world decisions

    .
  • Zenapse: Zenapse is an emotionally intelligent, agentic marketing platform, purpose-built to quickly drive business outcomes through goal-based conversion optimization, personalization and data — all within existing media and workflows.



  • Hightouch: Hightouch is an agentic marketing platform where AI agents and marketing teams work together to brief, create, review, and launch campaigns across 300+ channels, guided by a shared "marketing brain" that learns from your brand, customer data, and every campaign's results.

Creative Supply at the Speed of Everything Else

  • AdGreetz: AdGreetz offers DCO+®, which personalizes any ad into unlimited, relevant, data-driven versions served to each viewer and AdChef®, which orchestrates 50+ AI models with Proprietary Creative Agents to generate original, broadcast-quality video, display, UGC/influencer, rich media, carousel and product ads from a brief, URL or prompt in minutes.



  • Storyteq: ITG is an AI-enabled content company that helps global brands deliver personalized content at scale. Powered by our Storyteq platform, ITG combines technology, data and production expertise to lower costs and lift ROAS by up to 300%. 



  • Anoki: Anoki AI is the contextual video intelligence company advancing CTV with ContextIQ and its award-winning AI Marketing Co-Pilot, helping every ad find its perfect home, scene by scene.

Winning Customers When Machines Shape Discovery

  • Bluefish: Bluefish is the Agentic Marketing Platform (AMP) for the Fortune 500.



  • EmberOS: emberos, the Operating System for AI brand management, shows brands what AI is about to say about them, helps them change it at the source, and proves the change worked.



  • Olyzon: Olyzon is an agentic orchestration layer for advertising: its agents connect to any buying interface through open protocols to plan, activate and optimize across platforms, starting with CTV and extending to YouTube, Social, DOOH and Audio, live today across managed accounts.



  • Fuse: FUSE+Emet is the truth infrastructure layer for AI data systems. AI doesn't know when it's wrong. Emet does.

The Cohort 3 partners will be showcased at an in-person event in New York on October 1, where they will present to Horizon clients and engage in discussions around potential pilot deployments. Following the showcase, partners will be matched with interested client brands to scope and advance specific pilots, with client participation helping determine which opportunities move forward. 

Looking ahead, HorizonOS Labs will open its next RFI process in early 2027.

About Horizon Media Holdings

Horizon Media Holdings is the privately-held parent company of Horizon Media, the largest U.S. media agency and the largest independent globally, with additional portfolio companies including – Horizon Next (full-service marketing); Horizon Commerce (commerce and digital experiences); Horizon Business (consulting, media and creative); One Horizon (full-service advertising); HS&E (sports and experiential); and Blue Hour Studios (influencer agency). Horizon Media Holdings has a 50/50 partnership with Havas Media Network in the performance-driven agency network, Horizon Global. Horizon Holdings drives enterprise-level innovation, fosters collaboration across its portfolio, and explores new growth opportunities and technology solutions to help its clients navigate the shifting marketing challenges of today and tomorrow.

FBN Expands "The Big Money" Franchise with "Big Money in the Morning" Hosted by Dagen McDowell, Brian Brenberg, Taylor Riggs with Barron's Josh Schafer

Liz Claman to Launch New Friday Night Program "Claman's Power Players"

NEW YORK, Oct. 1, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- FOX Business Network (FBN) will unveil a new weekday programming lineup beginning on Monday, October 12th, announced FOX News Media President and Executive Editor Jay Wallace.

FBN will launch Big Money in the Morning (6-9AM/ET) hosted by Dagen McDowell, Brian Brenberg and Taylor Riggs with Barron's Josh Schafer. The Bottom Line will conclude its 6PM/ET run as McDowell and Brenberg transition to the morning show, with encore episodes of FBN's Kudlow taking over the 6 PM/ET timeslot. The Big Money Show (12-2PM/ET) will add rotating co-hosts Cheryl Casone, Marcus Lemonis, and Lou Basenese alongside current host Jackie DeAngelis. Additionally, Liz Claman will launch a new Friday night program entitled Claman's Power Players (7-7:30 PM/ET).

In making the announcement, Wallace said, "We're excited to bring viewers fresh programming from a seasoned team of journalists, offering expert insight and analysis on the forces shaping the economy and driving business news. FOX Business remains committed to delivering compelling business news, market analysis, and conversation throughout the day, and these changes will further strengthen our weekday lineup."

Claman's Power Players (Fridays, 7-7:30PM/ET) will feature industry titans, business leaders and creators on what will move Wall Street and Main Street in the week ahead. Since joining FBN as an anchor when the network launched in October 2007, Claman has conducted exclusive interviews with Tesla and SpaceX CEO Elon Musk, Apple's Tim Cook, JP Morgan CEO Jamie Dimon, world leaders, nearly every U.S. Treasury Secretary as well as celebrities and athletes about their business ventures. Notably, her first interview on FBN in 2007 was with legendary investor Warren Buffett. Her afternoon program The Claman Countdown routinely ranks among the top ten shows in all of financial news and has become a premier destination for CEOs, business leaders, and influential voices shaping the global economy. Claman also hosts the FOX News Podcast Everybody Talks to Liz Claman featuring today's most successful business leaders, entrepreneurs and executives that discuss motivational stories about their journey.

Featuring a mix of breaking business news, debate and analysis, Big Money in the Morning will provide a comprehensive look at the issues driving the market to help viewers navigate the forces shaping their financial future ahead of the trading day. McDowell joined FOX News Channel in 2003 and was a founding anchor of FBN when the channel launched in 2007. She previously served as a business day and evening anchor and throughout her career has conducted several news-generating interviews, including most recently with First Lady Melania Trump on The Big Money Show, as well as former Treasury Secretary Henry Paulson, former Secretary of State and First Lady Hillary Clinton, financier Charles Schwab and former Labor Secretary Eugene Scalia.

Brenberg joined FBN in 2020 and has co-hosted The Big Money Show and The Bottom Line. Prior to this, he served as an Associate Professor and Chair of the Program in Business and Finance at The King's College in New York City and worked in financial services and public policy research. Riggs joined FBN in 2022 from Bloomberg where she co-anchored a daily program covering equities, bonds, currencies, and commodities. She also led Bloomberg's cross-asset market coverage and was a municipal bond reporter. Schafer currently serves as a contributor across FBN and serves as Barron's Investor Circle Newsletter Editor. Prior to joining Barron's, he covered markets and the economy at Yahoo Finance. 

Since launching in 2023, The Big Money Show has offered viewers a fast-paced look at the trading day covering topics ranging from Wall Street markets to personal finance. Current host Jackie DeAngelis will be joined by Cheryl Casone and FBN contributors Marcus Lemonis and Lou Basenese who will serve as rotating co-hosts of the program. Casone was part of the team that launched FBN in 2007, previously serving as an anchor across the network's dayparts while providing financial analysis across FOX News Media's platforms, including the weekly job reports. She also hosted American Dream Home on FOX Nation. DeAngelis has co-hosted The Big Money Show since 2023. Prior to joining FBN in 2019, she spent 13 years at CNBC as the network's chief energy correspondent and later served as the anchor of Yahoo Finance's midday program.

Lemonis is a successful entrepreneur who has provided analysis on business and economic issues as a contributor across FBN and all FOX News Media platforms since joining FOX earlier this year. He is the executive chairman and CEO of Beyond where he has helped spearhead the transformation of the iconic Bed Bath & Beyond and Buy Buy Baby brands into a global e-commerce leader. Previously, he hosted The Profit on CNBC, which earned Critics Choice and Reality Television Award nominations. Basenese joined FBN in 2025 and provides financial analysis across the network. He also serves as executive vice president of market strategy at Prairie Operating Co (PROP) and is the founder of the financial news site, TheBigSkinny.com.

Headquartered in New York — the business capital of the world — FBN launched in October 2007 and is currently the top business channel on television. The network is available in more than 60 million homes in all markets across the United States and live streamed on FOX One. Super Girl Brings Free Women's Surf, Sports, Music and Lifestyle Festival to Jacksonville Beach Nov. 7-8

Super Girl's 20th Season Concludes with Elite Women's Surfing, 1,500+ Female Athletes Across 10 Sports and a Free Music Festival featuring 15 Artists

JACKSONVILLE BEACH, Fla., Oct. 1, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Following events in August and September, ASA Entertainment's Super Girl Surf Festival presented by Jersey Mike's will return to Jacksonville Beach Nov. 7–8 for the final stop of its milestone 20th season, bringing two days of women's surf, sports, live music, wellness and entertainment to the Jacksonville community. 

This summer, Super Girl celebrated its 20th year in Oceanside, California, and Virginia Beach, Virginia, continuing its longstanding mission to provide women in sports, music and entertainment with a platform to inspire, uplift and empower the next generation.

Now in its sixth year in Jacksonville Beach, this nationally televised festival will feature more than 1,500 female athletes across 10 sports, a World Surf League (WSL) women's competition, 15 live concerts and an interactive Festival Village featuring 16 free fitness and wellness classes, leadership panels, youth mentorship programs, a female art exhibition, local food and beverage vendors and more than 50 interactive brand activations. All competitions, concerts, classes and event activities are free and open to the public. 

"After two successful stops on the West Coast and in the Mid-Atlantic, the excitement heading into Jacksonville Beach is at an all-time high," said Rick Bratman, CEO of ASA Entertainment and Founder of the Super Girl Festival Series. "The level of female talent coming together across surfing, sports and music is remarkable, and we can't wait to bring that energy to Jacksonville as we close out an incredible 20th year celebration."

SUPER GIRL CONCERT SERIES: The weekend will feature 15 free live performances, headlined by Switchfoot, Lupe Fiasco, B.o.B and Gym Class Heroes. The lineup also spotlights a list of incredible female artists, including Emily Zeck, ANORA, Hello Sister, Flailing Idiot, McKenzi Brooke, Annie Dukes, Grom & The Jacks, Kalani Rose & The Vibe, Dove Bomb and Lucy Spotts.

PRO WOMEN'S SURFING RETURNS TO JACKSONVILLE BEACH: A World Surf League (WSL) QS2000 women's competition returns to the Jacksonville Beach Pier with a field expected to include former Super Girl champions Eden Walla, Kirra Pinkerton, Leilani McGonagle, Sage Erickson, U.S. Olympian Bryce Wettstein, local standout Lanea Mons and some of Florida's top rising surfers.

NEW THIS YEAR: Jacksonville Beach will welcome professional freestyle trampolining hosted by the Freestyle Trampoline Association, bringing a new high-energy competition to the festival as part of Super Girl's 20th anniversary season. The weekend will also mark the conclusion of the inaugural Quest for the Cape, with select athletes completing the three-stop points race spanning Oceanside, Virginia Beach and Jacksonville Beach to earn the coveted Super Girl cape.

Festival admission is free, with advance online registration required for concert access. Entry is first-come, first-served until capacity is reached. Premium VIP Packages are also available, featuring pit access, complimentary food and beverages, private VIP bars, shaded and elevated seating, deluxe restrooms and private entry.

The event is proudly supported by Jersey Mike's Subs, Visit Jacksonville, Florida Blue, Monster Energy, Sun Cruiser, SEAGLASS Wines, Atlantic Self Storage, SpringHill Suites Oceanfront, Athletic Brewing, Botanic Tonics, Rancho La Gloria, SG REVIVE, Body Glove, The Local, Mad Hippie and additional partners.

The surf competition will run at the Jacksonville Beach Pier from 8 a.m. to 4 p.m. both days. The Festival Village at SeaWalk Pavilion and Latham Plaza will run Saturday (Nov. 7) from 11 a.m. to 10 p.m. and Sunday (Nov. 8) from 11 a.m. to 8 p.m.

The event will be televised from January 10 to April 30 on 28 national and regional broadcast partners, and will be streamed live on Nov. 7 - 8 from 8 a.m. to 4 p.m. EST via 8 digital partners, including at www.supergirljax.com and twitch.tv/supergirlseries.

For schedules, concert information, concert registrations, sports competitions and more, visit supergirljax.com and follow @supergirlpro on social media.

ABOUT SUPER GIRL: The Super Girl Festival Series spans three annual sports, music, and lifestyle festivals across the West Coast, Southeast, and Mid-Atlantic with a mission to create athletic, social, cultural, educational and entertainment opportunities for women.

ASA's events span surfing, skateboarding, BMX, inline skating, freestyle motocross, snowboarding, esports and music, with content distributed globally. Season 3 of the original series, produced by HMPG in an exclusive partnership with VoLo Foundation, will premiere on Saturday, October 3. The 30-minute weekly eco-adventure show, hosted by international explorer Zay Harding, takes viewers around the world to showcase the remarkable scientists, engineers and everyday people who are creating sustainable environmental solutions. The series airs weekend mornings as part of the "CBS WKND" educational/informational (E/I) programming block (times vary; check local listings).

This season, Harding continues his international journey to meet the innovators, advocates and changemakers tackling the planet's biggest environmental challenges. Featured guests include award-winning actor Edward Norton; former Arizona Cardinals offensive lineman and clean-water and ocean-conservation advocate Kelvin Beachum; NASCAR driver Austin Green, who goes behind the wheel to test cutting-edge racing technology on the track; and Luci Baines Johnson, who carries forward her mother Lady Bird Johnson's environmental legacy. From the Great Barrier Reef to America's ports, racetracks and wildflower fields, The Visioneers introduces audiences to the people and bold ideas reshaping our planet's future.

"The future isn't something we wait for. It's being built right now, often in places we'd never expect. The Visioneers shows that the solutions to our biggest challenges are already in the hands of people with the courage to imagine a better world and the determination to make it real. They just need someone to tell their stories. That's exactly what we do, and with our third season, we're proud to bring these changemakers into homes every Saturday morning," said Thais Lopez V., president of VoLo Foundation.

"Alongside our partners at VoLo Foundation, we're proud to bring audiences two more seasons of The Visioneers," said Bryan Curb, president of HMPG. "The show has struck a real chord with viewers, sharing stories that prove environmental stewardship can take many forms — and that building a more sustainable future can be an engaging, hands-on adventure."

HMPG's current program portfolio comprises more than 30 original series and hundreds of hours of content annually on leading broadcast networks and station groups and on connected TV and streaming platforms. It has a library of 85 series (6,000 episodes) and its content can be found in 100 countries.

About VoLo Foundation

VoLo Foundation is a private nonprofit organization with a mission to accelerate change and global impact by supporting science-based climate solutions, enhancing education, and improving health. Learn more at volofoundation.org.

About Hearst Media Production Group

Hearst Media Production Group (HMPG), a business unit of Hearst Television, is an independent producer and distributor of original programming for TV stations, broadcast and cable networks and streaming services. HMPG produces hundreds of hours of Emmy® Award-winning programming annually across linear, streaming, digital and social media platforms for domestic and international distribution in 100 countries. Its popular weekly educational/informational (E/I) programming blocks air weekends nationwide including "Weekend Adventure," on ABC stations; "CBS WKND," on the CBS Network; "The More You Know," on the NBC Network; "One Magnificent Morning," on the CW Network; "Mi Telemundo" on the Telemundo Network and "Go Time" on independent stations. HMPG also produces and/or distributes a diverse slate of other programming and content including the company's dedicated FAST channels Xplore, The Jack Hanna Channel, Rovr Pets, and Lucky Dog Channel, available on some of the most popular smart TVs and streaming platforms. releases.body:

WASHINGTON, Oct. 1, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- The 4th Annual HBCU First LOOK Film & TV Festival (HBCUFLF) returns to Howard University November 5 -7, with STARZ as its inaugural presenting sponsor.

Under the theme "How to Be the Next," the three-day Festival will create an immersive experience connecting students and emerging creators with HBCU alumni actors, filmmakers, producers and industry leaders through screenings, master classes and interactive, hands-on sessions.

Actors and content creators Laya DeLeon Hayes (Doc McStuffins, Why Did I Get Married Again) and DaSan Frazier (Tough Love: Atlanta, Straw) will serve as the festival's 2026 I Aspire Ambassadors and host the Salute THEM Awards luncheon, where winners of the HBCU First LOOK Film Challenge, selected from more than 450 entries, will be announced and awarded $5,000 and internship opportunity.

The luncheon will also celebrate the 2026 I Aspire 25, recognizing HBCU alumni across five categories: Visionaries, Changemakers, Storytellers, Filmmakers and Entrepreneurs. This year's honorees include Michael Strahan, Eva Marcille, Jamila Mustafa, Colby Muhammad Nixon and Tone Bell, among others.

HBCU First LOOK's growing network of entertainment, media and brand partners is central to its professional development mission, helping build the pipeline of HBCU talent through industry insight, direct interaction and career-building opportunities.

STARZ, home to the critically acclaimed and award-winning drama "P-Valley" and the iconic "Power" franchise, continues to take the lead by creating opportunities for women and underrepresented audiences in front of and behind the camera. The network will participate in key programming during the festival, further underscoring its commitment to supporting diverse talent and emerging storytellers.

As one of the founding sponsors of the Festival, ANDSCAPE will celebrate its 10th anniversary, highlighting a decade of powerful storytelling at the intersection of sports and culture. The celebration will feature a special Clips & Conversations tribute with award-winning producers, Sheila Matthews and Jesse Washington, showcasing memorable stories and ANDSCAPE's cultural impact.

The 2026 lineup includes producer Autumn Bailey-Ford, who will examine the increasingly global nature of film production, and actress and filmmaker Nicky Micheaux, who will lead a master class on the rise of vertical storytelling. Grammy Award-winning producers Jimmy Jam & Terry Lewis will explore the relationship between music and film.

Creator-focused sessions will feature Alexis Powell, creator of The Jennifer Hudson Show's viral "hit" Spirit Tunnel; Howard University alumnae and content creators Jade & Jadah; media personality Jamila Mustafa; and independent filmmakers and producers the Vanzant Brothers.  Actress and I Aspire 25 honoree Kennedi Reece, who appears on CBS' Beyond the Gates and featured in Netflix's upcoming A Different World reboot, will participate on a leading lady panel.

New this year, aspireTV hosts a Clips & Conversation spotlighting its expansion into original scripted programming with New State of Mind, an HBCU-set comedy from producer Bentley Kyle Evans that follows first-year students navigating college life.

"HBCU First LOOK was created to build a pipeline that turns exposure into experience," said Sheila Eldridge, founder of the HBCU First LOOK Film & TV Festival. "This year, 12 Howard University students are helping produce the festival, lending a direct voice to programming and interactive elements presented. It's truly produced by students, for students—giving them a seat at the table and an active role in bringing the festival to life."

Black Girl Vitamins will host Fueling Your Future; a two-day wellness and career activation centered on how physical well-being supports the sustainability needed for creative careers.  TV One returns with a 'red carpet' readiness experience supports Micheaux's master class on vertical storytelling.

Additional partners include HBCUgo.tv, Storytellers Lab, Café Mocha Network, the Howard University Radio Network and the D.C. Office of Cable Television, Film, Music and Entertainment (OCTFME).

The HBCU First LOOK Film & TV Festival will take place at the Armour J. Blackburn University Center at Howard University, 2397 6th Street NW, Washington, D.C. For registration, programming updates, media coverage and additional information, visit www.hbcufirstlook.com and info@hbcufirstlook.com. 

On all social platforms @HBCUfirstlook  #hbcufirstlook #Elevatefilmmakers #TAKETHELEAD,  #BeTheNext

About HBCU First LOOK Film & TV Festival

Founded by Howard University alumna Sheila Eldridge, the HBCU First LOOK Film & TV  Festival inspires a new generation of diverse talent and storytellers in film, television and broadcasting. The festival provides a platform for emerging creators to showcase their work, connect with executives and build a pipeline of career opportunities while celebrating Black filmmakers rooted in the HBCU culture.

releases.title: FRANK BRIEGMANN PROMOTED TO CHAIRMAN & CEO OF UNIVERSAL MUSIC EUROPE, AUSTRALIA, NEW ZEALAND, CANADA & DEUTSCHE GRAMMOPHON
releases.body:
Proven artist champion combining creative leadership, commercial expertise, and a deep commitment to local culture

New structure will increase agility and create bigger impact for local, regional and global stars

SANTA MONICA, Calif. and BERLIN, Oct. 1, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Universal Music Group, the world's leading music entertainment business, today announced the promotion of Frank Briegmann to Chairman & CEO, Universal Music Europe, Australia, New Zealand, Canada & Deutsche Grammophon. This move brings unified leadership to a diverse group of territories, each with its own rich mix of cultures but sharing enormous potential to develop local talent into regional and global stars. Briegmann will continue to report to Sir Lucian Grainge, Chairman & CEO of Universal Music Group.

Today, artists have the potential to reach audiences around the world from day one. Briegmann has a proven track record of helping them realize that potential, working with leaders across territories to build strong local teams, nurture distinctive music cultures, and develop homegrown talent for success at home, regionally, and globally. Throughout his career, he has also opened up new commercial and creative opportunities for artists, including reimagining Deutsche Grammophon for the modern era.

The new structure is designed to create more opportunities for artists across borders by increasing agility and enabling closer collaboration. In a rapidly evolving music ecosystem, Briegmann's wider remit will help UMG anticipate and embrace change, using technology to amplify expertise, sharpen execution, and bring markets closer together.

Sir Lucian Grainge, Chairman & CEO, Universal Music Group said "Frank and I have worked together for more than 20 years, and he's a fierce artist champion with a proven track record of building long-term careers. He combines creative expertise with business acumen and the insights of data and technology. Just as importantly, he respects what makes every market different and knows how to give great local leaders the freedom and support to succeed. Frank's promotion is all about the power of possibility; making it easier for artists, ideas, and opportunities to travel across borders."

Frank Briegmann said "Great artists can emerge anywhere, and today they can find an audience almost everywhere. That makes strong local expertise more important. Our responsibility is to understand and nurture what makes each market dynamic and distinctive, while giving artists the investment, local expertise, and global reach to realize their full potential. I'm grateful to Lucian for his trust and this new opportunity to take on this broader responsibility. Over the years, I have seen what becomes possible when great local teams work closely together across borders. I look forward to building on that experience with this exceptional group of leaders and creating even more opportunities for artists throughout these markets and around the world."

Briegmann will work closely with the established leadership in each market, including Olivier Nusse who continues as CEO, Universal Music France; Sean Warner who continues as President & CEO, Universal Music Australia & New Zealand; and Julie Adam who continues as President & CEO, Universal Music Canada.

As part of his expanded role, Briegmann will also work with UMG's leadership in Europe, including the U.K. and Iberia, to create stronger connections across markets through technology, data and commerce.

Spain will continue to be led by Luis Fernández, President, Universal Music Spain, and Portugal will continue to be led by Ana Hernandez, Managing Director, Portugal, both reporting to Jesus Lopez.

The United Kingdom will continue to be led by Dickon Stainer, Chairman & CEO, UK, reporting to Sir Lucian Grainge.

Frank Briegmann

The appointment marks the latest step in Briegmann's more than three-decade career in the music industry and expands his international responsibilities.

Briegmann joined Universal Music in 2004 as CEO of its German business, becoming the youngest executive ever to lead a major music company in Germany. His responsibilities have since expanded across Central, Northern and Eastern Europe, alongside his global leadership of Deutsche Grammophon.

Throughout his career, Briegmann has championed local talent and distinctive music cultures, investing in artists and repertoire while helping them reach audiences far beyond their home markets. He has driven digital transformation and built new areas of business, combining strong local expertise with UMG's global reach. At Deutsche Grammophon, he has applied the same approach, combining the stewardship of the world's most renowned classical label with innovation in formats and audience development.

Briegmann is a board member of the Federal Association of the Music Industry. He also serves on Deutsche Bank's Eastern Regional Advisory Board, as well as on the boards of trustees of the renowned C/O Berlin Foundation and the German Sports Aid Foundation (Stiftung Deutsche Sporthilfe).

About Universal Music Group

At Universal Music Group, we exist to shape culture through the power of artistry. UMG is the world leader in music-based entertainment, with a broad array of businesses engaged in recorded music, music publishing, merchandising, and audiovisual content. Featuring the most comprehensive catalogue of recordings and songs across every musical genre, UMG identifies and develops artists and produces and distributes the most critically acclaimed and commercially successful music in the world. Committed to artistry, innovation, and entrepreneurship, UMG fosters the development of services, platforms, and business models in order to broaden artistic and commercial opportunities for our artists and create new experiences for fans. For more information, visit www.universalmusic.com.

releases.title: ALPFA announces the 2026 Scholarship Recipients, investing in the next generation of student leaders
releases.body:
CHARLOTTE, N.C., Oct. 1, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- ALPFA proudly announced the recipients of its 2026 Student Scholarship Program during the 2026 ALPFA Convention, awarding $1.4 million to 334 students in recognition of their academic excellence, leadership, and commitment to making a lasting impact in their communities across North America. This year's scholarship recipients reflect the talent, resilience and ambition shaping the future of business, technology, healthcare, finance, public service and entrepreneurship. With awards ranging from $2,500 to $10,000, the program represents ALPFA's continued investment in expanding access to higher education and professional opportunity.

Join us in expanding pathways to education, opportunity and career growth for the next generation of leaders. Support ALPFA's continued investment in students and communities.

Impact in Action

The ALPFA 2026 Student Scholarship Program awarded $1.4 million to 334 students, representing 122 colleges and universities across 31 states. The recipients included 240 first-generation college students and 203 students across 52 Hispanic-Serving Institutions (HSIs), highlighting the program's reach across institutions serving our communities nationwide.

A Commitment to Opportunity

"At ALPFA, we want every student to see a future where their culture and their career pull in the same direction where who they are becomes a source of strength in who they are becoming. These scholarships help create that future by expanding access to education, opportunity, relationships and experiences that can change the trajectory of a life. We are proudly rooted in Latino culture and open to all, building a community where people can learn from one another, lead authentically and use their success to create opportunity for the people who follow. When we invest in these students, we are investing in the leaders who will help build a better future for all of us." said Damian Rivera, President and CEO of ALPFA

The ALPFA Student Scholarship Program is designed to remove financial barriers to higher education while connecting students to a national network of mentors, corporate partners, and career development opportunities. Reflecting ALPFA's commitment to creating pathways to opportunity, the scholarship program welcomes students across all majors and backgrounds who meet application, academic and enrollment criteria. Beyond academic achievement, recipients are recognized for their leadership, service, resilience, and commitment to advancing their community.

"At ALPFA, investing in our students' education is a commitment to the dreams of our community," said Maria V. Fernandez, Student Programs Manager. "We see education as an accelerator, one that can transform the trajectory of a student's life and create an impact that reaches far beyond any single award. When we invest in them, we are also investing in the people they will mentor, the doors they will open, and the generations that will follow. That is how a scholarship becomes more than financial support. It becomes a lasting legacy of opportunity."

With more than 1,400 applications, the 2026 scholarship recipients represent a diverse group of emerging leaders bringing their own experiences, ambitions and perspectives to the next chapter of their academic and professional journeys. They are pursuing degrees across a wide range of disciplines, including business, engineering, healthcare, technology, and more, reflecting the strength and diversity of multicultural talent across undergraduate, graduate, and community college programs.

Meet the Scholars

Hear directly from some of our scholarship recipients and learn about their experiences here. 

Several recipients shared what receiving an ALPFA scholarship means to them:

"You have given me more than a scholarship—you have given me the confidence to push forward, knowing that I am not just building a career for myself, but a pathway for those who will follow in my footsteps." – Daniela Correa, Hult International Business School



"Beyond the financial support, this recognition serves as a reminder that hard work, perseverance, and community involvement matter. Through ALPFA, I have developed valuable leadership skills, built meaningful relationships, and gained access to opportunities that have shaped my career path. This scholarship motivates me to continue striving for excellence, give back to my community, and create opportunities for others who share similar aspirations." – Lorelys Alvarez, Lehman College CUNY

Creating Pathways for What's Next

The 2026 Student Scholarship Program was made possible through the generous support of our partners, whose commitment helped ALPFA award $1.4 million to 334 students. Their investment extends beyond financial support, helping scholars pursue their ambitions, build on their strengths and translate their potential into meaningful career impact.

This year, 8 scholarship recipients were also selected for fellowship opportunities, extending that investment through continued professional development, mentorship and career experiences. Together, these opportunities help prepare the next generation of professionals to contribute, lead and shape the future of the workforce.

Scholarships are one of the many ways ALPFA invests in the next generation of leaders. Through 270+ student chapters and 50+ professional chapters, ALPFA provides year-round access to career resources, mentorship, bootcamps, leadership development and a nationwide professional network. At the 2026 ALPFA Convention, 5,800+ attendees—including 3,200+ professionals, 2,600+ students, 370+ executives and 250+ speakers—came together, creating opportunities for students to connect with leading employers, expand their networks, build career-ready skills and take the next step in their professional journeys.

Learn more about our scholarship eligibility requirements and application criteria and fellowship opportunities designed to support students' continued professional development and career growth.

Join us in building pathways to opportunity and investing in the leaders of tomorrow. 

About ALPFA

Founded in 1972, ALPFA is the nation's leading professional association dedicated to empowering and developing leaders. With a nationwide network of professional and student chapters, ALPFA provides leadership development, career opportunities, mentorship, and community to professionals and students across every stage of their careers. Through strategic partnerships with leading organizations, ALPFA continues to create pathways for the next generation of leaders while advancing representation across every industry.

releases.title: Jiffy Lube® Celebrates the premiere of Matchbox The Movie with Free Mattel Matchbox Model Car with the Purchase of a Full Synthetic Oil Change
releases.body:
HOUSTON, Oct. 1, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Jiffy Lube®, an industry leader in fast oil changes and preventive automotive maintenance, announces its new promotion with Matchbox The Movie, a live-action feature film inspired by Mattel's line of iconic vehicles. With an oil change that is as fast as a speeding toy car, Jiffy Lube is helping bring the film's adventure and action to life with an exclusive limited-edition Jiffy Lube-branded Matchbox die-cast car.

Beginning tomorrow, October 2, and available at participating locations while supplies last, Jiffy Lube customers who purchase a qualifying Full Synthetic Oil Change will receive a free Mattel Matchbox car. The collectible – a 2018 Dodge Durango – is inspired by the vehicle featured in the film.

Created exclusively for this collaboration, the limited-edition die-cast transforms the vehicle into a collectible worthy of both Matchbox enthusiasts and movie fans. Packaged in premium Matchbox The Movie blister card artwork, the vehicle captures the adventurous spirit of the upcoming film while celebrating Jiffy Lube's role in helping drivers stay road-ready.

"Jiffy Lube is excited to collaborate with Matchbox The Movie, bringing together two iconic brands celebrating cars and the thrill of getting behind the wheel," said Suzanne Clerkin, Chief Marketing Officer, Jiffy Lube, LLC. "At Jiffy Lube, we're committed to delivering fast, convenient oil changes to help keep drivers on the road and ready for the adventures ahead."

Inspired by the iconic Matchbox brand that has sparked imaginative play for generations, Matchbox The Movie premieres globally Friday, October 9 on Apple TV.

"Matchbox is rooted in the spirit of exploration and freedom, and the adventures that begin behind the wheel," said Mahta Eghbali, Vice President of Strategic Alliances & Partnerships, Mattel. "Through our collaboration with Jiffy Lube, we're extending that spirit into the real world with a collectible that celebrates Matchbox The Movie while giving fans another memorable way to connect with one of Mattel's most iconic brands."

Whether you're a lifelong Matchbox collector, a movie enthusiast, or simply looking to keep your vehicle running at its best, this limited-time offer delivers a collectible that's built for adventure, and bridges the excitement of the film with the everyday importance of vehicle maintenance.

For more information and to find a participating Jiffy Lube location, visit JiffyLube.com.

About Jiffy Lube

Founded over 45 years ago, Jiffy Lube serves approximately 19 million customers each year at more than 2,000 franchised service centers across North America. Jiffy Lube pioneered the fast oil change industry in 1979 by establishing the first drive-through service bay, providing customers with fast, professional service for their vehicles. The company continues to lead the industry, offering expanded services such as brakes, batteries, and tires as well as other services consumers want and need. Visit www.JiffyLube.com to learn more about Jiffy Lube and vehicle care.
