releases.title: NHRA ANNOUNCES NEW MEDIA RIGHTS AGREEMENTS WITH FOX SPORTS, THE CW NETWORK AND FLOSPORTS
releases.body:
Landmark, multi-year agreements will enable largest reach for NHRA Mission Foods

Drag Racing Series events in NHRA's 75-year history

INDIANAPOLIS, Sept. 30, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- NHRA officials announced it has reached new, landmark multi-year media rights agreements for the Mission Foods Drag Racing Series with three standout distributors – FOX Sports, The CW Network and FloSports – positioning NHRA to enjoy the largest household reach in its 75-year history.

NHRA ANNOUNCES NEW MEDIA RIGHTS AGREEMENTS WITH FOX SPORTS, THE CW NETWORK AND FLOSPORTS

Starting during the 2027 season, NHRA will have a total reach of more than 125 million households, giving NHRA its biggest-ever media presence.

FOX Sports and The CW will carry all 20 NHRA Mission Foods Drag Racing Series events on raceday, with FOX Sports showcasing the first 13 races of the 2027 campaign, which kicks off with the NHRA Winternationals on Feb. 18-21 at In-N-Out Burger Pomona Dragstrip. FOX Sports telecasts will continue to include a mix of coverage on the FOX broadcast network and FS1, as well as streaming on the FOX One app, showing eliminations action on Sunday as well as a qualifying highlight/recap show on Sundays.

As part of this historic arrangement, NHRA is also thrilled to welcome two new partners in The CW and FloSports, which will both broadcast NHRA Mission Foods Drag Racing Series action for the first time.

The CW will be the exclusive broadcast home on raceday for the final seven races of the season, including the world's biggest drag race, the prestigious Cornwell Quality Tools NHRA U.S. Nationals, and the full six-race Countdown to the Championship playoffs. Sunday eliminations on The CW will also be available to stream on the ESPN App for ESPN Unlimited subscribers.

FloSports will make its FloRacing channel the streaming home for live qualifying action in the NHRA Mission Foods Drag Racing Series and eliminations on Sunday. These events and the NHRA partnership will be supported by an extensive line-up of original content, editorial, and social programming on FloRacing.

"This is a truly major moment for NHRA and for the future of our sport. These agreements with FOX Sports, The CW Network and FloSports put NHRA racing in front of fans in more ways and on more platforms than ever before," NHRA President Glen Cromwell said. "Celebrating our 75th anniversary in 2026, we continue to see tremendous momentum and growth in our audience.

"These new media relationships give us a huge opportunity to build on that and continue to reach new fans and introduce them to the incredible competition, drivers, race teams and excitement that make NHRA Drag Racing so special. We're extremely proud of these agreements for our race teams, tracks and sponsors, and we're thrilled to see NHRA's continued growth with our partners at The CW Network, FOX Sports and FloSports."

The CW Network

NHRA will make its 2027 debut on The CW at the world's biggest drag race at Lucas Oil Indianapolis Raceway Park, kicking off what will be a massive seven-race stretch broadcasting eliminations on the network. The addition of The CW also ensures NHRA will enjoy the most over-the-air broadcasts in its history between FOX and The CW, giving the six-race Countdown to the Championship playoffs a larger household reach and its biggest spotlight yet.

Race fans will also be able to watch NHRA action on The CW via CW Sports streaming on The ESPN App with an ESPN Unlimited subscription.

"The CW has quickly become a top-tier broadcast destination for motorsports fans, and we are thrilled to add NHRA events to our growing portfolio of CW Sports," said Mike Perman, Senior Vice President, CW Sports. "Beginning next fall, these seven adrenaline-packed NHRA playoff races will pair perfectly with the action of the NASCAR O'Reilly Auto Parts Series, making weekends on The CW the premier television home for all racing enthusiasts."

FOX Sports

NHRA and FOX Sports will continue a thriving relationship that first began in 2016 and continued with a multi-year extension in 2021. Starting in 2027, 2-3 of the first 13 events of the year will air on FOX, with the remaining airing on FS1, as well as coverage on the FOX One app.

Sundays on FOX Sports will also include a comprehensive recap/highlight show to set up elimination action. There will also be robust motorsports promotion in FS1 broadcast windows, a staple of the longtime collaboration between NHRA and FOX Sports.

"It's fantastic to continue our long-standing relationship with the NHRA," said Bill Wanger, FOX Sports EVP, Head of Programming and Scheduling. "With a sport built on speed, adrenaline and mechanical mastery, being able to continue to deliver the blink-of-an-eye action across FOX Sports platforms to the NHRA's dedicated fan base highlights the commitment to our motor sports lineup."

FloSports

NHRA and FloSports will enter into a first-ever agreement starting in 2027, with the platform serving as the live streaming home for NHRA Mission Foods Drag Racing Series qualifying and eliminations.

Through the agreement, FloRacing will exclusively stream all rounds of qualifying live at every national event, marking an ideal opportunity for both partners. FloRacing will also show Sunday eliminations, with race fans able to enjoy NHRA racing, alongside the largest grassroots motorsports portfolio in the world with more than 1,800 race events fueling 365-day coverage of NASCAR, short track, sprint cars, dirt, drag racing, late model and more.

"The NHRA is the crown jewel of drag racing and is going to be a standout addition to a FloRacing portfolio that is quickly becoming an essential destination for drag racing fans," said Michael Rigsby, GM of FloRacing. "We plan to give fans a deep dive into the sport and its drivers that will extend beyond our live streaming coverage."

For more information on NHRA, including the full 2027 schedule or information on the rest of the 2026 campaign, visit www.nhra.com.

About NHRA

NHRA is the primary sanctioning body for the sport of drag racing in the United States. NHRA presents 20 national events featuring the NHRA Mission Foods Drag Racing Series and NHRA Lucas Oil Drag Racing Series, as well as the JBS Equipment NHRA Pro Mod Drag Racing Series presented by Elite Motorsports and NHRA Flexjet Factory Stock Showdown™ at select national events. NHRA provides competition opportunities for drivers of all levels in the NHRA Summit Racing Series and NHRA Street Legal™. NHRA also offers the NHRA Jr. Street® program for teens and the Summit Racing Jr. Drag Racing League® for youth ages 5 to 17. With more than 100 Member Tracks, NHRA allows racers to compete at a variety of locations nationally and internationally. NHRA's Youth and Education Services® (YES) Program reaches over 30,000 students annually to ignite their interest in automotive and racing related careers. NHRA's streaming service, NHRA.tv®, allows fans to view all NHRA national events as well as exclusive features of the sport. In addition, NHRA owns and operates three racing facilities: Gainesville Raceway in Florida; Lucas Oil Indianapolis Raceway Park; and In-N-Out Burger Pomona Dragstrip in Southern California. For more information, log on to www.NHRA.com, or visit the official NHRA pages on Facebook, Instagram, Twitter, and YouTube.

releases.body:
With Spotlights, brands seamlessly launch Meta Partnership Ads and TikTok Spark Ads from content that is already driving affiliate sales, all from within the ShopMy platform.

NEW YORK, Sept. 30, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- ShopMy, the curator commerce platform for the world's most premium brands, creators, and shoppers, today announced Spotlights, a product that turns proven creator content into paid ads across Meta and TikTok. Spotlights leverages the creator relationships, content, and data brands already have inside ShopMy for an always-on paid program that gets smarter every time it runs. The product joins Affiliate, Opportunities, and Lookbooks as the final and critical step in ShopMy's full-funnel creator marketing system.

ShopMy announces Spotlights, a product that turns proven creator content into paid ads across Meta and TikTok.

The Problems Spotlights Solves:

While organic creator marketing is incredibly efficient at driving new site visits, much of that traffic leaves without converting. Meanwhile, paid ads are great at retargeting and converting returning shoppers, but struggle to scale without creative feeling repetitive. Spotlights bridges this divide, pairing the trust and creative diversity of creator content with the precision of paid performance.

Meta's own data shows that creator-led ads drive 13% higher CTR and 19% lower CPA than standard ads, and brands using TikTok Spark Ads have seen up to 25% higher CTR and 24% higher conversion rates compared to standard in-feed ads. Despite this impact, most brands can only run a handful of creator ads due to manual sourcing, upfront fees, and approval processes that cap volume before scale is possible.

Spotlights flips the traditional model, leveraging proven content to create a scalable, pay-for-performance ad program that is built to convert.

How Spotlights Works

  • Proven Content: Organic content is surfaced based on real performance affiliate data, so brands can invest in proven-to-convert content. Standard creator commission replaces a flat production fee, removing risk for brands.
  • Easy Approvals. Creators can turn on Instant Spotlights to pre-approve requests from brands they mention, or manually approve them from inside the ShopMy platform, turning organic content into high-performing ads within minutes.
  • Optimized Return On Ad Spend (ROAS). Faster approvals and no upfront fees mean more content in-market, which in turn gives brands the ability to test quickly and continuously.
  • Precise Control. Brands can build Spotlight strategies by product, market, or funnel stage, each with its own targeting, budget and outcome to optimize toward.
  • On a Centralized Platform. Spotlights runs on the creator relationships, content, data, and sales history already inside a brand's ShopMy account, eliminating the need for separate platforms.

"Spotlights transforms creator marketing from a brand awareness channel to a conversion channel," says Harry Rein, co-founder and CEO of ShopMy. "Brands can put a massive library of creator content to work as paid ads, reaching high-intent shoppers without the extra legwork. For the first time, brands can run their entire marketing program through ShopMy in a cohesive, consistent, brand-accretive way."

ShopMy's Spotlights ad partners were quick to recognize the product's value.

"'TikTok made me buy it' became a trend because so many people discover, decide, and buy through TikTok. Our partnership with ShopMy connects that moment to the scale and measurement rigor of paid media. With the Content Suite API, ShopMy can connect its affiliate content on TikTok directly to Spark Ads, so brands can amplify authenticity with proven results to reach even more people." — Jeffrey Huai, Global Product Lead for Creator Ads at TikTok

Early Results

MUTHA, a luxury skincare brand, increased its live partnership ads to over 100 in a single month, grew GMV by 140% over its pre-Spotlights monthly average, and saw a 55% lift over its standard Meta ROAS. Additionally, the number of creators earning through MUTHA grew roughly 62% over the same period.

"In an age where AI-generated content is growing exponentially, real creators bring authenticity and credibility. ShopMy allows us to use that trust to grow our brand, and we will continue to shift more paid media spend to Spotlights to take advantage of that." said Mick Burchfield, VP Sales & Marketing, MUTHA.

A few months after turning on Instant Spotlights, New York City-based fashion and lifestyle creator Marissa Huertas-Crespo now earns more than 60% of her lifetime ShopMy commissions through Spotlights.

"Spotlights has been a game changer for me," she says. "Content I shared months ago has been given a second, third, or sometimes even fourth life by turning on Instant Spotlights, in addition to helping me reach new audiences as well. I love how hands-off and effortless it is, especially as a creator balancing content and a full-time career."

About ShopMy: ShopMy is the creator commerce infrastructure that connects premium brands, curators, and consumers through taste and trust. Brands including Rhode, Kallmeyer, Net-a-Porter, Gucci, West Elm, and Therabody use ShopMy's affiliate tracking, gifting, and performance tools to work with a network of 330,000+ curated tastemakers.

Spotlights is available now to ShopMy brand partners.

releases.body:
Fellowships designed to support first-generation and Pell-eligible students now open for the 2027 academic year.

PORTLAND, Maine, Sept. 29, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- The Council on International Educational Exchange (CIEE) is the leader in providing opportunities for first-generation and Pell-eligible students to study abroad, awarding over $13 million each year in grants and scholarships to study and intern abroad.

"We are committed to increasing access to all college students from all backgrounds, especially for first generation and underserved populations, to ensure that all students can experience and benefit from the powerful impact of studying abroad," said James P. Pellow, Ed.D., President and CEO, CIEE.

Douglass O'Connell Global Internship Program

Established in 2015, the Douglass–O'Connell Global Internship Program in Ireland prepares high-achieving, Pell-eligible students for future career success through the power of international education and a global internship. Sponsored by Ireland's Department of Foreign Affairs, the African American Irish Diaspora Network (AAIDN), The John and Lillian Miles Lewis Foundation, and CIEE, the program celebrates the inspiration that Frederick Douglass experienced during his visit to Ireland over 175 years ago when he met the elder statesman and his personal hero, Daniel O'Connell. O'Connell and Douglass spent their lives advocating for equality and opportunity in Ireland, the United States, and around the world.

Thirteen students are selected each year for an 8-week global internship in Dublin, including full program funding, airfare, and a living stipend. Following in the footsteps of Frederick Douglass and Daniel O'Connell, students will experience Ireland through lectures and excursions, learning important lessons on leadership and social reform while gaining important skills that will enhance their future careers.

Applications for the Douglass O'Connell Global Internship Program are open and close on January 8, 2027.

Scan Design Foundation Environmental Sustainability Internship

Established in 2025, the Scan Design Foundation Environmental Sustainability Internship in Copenhagen, Denmark focuses on advancing Danish American relations by supporting cultural exchange focused on environmental sustainability. Twelve students will have the opportunity to study and intern with a company in Copenhagen focused on environmentally sustainable business practices for 8 weeks. Students also will explore Danish sustainability culture and participate in networking and professional development activities. Open to Pell-eligible students, the fellowship equips participants with practical skills to enhance their career readiness and tackle future environmental challenges.

The Scan Design Foundation honors the legacy of Danish immigrants, Inger & Jens Bruun, to advance Danish-American relations by supporting cultural exchanges focused on environmental sustainability.

Applications for the Scan Design Foundation Environmental Sustainability Internship are open and close on November 20, 2026.

"Few experiences rival the impact of a global internship for preparing students for life after graduation," explained Patrick Moran, Senior Vice President for College Study Abroad, CIEE. "Students selected for these programs will gain important problem solving, intercultural communication, and self-leadership skills most valued by employers in today's globally interconnected workplace."

Knowledge Without Borders: Democracy and Memory Fellowship

Established in 2026 by a generous gift from Karen Collias, The Knowledge Without Borders: Democracy and Memory Fellowship is designed for first-generation, Pell-eligible students who are passionate about history, political science, civic leadership, social justice, and global affairs. Through this fellowship, four exceptional students receive $10,000 each toward a CIEE Quarter In or CIEE Open Campus study abroad program in Berlin, Germany.

Fellows explore Berlin's storied history, including how the city has been shared by reflection, memorialization, and democratic responsibility. The fellowship includes courses on German history and Berlin's cultural and political landscape while students explore one of the world's most important living classrooms.

Applications are open for the Spring 2027 Knowledge Without Borders: Democracy and Memory Fellowship and close on November 1, 2026.

About CIEE

Since 1947, CIEE has built bridges between different people, countries, and cultures through study abroad and international exchange programs that advance peace in our world. We change lives; our alumni change the world. Learn more at ciee.org.

Media Contact: Leslie Taylor, ltaylor@ciee.org, (207) 553-4274

releases.title: Bloomberg's Big Take Podcast Spotlights Growing Artificial Stone Silicosis Crisis
releases.body:
NOVATO, Calif., Sept. 29, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Brayton Purcell LLP is highlighting a recent episode of Bloomberg's Big Take podcast, "Crafting America's Favorite Countertops Is Killing Workers," that brings national attention to the growing artificial stone silicosis crisis affecting artificial stone countertop fabrication workers across the United States.

The episode examines the fatal health risks associated with fabricating artificial stone countertops, a product that has become one of the nation's most popular countertop materials. Through the story of former countertop fabricator Tyler Jordan, Bloomberg explores the devastating impact of artificial stone silicosis, the litigation filed by affected artificial stone fabrication workers, and the ongoing debate regarding responsibility within the industry.

Artificial stone is at least 90% respirable crystalline silica, and the remaining approximately 10% consists of highly toxic dyes, resins, glues, and heavy metals. During fabrication activities such as cutting, grinding, polishing, and shaping slabs, enormous quantities of nano-sized, high-surface area toxic artificial stone dust is released into the air.

When inhaled, these particles penetrate deep into the lungs and become embedded in lung tissue. The resulting inflammation and scarring leads to artificial stone silicosis, a devastating, progressive, incurable, and fatal disease. Unlike many occupational diseases, artificial stone silicosis continues to progress long after exposure has ended.

According to Bloomberg labor reporter Josh Eidelson, artificial stone contains significantly higher levels of crystalline silica than natural stone products. During the podcast, he noted that artificial stone can contain approximately 93% crystalline silica, compared with substantially lower amounts in materials such as marble.

The Bloomberg episode focuses heavily on the experience of Tyler Jordan, who began working in his family's countertop fabrication business after graduating from high school. As artificial stone became an increasingly large part of the shop's work, he spent much of his time fabricating artificial stone slabs.

Jordan recalled that he was told artificial stone was stronger, less porous, and more resistant to staining than natural stone. However, according to the podcast, he and other workers were not warned that artificial stone presented significantly different health risks.

While still in his twenties, Jordan began experiencing severe health problems, including unexplained weight loss, chest pain, back pain, and other symptoms. Following extensive medical testing and a lung biopsy, he was diagnosed with artificial stone silicosis.

The consequences extended beyond lung disease. Jordan later developed autoimmune disease and kidney failure and ultimately received a kidney transplant from his father. His illness forced him to leave the industry and relocate his family.

His story reflects a troubling trend documented by physicians and researchers around the world. While silicosis has existed for centuries, countertop workers who fabricate artificial stone are increasingly being diagnosed at younger ages and experience more severe and rapidly progressing disease than has historically been associated with silica exposure.

Bloomberg reported that thousands of cases of artificial stone silicosis have been identified worldwide. In the United States, workers in their twenties, thirties, and forties have been diagnosed with artificial stone silicosis, raising concerns among physicians, researchers, and public health professionals.

The podcast also examines litigation brought by workers who allege that exposure to silica released during artificial stone fabrication caused artificial stone silicosis and other serious illnesses. Approximately 700 workers throughout the United States have filed lawsuits against companies involved in manufacturing and distribution of artificial stone slabs. Workers allege that artificial stone is an extraordinarily hazardous product, and that the risks associated with artificial stone fabrication were not adequately disclosed. Defendants have denied wrongdoing and continue to maintain that artificial stone can be fabricated safely.

At the same time, policymakers continue to debate how best to respond to the growing crisis. Proposed responses discussed during the podcast range from restrictions on artificial stone fabrication to legislation that would affect certain claims involving manufacturers.

"Bloomberg's reporting highlights the profound impact artificial stone silicosis can have on workers and their families. Many of the individuals being diagnosed are experiencing debilitating lung disease and serious complications at an age when they should be building careers and raising families. As awareness of this occupational disease continues to grow, it is important for affected workers to understand their legal rights and the options that may be available to them," said James Nevin, Partner at Brayton Purcell LLP.

The Bloomberg episode emphasizes that artificial stone silicosis affects far more than a worker's lungs. Careers are cut short, families face financial hardship, and workers confront serious medical complications that affect multiple organ systems and lead to premature death.

To listen to the podcast, visit the Big Take Spotify page.

About Brayton Purcell LLP

Brayton Purcell LLP has devoted decades to representing workers and families affected by occupational diseases and toxic exposures. The firm's accomplished attorneys have extensive experience involving artificial stone silica exposure, occupational lung disease claims, and other complex toxic exposure matters.

For additional information, visit www.braytonlaw.com.

releases.title: Scientology Network's New Documentary Unveils Mark Isham's Boldest Musical Creation Yet
releases.body:
LOS ANGELES, Sept. 29, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Scientology Network's acclaimed Signature Performances will debut Mark Isham: The Voice Within this October, offering an intimate look inside the making of his latest album.

Mark Isham records his boldest musical creation yet at the legendary Mad Hatter Studios.

The documentary follows Grammy and Emmy-winning artist Mark Isham—the iconic trumpeter, New Age giant, celebrated composer and electronic music pioneer—as he returns to the studio to create At the Carousel Club, his first new album in 15 years. Blending the artistry of master musicians with electronic synthesis, Isham shapes a sound that pushes the boundaries of his already expansive body of work.

Stepping into the legendary Mad Hatter Studios—famed for recordings by artists ranging from Paul McCartney to Prince—Isham candidly reflects on the challenges and expectations surrounding the project. Behind-the-scenes moments document creative risks, breakthroughs and the experiences that have defined his musical journey, giving viewers rare access to a composer continually redefining his sound.

Joining him is a handpicked ensemble of superb musicians, including legendary drummer Vinnie Colaiuta, vocalist Ayo Awosika, guitarist Nels Cline, bassist Kaveh Rastegar and the Orchid String Quartet. Their collaboration forms the backbone of the album's richly layered arrangements, bringing Isham's electronic compositions to life through ensemble performance.

The film also explores Isham's far-reaching career, which spans more than four decades and over 400 film and television projects, including his Academy Award–nominated score for A River Runs Through It and the box-office hits 42 and The Accountant. His genre-crossing collaborations include artists such as Bruce Springsteen, Van Morrison, Willie Nelson, Joni Mitchell and The Rolling Stones—a testament to the breadth of his influence.

Reflecting on the album, Isham explains: "I cast people that I trust. And the music has evolved for them, for their voice to be especially effective in the music. And each step of the process has done that. Now the album is here and it's exhilarating."

Scientology Network debuted on March 12, 2018, launched by David Miscavige, ecclesiastical leader of the Scientology religion. Since then, Scientology Network has been viewed in over 240 countries and territories worldwide in 17 languages. Satisfying the curiosity of people about Scientology, the network takes viewers across six continents, spotlighting the everyday lives of Scientologists, showing the Church as a global organization and presenting its Social Betterment programs that have touched the lives of millions worldwide. The network also showcases documentaries by independent filmmakers who represent a cross section of cultures and faiths, but share a common purpose of uplifting communities. Scientology Network's innovative content has been recognized with more than 175 industry awards, including Tellys, Communitas and Hermes Creative Awards.

Broadcast from Scientology Media Productions, the Church's global media center in Los Angeles, the Scientology Network is available on DIRECTV Channel 320, DIRECTV STREAM, AT&T U-verse and can be streamed at scientology.tv, on mobile apps and via the Roku, Amazon Fire and Apple TV platforms.

BOULDER, Colo., Sept. 29, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- In January 2027, the Sundance Film Festival will debut in Boulder, Colorado, after more than four decades in Park City. Taking place from January 21-31, 2027, the Festival's first edition in its new Colorado home will put Boulder firmly in the international spotlight. Beyond the screenings, premieres and creative energy of the Sundance Film Festival, six distinctive Northern Colorado destinations offer even more reasons to stay longer and explore the region.
releases.title: Boulder, Colorado, Hosts the 2027 Sundance Film Festival and Sets the Stage for Adventure Across Northern Colorado
releases.body:
From Rocky Mountain wildlife and Western heritage to craft breweries, thriving food scenes and celebrated arts communities, six Northern Colorado destinations offer plenty of reasons to turn a trip to the 2027 Sundance Film Festival into a wider Colorado adventure.

BOULDER, Colo., Sept. 29, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- In January 2027, the Sundance Film Festival will debut in Boulder, Colorado, after more than four decades in Park City. Taking place from January 21-31, 2027, the Festival's first edition in its new Colorado home will put Boulder firmly in the international spotlight. Beyond the screenings, premieres and creative energy of the Sundance Film Festival, six distinctive Northern Colorado destinations offer even more reasons to stay longer and explore the region.

Boulder: Where Creativity Meets the Outdoors

Set against the dramatic backdrop of the Flatirons, Boulder combines an energetic, creative spirit with the kind of immediate access to nature that defines Northern Colorado — a combination that will take on new significance when the Sundance Film Festival makes the city its new home starting January 21-31, 2027. At the heart of the city, pedestrian-only Pearl Street will celebrate its 50th anniversary in 2027, marking five decades as a vibrant gathering place lined with independent boutiques, galleries, restaurants, breweries and cafés. Boulder's wider culinary scene has also earned recognition from the MICHELIN Guide. Just minutes from downtown, Chautauqua Park provides a gateway to miles of hiking trails beneath the Flatirons, with its historic Chautauqua Auditorium also set to become one of the Festival's official venues. This means Sundance Film Festival visitors can easily experience the best of Boulder as they attend screenings at iconic venues, decompress in the natural outdoor setting and enjoy Boulder's rich food, coffee and shopping scene throughout their Festival journey.

With one-of-a-kind venues, Sundance Film Festival visitors can move easily between screenings and the outdoors, starting the morning in the mountains before returning downtown for the Festival's premieres, events and creative buzz.

Estes Park: Take the Story into the Rockies

Surrounded by soaring peaks and sweeping alpine landscapes, Estes Park allows travelers to experience Northern Colorado at its wildest, serving as the basecamp for Rocky Mountain National Park. Winter transforms the area into a quieter landscape of snow-covered trails and frozen lakes, with visitors able to explore on foot or by snowshoe and enjoy some of the park's most popular areas without the summer crowds. Wildlife remains part of everyday life here, with elk frequently seen around Estes Park and opportunities to spot mule deer and other native species throughout the surrounding landscape. Back in town, independent shops, restaurants, breweries and cozy mountain accommodations provide somewhere to warm up from a day outside. For something more leisurely, the scenic Riverwalk follows the Big Thompson and Fall rivers through the heart of downtown.

Fort Collins: Beer, Food and a Soundtrack of its Own

With a lively downtown, celebrated craft beer scene and strong independent spirit, Fort Collins is one of Northern Colorado's most energetic cultural hubs. The city is perhaps best known for brewing, with New Belgium Brewing and Odell Brewing Co. among the names that helped put Colorado craft beer on the map, alongside a growing collection of smaller local breweries. Historic Old Town Fort Collins provides the city's social heart, bringing together restaurants, cafés, boutiques, galleries and live music venues within its characterful streets. Music is woven particularly strongly into Fort Collins' identity, from intimate local performances to Mishawaka Presents' winter concert series, which brings live music to venues around the city, while its celebrated canyon-side amphitheater remains one of the region's best-known music destinations. Fort Collins is also one of Colorado's most bike-friendly cities, with an extensive network of trails making cycling an easy way to discover its neighborhoods, breweries and natural surroundings.

Loveland: Where Art is Part of the Landscape

Known as one of Colorado's most established arts communities, Loveland has built an identity around sculpture, craftsmanship and creativity. The city's artistic heritage is perhaps most visible at Benson Sculpture Garden, where visitors can wander among an extensive collection of sculptures in a landscaped outdoor setting, while Chapungu Sculpture Park showcases monumental stone works by Zimbabwean artists. Downtown, galleries, murals and public artworks continue the creative thread, alongside independent shops, restaurants and local businesses. Visitors can also explore exhibitions at the Loveland Museum or discover more about the artists, sculptors and bronze foundries that have helped shape the city's reputation as a center for the arts. Beyond its creative credentials, Loveland sits within easy reach of lakes, trails and foothills, allowing visitors to combine culture with Northern Colorado's outdoor lifestyle.

Longmont: A Taste of Northern Colorado

With an independent food and drink scene and a strong connection to local makers and producers, Longmont offers plenty of reasons to arrive hungry and thirsty. The city is home to renowned craft breweries, including Left Hand Brewing Company and Oskar Blues Brewery, alongside Wibby Brewing, which specializes in American craft lagers inspired by traditional German brewing techniques. Food lovers can explore Cheese Importers, a family-run Longmont institution with an extensive cheese and specialty-food market, before discovering the restaurants that feature Latin American cuisine, coffee shops and independent businesses clustered in the city's historic downtown arts and cultural district. Longmont's agricultural surroundings also remain an important part of its identity, creating connections between local farms, producers and the city's evolving culinary scene.

Greeley: A Diverse Culture Takes Center Stage

Greeley's arts and culture take center stage at the Union Colony Civic Center, a major performing arts venue that brings nationally touring artists, musicians, comedians and family entertainment to Northern Colorado. Public art, from murals to sculptures, reflects a diverse and vibrant culture. And within walking distance of downtown, the University of Northern Colorado brings jazz legends to campus and shares performing and visual arts as a vital part of the community. Visitors can discover craft beer at WeldWerks Brewing Co., explore the flavors of 477 Distilling, and experience Western heritage at local museums and special events like the century-old Greeley Stampede and others. Home to a growing creative sector, where artists, makers and entrepreneurs are shaping the city's evolving identity, Greeley celebrates community, arts, heritage and culture with a welcoming vibe.

About Explore Northern Colorado

Explore Northern Colorado is a collaborative tourism partnership bringing together six distinctive destinations across Northern Colorado: Boulder, Estes Park, Fort Collins, Greeley, Longmont and Loveland. Working together to showcase the diversity of the region, Explore Northern Colorado connects visitors with experiences spanning the Rocky Mountains and great outdoors, vibrant arts and culture, locally rooted food and drink, Western heritage and thriving creative communities. The partnership aims to inspire visitors to stay longer, explore further and discover the individual character of each destination while experiencing Northern Colorado as a connected and compelling year-round destination. For more information, visit explorenortherncolorado.com.

releases.title: Kubota Introduces All-New BX90 Sub-Compact Tractor Series: Bigger, Better, More Capable
releases.body:
America's Long-Time Trusted Sub-Compact Tractor Line Just Got a Major Upgrade

GRAPEVINE, Texas, Sept. 29, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Kubota Tractor Corporation, the #1-selling tractor brand in the USA for 20 years running,* today unveiled its all-new sub-compact tractor line, the BX90 Series. As the pioneer of the sub-compact category, Kubota introduced the original BX Series in 2000, and 26 years later, the company is once again reinventing the segment by introducing five new models with three trim levels: the BX2190, BX2390 Deluxe, and BX2690 Premium, plus the backhoe-equipped BX2390S and BX2690S Premium. The new BX90 Series represents a complete platform redesign built specifically around what property owners want: all-day comfort, real loader power, and exceptional mowing performance, all in one sub-compact machine.

"The BX90 Series was designed around what today's property owners value most: productivity, comfort, and choice, while building on the quality and versatility that has made Kubota a trusted leader in sub-compact tractors," said Matt McDonald, Senior Product Operations Manager, Kubota Tractor Corporation. "From intuitive side-by-side HST pedals to enhanced loader and mower systems, every improvement is intended to help customers accomplish more with ease. And with three distinct trim levels, customers can choose the BX90 that best fits their property, applications, and priorities. At the top of the lineup, the Premium model brings modern displays, programmable settings, and advanced controls traditionally associated with larger tractors, combining the proven BX experience with technology designed around how customers work."

Three Core Advancements: Loader Capability, Mower Performance and Operator Comfort

Three platform-wide advancements form the foundation of every model in the new BX90 Series: improved loader capability, heavy-duty mower performance and more intuitive operation. Together, these enhancements elevate productivity, versatility and operator comfort across the entire BX90 lineup.

  • Increased Loader Capability: The BX90 Series raises loader productivity with redesigned LA355 and LA405 loaders offering lift capacities of up to 721 and 904 pounds, respectively. The BX2390 and BX2690 models pair increased hydraulic flow and pressure with quicker cycle times and stronger response at lower engine speeds. Dual bucket cylinders, an improved rollback angle, protected hose routing, and an easier-to-align loader cradle are designed to support efficient operation, improve material retention, and enable more convenient loader attachment and removal.
  • Heavy-Duty Mower Performance: The new 54-inch and 60-inch mower decks combine durable welded-steel construction with the flexibility to choose either pin-on or drive-over capability. The available Swift-Mount™ auto coupling driveline connects as the tractor travels over the deck, making attachment faster and more convenient.
  • Operator Comfort and Intuitive Control: The all-new side-by-side HST pedals create a more natural operating position and make forward and reverse changes feel intuitive, helping operators work with greater comfort, confidence, and control.

Five BX90 Models Ready to Work Year-Round

The BX90 Series delivers the year-round versatility property owners expect from Kubota, from clearing snow and preparing gardens to mowing lawns, managing seasonal cleanup and moving material. With enhanced loader capability, multiple mower options and compatibility with a wide range of implements, the BX90 is equipped to take on the changing demands of property ownership. Five available models give customers the flexibility to choose the capability, convenience, price point, and technology that best fit the way they work.

  • BX2190 (19.3 gross horsepower): An accessible entry point to the BX90 lineup, combining essential BX versatility with the platform-wide enhancements and the LA355 loader. Its increased horsepower also supports larger tires and 60-inch mower-deck compatibility.
  • BX2390 Deluxe (21.6 gross horsepower): Balances capability, convenience and value with redesigned styling, compatibility with the high-performance LA405 loader, and upgraded controls that include electronically controlled PTO engagement, three-point hitch position control, telescopic stabilizers and simplified mower-deck height adjustment.
  • BX2690 Premium (23.9 gross horsepower): The most advanced BX model to date, featuring an electronically controlled engine, full-color LCD display, programmable engine-speed settings, and joystick-integrated throttle-up functionality, which provides on-demand, fingertip access to preset engine speeds for faster hydraulic response and more engine power during loader work.
  • BX2390S and BX2690S Premium: Two backhoe-equipped configurations featuring the new BT604 backhoe, a dedicated flip-up seat and an automatic stabilizer lock. The BX2690S Premium adds the LA405 loader and enhanced hydraulic performance for greater working capability.

The new BX90 Series will be available at Kubota authorized dealerships beginning in early 2027. For more information, visit KubotaUSA.com/BX.

*Based on total U.S. unit sales from EDA/UCC equipment transaction data for all tractor classes (Utility Tractor, Utility Loader, Utility TLB, and 4WD Ag Tractor) from 01/01/2005 through 12/31/2025.

About Kubota Tractor Corporation

Kubota Tractor Corporation, Grapevine, Texas, is the U.S. marketer and distributor of Kubota-engineered and manufactured machinery and equipment, including a complete line of tractors up to 200* Gross hp, performance-matched implements, compact construction equipment, consumer lawn and garden equipment, hay tools, commercial turf products, and utility vehicles. For product literature or dealer locations, contact: Kubota Tractor Corporation, 1000 Kubota Drive, Grapevine, TX 76051, (888) 4-KUBOTA [(888) 458-2682], Ext. 900, or visit KubotaUSA.com. *factory estimated rating.

BX90 Sub-Compact Tractor Description:

Kubota Tractor Corporation introduced the all-new BX90 Series, featuring five models designed to meet the evolving needs of today's property owners. Building on the BX Series that helped pioneer the sub-compact tractor category, the BX90 introduces platform-wide advancements in loader capability, mower performance and operator comfort. The five-model lineup features redesigned loaders offering up to 904 pounds of lift capacity, new 54-inch and 60-inch welded-steel mower decks with available Swift-Mount Deck™ auto coupling technology, and all-new side-by-side HST pedals for natural, intuitive forward and reverse control. The BX2690 Premium further advances the operator experience with modern display technology, programmable settings and advanced operating functions traditionally associated with larger tractor platforms. Designed for year-round versatility, the BX90 Series will be available at authorized Kubota dealerships beginning early 2027.

SEGUIN, Texas, Sept. 29, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- The Dr. Kerry Evans Scholarship for Sciences officially opens its application period for the 2027 cycle, inviting undergraduate students nationwide to submit their credentials for consideration.

The scholarship serves as a platform to recognize students who view science not merely as a subject of study, but as a collaborative endeavor with far-reaching societal implications. By providing financial assistance and public recognition, the Dr. Kerry Evans Scholarship aims to alleviate some of the burdens associated with higher education, allowing recipients to focus more intently on their research and academic goals.

Eligibility for the award requires applicants to be currently enrolled undergraduate students at an accredited U.S. institution. Candidates must pursue a degree in a science-related field and maintain a strong academic record, evidenced by official transcripts. Additionally, applicants must be U.S. citizens or permanent residents.

Dr. Kerry Evans brings over two decades of experience in high-pressure medical environments to this philanthropic effort. As a dedicated emergency room physician, he understands the importance of precision, dedication, and continuous learning.

Applicants must submit a 1,000-word essay addressing the specified prompt, official transcripts from their current institution, and letters of recommendation from professors or qualified professionals who can attest to their academic potential. All materials must be sent to apply@drkerryevansscholarship.com by the deadline of May 15, 2027.

The winner of this one-time award will be announced on June 15, 2027. This timeline allows the selection committee ample time to review submissions thoroughly and ensure that the recipient truly embodies the spirit of scientific curiosity and academic diligence.

For those interested in learning more about the requirements or the vision behind the initiative, detailed information is available at https://drkerryevansscholarship.com/.

About the Dr. Kerry Evans Scholarship for Sciences

The Dr. Kerry Evans Scholarship for Sciences was established by Dr. Kerry Evans, a seasoned emergency room physician with a deep commitment to education and healthcare advancement. Founded to support undergraduate students pursuing science-related degrees, the organization aims to reduce financial barriers and encourage academic excellence. Its core mission is to inspire the next generation of scientists by recognizing their potential and providing the resources necessary to achieve their professional goals.

releases.title: AMERIGO: THE SEARCH FOR THE AMERICAN DREAM WINS FIVE HONORS AT THE ACCOLADE GLOBAL FILM COMPETITION
releases.body:
Award-Winning Documentary Returns to PBS Stations Nationwide

Ahead of 2026 Elections

Accompanied by New Civics Education Guide for Students, Teachers, Families 

NEW YORK, Sept. 29, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- AMERIGO: The Search for the American Dream, the documentary that traveled across America asking people what the American Dream means today, has received five honors in the August 2026 season of the Accolade Global Film Competition.

The film received the Award of Excellence Special Mention for Documentary Feature, one of the competition's top honors, as well as Awards for Direction (Adam Mason) and Editing (Paul Crowder), and Award of Merit Special Mention for Cinematography and Award of Merit Special Mention for Narration/Voice-Over recognizing David McCourt's narration of the documentary.

The recognition comes as AMERIGO prepares to return to PBS audiences across the country ahead of the 2026 midterm elections. Since its premiere, AMERIGO has aired in over 90% of households across the country. It's second national broadcast is also expected to air in the majority of American households before the midterm elections.

"This recognition means a great deal to all of us who made AMERIGO," said McCourt. "But the film was never really about us. It was about the people we met across America who opened their homes, their workplaces, and their lives to us. These awards belong, in a very real sense, to them."

Accompanying the broadcasts will be a new AMERIGO Civics Guide, created to help teachers, students and families explore and discuss some of the critical issues facing their communities this election year.

Over two years, McCourt and the AMERIGO team traveled across the United States listening to Americans from different regions and backgrounds, capturing the real-life pressures shaping people's lives – from the cost of housing, healthcare, and education; wages and economic opportunity; the strength of local communities; trust in institutions; and whether the next generation will have the same opportunities as the generation before it.

McCourt added: "As the country approaches another important election, I hope AMERIGO can do something increasingly rare – give people with different experiences and different points of views a reason to sit in the same room, listen to one another and talk about the country we want to leave to the next generation. The big issues we explore did not begin in Washington; they are issues consistent in so many communities all across America and this film is about giving a voice to everyday citizens. AMERIGO does not tell viewers what to think, whom to blame, or how to vote. The film and the accompanying civics initiative invite people to listen, question, discuss, and decide for themselves."

To view the trailer and join the national dialogue, visit AD250.com.

The film explores the past, present, and future of the American Dream through conversations with people from across the United States, reflecting on work, opportunity, technology, and community.

ABOUT McCOURT ENTERTAINMENT

McCourt Entertainment, led by Emmy Award–winning producer and entrepreneur David McCourt, is a global media company developing innovative, socially resonant storytelling across film, television, and digital platforms. Its credits include the acclaimed children's programming Reading Rainbow (26 Emmys); Miracle Boys miniseries directed by Spike Lee; and the UN Works documentary series What's Going On? which included "Child Soldiers in Sierra Leone", hosted by Michael Douglas, and "Child Refugees in Tanzania" featuring Angelina Jolie. releases.title: FaverGray Named a 2026 Best Place to Work by Jacksonville Business Journal
releases.body:
JACKSONVILLE, Fla., Sept. 29, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- FaverGray, a general contractor specializing in multifamily and student housing construction, has been named one of the Jacksonville Business Journal's 2026 Best Places to Work, recognizing the company among Northeast Florida employers known for creating strong workplace cultures.

The annual Best Places to Work program recognizes companies throughout the First Coast based on feedback from their employees, with confidential surveys evaluating areas including team dynamics, trust in leadership, communication and overall workplace experience.

For FaverGray, the recognition comes at an exciting time of growth. As the company continues to grow, so does its team, creating new opportunities for employees to advance their careers, take on greater responsibilities and contribute to FaverGray's future.

"Our people have always been the foundation of FaverGray," said James A. Gray, CEO of FaverGray. "As we've grown, we've worked hard to maintain a culture where people enjoy coming to work, feel valued as part of the team and have opportunities to grow with the company. Being recognized as a Best Place to Work is especially meaningful because it comes from the feedback of our own employees."

That culture extends beyond the work itself. FaverGray makes it a priority to bring its team together throughout the year, whether it's a monthly food truck at the Jacksonville Beach office, holiday celebrations, team outings or company events. Most recently, employees and their families spent an afternoon together at Beach Bowl for FaverGray's Family Day, and the team is already looking forward to its annual Chili Cook-Off this fall.

Earlier this year, FaverGray completed an expansion of its Jacksonville Beach headquarters with the team in mind. In addition to new office space, the expansion includes indoor and outdoor gathering areas that have quickly become a favorite place for team lunches, monthly food trucks, celebrations and company events. The new space gives employees a place to step away from their desks, spend time together and celebrate the milestones that make working at FaverGray special.

For FaverGray, these investments are part of maintaining the culture that has been central to the company for more than two decades. As the team grows, the company remains focused on creating opportunities for employees to develop professionally, step into leadership roles and build long-term careers at FaverGray.

"Growth is exciting, but what's equally important to us is making sure FaverGray continues to be a place where people want to come to work and build their careers," said Ben J. Hinson, President of FaverGray. "We want to give our team opportunities to grow professionally, but we also want to make time to get together, celebrate our successes and enjoy the people we work with. Our new office expansion is another investment in that culture and in creating a workplace our team can be proud of."

releases.title: Avex Music Group CEO Brandon Silverstein Expands Global Role as Avex Acquires His S10 Entertainment
releases.body:
Avex increases its ownership to 85%, with an agreement to reach 100% ownership over time

LOS ANGELES and TOKYO, Sept. 29, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Avex Inc. (TSE: 7860) ("Avex"), the publicly traded global entertainment conglomerate led by CEO Katsumi Kuroiwa, has increased its ownership of S10 Entertainment acquiring 85% of the company from Silverstein and his partners. The transaction further integrates S10 into Avex Music Group and advances Avex's vision of one global music company.

"S10 is an exceptional management company that is playing a key role in realizing our global ambitions," said Katsumi Kuroiwa, CEO of Avex Inc. "Bringing S10 into Avex reflects our confidence in Brandon's leadership and our commitment to growing Avex's global music business. Together, we will bring the full breadth of Avex's capabilities to artists and creators around the world."

Silverstein continues as CEO of S10 and Avex Music Group, a board member and equity partner in Avex Music Group. Alongside the acquisition, he assumes a broader role in shaping Avex Group's global music strategy, working in close partnership with the Avex board to develop opportunities and strategic partnerships across recorded music, publishing, live entertainment, touring and investments. Avex Inc. drove nearly $1 Billion in revenue in its last fiscal year.

The transaction follows Avex's March 2025 acquisition of the S10 Music Publishing catalog, marking a second acquisition involving the businesses Silverstein built and deepening his partnership with Avex.

At the time of the publishing acquisition, S10 reported more than 22 global No. 1 hits and 50 billion streams worldwide, with a publishing repertoire that included songs recorded by Justin Bieber, Drake, Tate McRae, Doja Cat, Post Malone and Rihanna, among others.

The latest acquisition builds on two years of publishing development, including the integration of S10's publishing catalog, new songwriter signings and global partnerships. Since Silverstein became CEO in 2025, Avex Music Group has announced a global publishing administration partnership with Bruno Mars and launched an initial $100 million publishing acquisition initiative.

Its songwriters' achievements include Kamal Wilson's Grammy Award for Best R&B Song for co-writing Kehlani's "Folded." In June 2026, Silverstein and Avex Inc. CEO Katsumi Kuroiwa accepted Billboard's Global Growth Award on behalf of Avex Music Group.

"S10 began with a belief in exceptional talent and what we could build around it," said Silverstein. "I'm proud of what our artists, songwriters and team have accomplished, and grateful to the partners who helped us get here. This next chapter is an opportunity to build on that work at a greater scale with Avex, investing in talent, developing new businesses and creating more opportunities across markets."

Avex's vision of one global music company brings its music businesses around the world closer together across recorded music, publishing, artist management, marketing, live entertainment and touring. The strategy connects talent development, music rights and global partnerships, creating more opportunities for artists, songwriters and business partners across the group. Catalog acquisitions and strategic investments will support this growth alongside the signing and development of new talent.

Avex's label strategy combines continued investment in the global careers of XG and ONE OR EIGHT with the signing and development of artists from the United States and other global markets. The ambition is to build a global roster with the creative support, resources and reach to compete at the highest level.

"I'm grateful to Max Matsuura, Katsumi Kuroiwa, Shinji Hayashi and the Avex board for their continued trust and support," said Silverstein. "The global platform Avex has built is extraordinary, and together with our teams around the world, I look forward to extending it as one global music company."

In the transaction Silverstein was represented by Skadden, Arps, Slate, Meagher & Flom LLP.

Financial terms of the transaction were not disclosed.

releases.title: Cineverse Brings Video Podcasts Bad Movies Rule!, Mohr Stories with Jay Mohr, and The Stand Presents: 10 for 10 to Amazon Fire TV
releases.body:
Plus: Top Cineverse FAST Channels including The Dog Whisperer and The Bob Ross Channel Now Available on Fire TV Devices

LOS ANGELES, Sept. 29, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Cineverse (Nasdaq: CNVS), an entertainment technology company and studio, has announced the launch of eight video podcasts on Amazon Fire TV. This marks the company's first major distribution of ad-supported video-on-demand (AVOD) podcasts (VODcasts), furthering its commitment to growing the Cineverse Podcast Network – including horror shows from Bloody FM and comedy from the WITZ Podcast Network.

Additionally, some of Cineverse's most popular free, ad-supported streaming television (FAST) channels are also available via Fire TV.

Shows now available to all Amazon Fire TV customers – with no download, sign-ups, or fees – include:

  • Bad Movies Rule! – A comedy podcast for people who love so-called bad movies - those that have been declared bad by critics or audiences to see if they really deserve to be on the trash pile or if they actually rule.
  • Mohr Stories with Jay Mohr – hosted by comedian/actor and SNL alum Jay Mohr, featuring candid, often humorous interviews with celebrities, comics, and cultural figures. Discussions span careers, personal stories, and life in Hollywood, sometimes including in-depth, emotional, or nostalgic conversations.
  • The Stand Comedy Club Presents: 10 for 10 – 10 for 10 is The Stand Comedy Club's signature series celebrating a decade (and counting) of the club's raw, transformative impact on stand-up comedy. Hosted by the sharp and seasoned Kieran McCann, each episode dives deep with a standout comedian who calls The Stand home- unpacking the grind, the bombs, the breakthroughs, the green-room chaos, and the nights that changed everything. Past guests include Jim Gaffigan, Shane Gillis, Ari Shaffir, Janeane Garofalo, T.J. Miller and more!

"The trend toward video podcasts is well documented, with every major platform getting into the game, and Fire TV is the latest sign of our commitment to reaching audiences where and how they want to consume," said Tom Owen, Vice President, Networks Strategy. "According to Sounds Profitable, 71% of podcast creators are producing video, and revenue for video podcasts is estimated to be 12x higher per year than for audio-only. We are embracing this reality and will continue to do so moving forward."

Additionally, customers can now instantly access these Cineverse FAST channels for free on Fire TV:

  • The Bob Ross Channel – home to more than 400 episodes of The Joy of Painting.
  • Dog Whisperer with Cesar Millan – featuring all nine seasons and 160 episodes of the popular series.
  • GoPro Channel – features exhilarating, first-person action sports content from across the globe.
  • HISTORIAN – a variety of history-based programming, in partnership with American Public Television, where viewers can watch history unfold.
  • JoySauce TV – dedicated to American Asian audiences.
  • Real Madrid TV – comprehensive behind-the-scenes access to one of the world's most successful soccer clubs, delivering match highlights, exclusive interviews and documentaries.
  • Yu-Gi-Oh! – features nearly 400 hours of episodes spanning iconic titles like Yu-Gi-Oh! Duel Monsters, Yu-Gi-Oh! SEVENS, and the movie Yu-Gi-Oh! The Dark Side of Dimensions.

"We're thrilled to also be adding these FAST channels for Amazon Fire TV customers," added Cineverse Vice President of Partnerships Alexandra Viglione. "From established leaders in Dog Whisperer and Bob Ross, to new channels like HISTORIAN and JoySauce, fans of any IP or genre can find something they enjoy through Fire TV devices."

About Cineverse Podcast Network

Cineverse operates a top-10 podcast network with more than 35 audio series. It leverages owned-and-operated brands like Bloody Disgusting, Midnight Pulp and RetroCrush to deliver hit shows in horror, true crime and entertainment, also recently expanding into comedy programming with the launch of WITZ Podcast Network in partnership with The Stand Group. A growing division of the Company, the Cineverse Podcast Network generates advertising revenue from brands across key categories, including movie studios, retailers and consumer products. Series include Mayfair Watchers Society (from the mind of Siren Head creator Trevor Henderson), The Bloody Disgusting Podcast (hosted by Zena Dixon and Shelby Novak), Creepy Places (a true crime podcast hosted by Jon Grilz), The Dead (in partnership with The George A. Romero Foundation), The Losers Club (breaking down Stephen King's career chronologically), Murder in America (co-hosted by Courtney Shannon & Colin Browen), and more.

About Cineverse Streaming

Cineverse owns and/or operates a wide range of premium streaming brands, from free, ad-supported streaming television (FAST) channels to subscription video-on-demand (SVOD) apps. These span fandoms – from single IP channels around pop cultural icons such as Bob Ross and The Dog Whisperer with Cesar Milan, to channels curated for fans of Horror (Screambox, Midnight Pulp), Anime and Pan-Asian shows and films (RetroCrush, AsianCrush), Comedy (Gorilla Comedy+), Independent Film (Fandor), Romance (Dove Channel) and True Crime (Crime Hunters), to name a few.

About Cineverse

Cineverse (Nasdaq: CNVS) is an entertainment technology company and studio. Fiercely innovative and independent, Cineverse develops and invests in technology and content that drives the future of the industry. Core to its business is Matchpoint® – a growing tech ecosystem designed to prepare, distribute, monetize, and continuously improve content across any platform. Matchpoint helps studios large and small operate at scale and improve performance and efficiency in an increasingly fragmented distribution environment. Additionally, Cineverse distributes a vast library of premium films, series, and podcasts, across theatrical, home entertainment, and streaming; operates dozens of digital properties that super serve passionate fandoms around the world; and works with leading brands to connect them with audiences they value. From award-winning technology to the highest-grossing unrated film in U.S. history, Cineverse has created a playbook that marries tech and content to redefine the next era of entertainment. releases.title: Simple Interact Partners with Brookes Publishing to Automate ASQ®-3 Developmental Screenings
releases.body:
DALLAS, Sept. 29, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Brookes Publishing, a leading provider of early childhood resources and assessments, and Simple Interact, a leading healthcare front-office automation platform and 2025 & 2026 Best in KLAS® awardee for Patient Intake Management, are excited to announce the availability of the Ages & Stages Questionnaires®, Third Edition (ASQ®-3) through its platform as a result of a new partnership between the two companies.

Through this new collaboration, pediatric practices, FQHCs, and health systems will be able to electronically administer and automatically score the ASQ®-3 screening tool. For decades, healthcare professionals have relied on the ASQ®-3 to assess the developmental progress of children between the ages of 1 month and 5.5 years. Through the mobile-friendly, multilingual Simple Interact platform, clinics will be able to automatically assign the appropriate ASQ®-3 questionnaire to families based on the child's age and the type of medical appointment the child is scheduled for. These questionnaires can be sent via SMS or email to parents and guardians prior to the child's clinic visit, allowing them to complete the screenings in place of the clinic's intake and check-in forms and without needing to download any health and intake applications.

"Developmental screening is incredibly important, but often adds to the workload of healthcare providers who must complete the administration of these questionnaires and scoring of those responses," said Ravi Kalidindi, Founder and CEO of Simple Interact. "By making the ASQ-3 automated and integrated with the Simple Interact platform, we make it simpler for parents to complete these screenings and for healthcare providers to focus on patient care."

The addition of the ASQ-3 to Simple Interact expands the platform's capabilities to meet specialized screening needs and the unique requirements of each healthcare organization. Simple Interact's mobile-friendly, multilingual platform automates a variety of front-office processes, including patient intake, check-in, consents, screenings, reminders, two-way texting, patient feedback, scheduling, payments, and other patient interactions.

"For decades, ASQ has helped healthcare professionals and families identify and support children's developmental needs with confidence," said Douglas Solomon, Chief Strategy Officer at Brookes Publishing. "Partnering with Simple Interact allows us to extend that impact through Simple Interact's digital platform, making it easier than ever to administer screenings accurately and use the results to promote the healthy development of all children."

About Simple Interact

Simple Interact is a leading front office automation company and a 2025 & 2026 Best in KLAS® awardee. We help healthcare facilities across the United States run more efficiently and profitably by digitizing and streamlining their critical workflows. We collaborate closely with providers to customize our platform, transforming patient experience, boosting staff productivity, and driving provider success. Our platform integrates seamlessly with major EHR systems, ensuring that these improvements work in harmony with existing clinical workflows. Learn more at simpleinteract.com

About Brookes Publishing

For more than 40 years, Brookes Publishing has provided professional resources and assessments in early childhood, communication and language, and special education. Ages & Stages Questionnaires® are developmental and social-emotional screening tools used by early childhood and healthcare professionals worldwide. Learn more at agesandstages.com

releases.title: Spin Master and Universal Announce Licensing Agreement for a Preschool Line Inspired by the Jurassic World Franchise from Universal Pictures and Amblin Entertainment
releases.body:
TORONTO, Sept. 29, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Spin Master Corp. today announced a toy licensing agreement with Universal for a preschool toy line inspired by the Jurassic World franchise from Universal Pictures and Amblin Entertainment. Designed for dinosaur-loving kids ages 2–5, the collection will open a playful gateway into the Jurassic World universe, bringing colossal action-packed adventure down to size for young dinosaur fans through humor, discovery and age-appropriate play.

Spin Master's toy collection will feature roarsome dinosaurs, hands-on discovery and imaginative storytelling for first-time explorers. Blending excitement and adventure, the line is designed with preschoolers' developmental needs and natural play patterns in mind, helping them feel capable, confident and part of the action while exploring their fascination with dinosaurs and the prehistoric world.

"A preschool collection inspired by the iconic Jurassic World franchise opens the door for the youngest fans to experience the wonder of dinosaurs in a way that's built just for them," said Doug Wadleigh, Spin Master's President of Toys. "The collection introduces dinosaur-driven action play with a touch of humor and open-ended discovery, giving young fans the chance to interact with dinosaurs in an expressive and approachable way." 

"Jurassic World has captivated generations of fans by bringing the wonder, excitement and adventure of dinosaurs to life, and we're thrilled to collaborate with Spin Master to create toys designed specifically for our youngest explorers," said Rafa Macias, EVP, Global Consumer Products & Games, Universal Destinations & Experiences.

Under the global agreement, excluding China and Japan, Spin Master will develop a broad range of preschool toys, expected to launch in 2028 at major retailers.

This newest license joins a growing lineup of Universal franchises within Spin Master's portfolio, including Gabby's Dollhouse, How to Train Your Dragon, Wicked: For Good, the 2026 Toy of the Year award-winning Jurassic World Primal Hatch interactive toy, the viral Hatchin' Yoshi egg, and the upcoming launch of the Hellbreak™ trading card game, further building on the companies' longstanding relationship.

About the JURASSIC WORLD Franchise

From Universal Pictures and Amblin Entertainment, Jurassic World immerses audiences of all ages in a new era of wonder and thrills where dinosaurs and humankind must learn to coexist. Jurassic World is more than a film franchise. At every turn, this $6 billion film series delivers a larger-than-life destination for exploration, discovery, and epic adventure. Dinosaurs live again and they live in Jurassic World.  

About Spin Master

Spin Master Corp. (TSX:TOY) is a leading global children's entertainment company, creating exceptional play experiences across its three creative centres: Toys, Entertainment and Digital Games. With worldwide toy distribution, Spin Master is best known for award-winning brands including PAW Patrol®, Melissa & Doug®, Bakugan® and Rubik's® Cube, and is the global toy licensee for other iconic properties. Through its in-house entertainment studio, the company creates and produces captivating multiplatform content including powerhouse preschool franchise PAW Patrol, along with other original shows, short-form series and feature films. With an established presence in digital games anchored by Toca Boca® and Piknik™, Spin Master engages close to 60 million active users monthly in open-ended, creative and safe play. With 29 offices spanning nearly 20 countries, Spin Master employs close to 2,500 team members globally. 

About Universal Consumer Products & Games

Universal Consumer Products & Games (UCPG) brings NBCUniversal's iconic characters, stories and franchises into fans' everyday lives through innovative consumer products, games and digital experiences. Working with world-class licensees, retailers and strategic partners around the globe, UCPG creates products and experiences across toys, collectibles, apparel, publishing, home, lifestyle, video games and emerging digital platforms. Its diverse portfolio includes beloved properties from Universal Pictures, Illumination, DreamWorks Animation, Focus Features, Peacock and NBC. UCPG is a line of business within Universal Destination & Experiences' Franchise, Products & Partnerships team.

releases.title: Shipyard Joins StackGen, Adding Ephemeral Environments to the Autonomous Operations Factory
releases.body:
SAN FRANCISCO, Sept. 29, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- StackGen, the autonomous operations company, today announced it has acquired Shipyard, the ephemeral environments platform used by engineering teams at fast growing startups like Rippit and major enterprises like PepsiCo. Shipyard creates a full-stack environment for every pull request and removes it on merge. Shipyard's engineering and customer team joins StackGen, and the product continues for existing and new customers as Shipyard by StackGen, while Shipyard will also power new capabilities for StackGen's Autonomous Operations Factory. Terms were not disclosed.

AI agents now write a growing share of code and propose more of the changes that reach production. StackGen & Shipyard believe every one of those changes should run somewhere real before it ships. Shipyard gives teams that place: an isolated environment built from the application's own definition, where a change is tested against the full stack and then thrown away. Engineers get their own environment on every pull request, wired into the GitHub and GitLab workflows they already use.

Shipyard works at the pull request, where a change starts its path to production. StackGen's Autonomous Operations Factory coordinates Aiden agents for infrastructure, delivery, observability and incident response on a shared world model. StackGen will bring Shipyard's environments into the factory as the place those agents prove a change before it reaches a live system.

"Agents are proposing more changes to production every week, and enterprises want proof before they let those changes run," said Sachin Aggarwal, Co-Founder and Chief Executive Officer of StackGen. "Shipyard gives every change a real environment to prove itself in first. It is a strong business with enterprise and startup customers, and a team that has built a product engineers enjoy using. Bringing it into StackGen moves us toward production operations that agents can run safely."

"We started Shipyard so engineers could see their changes running before they merged them," said Benjie De Groot, co-founder of Shipyard. "More and more of those environments are now requested by agents. StackGen is building a place where agents prove their changes before they reach production, and Shipyard fits right into that. It's the right home for our customers and our team."

Customer quote

"We've been Shipyard customers for years and we've been very happy with it. Every pull request gets a high-fidelity environment where our browser tests run before anything merges. With more and more PRs coming in from agents, that step matters more than ever." - Harrison Hunter, CTO, Rippit

For Shipyard customers

Customers keep the product, contracts and support contacts they have today. Shipyard by StackGen continues on its own site at shipyard.build.

Availability

Shipyard by StackGen is available today at shipyard.build. Enterprise teams can book a demo at stackgen.com.

About StackGen

StackGen is the autonomous operations company. Its Autonomous Operations Factory takes software from commit to production and keeps it running, with Aiden agents for infrastructure, delivery, observability and incident response operating on a shared world model under policy-bound, auditable, human-on-the-loop governance. StackGen works inside the tools enterprises already use, such as GitHub, Jenkins, Datadog, PagerDuty and ServiceNow, and serves customers including Autodesk, Nielsen and Bancolombia. Recognized as a Gartner Cool Vendor and in Gartner Hype Cycle research, StackGen is backed by Thomvest Ventures, Seligman Ventures, WestWave Capital, Firebolt Ventures and Secure Octane, and is headquartered in San Francisco. For more information, visit stackgen.com.

About Shipyard

Shipyard, now Shipyard by StackGen, provides ephemeral environments for software teams and their coding agents. It creates a full-stack environment for every pull request, integrates with GitHub and GitLab, and gives agents access through an MCP server and CLI. Learn more at shipyard.build.

NEW YORK and SANTA CLARA, Calif., Sept. 29, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Fortune and ServiceNow today unveiled the 2026 Fortune AIQ 75, an expanded annual ranking of Fortune 500 companies generating significant, measurable impact from AI adoption. JPMorgan Chase captured No. 1 in the prestigious ranking. ServiceNow's 2026 Enterprise AI Maturity Index research served as the foundation for the methodology behind the Fortune AIQ 75 List.

Building on the inaugural 2025 Fortune AIQ 50, the 2026 list grows to 75 companies – with 36 new companies added to the ranking – spanning 18 sectors across Technology, Finance, Healthcare, Energy, Retail, and Industrials. The expansion reflects the rapidly widening adoption and impact of AI across the American corporate landscape.

The debut of the Fortune AIQ 75 list comes two days before the inaugural Fortune AIQ Summit hosted at the New York Stock Exchange in New York City on Thursday, October 1. The invite-only AIQ Summit will draw attendees and speakers from the Fortune AIQ 75.

The Fortune AIQ Summit will feature cross-industry conversations offering actionable insights on what separates successful AI implementations from stalled pilots. Participants will explore how to identify the right use cases, redesign workflows, and scale AI across an enterprise to deliver quantifiable business outcomes.

Together, the companies on the 2026 Fortune AIQ 75 represent $7.58 trillion in revenue, $1.33 trillion in profits, and $32.1 trillion in market value. Technology and Finance are the two most represented sectors, while New York and California are home to more AIQ 75 companies than any other states.

They're redesigning how work gets done and positioning their people close to where the change actually happens," said Jacqui Canney, Chief People and AI Enablement Officer at ServiceNow. "These 75 companies know that as technology moves faster, your competitive edge comes from the people who can read where the business is headed and steer their teams through the shift."
