releases.title: Scholastic to Acquire Cottage Door Press, a Leading, Fast-Growing Innovator in Early Childhood Publishing
releases.body:
Transaction Strengthens Scholastic's Position in Early Childhood Publishing and Expands Opportunities for Growth Across Formats and Channels

NEW YORK, Sept. 29, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- ― Scholastic Corporation (NASDAQ:SCHL), the global children's publishing, education and media company, today announced that it has signed a definitive agreement to acquire Cottage Door Press ("Cottage Door"), a leading independent children's publisher of innovative early childhood books, for approximately $71 million, subject to customary purchase price adjustments.

Upon completion, the strategic acquisition will expand Scholastic's position in the early childhood book market, a key focus area for the Company, by adding a proven independent publisher with distinctive strengths in early childhood and novelty formats. The transaction is expected to broaden Scholastic's children's publishing portfolio across formats, categories and channels, creating new opportunities to reach children and families.

"Cottage Door is a strong strategic fit for Scholastic and an attractive investment in an important growth area of the children's book market," said Peter Warwick, Scholastic President and Chief Executive Officer. "Dick Maddrell and his team have built one of the fastest growing independent publishers with category-defining formats, concepts and licenses, as well as strong relationships with retailers and families. Bringing their strengths together with Scholastic's trusted brand, publishing expertise, unique school channels and distribution scale creates meaningful opportunities to build on that momentum and create long-term value."

Cottage Door is the largest independent children's publisher in the United States and among the fastest-growing in the industry. Since its founding in 2014, Cottage Door has distinguished itself through creative publishing that encourages interaction and discovery, with particular strengths in board and novelty formats, as well as innovative product development supported by strong digital marketing and go-to-market capabilities.

"Cottage Door brings a distinctive creative vision to publishing for our youngest readers, with an exceptional ability to develop innovative formats that children want to touch, explore and experience," said Sasha Quinton, President of Scholastic's Children's Book Group. "We have long admired both the creativity of Cottage Door's publishing and the team that brings those books to market. We are thrilled to welcome them to Scholastic and are excited about what we can create together for children and families."

Dick Maddrell, Founder and CEO, Cottage Door Press added, "I am incredibly proud of what our team has built over the years, and it was deeply gratifying to see how strongly others valued what we have created. Finding the right home for our brand and our team was an important priority. Scholastic not only understands what makes Cottage Door special, but they share a kid-first culture and can help Cottage Door realize its full potential in this next stage of growth."

Following the closing, Cottage Door will be integrated into Scholastic's Children's Book Group and is expected to continue operating with its existing publishing team and entrepreneurial approach, preserving the brand, expertise, creative identity and innovative culture that has driven its success while benefiting from Scholastic's broader capabilities and resources.

Transaction Details

Under the terms of the definitive agreement, Scholastic will acquire Cottage Door Press for approximately $71 million, before customary purchase price adjustments. Cottage Door's Luna StoryTime products, a line of interactive electronic toys, will be spun off prior to closing and will not be acquired by Scholastic as part of the transaction. The transaction is expected to close by the end of 2026, subject to customary closing conditions, the completion of the pre-closing separation of the Luna StoryTime business, the receipt of required third-party consents and the entry into new license agreements with certain key licensors, as well as approval by shareholders of one of the sellers. Scholastic expects to fund the acquisition with cash on hand and borrowings under its available revolving credit facility.

Cottage Door Press generated approximately $45 million in net revenue and was strongly profitable during the twelve months ended May 31, 2026.

Scholastic expects the acquisition to contribute to revenue growth and Adjusted EBITDA in fiscal 2027 and to be accretive in its second year following close, including anticipated synergies. Over time, as Scholastic supports Cottage Door's continued growth through its broad distribution platform and realizes manufacturing and operating efficiencies, further financial benefits are expected.

Greenhill, a Mizuho affiliate, served as exclusive financial advisor to Cottage Door Press.

About Scholastic

For more than 100 years, Scholastic Corporation (NASDAQ: SCHL) has been meeting children where they are – at school, at home and in their communities – by creating quality content and experiences, all beginning with literacy. Scholastic delivers stories, characters, and learning moments that empower all kids to become lifelong readers and learners through bestselling children's books, literacy- and knowledge-building resources for schools including classroom magazines, and award-winning, entertaining children's media. As the world's largest publisher and distributor of children's books through school-based book clubs and book fairs, classroom libraries, school and public libraries, retail, and online, and with a global reach into more than 135 countries, Scholastic encourages the personal and intellectual growth of all children, while nurturing a lifelong relationship with reading, themselves, and the world around them. Learn more at www.scholastic.com.

About Cottage Door Press

Cottage Door Press is a leading publishing company focused on bringing joy, connection, and imagination to readers of all ages. Founded in 2014, the company has grown from a small collection of titles to an expansive catalog that includes beloved children's books, innovative storytelling products, and a range of adult lifestyle and activity titles. Cottage Door Press is committed to enriching lives, one story — or activity — at a time. For more information about Cottage Door Press, visit cottagedoorpress.com or follow us on social media @cottagedoorpress.

Forward Looking Statements

This press release contains forward-looking statements within the meaning of the Private Securities Litigation Reform Act of 1995. These forward-looking statements include, without limitation, statements regarding the expected completion, timing and financial benefits of the proposed acquisition of the publishing business of Cottage Door Press, including statements regarding expected contributions to revenue growth, Adjusted EBITDA and accretion. Forward-looking statements are based on management's current expectations and assumptions and are subject to risks, uncertainties and other factors that may cause actual results, performance or achievements to differ materially from those expressed or implied by such statements. Factors that could cause actual results to differ materially include, among others:

  • the failure to satisfy, or delay in satisfying, conditions to the closing of the transaction, including the successful completion of the pre-closing separation of the Luna StoryTime business and  the need to obtain shareholder approval from  one of the Sellers which is anticipated but cannot be assured;
  • the failure to obtain, or delay in obtaining, required third-party consents or to enter into new license agreements with key licensors on acceptable terms or at all;
  • unexpected costs, liabilities or delays associated with the transaction or the pre-closing separation;
  • the failure to successfully integrate Cottage Door's business and retain key personnel following closing;
  • the possibility that anticipated synergies and other benefits of the transaction may not be realized or may take longer to realize than expected; and
  • general economic, market and business conditions.

The foregoing list of factors is not exhaustive. Additional risks and uncertainties are discussed in Scholastic's filings with the Securities and Exchange Commission, including its most recent Annual Report on Form 10-K and subsequent Quarterly Reports on Form 10-Q. releases.title: Zoomlion Signs US$300 Million Credit Insurance Policy and Initial US$50 Million Non-Recourse Factoring Agreement
releases.body:
SHANGHAI, Sept. 29, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Zoomlion Heavy Industry Science & Technology Co., Ltd. ("Zoomlion") signed a US$300 million portfolio credit insurance policy and an initial US$50 million non-recourse factoring agreement at the Zoomlion 2026 Global Financial Partners Summit and Signing Ceremony in Shanghai on September 11, establishing a tiered insurance-and-financing framework for overseas installment receivables as its international business grows.

Developed over six months with international insurers and financial institutions, the arrangement combines portfolio credit insurance with non-recourse factoring. In practical terms, overseas installment receivables covered by the insurance policy can be factored with an overseas bank on a non-recourse basis. This gives Zoomlion a structured way to manage and finance overseas receivables rather than handling them transaction by transaction. The framework is designed to turn these receivables into scalable, standardized and replicable investment-grade assets.

At the signing ceremony, the US$300 million policy was signed with a double-A-rated international insurer and leading institutions, while the initial US$50 million non-recourse factoring agreement was signed with an overseas bank.

The agreements come as Zoomlion continues to expand internationally. In the first half of 2026, the company's international revenue rose 12.45% year over year to RMB 15.54 billion (approximately US$2.31 billion), accounting for 57.25% of total revenue.

Zoomlion CFO Du Yigang reviewed the company's cooperation with global financial partners and outlined its progress and future plans for overseas financial and insurance services.

"Zoomlion will continue to uphold the values of Integrity, Dedication, Inclusiveness and Responsibility and deepen mutual trust with our financial partners," said Du.

More than 40 financial and insurance partners from Singapore, Indonesia, Thailand, France, Kazakhstan, Hong Kong SAR and other markets attended the summit. Discussions covered the global macroeconomic outlook, overseas financial and insurance strategies, regional market opportunities, exchange and interest rate trends, and insurance innovation. The Economist Corporate Network (ECN) led a morning session on macroeconomic and geopolitical trends, while representatives from Radana and Alfa-Bank shared perspectives on market and financing developments.

Xu Xiaoming, General Manager of Zoomlion's Financial Business Management Department and Credit Insurance Department, discussed future cooperation, while Deputy General Manager Yan Xin introduced the company's overseas third-party financing and insurance strategy and cooperation models.

Looking ahead, Zoomlion plans to deepen cooperation with global financial and insurance partners and further develop scalable and replicable financial and insurance solutions to support its international growth.

releases.body:
NAPLES, Fla., Sept. 28, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Beasley Media Group has been named the official year-round audio partner of the Vegas Golden Knights, launching a multiyear agreement that will deliver English- and Spanish-language game broadcasts and expanded VGK programming across Beasley's audio and digital platforms. The VGK Radio Network is presented by Lee's Discount Liquor. 

Under the agreement, X 107.9 (KVGS FM) will serve as the team's official English-language radio flagship, while 105.7 Maxima (KOAS FM) will become the Spanish-language radio home of the Golden Knights. The two-station structure will broaden access to live game coverage while serving the diverse audiences that follow the team throughout Southern Nevada.

Dan D'Uva and Gary Lawless will return for their 10th season as the Golden Knights' official English-language radio broadcast team, with D'Uva handling play-by-play and Lawless providing analysis. X 107.9 will broadcast all of Vegas' games during the 2026-27 season with D'Uva and Lawless. Doug Lattuca will serve as host of the broadcasts on X 107.9, providing live coverage from every pregame, postgame, and intermission. Jesus Lopez and Alex Romo will also return to the Golden Knights and Beasley Media Group team as the Spanish-language play-by-play voice on 105.7 Maxima (KOAS-FM). 

The VGK Insider Show will return with Daren Millard as host of the hour-long program on X 107.9. The show will air each weekday from 5 to 6 p.m. PT and feature consistent appearances from Kelly McCrimmon, the General Manager of the Golden Knights, as well as players and broadcasters from the team and other personalities around the NHL. The VGK Insider Show will make its debut for the season on Monday, Sept. 28 on X 107.9.

The Henderson Silver Knights will broadcast on X 107.9 and 96.3 KKLZ-HD2 with full pregame and postgame coverage, carrying all 72 regular-season games and the Calder Cup Playoffs. Brian McCormack will provide play-by-play and Darren Eliot will serve as color analyst as the Silver Knights celebrate their seventh American Hockey League season.

"We're excited to partner with Beasley Media Group as we continue to advance our brand and connect with more fans throughout Las Vegas and Southern Nevada. With 107.9 X as our flagship station and 105.7 Maxima serving as our Spanish-language home, we'll be able to reach fans across the region through our radio broadcasts," said John Penhollow, President of Business Operations for the Vegas Golden Knights. "This partnership gives us a great opportunity to connect with our fans in new and meaningful ways throughout the year, not just on game days, and will broaden the connection to the Golden Knights and the future stars with the Silver Knights."

"Las Vegas is the sports and entertainment capital of the world, and the Golden Knights are the team that made it so. Beasley's four Las Vegas stations reach every corner of this valley, and now every one of them carries the team — with X 107.9 as the home of the Golden Knights and Máxima as their Spanish-language home," said Kevin LeGrett, chief business officer at Beasley Media Group.

The agreement expands Beasley's presence in live sports and creates an integrated platform for Golden Knights programming across broadcast radio, digital audio, podcasts and other content channels. It also provides the team and its partners with year-round opportunities to reach fans in Las Vegas and throughout the Golden Knights' radio affiliate network.

ABOUT THE VEGAS GOLDEN KNIGHTS

The Vegas Golden Knights are a National Hockey League franchise owned and operated by Black Knight Sports and Entertainment LLC. Established by Owner and Chairman Bill Foley and his family, the Golden Knights were the most successful expansion franchise in North American professional sports history in 2017-18 and won the Stanley Cup in 2022-23. The Golden Knights have advanced to the Stanley Cup Final three times and celebrate their 10th season as a franchise in 2026-27. For the latest news and information on the Golden Knights visit vegasgoldenknights.com and follow the team on Facebook, X, Instagram and TikTok.

ABOUT THE HENDERSON SILVER KNIGHTS

The Henderson Silver Knights are the American Hockey League affiliate of the Vegas Golden Knights. The Silver Knights are owned in part by Bill Foley and his family and operated by the Foley Entertainment Group. The Silver Knights play their home games at Lee's Family Forum, a state-of-the-art arena in Henderson, NV. For the latest news and information on the Silver Knights visit hendersonsilverknights.com and follow the team on Facebook, X and Instagram.

ABOUT BEASLEY MEDIA GROUP

Beasley Media Group LLC is a multiplatform media company providing advertising and digital marketing solutions across the United States. The company owns and operates radio properties located in 49 large and mid-size markets across the country and offers capabilities in audio technology, podcasting, e-commerce and events. Beasley Media Group reaches over 20 million consumers weekly through on-air, online and digital platforms.

releases.body:
NEW YORK, Sept. 28, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- FOX News Podcasts will broaden its original podcast slate with FOX News' the Girls, a new personality-driven conversation series featuring an array of leading female voices. The announcement was made today by FOX News Digital and New Media President Porter Berry and Megan Albano, Executive Vice President of Morning Programming & Program Development. "the Girls" will debut on October 1st, with new episodes dropping every Thursday across all podcast platforms, including FOX News Digital, YouTube, Spotify, and Apple Podcasts.

Each episode of FOX News' the Girls will include a rotating cast of co-hosts week to week, moving beyond the traditional news roundtable for a free-flowing conversation that can go anywhere — politics and pop culture; money and marriage; parenting, relationships, careers, or the group chat-worthy story of the day. Nothing is off the table. Showcasing multiple distinct perspectives, the conversation will revolve naturally around the issues impacting real life with undeniable chemistry, refreshing candor and no script. The first episode will feature FOX News Media stars Rachel Campos-Duffy, Harris Faulkner and Kat Timpf, newly named FOX News contributor Melissa DeRosa and former ESPN host Samantha Ponder.

In commenting on the announcement, Berry said, "the Girls is a natural addition to our growing podcast portfolio, and we're thrilled to continue expanding our slate of distinctive shows that complement our existing lineup while creating new opportunities for our audience to engage with our content."

Albano added, "We're excited to deliver a no-holds-barred format that captures the authenticity and perspectives of the many dynamic women of FOX News Media and beyond."

Bringing together unique female voices and experiences spanning news, politics, sports, comedy and culture, the premiere episode will feature a variety of viewpoints and backgrounds:

  • Rachel Campos-Duffy joined FNC in 2016 and currently co-hosts FOX & Friends Weekend. A mother of nine, she is a New York Times bestselling author and previously appeared on MTV's The Real World.
  • Emmy Award-winning journalist Harris Faulkner has been with FNC since 2005 and anchors The Faulkner Focus and co-hosts Outnumbered. She is also a New York Times bestselling author and mother of two daughters.
  • Kat Timpf, who joined FNC in 2015, is a panelist on Gutfeld!, comedian and two-time New York Times bestselling author. A mother and breast cancer survivor, she has spoken candidly about motherhood, loss, and her cancer diagnosis.
  • Veteran democratic strategist Melissa DeRosa previously held several senior roles in former New York Governor Andrew Cuomo's administration, becoming the first woman to serve as secretary to the governor.
  • Samantha Ponder is a former host of ESPN's Sunday NFL Countdown and a mother of three children.

The new podcast is the latest addition to FOX News Media's new media division which features an established suite of podcasts including Hang Out with Sean Hannity, Ruthless, Will Cain Country, Planet Tyrus and The Riley Gaines Show. 

FOX News Media operates the FOX News Channel (FNC), FOX Business Network (FBN), FOX News Digital, FOX News Podcasts, FOX News Audio, FOX News Books, the direct-to-consumer streaming services FOX Nation, and FOX News International and the free ad-supported television service FOX Weather. Currently the number one network in all of cable, FNC has also been the most watched television news channel for over 24 consecutive years, while FBN is the top business channel on cable. FOX News Media reaches nearly 200 million people each month and is also available to live stream on FOX One.

HOUSTON, Sept. 28, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Vortex Companies (Vortex), a leading provider of trenchless water and sewer infrastructure rehabilitation solutions, today announced the acquisition of Municipal & Contractors Sealing Products, LLC (MCSP), a Cincinnati-based trenchless services provider, specializing in the rehabilitation of pipelines, manholes, culverts, tunnels and other critical water and wastewater infrastructure.
releases.title: Vortex Companies Expands Geotechnical Services Platform with Acquisition of Municipal & Contractors Sealing Products ("MCSP")
releases.body:
Cincinnati-based MCSP adds specialized services and expands Vortex's Geotechnical capabilities

HOUSTON, Sept. 28, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Vortex Companies (Vortex), a leading provider of trenchless water and sewer infrastructure rehabilitation solutions, today announced the acquisition of Municipal & Contractors Sealing Products, LLC (MCSP), a Cincinnati-based trenchless services provider, specializing in the rehabilitation of pipelines, manholes, culverts, tunnels and other critical water and wastewater infrastructure.

"MCSP has earned its reputation by safely and cost-effectively rehabilitating municipal storm water and sanitary sewer systems for more than two decades," said Mike Vellano, Chief Executive Officer of Vortex Companies. "The combination of technical capability, field experience and customer trust is difficult to replicate. Bringing MCSP into Vortex gives us a stronger foundation in the Midwest and more ways to solve complex problems for the customers we serve."

Founded in 2000 by Bob O'Connor, MCSP has spent more than 25 years refining specialized rehabilitation methods for municipalities and utilities across a variety of states within the U.S. Its teams have become highly skilled in geopolymer and cementitious spray lining, protective coatings, chemical grout injection and manhole rehabilitation, with a strong record of performance across a wide range of infrastructure applications.

"What we've built at MCSP comes from years of learning the work—understanding the materials, refining the methods and knowing what it takes to perform in the field," said Drew O'Connor, Chief Executive Officer of MCSP. "Joining Vortex allows us to build on that experience and bring more solutions to the infrastructure challenges our customers are facing."

"The opportunity isn't simply to make the organization larger; it's to make both teams better," said Ram Vela, Chief Strategy Officer of Vortex Companies. "MCSP brings experience and operating knowledge that can strengthen Vortex, just as our broader platform can help MCSP scale. The value comes from putting those strengths to work across the business."

About Vortex Companies

Vortex Companies is a global leader in trenchless water and sewer infrastructure solutions, delivering advanced technologies and turnkey services for the rehabilitation, replacement and protection of critical infrastructure. Vortex specializes in pipe, manhole and structure rehabilitation and manufactures CIPP liners, geopolymer and hybrid mortars, polymeric coatings, resins and grouts. Its technology portfolio also includes UV curing systems, sewer robotics and high-speed drain cleaning equipment. For more information, visit www.vortexcompanies.com.

About Municipal & Contractors Sealing Products, LLC

Founded in 2000, Municipal & Contractors Sealing Products, LLC (MCSP) is a Cincinnati-based infrastructure rehabilitation contractor serving municipalities and utilities throughout the Midwest and surrounding regions. MCSP specializes in geopolymer and cementitious spray lining, protective coatings, chemical grout injection, and the rehabilitation of pipelines, manholes, culverts, tunnels and other water and wastewater infrastructure.

Earlier this year, Inox Solar Americas acquired Boviet Solar's U.S. PV module manufacturing and PV cell manufacturing assets in Greenville, North Carolina, as well as its U.S. commercial operations. The acquisition established the foundation for Inox Solar Americas' growing U.S. solar manufacturing and commercial platform.

GRADUAL BRAND TRANSITION

The brand transition will be implemented in phases across website content, social media channels, company and product information, marketing communications, trade shows, industry events, customer-facing materials, and other external brand touchpoints, progressively transitioning from Boviet Solar to the Inox Solar Americas brand.

During the transition period, customers, partners, and other industry stakeholders may continue to see both the Boviet Solar and Inox Solar Americas names across certain websites, social media platforms, product materials, technical documentation, trade shows, industry events, and other communications.

The transition will be managed progressively to maintain continuity and access to important product, technical, and customer information while establishing Inox Solar Americas as the company's U.S. solar manufacturing and commercial brand.

The transition represents another important step in the integration of Boviet Solar's U.S. business into Inox Solar Americas and the continued development and expansion of the company's U.S. solar manufacturing platform.

Additional updates regarding the Boviet Solar brand transition and related platforms, materials, and communications will be provided as the integration progresses.

CONTINUED SUPPORT FOR BOVIET SOLAR CUSTOMERS

Existing Boviet Solar customers and partners requiring customer service, PV module technical support, warranty assistance, product information or other product-related support can continue to submit inquiries through inoxsolar.us/company/contact-us. Inquiries submitted through the website will be directed to Boviet Solar's Global team for review and follow-up.

INOX SOLAR AMERICAS

Inox Solar Americas, founded in 2026 in the United States, is a leading solar technology and manufacturing company specializing in advanced monocrystalline PV cells and high-performance Gamma Series™ monofacial and Vega Series™ bifacial PV modules. Inox Solar Americas' photovoltaic solutions are engineered to meet the needs of residential, commercial, industrial, community solar, and utility-scale applications, delivering exceptional efficiency, reliability, and long-term value.

Inox Solar Americas acquired Boviet Solar's U.S. PV manufacturing assets in Greenville, North Carolina, USA, including 3.0 GW of annual PV module manufacturing capacity and 3.0 GW of planned annual PV cell manufacturing capacity, expected to come online in 2027. Through localized manufacturing, resilient supply chains, operational excellence, and efficient logistics, Inox Solar Americas is helping strengthen the U.S. solar supply chain and meet growing domestic demand.

Inox Solar Americas is part of the broader renewable energy platform of Inox Clean Energy and the INOXGFL Group, headquartered in India. Backed by the group's financial strength, business stability, manufacturing capabilities, technological innovation, and industry expertise, Inox Solar Americas is committed to delivering high-quality, reliable, and sustainable solar solutions to customers across the U.S. solar energy market.

NEWPORT BEACH, Calif., Sept. 28, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- StyleWeekOC® returns to Fashion Island in Newport Beach, CA from October 14–18, coinciding with the Newport Beach Film Festival from October 15–22, anchoring the West Coast cultural calendar along the California Riviera. Since joining forces three years ago, the two festivals have created a powerful Southern California destination for style, culture, and conversation. The immersive five-day fashion event features brand activations, industry panels, fashion shows, and a glittering opening night. Additional celebrity panelists are set to join this already star-studded event, with names to be revealed in the weeks ahead.

Among those in attendance for the 2025 edition were Jacob Elordi, Penn Badgley, Ashley Park, and Noah Schnapp, alongside fashion-centric screenings including the documentary premiere of Thom Browne: The Man Who Tailors Dreams.

This year's StyleWeekOC® theme, Sunlit Glamoratti, captures a legendary sun-dappled backdrop through a Hollywood lens. The portfolio features Neiman Marcus, Bloomingdale's, and Nordstrom, alongside OC market exclusives like RH, Ralph Lauren, Todd Snyder, Buck Mason, L'Agence, Rag & Bone, Cinq à Sept, Monica Vinader, Rails, PAIGE, and American Vintage.

"StyleWeekOC® continues to reinforce Fashion Island as a West Coast destination (or centerpiece) for style, and we're proud to bring that next-level experience to the Orange County community," said Gerard Widder, Vice President & General Manager at Fashion Island. "Our partnership with the Newport Beach Film Festival has elevated this event into something truly unique on the California Riviera, and this year's Sunlit Glamoratti theme captures exactly why people fall in love with Newport Beach."

Additional images found here. To purchase tickets and for additional information, visit www.StyleWeekOC.com and follow Fashion Island on Instagram at @fashionisland. Fashion Island is located at 401 Newport Center Drive, Newport Beach, CA 92660.

releases.title: UNIVERSAL MUSIC GROUP APPOINTS ÒSCAR CELMA AS SENIOR VICE PRESIDENT, APPLIED AI AND MACHINE LEARNING
releases.body:
Former Spotify, Pandora/SiriusXM and Condé Nast executive brings more than two decades of expertise in AI, music discovery and personalization

SANTA MONICA, Calif., Sept. 28, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Universal Music Group (UMG), the world leader in music-based entertainment, today announced the appointment of Òscar Celma as Senior Vice President, Applied AI and Machine Learning, effective immediately.

A recognized expert in AI, machine learning and music recommendation, Celma has helped shape how people discover and experience music. At Spotify, he helped lead the development of AI-powered personalized listening experiences including AI DJ, Jam and Daylist, as well as personalization and discovery products used by hundreds of millions of listeners worldwide.

Celma will help lead the development and application of AI and machine learning across UMG's global operations, supporting UMG's labels, divisions and businesses. He will report to Hannah Poferl, UMG's Chief Data Officer.

Hannah Poferl, UMG's Chief Data Officer, said, "Òscar brings a unique blend of quantitative and product experience, deep expertise in AI, and a love of music. He's built teams that have delivered and knows how to turn data at scale into useful insights. With the breadth and depth of UMG's data, there's enormous potential for him to help our teams do more for our artists."

Celma said, "I've spent much of my career exploring how technology can serve artists, songwriters and music fans. It's an exciting time to join Universal Music Group, given its industry leadership in using AI to expand what's creatively and commercially possible. I look forward to working with Hannah and leaders across UMG to advance our AI and machine learning capabilities to support human artistry.

Most recently, Celma led Machine Learning and Product Analytics at Condé Nast. Previously, as Director of Engineering at Spotify, he led engineering teams responsible for new listening experiences. He also spent seven years at Pandora/SiriusXM in senior data science leadership roles, focused on machine learning, music discovery, and recommendation. Earlier in his career, he was a Senior Research Scientist at Gracenote and co-founder and Chief Innovation Officer of Barcelona-based BMAT Music Innovators.

Celma holds a Ph.D. in Computer Science and Digital Communication from Universitat Pompeu Fabra in Barcelona and is a widely published researcher in music information retrieval and recommendation systems. He is the author of the Springer-published book Music Recommendation and Discovery.

About Universal Music Group

At Universal Music Group, we exist to shape culture through the power of artistry. UMG is the world leader in music-based entertainment, with a broad array of businesses engaged in recorded music, music publishing, merchandising, and audiovisual content. Featuring the most comprehensive catalogue of recordings and songs across every musical genre, UMG identifies and develops artists and produces and distributes the most critically acclaimed and commercially successful music in the world. Committed to artistry, innovation, and entrepreneurship, UMG fosters the development of services, platforms, and business models in order to broaden artistic and commercial opportunities for our artists and create new experiences for fans. For more information, visit www.universalmusic.com.

releases.title: Open-Source Model Accelerates Global Progress in Medical Video AI
releases.body:
SHANGHAI, Sept. 28, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Through an open-source model, a public dataset and benchmark, and the MedVidU Challenge, a global research competition, researchers worldwide now share a common foundation for advancing medical video AI. The Challenge drew 75 teams from 18 countries and regions across five continents, bringing diverse ideas and approaches into an ecosystem shaped by the wider research community.

Participants represented leading universities, medical institutions, and technology companies, including Harvard Medical School, the University of Oxford, LMU University Hospital, Nanyang Technological University, King Abdullah University of Science and Technology, The University of Hong Kong, and NVIDIA.

Supporting this community-driven momentum is a broader effort by United Imaging Intelligence (UII) to create the shared resources and platforms needed for medical video AI research to advance at scale.

Building an Open Foundation for Global Collaboration

Medical video understanding remains one of AI's most demanding frontiers, requiring precise spatial awareness, complex temporal reasoning, and rigorous clinical accuracy. Progress has often been constrained by limited clinical data and the high cost of expert annotation.

UII is addressing these barriers through an open framework designed to make research progress measurable and global collaboration more accessible. In April, following the acceptance of its MedGRPO research at CVPR 2026, UII released uAI NEXUS MedVLM and open-sourced 6,245 MedVidBench test samples. These samples are part of a broader research collection of 531,850 video-instruction pairs that UII annotated using eight existing, publicly available medical video datasets. Access to each component is subject to its release terms and the applicable source-data licenses.

Alongside the model and dataset, UII launched the MedVidBench public leaderboard, which evaluates models across ten metrics, including next-action prediction, skill assessment, and spatiotemporal grounding. Together, these resources gave researchers a common starting point and a consistent way to compare and refine their models.

To turn this shared foundation into collective progress, UII co-launched the MedVidU Challenge with the University of Strasbourg and the Technical University of Munich in summer 2026. UII also released a second MedVidBench batch of 6,270 test samples.

Within approximately three months of its latest release, MedVidBench surpassed 30,000 downloads and received citations from researchers around the world, reflecting growing interest from the global research community.

Uniting Global Expertise to Explore New Frontiers

According to the latest leaderboard, four teams advanced to the final stage of the Challenge. Two teams were invited to present their findings at the ECCV 2026 MedVidU Workshop, held in Malmö, Sweden in September.

The Workshop also featured oral presentations of two accepted papers exploring new ways to expand training resources for surgical AI and advance surgical skill assessment. Broader discussions brought together perspectives from biomedical engineering and robotics, highlighting emerging directions in medical video AI.

Surgical and clinical procedures are routinely recorded, yet much of this video remains underused. Medical video AI could unlock new clinical value, supporting surgical training through structured feedback, assisting with intraoperative safety checks, and streamlining postoperative review and documentation, with potential applications in nursing care and remote mentoring.

UII is building an open ecosystem of shared resources, transparent evaluation, global competition, and research exchange to help translate advances in medical video AI into clinical practice.

releases.title: From Multi-Platinum Recording Artist to Fashion Entrepreneur: Nailah Thorbourne Creates Vlair Shapewear for the Modern Woman
releases.body:
Brick & Lace artist, songwriter and entrepreneur transforms a personal fashion challenge into a shapewear line designed for today's boldest styles

MIAMI, Sept. 28, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- For women who love cut-out dresses, asymmetrical silhouettes, one-shoulder styles, sheer panels and other fashion-forward looks, finding the right shapewear can sometimes create a problem of its own. For Nailah Thorbourne, the multi-platinum recording artist, songwriter and entrepreneur known professionally as Nyla and as one-half of the internationally recognized music duo Brick & Lace, that challenge became the inspiration for a new fashion venture.

That solution is Vlair Shapewear, an online fashion brand created to provide women with shapewear designed to complement, rather than interfere with, today's bold clothing styles.

"I created Vlair because I saw a problem that needed to be solved, not just for myself, but for women who want to wear the clothes they love without having their shapewear work against the design," said Nailah Thorbourne, Founder/CEO of Vlair Shapewear. "I wanted to create something that allows a woman to put on that dress, step out and feel confident in what she's wearing."

MADE FOR THE CUT-OUTS

Traditional shapewear is often designed with conventional clothing silhouettes in mind. But today's fashion continues to embrace cut-outs, asymmetrical designs, one-shoulder styles, sheer panels and other looks that require a different approach to what is worn underneath.

Vlair was created with that reality in mind.

The brand's current collection includes shaper panties, shaper skirts, shaping bodysuits, shaper shorts and loungewear, with designs intended to work with a range of contemporary looks. The brand's signature positioning—"Made For the Cut Outs"—speaks directly to the fashion problem Vlair was created to address.

Among the collection is the Vlair Eclipse Bodysuit, which the company describes as being designed to disappear beneath one-shoulder dresses and sheer panels while helping provide shaping and support.

FROM THE STAGE TO THE FASHION INDUSTRY

Thorbourne brings a remarkable entertainment career to her role as a fashion entrepreneur. As a member of Brick & Lace, alongside her sister Nyanda Thorbourne, she helped establish an international recording career before continuing her work as a solo artist under the name Nyla.

Her career includes a significant collaboration with global electronic music group Major Lazer on the international hit "Light It Up." The song and its remix achieved platinum certifications in multiple international markets, with the remix featuring Nyla and Fuse ODG ultimately earning 2× Platinum certification in the United States.

In 2026, Thorbourne returned to the global stage when Nyla performed "Light It Up" with Major Lazer during the closing ceremony of the Milano Cortina 2026 Olympic Winter Games in Verona, Italy. The official ceremony program lists the performance as part of the closing celebration.

That combination of music, international performance and fashion experience has given Thorbourne a firsthand understanding of style, image and the importance of confidence when stepping in front of an audience.

With Vlair, Thorbourne is taking that experience in a new direction—creating a fashion brand built around a problem she believes modern women shouldn't have to accept.

"For me, Vlair is about more than shapewear. It's about giving women the freedom to wear the look they want to wear and feel good doing it," Thorbourne said. "The woman I designed Vlair for is bold, modern, and not afraid to step outside the box. She puts on the dress, walks through the door and owns the room."

DESIGNED FOR THE VLAIR WOMAN

Vlair describes its customer as "The Vlair Woman"—a woman who wears what she wants, how she wants, and approaches her style with intention.

The company's mission is to redefine shapewear for the modern woman through designs intended to promote confidence, individuality and the ability to wear today's boldest fashions.

Rather than asking women to change their fashion choices to accommodate traditional shapewear, Vlair takes the opposite approach: design shapewear to accommodate the fashion.

DISCOVER VLAIR SHAPEWEAR

Vlair Shapewear is available exclusively online, allowing customers to explore the collection and find pieces designed for their individual style.

To discover the collection and learn more about Vlair Shapewear, visit:

www.vlair.store 

ABOUT VLAIR SHAPEWEAR

Vlair Shapewear is a fashion-forward shapewear brand founded by multi-platinum recording artist, songwriter and entrepreneur Nailah Thorbourne, known professionally as Nyla and as one-half of Brick & Lace. Created from a personal need to solve the challenges of wearing shapewear beneath today's bold fashion silhouettes, Vlair is designed for the modern woman who wants to express her individuality without compromising confidence or style. With its "Made For the Cut Outs" philosophy, Vlair creates shapewear intended to work with contemporary fashion, including cut-outs, asymmetrical designs, one-shoulder styles and sheer looks.

releases.body:
Proactive cybersecurity provider to lead sessions on evolving student SOC programs and making cyber risk visible across higher education

ATLANTA, Sept. 28, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- TekStream, the digital resilience leader helping organizations modernize, secure and optimize their digital environments, today announced its participation at the 2026 Educause Annual Conference in Denver, CO from Sept. 29 through Oct. 2.

Throughout the conference, TekStream cybersecurity leaders will share practical approaches to two challenges higher education institutions face: building a stronger pipeline of career-ready cybersecurity talent and creating greater visibility into institutional cyber risk. TekStream will lead two sessions focused on helping colleges and universities evolve their security programs while strengthening long-term digital resilience.

"Higher education institutions are being asked to manage increasingly complex cyber environments while also developing the talent needed to protect them," said Taylor Morgan, Chief Solutions Officer at TekStream. "Educause gives us an opportunity to bring those conversations together and share practical models that can help institutions strengthen security today while building the workforce and capabilities they will need tomorrow."

The first of TekStream's two sessions is "Rethinking the Student SOC: Expanding Cyber Workforce Development Beyond Triage," which will take place Wednesday, Sept. 30 from 9:30 – 10:30 am MT. During the session, Matt Clemmons, Managing Director at TekStream, and Bruce Johnson, VP of Solutions Development, will explore how higher education institutions can evolve student security operations center (SOC) programs beyond traditional alert triage. As AI increasingly automates routine security analysis, the session will examine opportunities to expose students to higher-value functions including detection engineering, automation, incident response, risk intelligence, compliance and executive reporting.

On Thursday, Oct. 1, Johnson and Morgan will host the session, "From Blind Spots to Board Insight: Making Cyber Risk Visible in Higher Ed," from 1 – 1:45 pm MT. They'll discuss another persistent challenge for higher education security teams: turning fragmented security data into a clear picture of institutional cyber risk. The session will introduce a practical framework to reduce visibility gaps, establish continuous compliance assurance, and translate operational security data into insights that better inform institutional leaders and boards.

Attendees will leave with actionable approaches to connect technical telemetry to institutional risk, demonstrate the maturity of the security program, and improve cybersecurity decision-making across the institution.

"Higher education has a unique opportunity to make cybersecurity part of both its institutional resilience strategy and its educational mission," said Johnson. "By providing students with meaningful experience beyond alert triage and giving institutional leaders clearer insight into cyber risk, universities can build stronger security programs while preparing the next generation of cybersecurity professionals."

In addition to the conference sessions, TekStream will host a Higher Education Happy Hour on Wednesday, Sept. 30 from 6-8 pm MT at EDGE Restaurant & Bar at Four Seasons Hotel Denver. Educause attendees are invited to connect with TekStream leaders and higher education peers to continue the conversation around cybersecurity, workforce development and digital resilience. Please RSVP at https://go.tekstream.com/TekStreamEducauseFallHH2026 

About TekStream

TekStream is a digital resilience company that helps organizations secure, modernize, and operate their technology environments so they can adapt, recover, and grow. Named a Representative Vendor in the 2025 Gartner® Market Guide for Co-Managed Security Monitoring Services, TekStream delivers cloud migration, Managed Detection and Response (MDR), Security Operations Center (SOC) capabilities, and workforce consulting for commercial and government clients. With more than 200 active customers and a 98% retention rate, TekStream delivers on time and on budget. The company's Whole-of-State cybersecurity model combines workforce development with cost-deferment strategies, empowering public sector organizations to maintain long-term ownership of their security programs.

releases.title: Diamond Certified Resource Publishes New Article About Paid Advertising Versus Earned Certifications
releases.body:
Diamond Certified utilizes research-grade methodology to stand apart from paid advertising and crowdsourced reviews.

PETALUMA, Calif., Sept. 25, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- American Ratings Corporation, the creator of Diamond Certified Resource, the source for consumers who love quality local companies, has published a new article on diamondcertified.org titled, "Paid Advertising vs. Earned Certifications: The Diamond Certified Difference." The piece explains how Diamond Certified differs from advertising-funded review platforms by using verified customer surveys, rigorous qualification standards, credentials checks and ongoing performance monitoring.

All organizations that certify local companies rely on one or more funding sources: advertising, donations, company-paid subscriptions or consumer-paid subscriptions. They use these funds to create methodology, conduct operations, verify information, analyze results, deny or award certifications and monitor the performance of each certified company. Some spend even more on customer satisfaction surveys and collection of original research data.

Professional ethics matter most, starting with ratings methodology.

While all certifying organizations require funding, the highly ethical ones don't allow their funding sources to bias the results. In the case of 25-year-old American Ratings Corporation, creator of Diamond Certified Resource, high ethics and accuracy start with its methodology creation, which includes funding customer satisfaction surveys and collection of original research data. Any local company can apply for the certification and pay a small rating fee, whether they pass or fail. The Diamond Certified bar is set high, though. Only companies that achieve a customer satisfaction rating of 90 or higher on a 100-point scale for Highest in Quality and Helpful Expertise and pass all required credentials checks earn Diamond Certified. Companies that fall short of these high standards don't earn Diamond Certified, regardless of how much they'd be willing to pay.

Advertising funds crowdsourced review sites.

This isn't inherently a bad thing, but it does mean these sites must generate mass traffic and monetize company owners' interest to fund their business. To gain a high volume of reviews and a large number of companies, they use review intake methods that allow non-customers to post reviews and company owners to seed and cherry-pick only satisfied customers for review solicitations. Unfortunately, they're plagued by fake and cherry-picked reviews, which has resulted in massive star score inflation. A recent study by SEO Bandwagon concludes that two-thirds of rated Google business profiles hold at least a 4.5 star rating, with plumbers and roofers scoring an average 4.9 stars. Since most local companies have a star rating score that used to be held only by the top rated, consumers are forced to wade through reviews and see if they can purge fake and misleading ones in their minds.

Diamond Certified Resource's professional ethics, ratings methodology and experienced team

Having started their customer satisfaction research in the early 1990s, the founders of Diamond Certified are pioneers in creating certifications for local companies based on customer satisfaction surveys. The Diamond Certified Research Team is also deeply experienced in ratings and research, with most managers having served on the team for more than two decades. Team members are committed to maintaining high ethical standards and producing highly accurate company ratings and research. Founder/CEO Greg Louie describes their core principle as simple but powerful. "No company is awarded Diamond Certified unless it truly earns it," he says. "Also, companies must maintain their Highest in Quality and Helpful Expertise status or we take it from them."

What is Diamond Certified?

Created by American Ratings Corporation in 2001, the Diamond Certified Research Team rates local companies (mostly contractors and service companies) on customer satisfaction, quality and Helpful Expertise®. To earn Diamond Certified, companies must apply and pay a small rating fee, pass or fail. Then the Diamond Certified Research Team puts the company through a rigorous 12-step rating process, which includes in-depth customer satisfaction surveys and credentials verification.

The rating fee does not influence the results. In fact, most companies can't qualify.

The Diamond Certified Research Team does not use any unverified online reviews. It conducts independent, research-grade ratings and research of only verified customers. Here's a simple summary of its rating process:

  • A local company applies for Diamond Certified. The Diamond Certified Research Team gathers a customer list of all past customers during the previous year or a random sample of 400 customers for larger companies. Researchers conduct telephone and email surveys of these customers at random and verify that each respondent is an actual customer before proceeding. This process prevents surveying fake or cherry-picked customers.
  • During these live telephone interviews, surveyed customers evaluate the company's work quality, whether the company provided Helpful Expertise and whether the client would use the company again. In addition to collecting customers' scores for the company, researchers record verbatim responses to open-ended questions.
  • The Diamond Certified Research Team calculates an overall customer satisfaction rating on a 100-point scale for Highest in Quality and Helpful Expertise and verifies the company's credentials. Only companies that achieve a customer satisfaction rating of 90 or higher on a 100-point scale for Highest in Quality and Helpful Expertise and pass all required credentials checks earn Diamond Certified. The team then calculates a Star Equivalent Score for each verified customer rating by weighting a Quality score on a scale of 1 to 10, a YES/NO Loyalty (intent to return) score and a YES/NO Helpful Expertise score.
  • The team produces a bound, printed report (25-30 pages) that includes verification of applicable state licenses and confirmation of required general liability and workers' compensation insurance coverage.
  • Companies that meet all of Diamond Certified's high standards are awarded the prestigious Diamond Certified, and their complete ratings and research report is posted to their Diamond Certified Company Report at www.diamondcertified.org.
  • The Diamond Certified Research Team then monitors each Diamond Certified company's performance and produces ongoing ratings and research. Each Diamond Certified Company Report is the most accurate and deeply researched report available anywhere on that company. It includes ratings, verbatim survey responses, researched articles, a capabilities table, charts, videos, photos, and expert profiles and advice.

"Companies that maintain their Diamond Certified status also agree to additional levels of oversight," says Director of Ratings David Pak. "For example, they must participate in ongoing verified customer surveys and research interviews, which are published on their Diamond Certified Company Report at diamondcertified.org."

"We also track voluntary customer feedback between survey periods," adds Greg Louie. "A company may face suspension or termination if that feedback reveals a concerning pattern of business practices, even if its overall survey score remains high."

Consumers who work with a Diamond Certified company also receive mediation support and are backed by the Diamond Certified Performance Guarantee for up to $1,000.

The Diamond Certified Difference

Diamond Certified gives consumers a researched basis for choosing a quality local company: verified customer surveys, rigorous qualification standards, credentials verification, in-depth company-specific research, and ongoing performance ratings and monitoring. Companies can't buy their way into Diamond Certified. They must earn it and keep earning it to retain it.

For consumers, that means greater confidence when choosing a high-quality local company. The ratings and research behind each Diamond Certified company are available for free at www.diamondcertified.org, so consumers can examine the ratings, read customers' verbatim responses, explore the in-depth research and make an informed choice.

It's easy to find top rated companies in the San Francisco Bay Area and Other Areas on Diamond Certified Resource.

American Ratings Corporation (ARC), the creator of Diamond Certified Resource, the source for consumers who love quality local companies, rates local companies by surveying only their verified real customers to produce the country's most accurate ratings of local companies. It also creates deeply researched company reports and consumer guides that give consumers the best companies plus the best advice for choosing a local Auto, Home, Health or Personal service type of company.

Only companies rated Highest in Quality and Helpful Expertise® earn Diamond Certified and are backed by their Performance Guarantee. All their deeply researched reports and guides are available for free at diamondcertified.org. They also produce an annual, full-color, printed Diamond Certified Directory with 840,000 copies published in 9 geographic zones in the Greater San Francisco Bay Area. releases.title: Final Curtain of Latest Screenings of The King of Trash, The Sold-Out Movie About California Waste Solutions & David Duong, In San Jose & Emeryville
releases.body:
The King of Trash, a hit documentary about the Duong family and their recycling company California Waste Solutions, has captivated communities all over California. This weekend, the last VIP screening of the movie in California in the latest tour takes place in San Jose. 

SAN JOSE, Calif., Sept. 25, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- The King of Trash, the feature documentary about Vietnamese-American entrepreneur David Duong and the family that built California Waste Solutions, Inc. and Vietnam Waste Solutions, returns to San Jose on Saturday for its final VIP pre-screening, with Duong, members of the cast, and director Errol Webber expected to meet the audience.

The Saturday, September 26 program screens from 4:00 p.m. to 8:00 p.m. at AMC Eastridge, 2190 Eastridge Loop. It closes a new round of Bay Area public screenings that has drawn nearly 1,000 registrations and wait-list requests after an eight-city U.S. pre-screening tour that brought more than 5,000 people into theaters in San Jose, Oakland, Sacramento, Orange County, Dallas, Houston, Washington, D.C., and Orlando.

The film also screens Friday, September 25, at the 20th Red Rock Film Festival in St. George, Utah, where it was selected for the 2026 program. A further Bay Area date follows on Saturday, October 3, from 5:00 p.m. to 7:00 p.m. at AMC Bay Street Emeryville.

"We are absolutely amazed and thrilled at the reception for the movie," said David Duong, Founder & CEO of The King of Trash. "We honestly never expected anything like this. It's been very moving to see so many people touched by my family's story of arriving here on the shores of America, picking up trash by hand, and building CWS out into the wonderful company that it is today."

A Community Company

The work that goes on behind the scenes at California Waste Solutions to make the cities it operates in clean, green and pretty are laid out in painstaking detail in The King of Trash, as well as the enormous sacrifices that went into making it all happen.

Crews are on the yard before most neighborhoods are awake; drivers and operations staff inspect trucks, check equipment, and walk the day's routes; once the fleet leaves the gate, collection moves through traffic that changes block by block. At the facilities, incoming material is received, flow is managed, and processing is kept in step with the street. Mechanics keep both the trucks and the sorting lines in service. When weather, volume, or street conditions change at a moment's notice, crews adjust. The work never stops.

"For most people, recycling is part of a routine they rarely think about," said Michael Duong, President of California Waste Solutions. "In our business, that usually means a win. At the same time, educating people about recycling and the importance of this vital service is also something we've tried really hard to do over the past few years, and hopefully The King of Trash succeeds with this a little. We like to think so."

The company measures reliability less by tonnage than by whether residents can depend on the service without having to think about it. Pre-dawn preparation, coordination between people and machines, and the refusal to treat any honest job as small are the same disciplines that took the Duong family from a single truck to a municipal recycling franchise serving two major California cities. The King of Trash records that continuity in documentary footage and in several dramatized sequences drawn from the company's own history.

Closing Out In San Jose

San Jose is being treated as the natural close for the VIP series. It is a California Waste Solutions service city and home to one of the largest Vietnamese-American communities in the country. For many families in the room, the history on screen is not distant. Meanwhile, the last showing of the current screening run will come to an end in Emeryville, close to the Duong family's Oakland home roots.

"We came to this country with nothing but hope. Everything we built came from hard work and faith," said David Duong. "The movie is as much an homage to the places we were able to build the company into what it is today, and the wonderful, conscientious people in it who are our customers and employees."

Directed by Oscar-winning cinematographer Errol Webber, the 72-minute documentary traces the Duong family's escape from Saigon in April 1975, the open-sea crossing, a refugee camp in the Philippines, and the years of street-level recycling in San Francisco that grew into one of Northern California's major family-owned environmental services companies and a large-scale waste-management operation in Vietnam.

The new Bay Area run has drawn packed houses and unusually strong word of mouth from immigrant families who say the film is their story, not a corporate profile. Earlier dates in the current cycle included a sold-through showing in Hayward and a special screening in Dublin on September 19.

The production is preparing for official release and global distribution and has also been selected for the 2026 San Francisco International New Concept Film Festival.

The King of Trash California Screening schedule

San Jose: Saturday, Sept. 26, 4-8 p.m., AMC Eastridge 15, 2190 Eastridge Loop. Final VIP red-carpet prescreening.

Emeryville: Saturday, Oct. 3, 5-7 p.m., AMC Bay Street 16, 5614 Bay St., Suite 220. Free and open to the public.

Registration: TheKingofTrash.us. Seating is limited.

About The King of Trash

The King of Trash is a feature documentary directed by Errol Webber. It tells the true story of David Duong and the Duong family, Vietnamese refugees who survived the fall of Saigon, rebuilt their lives in America, and founded California Waste Solutions and Vietnam Waste Solutions. Official site: www.thekingoftrash.us. Media: info@thekingoftrash.us.

About California Waste Solutions

Founded in 1992 by David Duong, California Waste Solutions provides recycling collection, processing, customer service, and material recovery for residential, commercial, and municipal customers in Northern California, including Oakland and San José. Through its subsidiary Vietnam Waste Solutions, the company also operates large-scale environmental infrastructure in Ho Chi Minh City. Headquarters: 1211 Embarcadero, Suite 300, Oakland, CA 94606. www.calwaste.com.

releases.title: Hasan Minhaj Named Recipient of the AAF's 2026 Cultural Force Award
releases.body:
Comedian, Writer, Actor, & Producer 186K Films Honored for Shaping Culture at the Intersection of Comedy, Media, and Marketing

WASHINGTON, Sept. 25, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- The American Advertising Federation (AAF), "The Unifying Voice for Advertising", today announced that comedian, writer, and producer Hasan Minhaj will receive the 2026 Cultural Force Award, a special honor presented as part of the AAF's long standing Advertising Hall of Achievement (AHOA). While the AHOA recognizes advertising professionals age 40 and under, the Cultural Force Award — introduced in 2023 — honors a public figure outside the industry whose work has nonetheless shaped how brands advertise, market, and reach new audiences.

Minhaj joins the AHOA Class of 2026, alongside eight previously announced honorees who have found ways to make their impact on advertising. Previous Cultural Force Award recipients include former NBA All-Star Chris Paul in 2023; writer, producer, and actress Issa Rae in 2024; and supermodel Ashley Graham in 2025.

Today's announcement comes as Minhaj's Netflix feature film Best of the Best — produced by his company 186K Films and co-written by and starring Minhaj — premiered globally on September 18, 2026.

While Minhaj is known for his career as a stand-up comedian, writer, producer, political commentator, and actor, he has also become one of the advertising industry's most recognizable creative collaborators. Notably, Minhaj is the face of Adobe's multi-year Acrobat campaign, including starring as a marketing executive in Adobe's original branded comedy series The Marketers — playing, in effect, the very industry now honoring him.

"The Cultural Force Award is reserved for individuals who have not only shaped culture, but challenged it, pushing conversations forward, redefining narratives, and leaving audiences thinking a little deeper. Hasan's work has consistently done exactly that," said Steve Pacheco, President & CEO of the AAF. "Whether unpacking complex social issues, questioning systems of power, or simply reminding us that the right storytelling has the power to cut through noise -- he's created a voice that resonates far beyond entertainment."

"I've played a marketing exec in Adobe ads for three years, so getting an actual advertising award feels like incredible method acting finally paying off," said Minhaj. "In all seriousness, it's an honor — advertising forced me to say 'synergy' out loud on camera, so really, this serves as a two-way apology."

Minhaj will be presented the award on Thursday, November 19, at Pier Sixty in New York City, alongside this year's AAF's Advertising Hall of Achievement inductees. Corporate sponsors for this year's event include LinkedIn, Dentsu, Disney Advertising, Google, TikTok, AMC Networks, Amazon Ads, Paramount Advertising, TelevisaUnivision, Omnicom Media, 3C Ventures, Albertson's Media Collective, Known, and WPP Media.

For further details about the AAF AHOA dinner and ceremonies, including sponsorship opportunities, visit aaf.org/ahoa. At The Moment Media (ATM) is the official media partner of the 2026 Advertising Hall of Achievement Ceremonies.

About Hasan Minhaj

Hasan Minhaj is a two-time Peabody Award-winning comedian best known for his breakout Netflix special Homecoming King and his political satire series Patriot Act with Hasan Minhaj, winner of a Peabody, an Emmy, and a Television Academy Honor. He is the co-founder and CEO of 186K Films, whose feature Best of the Best — directed by Lena Khan and starring Maitreyi Ramakrishnan and Priyanka Kedia — premieres globally on Netflix September 18, 2026. Minhaj co-wrote the film with Prashanth Venkataramanujam and stars in it. He hosts the podcast and digital series Hasan Minhaj Doesn't Know and was a senior correspondent on Comedy Central's The Daily Show with Jon Stewart.

ABOUT AAF (AMERICAN ADVERTISING FEDERATION)

The American Advertising Federation (AAF), established in 1905, is the nation's oldest national advertising trade association and serves as "The Unifying Voice for Advertising." Guided by its Board of Directors, the AAF leads the industry's premier programs and events, including the Advertising Hall of Fame, Advertising Hall of Achievement, American Advertising Awards, ADMERICA, Advertising Day on the Hill, the Most Promising Students Program, and HBCUs for Advertising. Together, these initiatives support a nationwide network of more than 125 professional chapters, 140 collegiate chapters, and more than 65 corporate members representing leading media and technology companies, advertisers, and agencies. Learn more at https://aaf.org. 

ABOUT AAF ADVERTISING HALL OF ACHIEVEMENT (AHOA)

For more than 30 years, the AAF Advertising Hall of Achievement has recognized exceptional advertising leaders age 40 and younger who are shaping the future of the industry. Inductees are selected through a rigorous, two-round judging process led by Hall of Achievement alumni and senior industry executives. Established by the American Advertising Federation (AAF) in 1993, the program is one of the industry's highest honors for emerging leaders.

releases.title: MELLODY FARM HARVEST FESTIVAL RETURNS OCT. 24 WITH LIVE MUSIC, FOOD AND DRINK TASTINGS, PET ADOPTIONS AND FALL FAMILY FUN
releases.body:
Daylong Vernon Hills Event Will Feature The Harvest Haul, Illinois Agriculture Programming, Yappy Hour With Lazy Dog, Bites & Sips And Bourbon & Bonfires

VERNON HILLS, Ill., Sept. 24, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Mellody Farm celebrates the season with its annual Harvest Festival on Sat., Oct. 24, from 10 a.m. to 8 p.m., bringing together fall activities, live entertainment, food and beverage experiences, pet-friendly programming, and community fundraising throughout the shopping center.

The daylong festival features free activities beginning at 10 a.m., followed by ticketed Harvest Festival Bites & Sips and Bourbon & Bonfires experiences from 4 p.m. to 8 p.m. Proceeds from the event will benefit the Hawthorn School District PTO.

A centerpiece of this year's festival will be the Mellody Farm Harvest Haul, a shopping center-wide experience encouraging guests to "Fill Your Basket Around the Farm." Guests can pick up a free Harvest Haul card at festival check-in and visit participating retailers, restaurants and activities throughout Mellody Farm to collect fall-themed stickers. Guests who complete at least eight participating stops can return their cards to receive a free fall-themed Mellody Farm item, while supplies last, and be entered to win prizes.

The grand-prize package will be highlighted by a two-night family getaway to Eagle Ridge Resort & Spa and will include additional prizes and experiences from Mellody Farm businesses, including a Hydrafacial from OVME Medical Aesthetics, retail items from European Wax Center, a prize from SITKA Gear and additional dining, merchandise and tenant contributions.

From 10 a.m. to early afternoon, the festival will also feature an Illinois Agriculture & Urban Farm Zone. From 10 to 11:30 a.m., guests can take part in a free "Winterizing Your Garden" workshop, offering seasonal tips and practical guidance for preparing home gardens for the colder months. The morning programming also features Biscuits & Bloody Marys, a special Bites & Sips offering with biscuits and seasonal beverages, including lemonade, cider and Bloody Marys.

Representatives from the Lake County Farm Bureau, University of Illinois Extension and Illinois Sustainable Agriculture Partnership are also participating with activities and conversations focused on Illinois agriculture, urban farming, soil health, sustainability, gardening and local hunger-relief efforts.

Throughout the center from 10 a.m. to 2 p.m., guests will encounter roaming entertainment. Programming includes a mix of face painting, balloon artists, photo opportunities, seasonal characters and Mellody Farm's four-legged ambassador, Keenam, who will make appearances throughout the property.

From 1 p.m. to 2 p.m., Yappy Hour presented by Lazy Dog will put the spotlight on Mellody Farm's canine guests. The pet-friendly event is planned to include a fall pet costume contest, pet photo opportunities, giveaways and a pet rescue and adoption event with PAWS Chicago. Costumed pets and their owners also will be invited to join a festive pet parade through Mellody Farm.

Beginning at 4 p.m., the festival will transition into its primary evening celebration with live music from Big Boss and the Toes and a Harvest Festival Bites & Sips experience. The festival will feature approximately six Bites & Sips stations with participating restaurants including City Works, Tangled Roots, Mendocino Farms and Lazy Dog. Offerings will range from meatloaf sliders and pretzels to beer, house-made lemonade and other seasonal bites and beverages.

A separate Bourbon & Bonfires experience with Aged in Oak will feature bourbon tastings, curated flights, bourbon education and gathering areas around Mellody Farm's fire pits.

Tickets are $35 for Harvest Festival Bites & Sips, $35 for Bourbon & Bonfires or $55 for a package that includes both experiences. A $20 designated driver ticket also will be available. Most daytime festival programming is free and open to the public.

The festival also will help launch Mellody Farm's seasonal community giving initiative, encouraging guests to donate nonperishable food and clothing to support local families and hunger-relief efforts.

The Harvest Haul Grand Prize will be announced at approximately 7:30 p.m., and the festival will conclude at 8 p.m. Guests are encouraged to remain at Mellody Farm for dinner, drinks and evening shopping.

Harvest Festival Bites & Sips tickets can be purchased online at omella.com/267p5. Additional festival programming and participating businesses can be found at www.mellodyfarm.com.

About Mellody Farm

Located in the heart of Vernon Hills, Illinois, Mellody Farm is an open-air shopping, dining and lifestyle destination owned and operated by Regency Centers. Conveniently located at the corner of Milwaukee Avenue and Townline Road, just two miles west of Interstate 94, the center features approximately 270,000 square feet of retail, restaurants and entertainment alongside 260 executive apartments. Designed as a vibrant community gathering place, Mellody Farm offers a thoughtfully curated mix of national retailers, local dining experiences and year-round events that bring people together through shopping, dining, wellness and community engagement.

Vernon Hills, IL 60061
