releases.body:
Five events from October 11-18 feature Grammy-winning jazz and vocals in A Tribute to Quincy Jones, unique classical featuring both storytelling and rock, bluegrass legends Carter and Cleveland, and a special holiday choral finale in December from Chanticleer

  • Fall Series runs October 11 through 18, with a holiday concert December 15
  • Pacific Jazz Orchestra brings A Tribute to Quincy Jones on Oct 18 at Rancho Campana PAC; Grammy-nominated conductor Chris Walden leads, featuring vocalists Nayanna Holley, Adam "Aejaye" Jackson
  • Bluegrass Fiddle Legends Michael Cleveland and Jason Carter perform at Mission Park on October 17
  • Season closes December 15 with Chanticleer at Ventura Center for Spiritual Living
  • Tickets on sale now at venturamusicfestival.org

VENTURA, Calif., Sept. 24, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- The Ventura Music Festival (VMF) proudly presents its 2026 Fall Series, a 5-event run in October featuring an exceptional range of world-class performers across jazz, classical, and bluegrass, with a special holiday concert in December from the choral institution, Chanticleer. Presented across beloved, iconic venues throughout Ventura County, the Fall Series delivers genre-spanning programming rooted in VMF's 31-year commitment to musical excellence and community access.

Tea and Trumpets | Sunday, October 11 | 3 PM

The Fall Series opens with Tea and Trumpets, VMF's signature intimate experience pairing an elegant afternoon tea service with live brass quintet performance. A local favorite, the event returns by popular demand for another season, hosted at the historic Pierpont Inn.

Birth of Impressionism | Thursday, October 15 | The Museum of Ventura County | 7 PM

VMF's popular Classical Edge Concert format returns with Birth of Impressionism, an evening that is part performance, part history, and part discovery. Led by VMF Artistic Director and violinist Nuvi Mehta, the event takes audiences inside a pivotal moment in musical history, bringing the ideas and sounds of the Impressionist movement to life through storytelling and live music.

TAKE3: Where Rock Meets Bach | Friday, October 16 | Ventura Music Hall | 7 PM

On Friday, October 16, TAKE3 takes the stage at Ventura Music Hall for a genre-smashing evening that pairs the technical precision of Bach with the energy and irreverence of rock. The violin, cello, and piano trio -- conservatory-trained and rock-star electrifying -- has built a devoted following for performances as surprising as they are virtuosic. This event is ticketed directly through Ventura Music Hall.

Michael Cleveland and Jason Carter | Saturday, October 17 | Mission Park, Ventura | 5 PM

On Saturday, October 17, VMF brings the two most decorated fiddle players in the history of the International Bluegrass Music Association to Mission Park in Ventura. Michael Cleveland, a 12-time IBMA Fiddle Player of the Year, joins 6-time winner Jason Carter for an outdoor performance that celebrates the finest traditions of American roots music in one of Ventura's most beloved community settings. Sponsored by Vita Arts Center, The Welcome Room, Ofi Property and Daly Group

Pacific Jazz Orchestra: A Tribute to Quincy Jones | Sunday, October 18 | Rancho Campana Performing Arts Center, Camarillo | 3 PM

The Fall Series centerpiece brings Pacific Jazz Orchestra to Rancho Campana Performing Arts Center for an exploration of Quincy Jones' masterful early work from the 1950s and 60s. Seven-time Grammy-nominated Artistic Director and conductor Chris Walden -- who counts Jones himself among his mentors -- leads the group's 19-piece Big Band Ensemble through original arrangements drawn from Jones' groundbreaking recordings, his arrangements for legendary singers including Frank Sinatra and Sarah Vaughan, and his film scoring work on landmarks such as The Pawnbroker (1964) and In the Heat of the Night (1967).

Guest vocalists Nayanna Holley and Adam "Aejaye" Jackson join for the occasion. Holley, a longtime member of the house band for NBC's The Voice, brings extraordinary range as a performer and vocal contractor whose credits span The Color Purple, Encanto, and The Academy Awards. Jackson, a Detroit-born vocalist, songwriter, and actor, brings a soulful blend of R&B, soul, and jazz shaped by decades of collaboration with artists including Stevie Wonder, Josh Groban, Toni Braxton, and David Foster.

Pacific Jazz Orchestra has garnered critical acclaim for performances that "entertain, inspire, and enrich" (Variety). The 40-piece Los Angeles-based ensemble is recognized as the city's first resident jazz orchestra since 2006. Tickets for the October 18 concert are $15 -- $109, available at venturamusicfestival.org or by calling (805) 648-3146. The concert takes place at Rancho Campana Performing Arts Center, 4235 Mar Vista Drive, Camarillo, CA 93010.

Chanticleer | Tuesday, December 15 | Ventura Center for Spiritual Living | 7 PM

VMF's 31st season closes December 15 with a special holiday concert from Chanticleer, the celebrated twelve-voice male ensemble that has sold over one million recordings and performed thousands of concerts across the globe. Named for the clear-singing rooster in Geoffrey Chaucer's Canterbury Tales, the ensemble spans countertenor to bass and performs five centuries of choral music with breathtaking precision. The performance at Ventura Center for Spiritual Living brings the season to a warm and luminous close.

Tickets

Tickets for all VMF-presented Fall Series events are on sale now at venturamusicfestival.org or by calling (805) 648-3146. VMF also offers subsidized ticket pricing and free programming to ensure music remains accessible throughout the community.

About the Ventura Music Festival

A 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization since 1995, the Ventura Music Festival has been a cornerstone of cultural life in Ventura for over thirty years, presenting world-class performances while championing music education and free community programming. VMF's Music in the Schools program serves more than 1,600 students annually, and the organization delivers free community concerts each season, reaching a total community audience of 10,100+. The 2026 season is presented with generous support from Impresario Season Sponsors, the John and Glenda Hammer Family. For tickets and information, visit venturamusicfestival.org or call (805) 648-3146.

releases.title: Paralyzed Veterans of America Debuts "Voices of PVA" Podcast - the Definitive Voice on Life with Spinal Cord Injuries and Diseases, like MS and ALS
releases.body:
Audio program to appeal to veterans and broader disability community alike, with new episodes dropping every other week starting Oct. 6

WASHINGTON, Sept. 24, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Paralyzed Veterans of America launches "Voices of PVA" – an audio-only podcast designed to inform, empower, and connect veterans and people living with spinal cord injuries or diseases (SCI/D), like MS and ALS, and those who support them. Having debuted on September 22 and on the heels of PVA's One of One campaign, the podcast serves as the definitive voice of PVA and life with SCI/D. Every episode brings listeners inside the healthcare battles, legislative wins, adaptive sports journeys, and more shaping the lives of those with disabilities. Hosted by U.S. Navy SEAL veteran/Paralympian and editor-in-chief of Paraplegic News and Sports 'N Spokes magazines Al Kovach, as well as PVA reporter Chad Stewart, each installment features guests with personal ties to paralysis — from veteran athletes and policy leaders to caregivers, renowned researchers, and more.

"The 'Voices of PVA' podcast is an extension of PVA's commitment to ensuring veterans with spinal cord injuries and diseases, like MS and ALS, not only have access to trusted information and meaningful stories, but also feel seen and heard," said Carl Blake, CEO of Paralyzed Veterans of America. "We're creating a space where lived experiences, expert insights, and advocacy intersect in a way that is deeply human, highly impactful, and one of a kind. While most outlets cover veteran or disability issues, our podcast, like PVA's important work, covers them both."

The first season of "Voices of PVA" will feature 24 episodes – complete with powerful, actionable content. Whether you're new to the SCI/D community, a longtime advocate, or know someone living with a disability, "Voices of PVA" offers practical insights and a deeper connection to the issues that matter, with new episodes dropping every other week.

"This podcast is something PVA has wanted for a long time, and now we finally have it," said Robert Thomas, a U.S. Army veteran and national president of PVA. "Some of the most important conversations in our community happen when people come together, and 'Voices of PVA' creates a space for these conversations to reach further."

Listeners can expect a dynamic mix of personal stories, expert interviews, policy discussions, and practical guidance delivered in a format that is accessible, engaging, and rooted in real-world experience. The podcast represents a significant step forward in PVA's ongoing efforts to innovate how it connects with its community and elevates issues impacting veterans and people with disabilities.

"Conversations have power. A magazine article can inform you, but a conversation lets you hear someone's heart," Kovach said. "We hope every listener walks away from our podcast having learned something useful, felt inspired, and more connected to the community. If someone hears an episode and thinks, 'I'm not alone,' or 'I didn't know that resource existed' — that's success in our eyes."

Just two days following its launch, listeners flooded PVA with reactions, such as:

"The 'Voices of PVA' podcast creates a safe, engaging space for diverse perspectives to ask questions, sharpen our knowledge, and pass that knowledge along to our own communities," said Chadwick W., U.S. Air Force veteran and PVA Buckeye Chapter member. "[These] honest conversation[s], help to problem-solve better approaches to care and advocate to the broader community."

To learn more about the "Voices of PVA" podcast and its hosts visit PVA.org/VoicesOfPVA. To subscribe, leave a review, or share an episode with someone you know, visit Substack.com/@PVA1946.

About Paralyzed Veterans of America

Paralyzed Veterans of America is a 501(c)(3) non-profit and the only congressionally chartered veterans service organization dedicated solely for the benefit and representation of veterans with spinal cord injury or diseases. The organization ensures veterans receive the benefits earned through service to our nation; monitors their care in VA spinal cord injury units; and funds research and education in the search for a cure and improved care for individuals with paralysis.

As a life-long partner and advocate for veterans and all people with disabilities, PVA also develops training and career services, works to ensure accessibility in public buildings and spaces, and provides health and rehabilitation opportunities through sports and recreation. With more than 70 offices and 33 chapters, Paralyzed Veterans of America serves veterans, their families, and their caregivers in all 50 states, the District of Columbia, and Puerto Rico. Learn more at PVA.org.

releases.title: Byron Allen Comes to DPAA Global Video Everywhere Summit with Opening Keynote Conversation: Your Brand's Best Storyteller is Video
releases.body:
Founder of One of the Largest Independent Studios in the World to Talk about the Future of Media and Advertising on October 13th in NYC

DPAA to Bring Together Allen, Anthony Scaramucci, Leading CMOs and Agency Executives Around the Theme "Real Connections" and to Discuss the Value of Digital OOH to Brands

NEW YORK, Sept. 24, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Byron Allen - founder, chairman and CEO of Allen Media Group, will be taking the stage in the opening keynote conversation at the 14th annual DPAA Global Video Everywhere Summit. Allen will talk about the power of video as the primary storytelling tool for brands looking to meaningfully connect with consumers.

Digital screens and video are now prolific and growing aggressively outside the home, from Times Square and Piccadilly to movie theaters, office buildings, airports, highways plus retail and transit centers. These screen advertising and storytelling opportunities will be showcased and discussed, attracting media and marketing decision makers to the Summit — October 13th in Chelsea Piers, NY.

Curated around the theme of Real Connections, this year's Summit intentionally brings together influential voices who would not ordinarily share the same stage. From Byron Allen and former White House Communications Director Anthony Scaramucci to agency leaders from Mediahub and Stagwell and CMOs representing American Eagle Outfitters, Major League Soccer, Expedia and more, the lineup spans media, culture, brands, business and public conversation — different worlds connected by a shared understanding of how to earn attention, build trust and ultimately move people to action.

Scaramucci, founder and managing partner of SkyBridge Capital, will join the Summit following the release of his new book, All the Wrong Moves, for a keynote fireside conversation just weeks before the U.S. midterm elections. His appearance alongside Allen and some of the world's leading marketing and agency executives reflects the Summit's broader ambition: bringing different perspectives into one room to explore how influence, attention and real connections are created today.

"We are intentionally putting the people shaping media, culture and public conversation in the same room as the key decisionmakers across brands, commerce and investment," said DPAA President & CEO Barry Frey. "True to this year's theme of Real Connections is bringing together people who have a deep understanding of how to turn attention, influence, and trust into action."

While the Summit is designed to provide attendees with perspectives, relationships, and ideas they can apply to their advertising, marketing, media and technology businesses, DPAA also believes that in order to engage and educate you also need to entertain. As previously announced, the Broadway cast of The Book of Mormon will be performing live at the event. (Click HERE for the full lineup for the October 13 event at Pier 60 in New York City.)

The Built-in Connection of Entertainment and Brand Engagement

Byron Allen is one of the most influential media moguls in today's entertainment and technology space. Among his portfolio are The Weather Channel and its Local Now streaming service, 13 network-affiliated broadcast television stations, cable television networks, a theatrical and digital movie production and distribution arm, and a majority stake in Buzzfeed, at which he is chairman and CEO. Allen Media Group is the largest supplier of first-run syndicated programming and network television in the industry.

Having begun his career as a performer - including being the youngest stand-up comic on The Tonight Show starring Johnny Carson - Allen is celebrating the 20th anniversary of his original show, Comics Unleashed with Byron Allen, which in May replaced The Late Show with Stephen Colbert in the 11:30 p.m. hour, and airs weeknights on CBS, followed by his comedy game show, Funny You Should Ask. This unique life experience has given him an intimate understanding of what it takes to stay engaging as a brand, and is one factor that makes him a much sought-after speaker at leading industry conferences.

"The media industry is going through an enormous transformation," said Byron Allen, Founder/Chairman/CEO of Allen Media Group and Chairman/CEO of Buzzfeed, Inc. "The disruption is creating both a massive demise and extraordinary opportunities. Without hesitation, this is the moment you must decide – are you a victim or a pioneer? I've chosen pioneer."

Added Frey, who will be moderating the keynote conversation, "We are really looking forward to talking with Byron Allen about how his growing media empire thinks about the state and future of advertising, and why video is key to forming real connections between brands and consumers – although I'd be lying if I didn't admit to being a little worried that he will ask me to be on Comics Unleashed as I'm not sure my comic repertoire is ready just yet. That said, by adding a pioneer in media to the lineup, we will bring a new dimension of insights to those attending the Summit, which will feature one of our most influential and impactful groups of brand, agency and industry leaders to date."

About Byron Allen

Byron Allen founded Allen Media Group in 1993. Headquartered in Los Angeles, it has offices in New York and Atlanta. Allen Media Group owns/operates 13 ABC-CBS-NBC network affiliate broadcast television stations in 11 U.S. markets and ten 24-hour HD television networks serving nearly 315 million subscribers: THE WEATHER CHANNEL, PETS.TV, COMEDY.TV, RECIPE.TV, CARS.TV, ES.TV, MYDESTINATION.TV, JUSTICECENTRAL.TV, THEGRIO TELEVISION NETWORK, and HBCU GO. Allen Media Group also owns the digital streaming platforms HBCU GO, SPORTS.TV, THEGRIO, THE WEATHER CHANNEL STREAMING APP, and LOCAL NOW--the free-streaming AVOD service powered by THE WEATHER CHANNEL and content partners, which delivers real-time, hyper-local news, weather, traffic, sports, and lifestyle information. In 2026, Allen's family office acquired a majority of the outstanding shares of the digital media platform BuzzFeed, Inc., with Byron Allen assuming the role of Chairman and Chief Executive Officer with a vision to build on the iconic foundations of BuzzFeed, HuffPost, and Tasty by expanding into free-streaming video, audio and user-generated content. Allen Media Group also produces, distributes, and sells advertising for 80 television programs, making it one of the largest independent producers/distributors of first-run syndicated television programming for broadcast television stations. With a library of over 10,000 hours of owned content across multiple genres, Allen Media Group provides video content to broadcast television stations, cable television networks, mobile devices, and digital platforms. Our mission is to provide excellent content to our viewers, global platforms, and Fortune 500 advertising partners. For more information, visit: www.allenmedia.tv

About the DPAA Global Video Everywhere Summit

Each year in the heart of New York City, DPAA's flagship Summit brings approximately 1,000 industry leaders direct access to the people who influence the future of omnichannel marketing. There, people from brands, agencies, media platforms, and technology companies around the world network with others in this vibrant community; discuss marketing trends, challenges, and opportunities; and hear from CMOs, newsmakers, and agency executives. One Day. Real Connections. Year-Round Impact. The people shaping what's next in DOOH, including real-life experiences, retail media networks, sports marketing, and more, come together at the Summit for conversations that shape the future of advertising for brands and agencies.

Over the years, speakers have included leaders representing companies ranging from Colgate-Palmolive, General Motors, Mastercard, McDonald's, PepsiCo, Kroger, Danone, Warner Bros., Paramount+, and H&R Block, to WPP, Dentsu, Omnicom, and more.

For more information, or to register to attend the Global Summit – part of Out of Home Week New York – please visit www.dpaasummit.com/global.

About DPAA

DPAA (www.dpaaglobal.com) is the global trade marketing association, driving the growth and digitization of out-of-home (OOH) advertising and its growing role in the Omnichannel mix. Membership in the DPAA community includes many business acceleration benefits and access to a wide array of products. It offers members an extensive database of research, best practices and case studies; tools for planning, training and forecasting; social media amplification of news; insights on software and hardware solutions; and further integration into the advertising ecosystem by connecting DOOH networks, brands, agencies, ad tech, and others – including through its podcast, Launchpad of Innovation. DPAA's Video Everywhere Summit, the largest one-day media/marketing event of its kind, is October 13, 2026, at Pier 60 in New York City.

releases.title: Annapolis Jazz & Roots Festival Offers Music, History and Culture November 6-15
releases.body:
ANNAPOLIS, Md., Sept. 24, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Annapolis Jazz & Roots is launching its fifth festival on the scenic shores of the Chesapeake Bay. Enjoy music, art, poetry and history on two weekends, November 6-15. Based in the maritime community of Eastport, the festival includes eight venues in five neighborhoods. Each has its own distinct character and charm. Festival goers can visit centuries old buildings, take in restorative bay views and stroll the tree-lined streets of the historic Maryland city.

THEME AND HIGHLIGHTS

The 2026 theme "New World Music: Centuries of Sound" will be brought home by international and regional performers. An adventurous lineup includes programs rooted in history and culture from colonial days to modern times. Trace the evolution of music and culture since the days Indigenous tribes walked the forests and rode the waters. Gain new insights into the startling history and lasting legacy of slavery and indenture in Maryland; delve into the soulful roots of jazz, and celebrate the changing color of sound in America.

Events are free or require modest admission, and all but two venues offer free onsite parking. Reservations are strongly advised for all events. Visit instantseats.com ( https://instnt.us/AJRF ).

WEEKEND ONE

Opening Night takes place Friday, November 6 at 7:00 p.m. at St. Luke's Episcopal Church in Eastport. Jazz lovers will appreciate how the intimacy and beautiful acoustics of the venue elevate the listening experience when the Muneer Nasser Band performs.

Trumpeter Muneer Nasser was exposed to great music by his father, jazz bassist Jamil Nasser. His concert pays homage to three legendary musicians born in 1926: John Coltrane, Miles Davis and Randy Weston. Their brave explorations led to seismic shifts in the sonic landscape and continue to resonate around the globe.

On Saturday at 11:00 a.m. visit Eastport-Annapolis Neck Library to learn about slavery and indenture in colonial times. Lecturer William Kelly, Ph.D. is a research archivist and historian at the Maryland State Archives. His event concludes a Q & A.

The second November 7 offering will be held at Peerless Rens Club, an historic Black social club. Listeners will be blown away by Perkutao, an Afro Peruvian band formed in Lima, Peru! Catch shows at 4:00 p.m. or 6:00 p.m. Food and bar beverages will be on sale.

Two amazing shows await music lovers on Sunday. At 2:00 p.m. David and Ginger Hildebrand will play colonial music on period instruments at Unitarian Universalist Church of Annapolis. The richly entertaining concert pays tribute to General Lafayette, the French nobleman who won American hearts during the American Revolutionary War.

At 7:00 p.m. the focus shifts to modern-day America when musician Makaya McCraven appears at Maryland Hall. The drummer and composer transforms jazz through a bold blend of improvisation, hip-hop production, and global musical traditions. For this show only, purchase tickets from the venue: https://my.marylandhall.org/makayamccraven.

WEEKEND TWO

On Friday, November 13 at 7:00 p.m., Eastport UM Church hosts the U.S.N.A. Band's Superintendent's Combo in a tribute to Miles Davis. The event is dedicated to the late Annapolis musician and lifelong arts volunteer "TEA" Arthur and concludes with a public reception.

Jazz fans may want to chug their Saturday morning coffee to reach Eastport-Annapolis Neck Library by 11:00 a.m. NY jazz vocalist Vanessa Racci will review the many Italian contributions to American jazz. The award-winning artist has delivered her colorful presentation at Rutgers University, The Generoso Pope Italian American Cultural Center and The Italian American Museum of NYC.

A jazz artist of extraordinary talent and crowd-moving passion, Akua Allrich appears Saturday at 2:00 p.m. at Banneker-Douglass-Tubman Museum. Rooted in blues, soul, and R & B, the D.C. vocalist has electrified international audiences through concerts and recordings. On November 14, she celebrates the release of her 2026 album Bonya and pays tribute to two legendary artists and civil rights activists: South Africa's Miriam Makeba (1932-2008) and America's Nina Simone (1933-2003).  Visitors can see a related art exhibition before the show. She Speaks: Black Women Artists and the Power of Historical Memory examines 250 years of American history through a Black Feminist lens.

The closing event on Sunday at 2:00 p.m. features Uhwachi-Reh at Pip Moyer Recreation Center. Led by Louis Campbell (Lumbee), the Indigenous troupe performs traditional dance in ceremonial regalia with live drumming and singing. Also appearing are Denmi Whiteman (Lakota), Angela Miracle Gladue (Cree), and Keith Colston (Lumbee -Tuscarora). They've appeared at community events, the Baltimore Museum of Art, the Maryland Folklife Festival and The Kennedy Center.

Annapolis Jazz & Roots is an affiliate under the umbrella of the Annapolis Community Foundation. AJRF is grateful for support from the Maryland State Arts Council, Arts Council of Anne Arundel County, the City of Annapolis, Anne Arundel County Library & Foundation and Jazz Beyond Borders. Visit annapolisjazzandrootsfestival.com for more information.

releases.title: Horizon Commerce and Pacvue Expand Strategic Partnership to Connect Retail Media Planning, Activation and Measurement
releases.body:
Expanded partnership brings together Horizon Commerce's strategy and activation expertise with Pacvue's Commerce Media Operating System to help marketers move from insight to outcomes faster

NEW YORK, Sept. 24, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Horizon Commerce, Horizon Media Holdings' specialist agency for commerce and digital experience, and Pacvue, the leading AI-Powered Commerce Media Operating System, today announced an expanded strategic partnership designed to help advertisers more effectively connect retail media planning, activation and measurement. The expanded relationship brings Horizon Commerce's Strategy and Activation teams, including its Blu Commerce intelligence capabilities, closer to Pacvue's Commerce Media Operating System, enabling a more integrated workflow across planning, activation and measurement on major retail media platforms.

The partnership addresses a persistent challenge for marketers: the systems used to measure media performance and determine investment strategy are often disconnected from the platforms used by teams to execute campaigns. As a result, marketers can identify an opportunity through measurement but are forced to rely on manual processes, separate taxonomies and retailer-specific metrics to translate that insight into action.

Blu Commerce provides a standardized view of retail media performance across retailers, products and media tactics, including measurement of incremental contribution and iROI. Pacvue unifies that intelligence with other proprietary omnicommerce signals to power media activation, giving Horizon Commerce's Strategy and Activation teams one platform to translate those insights into investment decisions and activation strategies across major retail media networks.

Blu Commerce and Pacvue's technology works in lockstep, feeding performance back into the next cycle of planning and optimization. Pacvue's real-time commerce signals – including availability, pricing, and content health – keep activation aligned with what's happening on the digital shelf. The result is a common decision framework connecting senior marketing leadership and campaign practitioners, helping brands allocate investment more effectively, reduce inefficient spend and drive greater incremental sales.

"Retail media has no shortage of data. The harder problem is turning that data into a consistent investment decision," said Katie Comerford, President of Horizon Commerce. "A brand may be operating across Amazon, Walmart, Target and other retailers, each with different attribution methodologies, reporting structures and optimization environments. Blu Commerce was built to create a common economic view across those investments. By bringing that intelligence into a workflow that connects our Commerce Strategy and Activation teams with Pacvue, we can shorten the distance between understanding what is driving incremental growth and doing something about it."

This connected approach is already delivering results. When Revlon's Mitchum brands needed to close the gap between retail media and commerce operations on Amazon, Horizon Commerce unified its internal platforms with Pacvue's advertising and commerce signals. The results included a 13% average weekly revenue lift, a 19-point improvement in Best Seller Rank (BSR), a 5% lift in paid search revenue, and a 3% lift in paid search conversion rate. By aligning media investment with commerce signals, Revlon and Horizon Commerce shifted from reactive adjustments to proactive growth, powered by automation, actionable insights, and the integrated capabilities of Pacvue's Commerce Operating System.

"Horizon Commerce has been a valued partner since 2022, and this expansion reflects how that relationship has grown," said Melissa Burdick, Co-founder and President of Pacvue. "With more touchpoints across the customer journey than ever, measurement and activation must keep pace with how complex investment decisions have become. Pacvue empowers agency teams with the insight and activation to execute faster, while preserving the flexibility to evaluate performance against the business outcomes that matter to each brand."

The partnership reflects Horizon's broader approach to commerce technology: building an open intelligence layer that connects data, decisioning and activation rather than requiring marketers to operate within a closed technology ecosystem. Together, Horizon Commerce and Pacvue are creating a more connected commerce investment workflow, combining Blu Commerce's cross-retailer measurement, iROI, scenario planning and investment intelligence with scaled activation through Pacvue. The result is a clearer path to shifting dollars toward the highest-value opportunities, reducing inefficient spend and driving greater incremental sales.

ABOUT HORIZON COMMERCE

Horizon Commerce is Horizon Media Holdings' commerce and digital experience agency, helping brands connect media, commerce, data, and technology to drive measurable growth. As a fiercely independent growth partner, the agency combines human expertise, open technology ecosystems, and transparent intelligence to help brands make better investment decisions and create more connected customer experiences across DTC, retail, marketplaces, social, and omnichannel environments. 

At the center of its offering is Blu Commerce, Horizon Commerce's proprietary commerce intelligence platform, which creates a standardized view of performance across retailers, products, and media tactics. Blu Commerce connects measurement, scenario planning, forecasting, and optimization to help marketers understand what is driving incremental growth, identify future investment opportunities, and move from insight to action faster.

ABOUT PACVUE

Pacvue is the leading Commerce Media OS, powering over $12B in advertising spend across 100+ global retail media networks including Amazon, Walmart, Target, Kroger, Instacart, Criteo, and CitrusAd. Powered by industry-leading AI and real-time data, Pacvue enables over 70,000 brands and agencies to maximize advertising performance, drive incrementality, and expand reach across the commerce universe from a single mission control. As of 2025, Pacvue powers 12% of total retail media ad spend worldwide excluding China. Combined with Helium 10's SMB solutions, Pacvue delivers the industry's most comprehensive platform for businesses of all sizes. Founded in 2018, Pacvue spans Seattle, Los Angeles, Chicago, New York, Washington D.C., London, Shanghai, and Tokyo. Discover more at pacvue.com.

releases.title: TikTok Partners with BBB National Programs to Strengthen Trust in Digital Advertising
releases.body:
MCLEAN, Va., Sept. 24, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- BBB National Programs, the non-profit home of U.S. independent industry self-regulation, today announced a collaboration between its National Advertising Division and TikTok that will strengthen accountability for advertising on the platform by creating a direct channel for the National Advertising Division to refer potential violations of TikTok's advertising policies for review.

The collaboration represents a proactive step by TikTok, one of the world's leading platforms for digital discovery, creator content, and brand advertising, to connect its advertising standards with independent industry self-regulation. When the National Advertising Division hears a case involving advertising on TikTok, it will be able to share relevant case outcomes directly with TikTok's Ad Experience team for review against the platform's advertising policies.

"Advertising is evolving and accountability needs to keep pace," said Eric D. Reicin, President and CEO, BBB National Programs. "By working with TikTok, one of the world's leading platforms for brand engagement, we are connecting independent advertising review more directly with the platforms where consumers encounter advertising every day. That is good for consumers, good for businesses, and good for trust in digital advertising."

"When people see advertising on our platform, they expect the brands behind it to be accountable," said Francis Stones, Head of Global Brand Safety & Industry Relations, Global Business Solutions, TikTok. "That means making sure the standards we set for advertising are reflected in the content people encounter. Our collaboration with the National Advertising Division is an important step toward bringing independent review and platform accountability closer together and helping create a digital environment people can trust."

BBB National Programs' National Advertising Division has monitored and reviewed national advertising for truthfulness and accuracy since 1971, providing an independent forum for resolving advertising disputes, monitoring the marketplace, supporting fair competition, and strengthening consumer trust. With multiple case choice options, the National Advertising Division can handle certain case types from receipt to resolution in 20 business days or less.

This collaboration demonstrates how platforms can work with established self-regulatory systems to address emerging advertising challenges as quickly as the marketplace evolves.

Learn more about the National Advertising Division here. 

About BBB National Programs: BBB National Programs, a non-profit organization, is the home of U.S. independent industry self-regulation, currently operating more than 20 globally recognized programs that have been helping enhance consumer trust in business for more than 50 years. These programs provide third-party accountability and dispute resolution services that address existing and emerging industry issues, create fair competition for businesses, and a better experience for consumers. BBB National Programs continues to evolve its work and grow its impact by providing business guidance and fostering best practices in advertising, child-and-teen-directed marketing, data privacy, dispute resolution, automobile warranty, technology, and emerging areas. To learn more, visit bbbprograms.org.

About the National Advertising Division: The National Advertising Division (NAD) of BBB National Programs provides independent self-regulation and dispute resolution services, guiding the truthfulness of advertising across the U.S. NAD reviews national advertising in all media and its decisions set consistent standards for advertising truth and accuracy, delivering meaningful protection to consumers and creating fair competition for business.

releases.body:
Partnership gives CertainPath members a specialized recruiting resource spanning field technicians through executive leadership

HAYMARKET, Va., Sept. 24, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Work With Your Handz, a national workforce solutions firm serving skilled trades and service-driven organizations, today announced it has joined the CertainPath Partner Network as a recruiting partner for home-service contractors.

Contractors in the CertainPath network have built strong market positions and see real demand for their services, but growth stalls when they can't find or hire enough skilled people. CertainPath coaches work closely with member businesses and are often the first to recognize when recruiting, not demand, has become the limiting factor in a contractor's growth. Through this partnership, coaches can introduce Work With Your Handz as a specialized recruiting resource once that gap is identified.

"Many contractors have the demand and opportunity to grow, but they can't grow without the right people," said Kelly Rowlett Presgrave, Founder, President and CEO of Work With Your Handz. "We understand the skilled trades from the technician level through leadership, and this partnership gives CertainPath members another resource when hiring becomes a barrier to growth."

Work With Your Handz brings established experience in the industries CertainPath members serve, including HVAC, plumbing, electrical and related skilled trades. That familiarity allows the firm to support hiring across an entire organization, from field technicians and skilled-trades roles to managers, senior leadership and executive search.

A key differentiator for Work With Your Handz is its ability to communicate credibly across both ends of the home-services business. Because its recruiters have direct industry experience, they can ask the technical questions needed to determine whether a candidate genuinely has the skilled-trades background a client requires. That same team is equally comfortable working with owners, senior executives and private-equity-backed home-service organizations navigating growth and leadership transitions.

"Finding and keeping great people continues to be one of the biggest challenges facing home service contractors," said Tim Cummings, Director of Strategic Partnerships & Member Incentives at CertainPath. "Work With Your Handz understands this industry and the realities our members face when it comes to building the teams they need to grow. This partnership gives CertainPath members access to a recruiting resource with deep experience in the skilled trades, from the field to leadership, and we're excited to bring that expertise to our network."

Work With Your Handz joins CertainPath's Partner Network as part of the company's continued expansion into new referral channels and industry partnerships across the skilled trades.

About Work With Your Handz

Work With Your Handz is a national workforce solutions firm founded in 2018 to solve a challenge shared across every skilled trade and service-driven industry: finding reliable, qualified people in competitive, labor-constrained markets. Rooted in residential services, the company has built a recruiting blueprint that now supports skilled trades and service organizations across residential, commercial, facilities and industrial-adjacent environments, with direct hire, contract and temp-to-perm solutions covering roles from frontline and apprentice positions through supervisors, managers and executive leadership. Learn more at www.workwithyourhandz.com.

About CertainPath

CertainPath is a proven growth system for home–service contractors, combining business coaching, training, events, and software to help HVAC, plumbing, electrical, and roofing companies grow revenue and profitability. Through its Partner Network, CertainPath connects member contractors with vetted solutions that support world–class operations, customer experience, and long–term success. Learn more at https://mycertainpath.com.

releases.title: Pipit Takes a New Approach to Independent Music Discovery and Artist Support
releases.body:
Built only for independent artists, Pipit combines direct fan support and fan-driven discovery, with no major-label artists and no generative-AI music.

VALPARAISO, Ind., Sept. 24, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Pipit, a new music platform built exclusively for independent artists and the fans who want to discover and support them, today announced that its platform is officially open for artist sign-ups.

Independent artists can now create a free Pipit profile, upload their music, build their presence, and begin connecting their existing fan base to Pipit ahead of the platform's broader fan launch.

Pipit was created around a simple idea: independent artists need more than another place to upload music. They need a place where music discovery, artist support, and the artist-to-fan relationship can live together.

Direct Support for Artists

One of Pipit's central features is Support. Artists receive a personalized Pipit Support invite they can share with followers through social media, websites, email, text messages, and other channels.

Fans can join Pipit for just $3.99 per month and choose an independent artist to support, with $2 of that monthly membership going directly to the artist. Supporters can also stream that artist's full catalog on Pipit during the month they support them. A relatively small community of committed supporters can create meaningful recurring revenue.

Social Built Into the Music Experience

Pipit also brings the social relationship directly into the platform. Through Pipit's integrated Social Feed, artists can share updates, photos, videos, performances, and behind-the-scenes moments with the people discovering and supporting their music.

Instead of releasing music on one platform, promoting it on another, posting videos elsewhere, and hoping an algorithm lets followers see it, Pipit brings those interactions closer together.

Discovery Chosen by the Listener

Pipit's Discover Wave gives listeners a more active role in music discovery. Nine musical categories define songs on Pipit: Genre, Flow/Journey, Mood, Sound, Vocals, Lyrics, Tempo, Studio/Production, and Region.

Listeners use those same categories to build their own Discover Waves and explore music based on what they want to hear, rather than relying entirely on a platform-generated playlist.

"Music discovery shouldn't be something that happens to you," Shingler said. "It should be something you drive."

Discover Waves are also designed to remain alive, allowing newly added songs that match a listener's preferences to enter existing Waves over time.

No Major Labels. No Generative-AI Music.

Pipit is intentionally being built as an independent-music ecosystem. The platform does not accept major-label artists and has established a no-generative-AI music policy for artist uploads.

Artists certify that they did not use generative AI to create or replace lyrics, melody, composition, vocals, instrumentals, backing tracks, or musical arrangement.

Artists can join Pipit for free. In addition to direct fan Support, Pipit plans to compensate qualifying discovery streams at $0.005 per stream as its discovery offering expands.

Thinking Outside the Box & Inside the Crate

When the team began designing Pipit, they did not start by asking how to build another version of an existing streaming service.

They looked further back.

Before recommendation algorithms and automatically generated playlists, music discovery required participation. People flipped through records, dug through crates, asked friends what they were listening to, and took chances on artists they had never heard before.

"We wanted to think outside the box of today's music platforms and, in a way, inside the crate of old-school music discovery," Shingler said. "Technology should make discovering independent music easier without taking the listener out of the discovery process."

Independent artists can create an account and begin uploading music now at indiepipit.com.

About Pipit, Inc.

Pipit, Inc. is a five-person technology company building a music platform exclusively for independent artists and the fans who want to discover and support them.

The founding team brings together experience in business, product development, software engineering, front-end development, and user experience design. Pipit combines modern technology with the curiosity and participation that once came from digging through a crate of records looking for something new.

For more information, visit www.indiepipit.com.

releases.title: "We've Got Heart in Boston": From Three-Deckers to Ducklings, Here's a Song That Puts Boston's "Yeah, That's Us" Moments to Music
releases.body:
Daria MonDesire Delivers a Spirited Song About Boston's Quirks, Character, and Its Knack for Making the Letter 'R' Disappear

BOSTON, Sept. 24, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Finish this sentence: If you see a chair in the street after a snowstorm, it's there to _________________.

If you know the answer, you just might be from Boston.

Roxbury-born Songwriter Daria MonDesire salutes her hometown with the release of her new single, "We've Got Heart in Boston." Available September 25th across all major streaming platforms.

The lyrics pay homage to the city's no-nonsense, 'Boston Charming' ethos, and celebrate even the scofflaws who call dibs on shoveled out parking spaces.

The release, produced by Peter Young of Nashville, features MonDesire on vocals; or, as she quips, "unfeatures." "I sang because the song is meant for every Boston-lover and every voice," says MonDesire. "No Rihannas required. All you need is pride in the city."

The song's arrangement showcases a mélange of West African and Celtic drumming, Irish tin whistle, and a touch of Bahian rhythm. As for the Boston accent in the vocals, "That's how I sound," says MonDesire. "I wanted to honor the fact that Boston is a diverse city. There's a misperception that the Boston accent is a White accent. But I can't tell you the number of times people have tried to get me to say "park the car in the Harvard yard." Bostonians of any ethnicity can have a Boston accent, and often do."

"We've Got Heart in Boston" is available September 25th on all major streaming platforms.

To hear it now, visit heartinboston.com (password: BostonCharming).

About the Artist --- Daria MonDesire is a Bennington College alumna and an award-winning writer. Her short story, "Reflections," is etched in stone outside Boston's Green Street T station. MonDesire is a MacDowell Fellow who calls Boston and Vermont's Northeast Kingdom home.

releases.title: Black Girl Vitamins Launches Kitchen Confessions, a New Podcast Centering Black Women's Health and Wellness
releases.body:
Hosted by Dr. Contessa Metcalfe, the series gets candid about motherhood, mental health, hormones, aging and more.

CHICAGO, Sept. 24, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Black Girl Vitamins (BGV) today announced the launch of Kitchen Confessions, a new video podcast that brings Black women together for candid conversations about the health, wellness and life experiences shaping their lives. Hosted by Dr. Contessa Metcalfe, a BGV brand partner and cast member of Married to Medicine.

Bringing together physicians, entrepreneurs, mothers, and community leaders, the conversations explore motherhood, mental health, aging, perimenopause, self-care, identity and more. Through candid personal stories and expert insight, guests discuss what changes during these stages, what women are not always prepared for and what they wish they had understood sooner.

Season 1 featured guests include psychiatrist and fellow Married to Medicine cast member Dr. Mimi Sanders; entrepreneur Kesha "Pea" Ward and wife of Grammy Award-winning rapper 2 Chainz; and Christina "Ms. Basketball" Granville. Together, they bring a mix of lived experience and professional perspective to the table.

The inaugural season premiered September 23rd with a conversation exploring pregnancy and motherhood (watch HERE), followed by a discussion coming soon on aging and perimenopause. Future episodes will take on PCOS, weight management and exercise, fibroids, and beauty, bringing new voices and perspectives to the table with each conversation.

Building on BGV's short film The Visit, Kitchen Confessions continues the brand's investment in original storytelling that reflects Black women's health experiences and gives those conversations a larger platform.

"Black women deserve to see the full range of their health and wellness experiences reflected in the conversations around them," said Jennifer Juma, Chief Strategy Officer at Black Girl Vitamins. "Kitchen Confessions brings lived experience and expert perspective together in a way that feels honest, relevant and connected to women's lives."

New episodes will premiere on Black Girl Vitamins' YouTube Channel.

About Black Girl Vitamins

Black Girl Vitamins (BGV) is a Black-owned health and wellness brand dedicated to meeting the unique nutritional needs of Black women. Since its launch in 2021, BGV has partnered with leading experts to formulate science-backed supplements specifically designed to support the health and wellness of Black women. releases.title: Joe Granda to Receive Two 2026 Honors Celebrating More Than Five Decades in Music and Entertainment
releases.body:
His work spans Latin and crossover music, remix production, live events and LGBTQIA+ audience outreach.

MIAMI, Sept. 24, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Joe Granda, founder and CEO of Granda Entertainment, will receive two honors in October recognizing a 53-year career in music and entertainment, including his work promoting Latin artists and connecting them with English-speaking and LGBTQIA+ audiences.

Granda will receive the "Empresario Internacional del Año" recognition at the Golden Music Awards in Orlando on October 1. On October 16, Unity Coalition | Coalición Unida will recognize his contributions and artistic vision at the ORGULLO Honors Awards Dinner & Fashion Show in Miami Beach.

Early in Shakira's career, Sony executive Oscar Llord hired Granda Entertainment to market and promote her Radio y Música showcase. Granda later handled separate LGBTQ+ marketing and promotion projects for Shakira over the years. Most recently, he worked on remixes of her 2024 single "Soltera."

Granda also recently executive-produced dance remixes of Gloria Estefan's "La Vecina (No Sé Na')," a single from Raíces, the winner of the 2026 Grammy Award for Best Tropical Latin Album. His work with Estefan has also included promotion to LGBTQIA+ audiences.

His executive production credits include remixes of Thalía's "A Quién Le Importa," Gloria Trevi's "Todos Me Miran," Ricky Martin's "María" and "She Bangs," and Paulina Rubio's "Don't Say Goodbye." He also executive-produced Celia Cruz In The House and remixes of La India's "Seduce Me Now," which won Latin Dance Club Play Track of the Year at the 2004 Billboard Latin Music Awards. Other projects involved Christina Aguilera, Madonna, Village People, Gloria Gaynor and Evelyn Thomas.

Granda also thanked the companies that have placed their trust in him and Granda Entertainment over the years, including Sony Music, Universal Music, Warner Music and Live Nation, among others.

Granda's promotional work includes LGBTQIA+ tours for Latin artists such as Elvis Crespo, Fey, La India, Lucía Méndez and Ivy Queen, who received a special recognition from GLAAD in 2008. Through Pride stages and promotional events, he has helped connect Latin music with LGBTQIA+ audiences.

For approximately 15 years, Granda produced Viva la Música at SeaWorld Orlando and Busch Gardens Tampa. The event brought Latin music to family audiences, with performers including salsa artists Víctor Manuelle, Gilberto Santa Rosa and Jerry Rivera, as well as reggaeton artists Daddy Yankee, Don Omar and Zion & Lennox.

Born in Cuba and raised in Hialeah, Granda began his professional music career in 1973 with Miami band Majesty. He later co-wrote and produced "Diamond Girl" by Nice & Wild. According to Granda, the song spent approximately 27 weeks on Billboard's dance and crossover charts and was among the first songs with a Spanish-language verse to receive airplay on R&B radio.

"I'm halfway between both worlds. That's why crossover came naturally to me," Granda said of his Latin and Anglo musical influences.

His current projects include Incluvision, a music label dedicated to LGBTQIA+ artists, and a streaming TV channel for LGBTQIA+ Latino audiences.

The ORGULLO dinner will take place October 16 at 6:30 p.m. at Fogo de Chão, 836 1st Street, Miami Beach. Event information is available at CelebrateORGULLO.com.

Granda is available for interviews in English and Spanish about his music career, Latin artist promotion, LGBTQIA+ audience outreach, and live entertainment and event production. Photos and interview arrangements are available through Granda Entertainment Press.

About Granda Entertainment

Granda Entertainment provides artist development, production, marketing, promotion and consulting across Latin, Anglo, crossover and LGBTQIA+ markets.

Massive Strategic Momentum & Grammy Legacy:

To firmly anchor 2027 Grammy nomination eligibility, the record underwent an exclusive, quiet industry soft launch on Friday, August 21, 2026, hitting targeted global distribution lanes including Tidal and Amazon Music. This Friday, the record is making its explosive worldwide release across Spotify and Apple Music grids. This marks a powerful return to the national awards arena for Raphael Ashanti, whose acclaimed 2010 release, "Inside My Tears," was officially solicited for nomination and successfully presented to the 53rd Grammy Awards voting body.

An Elite Heritage: From Midwest Jazz Roots to Culture Architecture:

Ashanti's complex vocal and theoretical mastery is rooted in a strict, deep-set lineage of classic Midwestern training. While attending Milwaukee Area Technical College and Marquette University, Ashanti studied advanced music theory under the legendary Tony King—foundational creator of the renowned jazz program at the Wisconsin Conservatory of Music (the "Berklee of the Midwest"). During this formative era, Ashanti also honed his pristine vocal technique under the intensive guidance of renowned jazz vocalist Jessie Hauck.

This elite foundation directly fueled Ashanti's legacy as an influential culture architect, notably serving as a primary pre-fame mentor to stic.man of the iconic, revolutionary hip-hop duo Dead Prez. Furthermore, legendary industry force Shaheed Najm—creative visionary and father of trailblazing icon T-Pain—served as a core creative consultant on this new project alignment.

The Heavyweight South Florida Sound and Engineering Lineup

In a commanding sonic blueprint, the track was produced, mixed, and mastered entirely in South Florida by legendary platinum hitmaker Tony Castillo, professionally known as Gorilla Tek. Renowned for dropping some of the heaviest regional sub-bass bangers for icons like Trina, Gorilla Tek crafted the song's earth-shaking beat down in South Florida.

The complex vocal tracking process brought together top-tier engineering talent across the region:

  • Awarrior Music Group handled principal recording duties in Pensacola, Florida, meticulously tracking Ashanti's intricate, soulful singing arrangement ahead of their debut executive broadcast interview on the WRNE network.
  • Jimmy Starr of the renowned Hideaway Recording Studio (Davie, FL) captured the raw, driving energy of the hip-hop tracks, tracking the sharp rap vocals.

Elite Vocal Collaboration and Regional Power       

Driven by the commanding lead vocals of Raphael Ashanti and anchored by a powerful performance from R&B vocal powerhouse Urban Mystic, "Life Is A Gamble" is a definitive masterclass in modern Southern hip-hop and soul. The track features a dynamic contribution from South Florida rap phenom Robbie Miller (p/k/a Dirty Dankk), who is currently dominating the independent charts with his hit "BOPPIN"—featuring Uncle Head of the legendary group Splack Pack. The Anthem for Self-Belief

"This song is a cautionary tale and an anthem for anyone betting on themselves when the world doubts them," states the production team. Following this release, fans can also look forward to a high-octane remix release featuring an expanded performance from Dirty Dankk, alongside a state-of-the-art cinematic visual campaign currently in development by premier rendering teams in Argentina.

GREENWICH, Conn., Sept. 24, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- O'Shaughnessy Ventures LLC (OSV), an investment firm that empowers creators, has awarded an O'Shaughnessy Fellowship to Dimitri Vallein, a filmmaker and technologist based in Paris.

Vallein will use the fellowship to complete "The Day I Met You," an immersive science-fiction short film that brings quantum physics into an intimate story about love, choice and the nature of reality, made for both cinema screens and virtual reality. He is capturing actors' performances with 4D Gaussian splatting, a technique that surrounds performers with about 200 synchronized cameras and reconstructs their movement as a photorealistic three-dimensional image a viewer can walk around, rather than as flat footage fixed to a single camera angle. He then places those performances inside digital environments. Over the next 12 months, he plans to finish the film and pursue an international festival premiere.
releases.title: O'Shaughnessy Ventures Backs Filmmaker's Immersive Sci-Fi Short
releases.body:
Dimitri Vallein receives an O'Shaughnessy Fellowship to complete "The Day I Met You," a science-fiction short that films its actors in three dimensions using 4D Gaussian splatting.

GREENWICH, Conn., Sept. 24, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- O'Shaughnessy Ventures LLC (OSV), an investment firm that empowers creators, has awarded an O'Shaughnessy Fellowship to Dimitri Vallein, a filmmaker and technologist based in Paris.

Vallein will use the fellowship to complete "The Day I Met You," an immersive science-fiction short film that brings quantum physics into an intimate story about love, choice and the nature of reality, made for both cinema screens and virtual reality. He is capturing actors' performances with 4D Gaussian splatting, a technique that surrounds performers with about 200 synchronized cameras and reconstructs their movement as a photorealistic three-dimensional image a viewer can walk around, rather than as flat footage fixed to a single camera angle. He then places those performances inside digital environments. Over the next 12 months, he plans to finish the film and pursue an international festival premiere.

Vallein is building Revery, an entertainment company developing original stories for film, games and immersive formats. His animated short films have earned more than 40 international festival selections. Previously, he built augmented reality experiences on Meta's Spark AR platform for brands and artists, including Netflix and Dua Lipa. His work has drawn hundreds of millions of views across social media.

OSV's founder and CEO, Jim O'Shaughnessy, commented, "I've long argued that modern science fiction has abandoned any belief in a better future. Dimitri's approach combines two of my favorite things: positive ideas and cutting-edge technology. We're delighted to be backing him."

"I want to make beautiful films that bring our most extraordinary scientific and philosophical ideas into popular culture," said Vallein. "Receiving an O'Shaughnessy Fellowship will help me bring that vision to life. I'm grateful to the OSV team for believing in ambitious ideas before the path is obvious."

About the O'Shaughnessy Fellowships Program

Launched in 2023, the O'Shaughnessy Fellowships program discovers and empowers the world's boldest creatives, builders and researchers. Fellows receive a grant of up to $100,000 and gain access to OSV's network of founders, investors and experts.

Vallein is the twenty-third fellow announced in 2026. More information about previous fellows is available at OSV's website.

Applications for the O'Shaughnessy Fellowships are now closed and will reopen on Jan. 1, 2027. Individuals interested in applying can do so via OSV's website.

About O'Shaughnessy Ventures

OSV is a creative investment firm that empowers creators to bring their ideas to life. Founded by Jim O'Shaughnessy, a pioneer in quantitative investing, founder of O'Shaughnessy Asset Management, and author of five books, OSV aims to provide financial support and to partner in growing the next life-changing creative ideas.

OSV combines Jim's deeply rooted interest in all things art, science, investing and technology with his long-held desire to establish scenarios designed to help promising creators and their inspiring ideas succeed, regardless of age, location, job history or level of education. For more information, visit OSV's website.

releases.title: Context Networks Selects Broadsign to Scale Contextual Advertising Across Display Networks
releases.body:
Broadsign Platform to unlock programmatic demand and scalable OOH operations across Context Networks inventory, with gaming environments a launch focus ahead of G2E

LAS VEGAS, Sept. 24, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Context Networks, a contextual advertising and monetization platform for gaming and network digital display environments, today announced a collaboration with Broadsign, the leading global platform for managing and monetizing out-of-home (OOH) media, to support the next phase of growth of Context Networks' Contextual Promotions Media Network™ (CPMN™). As a result, Context Networks now has a unified foundation for managing, delivering and monetizing screen-based media as the company expands across gaming and other controlled display environments.

Through the collaboration, Context Networks is connecting eligible CPMN™ inventory to the Broadsign Platform, the company's complete, reliable Ad Server and Content Management System (CMS). This will enable Context Networks to manage business-critical content and advertising across its network of displays as well as the Place Exchange supply-side platform (SSP), Broadsign's programmatic digital out-of-home (DOOH) SSP.

Context Networks brings contextual intelligence, a monetization model designed for controlled screen environments, specialized integrations, and operator and reseller relationships that can help extend Broadsign technology into non-traditional screen environments as the network grows. It introduces a differentiated source of digital inventory and vertical expertise for Broadsign in environments where customer attention, dwell time and operator-controlled screens create a distinctive media opportunity. Broadsign delivers enterprise network management, campaign automation, reporting and established programmatic demand connectivity.

While gaming is Context Networks' immediate launch focus ahead of Global Gaming Expo (G2E), taking place September 28 through October 1 at The Venetian Expo in Las Vegas, the collaboration is designed to support its broader display network strategy. Context Networks' business model extends beyond casino floors to operator-controlled environments that include distributed gaming, ATMs, kiosks, gift-card kiosk networks, digital faucets, hotel concierge apps and other connected screens.

The company's current footprint spans 14 states and 23 designated market areas, with advertising and operator-owned content already running in distributed gaming environments. Broadsign provides Context Networks with a more scalable way to onboard additional screen networks and reseller partners while maintaining consistent campaign logic, delivery and reporting.

"Broadsign gives us a proven infrastructure to scale our model without losing what makes it valuable: contextual relevance, operator control and measurable monetization," said Matthew Olden, Founder, COO & Executive Chair of Context Networks. "Gaming is an important launch market for this work, but the underlying opportunity is broader. Across network digital display environments, operators already control valuable screens and audience relationships. Our job is to help turn those assets into new commercial value while giving advertisers a better way to reach qualified audiences in the moments and environments that matter."

For operators and media owners, the combined model creates a path to turn existing digital displays into measurable new revenue without requiring them to build a separate advertising technology business. Operators retain governance over eligible inventory, campaign rules, house content and the customer experience, while CPMN™ creates a new commercial layer around screens and systems they already own or manage.

Brands and agencies can now access differentiated inventory in high-attention environments that traditional media plans might miss. Contextual signals can help align advertising with place, activity, timing and audience value, while the Broadsign Platform makes eligible inventory easier to access through familiar OOH and programmatic workflows. As a result, advertisers get a stronger contextual fit, more relevant delivery and clearer performance feedback.

"Context Networks is opening a compelling category of inventory that fits naturally with the continued evolution of out-of-home," said Robert Loftus, VP of Platform Sales at Broadsign. "By connecting Context Networks' operator relationships and specialized integrations with the Broadsign Platform and Place Exchange SSP, we can help make these screens easier for buyers to access while giving operators the control, transparency and flexibility they need to participate with confidence."

Operator control is particularly important in gaming environments, where security, regulatory oversight, and operational continuity are central considerations. Rather than asking operators to introduce an isolated advertising stack, the Context Networks model uses established digital signage and programmatic infrastructure while preserving operator control over what appears on each participating screen. Existing promotions and operational content can continue to run alongside paid advertising based on rules set by the operator.

During G2E, Context Networks will demonstrate how the combined technology stack can connect gaming and other operator-controlled digital screens to the broader advertising ecosystem, while meeting with operators, integrators, resellers, advertisers and agencies about opportunities to activate new screen inventory.

About Broadsign

Broadsign develops the leading global platform for managing and monetizing out-of-home (OOH) media. The company, which also operates Place Exchange by Broadsign, the largest independent SSP for Digital OOH, empowers media owners, media buyers, and retailers to harness the power and reach of out-of-home to connect with audiences in ways unlike any other advertising channel. More than 3 million static and digital signs along roadways and in airports, shopping malls, grocery and convenience stores, health clinics, transit systems, and more run on Broadsign. For more information, visit https://broadsign.com. 

About Context Networks

Context Networks is a contextual advertising and monetization platform for gaming and network digital display environments, helping brands deliver more relevant, personalized messages in high-attention moments enabling operators to turn existing screens into measurable new revenue. By combining contextual intelligence, secure marketplace infrastructure, real-time buying, and operator-controlled delivery, Context makes emerging screen inventory easier to access, buy, measure, monetize, and scale. The result is a marketplace that helps advertisers improve campaign relevance and performance while helping operators create new commercial value without compromising the player or customer experience. For more information, visit https://www.contextnetworks.net.

releases.body:
Hosted by Nearmap Chief Product Officer David Tobias, new podcast brings together leaders across insurance, government, AECO, and commercial real estate to explore AI, data, and the future of property intelligence

SALT LAKE CITY, Sept. 24, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Nearmap, the global property intelligence company, today announced the launch of The Reality Layer, a new podcast hosted by Nearmap Chief Product Officer David Tobias that explores how technology, data, and artificial intelligence are changing the way organizations understand and act on the physical world.

Launching today, The Reality Layer will bring together executives, practitioners, and technology leaders from across industries for candid conversations about the forces reshaping the built environment. Episodes will explore topics ranging from AI and property intelligence, to insurance underwriting and claims, catastrophe response, and the future of cities and communities.

As organizations navigate rising loss costs, increasingly complex property risk, and growing pressure to make faster, more informed decisions, access to better data and intelligence is becoming increasingly important. The Reality Layer will examine these challenges through the experiences and perspectives of the people working to solve them.

"There's an enormous amount happening in the physical world that we can't always see or understand from traditional data alone," said David Tobias, Chief Product Officer at Nearmap and host of The Reality Layer. "The combination of AI, geospatial technology and property intelligence is changing that. This podcast is about exploring what happens when we can see the world more clearly, and what organizations can do with that enhanced understanding."

Each episode will feature conversations with industry leaders and subject-matter experts exploring both the opportunities and practical challenges facing organizations today.

"We're at a point where technology is changing not just how businesses operate, but how they understand the world around them," continued Tobias. "The most interesting conversations are no longer about technology for technology's sake. They're about how organizations can turn data, AI, and new sources of intelligence into better decisions and better outcomes. That's what makes The Reality Layer such a timely conversation."

The podcast is part of the Nearmap broader commitment to advancing the conversation around property intelligence and the role of technology in helping organizations better understand the built environment.

Listen to and subscribe to The Reality Layer on Apple Podcasts, Spotify, and YouTube.

About Nearmap

Nearmap is a global property intelligence company redefining how organizations understand and act on the built environment. By owning the entire intelligence value chain—from high-recency geospatial capture powered by patented camera technology to accurate AI-derived analytics and guaranteed building materials data—Nearmap delivers a single, trusted source of truth for property decisions. Insurers, government agencies, and AECO organizations rely on Nearmap to transform property uncertainty into evidence, helping organizations move beyond fragmented data and manual processes with verified, frequently updated insight. These proprietary insights enable faster, more confident decisions across underwriting and claims, assessment and response, and planning and construction so teams can see truth, assess risk, and act with certainty. Founded in Australia in 2007, Nearmap stands as the definitive source of truth that shapes the livable world.

NEW YORK, Sept. 24, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Reshift Media, an award-winning digital marketing and technology company specializing in franchise and multi-location organizations across the United States, Canada and internationally, has been named one of Entrepreneur magazine's Top Franchise Suppliers for the fourth consecutive year, ranking #2 in the Marketing Agencies category for 2026.

The recognition adds to a sustained run of international accolades for Reshift Media. The company has been recognized as the World's Best Franchise Marketing Firm at the Global Franchise Awards for four consecutive years and has received three consecutive Gold Stevie Awards at the International Business Awards, most recently for Technical Innovation of the Year for Franify, Reshift Media's AI-powered franchise marketing platform.

"Being recognized by Entrepreneur for the fourth consecutive year is incredibly meaningful because the ranking is driven by feedback from the franchise community," said Steve Buors, CEO and Co-Founder of Reshift Media. "When you combine that with four consecutive Global Franchise Awards and three consecutive Gold Stevie Awards, we're incredibly proud of the consistency. We have chosen to focus our company on franchise marketing, innovation and technology, and it's rewarding to see that work recognized year after year."

Four consecutive years of recognition from Entrepreneur

Entrepreneur's annual Top Franchise Suppliers ranking is based on feedback from franchisors, with more than 1,000 franchise brands participating in 2026. Franchisors identify the suppliers they and their franchisees work with and rate their satisfaction based on quality, cost and value. The highest-scoring suppliers are then ranked within their respective categories.

Reshift Media's fourth consecutive appearance reflects the company's long-term specialization in franchise digital marketing. Reshift Media works with franchise and multi-location organizations on digital advertising, social media, search engine optimization, franchise development marketing, content and influencer marketing, website and mobile development, conversion optimization and proprietary franchise marketing technology.

The company's approach is designed around a fundamental challenge in franchise marketing: enabling franchisors to develop sophisticated, brand-led marketing strategies while empowering individual franchise locations to execute effective, locally relevant marketing in their communities.

A growing record of franchise marketing innovation

The Entrepreneur ranking follows Reshift Media's fourth consecutive Global Franchise Award, recognizing the company as the World's Best Franchise Marketing Firm. Reshift Media has received the international franchise marketing honor every year from 2023 through 2026.

Reshift Media has also received three consecutive Gold Stevie Awards at the International Business Awards. The company was named Marketing Disruptor of the Year in both 2024 and 2025, recognizing its innovative approach to localized franchise digital marketing and proprietary technology.

In 2026, that recognition evolved from marketing innovation to technology innovation when Franify received Gold for Technical Innovation of the Year.

Franify is Reshift Media's AI-powered digital marketing platform built specifically for franchise and multi-location organizations. The platform connects franchisor strategy and brand control with franchisee-level local marketing execution, allowing organizations to create marketing initiatives centrally and localize them across dozens, hundreds or thousands of locations.

Franify builds on more than a decade of franchise marketing technology developed by Reshift Media and represents the company's continued investment in using AI, automation and technology to help franchise organizations scale national and local marketing.

About Reshift Media

Reshift Media is an award-winning digital marketing and technology company headquartered in Toronto, Canada, serving franchise and multi-location organizations across the United States, Canada and internationally. The company specializes in digital advertising, social media, search engine optimization, franchise development marketing, content and influencer marketing, website and mobile development, conversion optimization and proprietary franchise marketing technology.

Reshift Media has been recognized as an Entrepreneur Top Franchise Supplier for four consecutive years, as the World's Best Franchise Marketing Firm at the Global Franchise Awards for four consecutive years, and with three consecutive Gold Stevie Awards at the International Business Awards.

Reshift Media is also the creator of Franify, an AI-powered digital marketing platform built specifically to help franchisors and franchisees manage and scale local digital marketing.

For more information, visit reshiftmedia.com or franify.com.

XI'AN, China, Sept. 24, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- A News Report from Shaanxi International Communication Center:

On September 19, the 13th Silk Road International Film Festival opened in Xi'an under the theme "Silk Road Connects the World, Light and Shadow Shine over Chang'an". Co‑hosted by China Media Group, the People's Government of Shaanxi Province and the People's Government of Fujian Province, and undertaken by the Shaanxi Provincial Film Bureau and the Xi'an Municipal People's Government, the festival ran for five days.

The international jury was chaired by Peter Pau, winner of the Academy Award for Best Cinematography. Egypt served as the Guest‑of‑Honour Country, advancing Sino‑Egyptian cinematic and cultural exchanges through events including the China‑Egypt Roundtable Dialogue and Egyptian Film Week.

Key sessions during the festival featured the Belt and Road Film Industry Development Dialogue, the Dialogue on Inheritance and Innovative Development of Film, and the "Silk Road Journey for Children• Children's Film Season". The Blue Book on Chinese Children's Films was released, and the Silk Road Research and Exchange Centre for Children's Films was inaugurated. Other highlights included the Xi'an International VR Film Exchange, the "Starry Brilliance" High‑Quality Micro‑Drama Programme, the Silk Road Film Market, Silk Road Film Exchanges, screenings and promotions for low‑and‑medium‑budget Shaanxi films, and the SRIFF Young Talent Venture Initiative, fostering international collaboration, industrial integration and youth talent development.
