releases.title: CACI Launches Good Dogs for Great Americans to Help Veterans Regain Independence Through Custom-Trained Service Dogs
releases.body:
New partnership with the Washington Capitals and America's VetDogs turns every Capitals blocked shot into funding to train and place service dogs

RESTON, Va., Sept. 24, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- CACI International Inc. (NYSE: CACI) today announced the launch of Good Dogs for Great Americans, the company's signature philanthropy program dedicated to helping veterans regain independence through specially trained service dogs. In partnership with the Washington Capitals and America's VetDogs, the program turns defense on the ice into life-changing support for those who defended our nation.

As the ambassador for Good Dogs for Great Americans, Lt. Gen. (Ret.) Mike Shields, CACI Senior Vice President, brings more than three decades of Army leadership and a commitment to serving America's veterans.

"Throughout my Army career, I learned that no one succeeds alone. We rely on trusted teammates to overcome obstacles and accomplish the mission," said Shields. "For many veterans, a specially trained service dog becomes that trusted partner. The dogs provide greater independence, renewed confidence, reduced anxiety, and unwavering support every day. I'm proud to help champion CACI's Good Dogs for Great Americans because this organization allows more veterans the opportunity to experience that profound partnership and improved quality of life."

The program comes to life through CACI On Defense, CACI's season-long activation with the Washington Capitals. Throughout the NHL season, CACI will donate $250 to America's VetDogs for every Capitals blocked shot. Those donations will help train and place service dogs with veterans living with physical disabilities, post-traumatic stress, hearing and vision loss, and other challenges. Based on the team's average of approximately 1,300 blocked shots each season, the partnership is expected to fund training for up to eight service dogs annually.

Service dogs trained by America's VetDogs help veterans and first responders navigate everyday life, increase mobility, independence, and improve overall well-being. Each placement helps individuals regain confidence while strengthening their connection to their communities.

"We are incredibly proud to partner with CACI in support of our mission to provide life-changing service dogs to veterans with disabilities," said John Miller, president and CEO of America's VetDogs. "A service dog can restore confidence, independence and dignity, empowering a veteran to navigate everyday life with greater freedom. CACI's partnership will help us expand that impact and reach more veterans who can benefit from these extraordinary partnerships. We are grateful for their commitment to those who have served and for helping ensure more veterans have access to the support they deserve, at no cost to them."

"We're thrilled to partner with CACI through the CACI On Defense Program. CACI has been an outstanding partner to the Capitals, and this platform reflects a shared commitment to honoring and supporting our nation's veterans. It gives us a meaningful way to support the veteran community that means so much to the Capitals and our fans, and we're excited to build on this partnership and create lasting impact for years to come," said Patrick Duffy, Chief Partnership Officer at Monumental Sports & Entertainment.

Throughout the season, fans will experience CACI On Defense through in-arena features, broadcast integrations, social media, and community storytelling, highlighting how every blocked shot helps change veterans' lives.

About CACI

CACI International Inc (NYSE: CACI) is a technology-first national security company that expands the limits of national security through innovation, discipline, and operational excellence. We deliver advanced technologies that help our customers move faster, operate more efficiently, and anticipate and defeat evolving threats. Our 27,000 talented employees and strong culture drive our success and have earned CACI recognition as a Fortune World's Most Admired Company. CACI is a member of the Fortune 500™, the Russell 1000 Index, and the S&P MidCap 400 Index. For more information, visit caci.com.

About Monumental Sports & Entertainment

Monumental Sports & Entertainment (MSE) is one of the leading integrated sports and entertainment companies globally. MSE's portfolio spans premier professional sports teams, world-class venues, and next-generation media properties, with marquee assets including the NHL's Washington Capitals, NBA's Washington Wizards, WNBA's Washington Mystics, NBA G League's Capital City Go-Go, Capital One Arena, and Monumental Sports Network, along with an investment in Team Liquid.

Rooted in the nation's capital, MSE brings Washington, D.C.'s distinct influence, ambition, and leadership to the global sports and entertainment landscape. The company harnesses the power of its platform to drive continuous innovation and deliver extraordinary experiences that inspire and unite our community, our fans, and our people. For additional information on MSE, please visit monumentalsports.com.

About America's VetDogs

For more than 20 years, America's VetDogs (www.VetDogs.org) has trained and placed guide and service dogs to provide independence, enhanced mobility, and companionship to veterans with disabilities from all eras. In 2015, America's VetDogs opened its programs to first responders, including fire, police, and emergency medical personnel. America's VetDogs is a 501(c)(3) not-for-profit organization founded by the Guide Dog Foundation (est. 1946) and serves our country's and communities' heroes in all 50 states, Washington, DC. Puerto Rico, and beyond. America's VetDogs relies on contributions from generous individuals, corporations, service clubs, and foundations to fund its mission to help those who have served our country live with dignity and independence. It costs more than $50,000 to breed, raise, train, and place one assistance dog, but America's VetDogs provides its services completely free of charge to the individual. America's VetDogs has been accredited by both the International Guide Dog Federation and Assistance Dogs International. Apply, volunteer, and donate at VetDogs.org.

releases.title: Introducing Outpost Space Factories: Orbital Manufacturing as a Service Unlocking Commercial Scale Production
releases.body:
With "Space Factories," Outpost offers standardized, modular manufacturing infrastructure as a service; and will manufacture its own StarFiber optical fiber as the first product off the line

LOS ANGELES and PLAYA VISTA, Calif. , Sept. 24, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Outpost Technologies Corporation today introduced Space Factories, a program that lets companies manufacture products in orbit and return them to Earth without building a space program of their own. Instead of developing a bespoke spacecraft, reentry system, and recovery operation for a single mission, companies bring their manufacturing process to Outpost's standardized, reusable platform; turning space manufacturing into standardized infrastructure they can specify rather than design and build.

With "Space Factories," Outpost offers standardized, modular manufacturing infrastructure as a service

A growing list of high-value products from specialty optical fibers to pharmaceuticals, semiconductors, and advanced crystals can be made better, or only, in microgravity. To date, every attempt to produce them in orbit has been a one-of-a-kind effort, with each company re-solving the same problems of power, thermal control, containment, safety, and return from scratch. Space Factories lets customers focus on what they do best, developing high-value products, while Outpost provides a common industrial platform: standardized modules that reduce bespoke engineering, shorten development timelines, and allow far more rapid deployment.

Just as important is what happens after production. Making a product in orbit is only valuable if it can be brought home frequently, reliably and at scale. Bringing things back from orbit is Outpost's core capability, which makes the company uniquely positioned to close the loop from orbital manufacturing to recovered product on the ground.

"No company should have to become a spacecraft company just to find out whether their product is better when it's made in space," said Amir Blachman, President and co-founder of Outpost. "We're designing and building the hard, expensive infrastructure: the vehicle, the power and thermal systems, standardized manufacturing modules, the reentry and recovery; and we operate it as a service."

Proving it with StarFiber

Outpost is putting the platform to work, manufacturing its own high-value products in orbit. StarFiber, the company's next-generation metal fluoride optical fiber, will be produced in a Space Factory module. Metal fluoride fibers can achieve dramatically lower signal loss than the silica fibers that carry today's data and telecommunications traffic, but they are extremely difficult to manufacture at quality on Earth, where gravity introduces defects during production. Microgravity offers a path to producing them at the quality their performance promises. StarFiber's formulation is also radiation-hardened, making it well suited to satellite, defense, and other demanding environments (and it will demonstrate the full Space Factory model end to end, from orbital production to recovered product on the ground).

"StarFiber is how we prove the platform on ourselves before we ask anyone else to fly on it," said Ryan Reel, VP of Commercial Partnerships and Product Strategy at Outpost. "It's the same infrastructure, the same modules, and the same return path we're offering to every customer. Any company developing a product that benefits from microgravity can plug into a platform we've already flown and get to orbit far faster and for less cost than they could on their own."

One platform, not a bespoke factory for every customer

Space Factories is built on a modular architecture that keeps the expensive, complex systems common and reusable, while confining customization to the smallest possible layer. Outpost's reusable free-flying spacecraft, CarryAll, provides the standardized foundation: orbital transport, power, communications, and the systems for Earth return and recovery. A separable CarryAll Space Factory container houses the customer's payload, manages production, pressurization, thermal, data, and safety interfaces. Only the innermost manufacturing module is tailored to a customer's specific process.

By using a common spacecraft, recovery infrastructure, software, and much of the manufacturing components across every mission, customers avoid the cost, risk, and delay of engineering a full system for a single flight. Proven modules can be replicated across missions or scaled in capacity as demand grows. Recovered equipment can be inspected, refurbished, and reflown: forming the foundation of commercial-scale production.

An open invitation

Space Factories is designed as a shared platform, and Outpost is opening it to industry. Companies developing products that benefit from manufacturing in space in optical materials, pharmaceuticals and biotech, semiconductors, crystal growth, and beyond can build and fly with Outpost. To learn more or discuss a manufacturing module, contact sales@outpost.space.

About Outpost Technologies Corporation

Outpost is building reusable Earth-return vehicles that close one of the most important gaps in the space economy: the ability to move meaningful quantities of cargo back from orbit with precision, speed, and repeatability.

Launch capacity has advanced rapidly, but Earth-return capacity remains limited. Outpost is building the southbound logistics layer required to support national security, in-space manufacturing, orbital warehousing, scientific research, and critical logistics. The CarryAll vehicle family is intended to scale from early payload-return missions to large-mass cargo operations, with precision delivery and large-mass capacity serving as the company's defining differentiation. For more information visit: www.outpost.space

releases.title: COUNTRY MUSIC HALL OF FAME® AND MUSEUM TO OPEN NEW EXHIBITION, ROGER MILLER: WIT, WISDOM, AND WONDER
releases.body:
NASHVILLE, Tenn., Sept. 23, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- The Country Music Hall of Fame® and Museum will explore the life and career of Country Music Hall of Fame member Roger Miller in a new exhibition. Roger Miller: Wit, Wisdom, and Wonder follows the story of the musical savant whose multifaceted career earned him a flood of accolades and widespread affection from the public. The exhibit is included with museum admission and runs from Friday, Nov. 6, until March 2028. It is supported by All Access Coach Leasing.

Miller (1936-1992) became a country-pop superstar in the 1960s with self-penned crossover hits like "Dang Me" and "King of the Road." At the height of the British Invasion, Miller won 11 Grammy awards, and he was the first country artist to win a Tony. He was a true renaissance man, mastering multiple crafts as a songwriter, singer, fiddler, guitarist, drummer, film and television star, Las Vegas headliner and Broadway composer.

Recognized for his quick wit, Miller's natural comedic ability was so sharp that Nashville songwriters were known to trail him around town, hoping to collect lines that flew from his mouth. He counted songwriting giants Bill Anderson and Willie Nelson among his closest friends, and has influenced countless others, including John Prine, Toby Keith and Kacey Musgraves.

"Roger Miller was a singular creative force," said Kyle Young, CEO of the Country Music Hall of Fame and Museum. "Though considered a musical genius and humorist, his greatest gift may have been his ability to connect with people. He channeled his many sides into fantastically absurd, touching and astute songwriting that still resonates today."

The exhibit will feature a short film produced by the museum and narrated by Country Music Hall of Fame member Marty Stuart. Visitors will see clothing, awards, handwritten notes, song manuscripts, instruments and rare footage of Miller's television appearances and performances.

Examples of items to be displayed include: 

  • Fiddle – When Miller was around 10 years old, musician and actor Sheb Wooley, who was married to Roger's cousin Melva at the time and lived nearby, bought him this fiddle.
  • Drawing – During his senior year in high school, Roger Miller drew this portrait of one of his musical heroes, Hank Williams.
  • Army shirt – Miller wore this shirt while serving in the U.S. Army from March 1954 to March 1957. He was stationed in South Korea for a time, where he drove a Jeep and played in a country band with other soldiers.
  • Guitar – This 1963 Gibson C-1E nylon-string model was Miller's primary guitar for most of the 1960s. He used it to write, record and perform many of his biggest hits, including "King of the Road."
  • Song manuscript and statuette – The credit card application, on which he started writing lyrics to "King of the Road," and a wood carving of a hobo, which inspired him to finish writing the song, are housed together in a shadow box built by Miller.
  • Grammy awards – Miller won 11 Grammy awards in 1965 and 1966. In addition to Miller's wins in nine country music categories, "King of the Road" earned him Grammys for Best Contemporary (Rock & Roll) Single and Best Contemporary (Rock & Roll) Vocal Performance, Male.
  • Hand-written notes – Roger Miller often wrote down song ideas and lyrics on scrap pieces of paper. Mary Miller, Roger's wife, called them his "droppings."
  • Motorcycle – Miller purchased this Honda CA95 Benly Touring 150 motorcycle in 1965, following his financial windfall with the success of "Dang Me," "Chug-a-Lug" and "King of the Road."
  • Western shirt – Miller wore this western shirt, designed by Manuel Cuevas, when he performed at a taping of "Roger Miller: A Soundstage Special" at WTTW Studios in Chicago in 1982.
  • Tony award and tuxedo – Miller won this Tony award for "Best Original Score (Music and/or Lyrics) Written for the Theatre" for the Broadway musical "Big River," for which he wrote all the songs. The musical won a total of seven Tonys. He wore this tuxedo at the 39th Annual Tony Awards, June 2, 1985.

Miller was inducted posthumously into the Country Music Hall of Fame in 1995. For more information on his life and career, read Miller's Country Music Hall of Fame bio.

Exhibit Companion Catalog

An illustrated and in-depth exhibit catalog will supplement the gallery presentation, featuring historical photographs and artifacts from the exhibit. It includes a foreword by Grammy award-winning artist Dwight Yoakam. The catalog is available through The Museum Store beginning Nov. 6. It is made possible through support from Maverick Nashville and will be widely available in bookstores and online outlets through a distribution partnership with the University of Illinois Press.

Exhibit Playlist

The official exhibit playlist, compiled by the museum's curatorial staff, is now available on major streaming platforms.

Upcoming Programs

In support of the exhibit, the museum will host a variety of public programs during its run. Upcoming programs include: 

  • Panel Discussion – Saturday, Nov. 7, at 2:30 p.m. (Ford Theater)

    The museum will host a conversation with some of the people who knew Miller best: the late musician's wife, Mary Miller, a former member of Kenny Rogers' band the First Edition; Country Music Hall of Fame member and Miller's close friend Bill Anderson, who first met Miller in Atlanta in the 1950s when both were struggling songwriters; and Randy Hart, Miller's musical director and bandleader of eight years who currently serves as staff pianist and assistant music director at the Grand Ole Opry. The talk will be hosted by the museum's exhibit co-curator Erin Osmon and illustrated with archival images, audio and video from the museum's collection.
  • Songwriter Session with Dean Miller – Saturday, Feb. 6, 2027, at noon (Ford Theater)

    Dean Miller is Roger's son and an accomplished singer and songwriter. He will perform and discuss some of his father's songs, as well as his own. During Songwriter Sessions at the museum, songwriters share stories and songs behind classic and current hits.

The programs are included with museum admission with reservations encouraged in advance. Visit the museum's website to reserve tickets and learn more about the exhibit.

About the Country Music Hall of Fame and Museum:

The Country Music Hall of Fame® and Museum collects, preserves and interprets country music and its history for the education and entertainment of diverse audiences. In exhibitions, publications, digital media and educational programs, the museum explores the cultural importance and enduring beauty of the art form. Among the most-visited history museums in the United States, the Country Music Hall of Fame and Museum was awarded the country's highest honor in the arts, the National Medal of Arts, in 2024. Accredited by the American Alliance of Museums, the museum is operated by the Country Music Foundation, a not-for-profit 501(c)(3) educational organization chartered by the state of Tennessee in 1964. The Country Music Foundation operates Historic RCA Studio B®, Hatch Show Print® poster shop, Haley Gallery, CMA Theater, CMF Records, the Frist Library and Archive and CMF Press.

More information about the Country Music Hall of Fame® and Museum is available at www.countrymusichalloffame.org or by calling (615) 416-2001.

releases.title: PomeGran Launches The Fibre Files Podcast to Explore the Impact of Connectivity on Communities
releases.body:
Hosted by award-winning broadcaster Sam Laprade, the new series brings together community, business, government, and industry voices to explore what connectivity makes possible

TORONTO, Sept. 23, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- PomeGran Inc. (PomeGran), a fibre-centric broadband infrastructure provider focused on connecting rural and underserved communities, today announced the launch of The Fibre Files, a new podcast exploring the role connectivity plays in communities, businesses, and everyday life.

Sponsored by PomeGran and hosted by award-winning broadcaster, professional fundraiser, author, and community advocate Sam Laprade, The Fibre Files moves the conversation beyond broadband infrastructure and technical specifications to examine how connectivity drives economic development, entrepreneurship, education, technology, innovation, and community life.

The Fibre Files will be available to stream on Spotify and to watch on NIVO's YouTube channel. NIVO is PomeGran's consumer internet service provider brand. Episodes and related content will also be shared across PomeGran and NIVO's digital channels.

"Building digital broadband infrastructure is ultimately about what that infrastructure allows people and communities to do. The Fibre Files gives us an opportunity to bring different perspectives together and have meaningful conversations about the role connectivity can play in economic development, education, entrepreneurship, and community life," said Dr. Kalai S. Kalaichelvan, Chairman & CEO of PomeGran.

Episode One: Beyond Broadband

The inaugural episode, Beyond Broadband: What Connectivity Means to Rural Communities, features Tamara Moellenberg, Partner at ReD Associates, a global strategy consultancy that helps organisations grow and transform by creating original strategies based on human behaviour.

Laprade and Moellenberg explore rural entrepreneurship, remote work, education, artificial intelligence, and the importance of understanding the lived experiences of rural communities when designing and delivering connectivity.

"Connectivity is increasingly part of the foundation that allows people to participate fully in modern life. The Fibre Files gives us the opportunity to look beyond the technology and hear directly from people about how digital connectivity can impact communities, businesses, and individuals," said Sam Laprade, host of The Fibre Files.

Bringing Different Perspectives to the Conversation

Following its inaugural episode, The Fibre Files will continue to bring together leaders with different perspectives on the future of broadband and the communities it serves.

Upcoming guests include Rob Barlow of revQuotient and Peter Politis, Mayor of the Town of Cochrane, Ontario.

Through conversations with leaders from the broadband industry, business, government, and communities, the series will explore topics including fibre infrastructure, rural economic development, emerging technology, artificial intelligence, entrepreneurship, and the evolving connectivity needs of communities.

"The goal is to create a platform where people with different experiences and perspectives can discuss where connectivity is taking us and, more importantly, what communities need from it," concluded Kalaichelvan.

Listen and Watch

Stream The Fibre Files on Spotify or watch the series on NIVO's YouTube channel.

About PomeGran Inc.

PomeGran Inc. is Canada's fastest-growing fibre-centric rural digital infrastructure provider. Dedicated to enhancing broadband services, PomeGran has emerged as a leader on a mission to empower underserved markets in Quebec and Ontario. PomeGran is investing in rural Quebec and Northern Ontario as part of their strategic plan. Boasting ownership of broadband networks, underground and aerial fibre assets, and fixed wireless access (FWA) assets, PomeGran is committed to enabling broadband sovereignty and bridging the digital divide that exists between urban, rural, and Indigenous communities. Founded on the fundamental principle of ensuring equitable access to digital infrastructure, PomeGran believes that everyone deserves the opportunity to participate in today's digital-first economy. PEACHTREE ENTERTAINMENT ANNOUNCED AS CO-OWNER AND EXCLUSIVE OPERATOR OF THE RAIL WITH FIRST SHOWS TO BE UNVEILED LATER THIS YEAR

LEXINGTON, Ky., Sept. 23, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- National concert promotion company Peachtree Entertainment, in partnership with The Commons, has been announced as co-owner and exclusive operator of The Rail, Lexington's forthcoming state-of-the-art live music venue within the Commons Entertainment District, designed to deliver exceptional experiences on both sides of the stage. Peachtree Entertainment will provide operations, marketing, sponsorship. select programming support and more. Brand new venue renderings were also unveiled today as well as plans to announce the first wave of shows later this year followed by a grand opening in early 2027. Music fans are encouraged to visit theraillex.com and follow the venue on social media (Facebook, Instagram, X, TikTok, etc.) for all of the latest news, announcements and updates.

Located within The Commons, the 43-acre mixed-use entertainment district one mile from downtown on Lexington & West Main Street, The Rail represents a major investment in Lexington's future as it attracts visitors, creates jobs and supports local businesses. Beyond Lexington, the venue is located within a day's drive of Nashville, Louisville, Cincinnati, Indianapolis, Columbus, Knoxville and St. Louis. "Lexington's cultural and entertainment scene is experiencing great momentum. The Commons is expanding what an evening or weekend in our city can look like, and The Rail anchors that vision with exceptional energy. A venue of this caliber amplifies our regional entertainment offerings, encourages visitors to stay longer, and gives our local community a premier space to gather," said VisitLex President, Mary Quinn Ramer.

With a capacity of 2,200 guests and more than 1,000 seats for theater-style events, The Rail brings the scale, flexibility, and production capabilities needed to host national touring artists while maintaining an intimate, high-energy experience. The venue features six full-service bars, two outdoor decks, premium VIP spaces, an exclusive membership program, ample restrooms, and a flexible floor plan designed for concerts, club nights, corporate functions, special events, and private rentals.

Designed with both the guest and artist experience in mind, The Rail pairs top-tier sound and production with three dedicated dressing rooms, an artist lounge, and thoughtfully designed backstage amenities. Together with the dining, entertainment, and hospitality offerings throughout The Commons, The Rail delivers a complete destination for live entertainment and private events in Lexington.

"We are excited and honored to be involved in this revitalization of Lexington. Every seat, every sightline, every bar, and every common area has been intentionally designed so fans feel close to the performance," said Dustin Labbe, SVP of Booking for Peachtree Entertainment. "Whether you're on the floor, in the mezzanine, or in a VIP space, the experience stays immersive. The Rail, located within a day's drive of other major midwest markets, is an ideal routing stop for national tours. That means more opportunities to bring artists, and the economic impact that comes with them, to Central Kentucky."

"What we've always wanted The Commons to become is a place where people can spend an entire day, and now an entire evening, without having to leave. The Rail brings that vision together," said Daren Turner, Founder of The Commons. "People can come for a show, have dinner beforehand, meet friends for drinks afterward, and stay just steps away from the venue. That kind of activity and connection is what turns a development into a true destination. We believe The Rail will not only become the heartbeat of The Commons, but an important part of Lexington's growing entertainment scene."

About The Commons

The Commons is a 43-acre mixed-use entertainment district in Lexington, Kentucky, built on a former tobacco processing campus one mile from downtown, with an active rail line running through the property. Restored warehouse buildings and new construction house dining, retail, recreation, studios, and luxury short-term stays, connected by walking trails and a central greenspace. More than thirty businesses already operate on the campus. The Commons is developed by Turner Properties.

About Peachtree Entertainment

Peachtree Entertainment is a nationally acclaimed concert promoter committed to spotlighting rising talent. With over 15 years of expertise in the music industry, Peachtree Entertainment has earned its reputation as a leader and innovator in live music. As pioneers in identifying and nurturing new talent, Peachtree Entertainment has played a key role in launching the touring careers of artists like Luke Combs, Morgan Wallen, Luke Bryan, Ella Langley, and many more. Beyond tours, Peachtree's portfolio also features major festivals and key partnerships with venues and universities across the country.

Peachtree Entertainment remains dedicated to shaping the national live music scene, continuing its legacy of significant influence and success. To learn more information about Peachtree Entertainment tours and events, click here, or follow on Instagram or Facebook.

NET PROCEEDS TO BENEFIT BLACK MUSIC ACTION COALITION (BMAC)

Musically directed by GRAMMY® Award winning songwriter Pynk Beard, the album brings together Brandy, Keb' Mo', Kashus Culpepper, Elsie, 2'Live Bre, Reyna Roberts, Tone Stith and more for new interpretations of songs that defined an era

"By Any Means" music video premiered September 4, 2026.
"We Shall Overcome" music video by Pynk Beard premieres September 25, 2026.

LOS ANGELES, Sept. 22, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Anzie Blue Records and Surf Club today announced the September 25 release of By Any Means: The Album, featuring music from and inspired by the feature film BY ANY MEANS now in theaters. The album will be distributed globally by The Orchard. BY ANY MEANS is distributed domestically by Paramount Pictures. Bonnie Greenberg served as the music supervisor and executive music producer for the film.

Ole Smoky Distillery is the marketing partner for By Any Means: The Album, with plans including an upcoming tour by Pynk Beard and select album artists. CEO Mike Novy says, "We're proud to partner with these artists and the music community to bring such iconic American songs to life. Nothing brings people together like music, except for passing around a jar of Ole Smoky moonshine!"

The album is executive produced by Surf Club co-founder Hit-Boy, whose extensive production credits include Beyoncé, Jay-Z, Travis Scott and Drake, and Dr. Blum, whose credits include Twenty One Pilots, Big Sean and Nas. Parasol Music, co-founded by Martin Wave, served as a creative and production partner on the album.

Musically directed by Anzie Blue Records' country artist and GRAMMY®-nominated songwriter Pynk Beard, By Any Means: The Album brings together artists across generations and genres to reinterpret songs connected to the sound and spirit of the 1960s. Brandy, Kashus Culpepper, Keb' Mo', Tone Stith, and others put their own stamp on songs from iconic artists — including three performers in the Rock & Roll Hall of Fame's premiere induction class: Ray Charles, Sam Cooke, and James Brown.

Regarding new single "We Shall Overcome," Pynk Beard says "There are very few songs that transcend time quite like this one. I'm honored to be a part of this project and particularly this song. The lyrics speak to the hope that I think we should all share for this world. Hate will not win. We WILL overcome."

Three songs from the BY ANY MEANS film are featured on the album, including Elsie's "I Love Your Lovin' Ways" (popularized by Rock Hall inductee Nina Simone) and Parson James & ASHBY's "Talking About My Baby" (popularized by Rock Hall inductees The Impressions and written by solo Rock Hall inductee Curtis Mayfield) in addition to the title track. "By Any Means" makes The Isley Brothers the latest of over 40 Rock Hall inductees to record a Diane Warren song.

Much of the album was recorded at FAME Studios in Muscle Shoals, Alabama in less than a week — bringing the project to a place with deep roots in American soul music and to Pynk Beard's home state. Artists include 2'Live Bre, Ariel J., ASHBY, Brandy, David Kushner, Denitia, Elsie, Kashus Culpepper, Keb' Mo', nanawho, Parson James, Pynk Beard, Reyna Roberts, Saekyi, Steve Ray Ladson, Tatiana Marie Clark, The BoykinZ, The Isley Brothers, and Tone Stith.

Net proceeds from the album will benefit the Black Music Action Coalition (BMAC), supporting the organization's work to advance equity, expand opportunity, and create pathways for the next generation of artists, creatives, and music industry professionals.

The partnership with the Black Music Action Coalition extends the album's impact beyond the music itself. Net proceeds from By Any Means: The Album, will support BMAC's work to protect and advance the legacy of Black creators while investing in the artists, executives, and emerging leaders who will shape the future. The collaboration reflects the shared belief at the heart of the film and its music: that culture can be a powerful force for progress, and that honoring the legacy of those who came before us must include creating opportunity for those who come next.

The official "By Any Means" music video, featuring The Isley Brothers and Kushner, was released September 4. Watch here: https://youtu.be/pZaWebkmJDY Directed by Fran Strine of F26 Productions — who directed Dolly Parton's Live at London O2 Arena film — the video will be followed on September 25 by Pynk Beard's "We Shall Overcome," also directed by Strine.

Diane Warren explains her inspiration for the title track, "By Any Means":

"I wanted to write a song that captured the spirit of the film, which is about those who go beyond the rules to do what is necessary. My idea was to take an iconic artist who came from that era and pair them with an artist from this current era. Having The Isley Brothers come on board was a dream come true. They are as amazing today as they were when they were performing during the time of these events, and they are so authentic to this story.

"David Kushner is a great young singer who sounds like he could have come from that era too. He is a young guy with an old-soul voice. The combination of him and the Isleys is pure magic, and together they have created a song that could live in many eras to come. I'm proud to be a part of it."

For Ronald Isley, the film's story carries a personal connection:

"Having lived through the Civil Rights era, this story is personal. We saw firsthand the courage, sacrifice and struggle it took for change to come. Music has always had the power to speak to what people are going through, and Diane Warren has written a song that carries that kind of meaning. It was an honor for Ernie and me to be a part of it and to lend our voices to a film that remembers this history while reminding a new generation why it still matters."

Ernie Isley adds, "I believe the film and the song will have a major impact. Ronald and I are happy to be involved with this project."

David Kushner says:

"It's an honor to be a part of the music that soundtracks a powerful film like By Any Means. I'm a huge fan of Mark Wahlberg, and being part of this song alongside Diane Warren, a songwriter I've looked up to since I fell in love with music and began writing songs, as well as The Isley Brothers, is beyond surreal and has been an incredible experience."

BY ANY MEANS: THE ALBUM soundtrack

ABOUT BY ANY MEANS

BY ANY MEANS stars Yahya Abdul-Mateen II and Mark Wahlberg and is directed by Elegance Bratton from a screenplay by Sascha Penn. Inspired by a true story and set in the 1960s, the film follows a young Black FBI agent (Abdul-Mateen II) sent to Mississippi to investigate a wave of brutal killings targeting civil rights leaders. Forced to work alongside notorious hitman Greg Scarpa (Wahlberg), he finds himself pulled into a deadly hunt where justice and vengeance begin to blur.

releases.title: ENCOUNTERS IN THE MILKY WAY A NEW FILM COMING TO THE PLANÉTARIUM ON OCTOBER 6
releases.body:
MONTREAL, Sept. 23, 2026 /CNW/ -- Just as the planets orbit the Sun, our solar system continues its own journey through our galaxy. Explore the Milky Way, discover its history, its future, and the dynamic transformations constantly taking place within it in the new film presented by the Planétarium | Espace pour la vie, Encounters in the Milky Way, opening October 6 and narrated by Chilean-American actor Pedro Pascal. The film is produced by the American Museum of Natural History in New York, with major support from and in partnership with NASA.

Synopsis

Discover the chance encounters that have shaped our place in the universe. Reaching billions of years into the past and peering millions of years into the future, Encounters in the Milky Way is a time-traveling journey about the cosmic movements that shape our galactic neighbourhood.

Witness spectacular moments in our solar system's past and future, including the paths of stars, comets, interstellar debris, and visually stunning gas and dust clouds--and, visualized for the first time, a dramatic, ongoing merger of our galaxy with a smaller satellite galaxy.

Developed by a team that includes astronomers, science visualization experts, and artists, Encounters in the Milky Way is made possible by data from one of the most transformative projects of the past century: the European Space Agency's Gaia mission, dubbed the "billion-star survey" for mapping the precise positions, distances, and motions of nearly 2 billion stars in our galaxy.

Contribution from an expert at the Planétarium de Montréal

As part of ongoing collaborations related to the publication of scientific articles, Jackie Faherty, a senior research scientist at the American Museum of Natural History in New York and curator of the film project, called on Jonathan Gagné, a scientific advisor at the Planétarium, to visualize the distribution of young stars in a region near the Sun. The information compiled and provided by Jonathan--namely, the position and velocity of these stars--comes primarily from a database he developed himself as part of his own research, a reference source for which his expertise is sought on a regular basis.

Encounters in the Milky Way is the first production to shed light on the history of our galaxy's cosmic motion and its influence on our solar system.

About the Service de l'Espace pour la vie, des grands parcs et du Mont-Royal

The Espace pour la vie museums and the network of major parks are at the heart of this service. Its activities contribute significantly to the quality of life of Montrealers. It plays a key role in the city's appeal and influence. With its five science museums, natural habitats, urban forest, and public spaces, the Service de l'Espace pour la vie, des grands parcs et du Mont-Royal is dedicated to protecting nature and promoting biodiversity. Through its efforts in conservation, restoration, development, research, and education, it contributes to Montreal's socio-ecological transition.

BrandMo Tech has spent five years proving the model, powering campaigns for Canadian affiliates of global agency holding companies. It now enters its growth phase as culturally diverse communities become Canada's fastest-growing consumer segment -- audiences legacy targeting tools weren't built to recognize.

"As cultural diversity accelerates, cookies disappear, and walled gardens deliver diminishing returns, advertisers are losing more than signals -- they're losing audience understanding," said Pawan Jailkhani, Founder & CEO of BrandMo Tech. "BrandMo Tech was built to solve this problem."

Through its proprietary technology and partnerships with SSPs, DSPs, and premium publishers, BrandMo Tech reduces reliance on cookies and fragmented third-party signals, enabling activation across desktop, mobile, app, CTV, and social inventory.

"To reach today's audiences, advertisers must go beyond language. They require context and nuance that honour culture," added Jailkhani, a two-decade media and adtech veteran who saw Canada as the ideal launching ground: culturally diverse audiences the industry could not reach. "We built culture into every layer of our tech stack so advertisers can reclaim the open internet."

Committed to investing in Canadian partnerships, BrandMo Tech is also expanding its Toronto team over the next 12–24 months.

releases.title: Parks Associates: Ten Streaming Services Phased Out in Q2 2026 as US Streaming Video Market Reorganizes
releases.body:
Streaming Video Tracker highlights 500+ streaming services across US and Canada 

PLANO, Texas, Sept. 23, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Parks Associates' Streaming Video Tracker reports ten US streaming service profiles were phased out in Q2 2026 as many services rebrand and reorganize their content and brands. Notably, Paramount Skydance ended BET+ as a separate service and consolidated that content within its flagship Paramount+ streaming service.

The Streaming Video Tracker also started tracking two new services last quarter, OG Network and TrueTVplus, which brings the total number of streaming service profiles in this product to 370 in the US and 234 in Canada. Parks Associates will host the industry webinar "Streaming Video: Churn, Loyalty, and Competition" on September 24, where the firm's analysts will share research and comment on market trends and the implications for service providers and content owners.

Recent market changes highlight an active streaming market where services are closing, consolidating, or moving content to different distribution models. In particular, the market has been active regarding sports content, as providers experiment with the best strategies to capture sports fans and viewers:

  • FIFA+ moved to DAZN.
  • RidePass now operates solely as a FAST channel.
  • FanDuel Sports Network shut down its television channels and streaming operations.

"Streaming services continue to experiment with the best ways to reach and monetize audiences," said Michael Goodman, Director, Entertainment Research, Parks Associates. "The movement of content from standalone apps to larger platforms and FAST channels shows how quickly distribution strategies are changing."

In its monthly updates, the Streaming Video Tracker analyzes the strategies and emerging market trends when providers move content into larger offerings or launch new services:

  • BET+ has been phased out by Paramount Skydance, and its content library has migrated to Paramount+ under a dedicated BET Hub.
  • CTV Throwback and Movies moved to Crave.
  • OHL Live transitioned its digital streaming content to FloHockey.
  • Barça One was replaced by Barça Play, which is integrated into FC Barcelona's app and website.
  • OG Network and TrueTVplus were added to the tracker in Q2 2026. OG Network operates as an AVOD and FAST service, while TrueTVplus launched as a FAST platform with programming across sports, independent films, documentaries, and lifestyle content.

Registration for the webinar "Streaming Video: Churn, Loyalty, and Competition" is complimentary. For more information or for trial access to the Streaming Video Tracker, contact Mindi Sue Sternlitz-Rubenstein or visit www.parksassociates.com.

releases.title: Itibari-Waynne & Partners (IWP) Team with SHARE to Connect Filmmakers with Investment Capital
releases.body:
Partnership combines IWP's investor-focused financing model with SHARE Studios' creator infrastructure to help filmmakers fund projects while retaining intellectual property ownership

LOS ANGELES, Sept. 23, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Itibari-Waynne & Partners (IWP), an Agentic financing platform focused on de-risking capital for creative small businesses, has partnered with SHARE to create a new pathway for independent filmmakers to access financing while maintaining ownership of their intellectual property and participating in the long-term financial upside of their projects.

The alliance combines IWP's investor-focused capital de-risking strategies with SHAREs' collaborative infrastructure, profit-sharing models and distribution networks. Together, the companies aim to address one of independent filmmaking's persistent challenges: connecting creators and their projects with investment capital while providing a structure that allows filmmakers to retain control of their work.

IWP's funding model connects investors with creator-led projects, without requiring creators to surrender their intellectual property. Led by Bruce Waynne and Itibari Zulu, IWP brings experience across entertainment and finance to channel investment capital into the creator economy.

"This partnership addresses access to capital while recognizing that funding a project shouldn't mean giving away rights," adds Bruce Waynne, CEO of IWP. "We are creating a stronger connection between investors, creators, and the financial value generated by the creator economy."

Through the association, IWP's financing model will be paired with SHAREs' platform, which provides filmmakers with tools to connect, build crews, structure projects and negotiate transparent backend profit-sharing agreements.

SHARE's infrastructure is designed to help creatives mobilize communities, organize independent productions and maintain control over their work. When combined with IWP's capital resources, the companies intend to provide filmmakers with both financing opportunities and the infrastructure needed to prepare and advance projects.

"As a filmmaker myself, I've spent years navigating the same frustrating catch-22 so many creators face: agents and managers often want financing in place before giving you access to talent, while investors want recognizable talent attached before they'll consider funding the project," explains Erin Norman, CEO & Co-Founder of SHARE Studios. "When I learned about IWP and met their team, I felt genuinely hopeful about what this could mean for the future of our industry. It can get crews back to work, creating sustainable careers and help reshape a financial system that is long overdue for change."

Filmmakers and creators can register for early access and begin preparing their projects ahead of upcoming funding opportunities through IWP.

Following an initial email registration, creators will be guided through five steps intended to help organize and strengthen their projects for future funding consideration.

Filmmakers are encouraged to assemble key project elements including cast, crew, production materials, budgets and other relevant information so projects are prepared when IWP funding opportunities become available and investor review begins.

Big A Anime positions itself as the premier hub for domestic anime fans, featuring original #1 influencer game shows like Anime Showdown, alongside event specials such as Inside Anime NYC, Inside Anime EXPO LA, and Inside New York Comic Con.

"Our mission at ESREVOLUTION has always been to build accessible, high-yield global media highways that connect passionate youth audiences with elite content libraries," said Wendy Wang, CEO of ESREVOLUTION, Inc. WEST PALM BEACH, Fla., Sept. 23, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Real America's Voice (RAV) today announced that its White House and presidential pool coverage, captured by RAV's internal camera teams, will be made broadly and freely available to media organizations everywhere.

"At a time when a handful of legacy outlets are casting the President's decision as the death of the free press, the reality is exactly the opposite," said Parker Sigg, Vice President of Real America's Voice at Performance One Media. "Real America's Voice is pleased to provide a feed of the pool camera to all the media, even the fake news, and to the American people. A free press is alive and well, and we are honored to be a conduit of this foundational constitutional principle for all of America."

RAV is making its pool coverage available through three channels:

A clean, public feed. Unwatermarked video from the White House and presidential pool will be published publicly on RAV's official YouTube channel, (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Rswk5YjG-3g) where any media organization — national, local, or independent — can access and utilize the footage.

Direct professional delivery. Networks and outlets requiring the feed delivered directly can receive it through professional distribution and ingest methods, coordinated to their technical requirements.

A single point of contact. All media organizations interested in receiving the pool feed should contact pool@americasvoice.news, where RAV's team will coordinate the appropriate technical delivery method.

Contrary to the claims and assumptions currently circulating about access to and availability of this coverage, RAV's position is unambiguous: this is coverage of the presidency, produced in the public interest, and it will be distributed as widely as possible.

You can watch all Real America's Voice Programming at https://realamericasvoice.com or by downloading the app on Apple or Android. Real America's Voice is also available on DISH Network, Prime Video, Apple TV, Amazon Fire TV, Pluto TV, Samsung TV Plus, and Roku.

releases.body:
The selection brings ticketing, fan experiences, and event operations onto a single platform across FAN EXPO's portfolio of events, which welcomes more than one million fans annually.

CALGARY, AB, Sept. 23, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Showpass today announced that it has been selected as the official ticketing and event technology partner for FAN EXPO, the world's largest comic con producer. Showpass will power ticketing, fan engagement, and event operations across FAN EXPO's portfolio of industry-leading events, including FAN EXPO Canada, FAN EXPO Boston, FAN EXPO Dallas, MEGACON Orlando, CALGARY EXPO, FAN EXPO Denver, FAN EXPO Chicago, and many more.

Spanning 13 cities across North America, FAN EXPO's events bring together fans of comics, gaming, anime, horror, sci-fi, cosplay, entertainment and everything in between. From the nearly 200,000 attendees who gather annually at MEGACON Orlando to the hundreds of thousands more attending FAN EXPO events throughout North America, FAN EXPO has built one of the most recognized and influential portfolios in live entertainment.

Across FAN EXPO's North American portfolio, Showpass will provide the technology and operational infrastructure needed to support high-demand on-sales, large-scale fan experiences, and complex event operations.

Fans will benefit from a seamless purchasing experience directly through FAN EXPO channels, allowing them to purchase tickets, photo opportunities, autographs, premium experiences, merchandise, and event add-ons through a single transaction. The collaboration will also provide a fully branded FAN EXPO purchasing journey, RFID capabilities, advanced event operations technology, and the scalability required to support some of the largest fandom events in the world.

"FAN EXPO has built one of the most impressive event portfolios in live entertainment," said Lucas McCarthy, Founder and CEO of Showpass. "Supporting events of this scale requires more than ticketing. It requires a platform capable of powering the entire event operation. Whether a fan is purchasing a badge or securing a photo opportunity with a favourite celebrity, every interaction should feel effortless. We're proud to provide FAN EXPO with one connected system to manage its events and deliver world-class fan experiences across North America."

FAN EXPO Vice President Andrew Moyes said, "As our events continue to grow, we're focused on ensuring the fan experience evolves alongside them. Showpass brings the innovation, technology, flexibility, and operational expertise needed to support that growth while helping us create an even better experience for our fans."

FAN EXPO's selection of Showpass represents another milestone in Showpass's work across entertainment, sports, festivals, conventions, and cultural events throughout North America. Trusted by organizers to power everything from community events to some of the continent's most attended live experiences, Showpass connects ticketing, marketing, operations, analytics, and fan engagement through a single platform designed to give organizers greater control over their events.

ABOUT SHOWPASS:

Showpass is the operating system for independent live events, connecting every stage of the event lifecycle into one platform. From ticketing and marketing to operations, analytics, and financing, Showpass gives organizers one system to run, grow, and own their events. More than 175 million tickets have been issued through Showpass, powering music, sports, festivals, venues, cultural events, and everyday things to do across North America. Built with a mission to reignite the joy of live experiences, Showpass equips organizers with the tools and support needed to elevate the fan experience. Independently owned, Showpass is one of North America's fastest-growing event technology companies, recognized by Deloitte's Technology Fast 50 and named to The Globe and Mail's Canada's Top Growing Companies list for three consecutive years.

ABOUT FAN EXPO:

With over a million fans and counting, FAN EXPO HQ attracts pop culture enthusiasts, locally and internationally, to come together to celebrate all things fandom. Collectively it hosts over one million fans annually at FAN EXPO Dallas, FAN EXPO Canada, MEGACON Orlando, FAN EXPO Boston, FAN EXPO Denver, CALGARY EXPO, FAN EXPO Chicago, FAN EXPO Philadelphia, FAN EXPO Portland, FAN EXPO New Orleans, FAN EXPO Cleveland, FAN EXPO Vancouver, Toronto Comicon, Dallas FAN FESTIVAL, and EDMONTON EXPO. releases.body:
New Series Will Lead a Full Hour of Lucky Dog Programming

Watch Trailer

NEW YORK, Sept. 22, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Hearst Media Production Group (HMPG) today announced its new series Lucky Dog: Paws with Purpose will debut Saturday, October 3 on CBS. Produced by HMPG in an exclusive partnership with USAA, the leading financial services company for the military, veterans and their families, it will air weekend mornings on CBS as part of the "CBS WKND" educational/informational (E/I) programming block (times may vary; check local listings).

Hosted by Emmy® Award-winning animal trainer Brandon McMillan, the series, which will be followed immediately by Lucky Dog: Down Under, will lead a full hour of Lucky Dog programming on CBS.

Lucky Dog: Paws with Purpose follows McMillan as he pairs dogs with military veterans and families, creating matches that provide comfort, companionship and stability. Featured stories include Peaches, a mixed breed who may be the perfect match for an Air Force veteran and her son and Steve, a playful poodle being considered for a Marine Corps vet and her daughter. The series will also feature Smoky, a certified therapy dog and USAA's new K9 ambassador and Chief Pawsitivity Officer, alongside her handler, Chris, an Air Force Reservist and former military working dog handler.

"USAA has been taking care of our members every day since our founding 104 years ago, and Smoky is the embodiment of that as she is a symbol of comfort and well-being for our employees and the military community," said Chris Curtin, Chief Marketing Officer of USAA. "The stories in Lucky Dog: Paws with Purpose reflect the strength, resilience and connection that are such an important part of military life. We're proud to be part of a series that celebrates those experiences."

"The Lucky Dog franchise has always been about the transformative bond between people and animals," said Bryan Curb, president of Hearst Media Production Group. "Paws with Purpose builds on that foundation while shining a light on the unique experiences of military veterans, spouses and families. We know the show will resonate with our audiences and inspire viewers to see the comfort, connection and purpose dogs can bring to people's lives."

In the subsequent timeslot, Lucky Dog: Down Under – also hosted by Brandon McMillan and premiering its second season – takes viewers to Australia for heartwarming stories of shelter dogs as they transition from rescue and rehabilitation to cherished members of loving families.

Since its inception in 2013, the Lucky Dog franchise has helped to rescue, rehabilitate, train and re-home more than 200 dogs. The show has received three Daytime Emmy® Awards, 63 Telly Awards, seven Parents' Choice Awards and five Cynopsis Kids Imagination Awards. For his work on the series, McMillan has earned two Daytime Emmys® for Outstanding Host in a Lifestyle/Travel/Children's or Family Viewing Program.

HMPG's current program portfolio comprises more than 30 original series and hundreds of hours of content annually on leading broadcast networks and station groups and on connected TV and streaming platforms. It has a library of 85 series (6,000 episodes) and its content can be found in 100 countries.

About USAA

Founded in 1922 by 25 soldiers, USAA is among the leading providers of insurance, banking and retirement solutions and serves more than 14.5 million members of the U.S. military, veterans who have honorably served and their families. Headquartered in San Antonio, USAA has offices in seven U.S. cities and four overseas locations and employs more than 36,000 people worldwide. Each year, USAA supports national and local nonprofits serving military families and communities. With Honor Through Action, USAA advances policy, advocacy and philanthropy to support financial security, build meaningful careers and promote overall well-being across the military community. For more information about USAA, follow us on Facebook or X (@usaa), or visit usaa.com.

About Hearst Media Production Group

HMPG produces hundreds of hours of Emmy® Award-winning programming annually across linear, streaming, digital and social media platforms for domestic and international distribution in 100 countries. releases.title: Ande Raises $52M Seed and Series A to Launch The First Entertainment Operating System For Enterprises
releases.body:
Ande brings corporate entertainment into a single platform and gives venues a direct channel to enterprise bookings.

NEW YORK, Sept. 22, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Ande, the AI-native network for corporate entertainment, emerges from stealth with more than $52 million in seed and Series A funding from Lightspeed Venture Partners, Redpoint Ventures, Duration Ventures, and Sierra Ventures, with participation from Bain Capital Ventures.

Enterprises spend an estimated $325 billion a year on entertainment from client dinners and team outings to catering, sporting events, and gifting. Yet the booking and expense management behind it is fragmented across credit cards, AP systems, and consumer apps creating an extremely manual reconciliation process for finance teams.

Ande brings structure to one of the last unmanaged categories of enterprise spend by giving teams a single platform to book entertainment effortlessly, while finance and legal teams keep full visibility and control over every dollar spent.

Ande's agentic workflows surface venue availability, book experiences, route approvals, execute contracts, and reconcile expenses automatically. Executive assistants, office managers, field marketers, GTM teams, and their managers all work together in a single, multiplayer workspace in order to book team offsites and deal-closing dinners, while the agents move each request through approval, signing, and payment.

More than 60 enterprises already run their entertainment on Ande, reporting savings of 12 to 15 percent. Customers like Cloudflare, Salesforce, McGraw Hill, Netskope, Navan, Sigma Computing, Monday.com, Workato, Semgrep, Checkout, Rillet, and many more contribute to over $400 million in entertainment spend flowing through the platform annually.

"Entertainment is one of the most important things a company does. It builds culture, closes deals and deepens the relationships that matter most. Yet the infrastructure to manage it is broken on both sides of every transaction," said Lohit Sarma, CEO and co-founder of Ande.

"Ande is the first enterprise channel between corporate buyers and the world's best entertainment vendors. Part of the reason this is such a hard problem to solve is that venues and entertainment providers don't have a centralized distribution system to plug into. We had to build it. We've spent two and half years working with venues to digitize their data, and train models and agents for these workflows that are unique to enterprises," continued Sarma.

For venues on the other side of the transaction, Ande is the corporate sales and marketing channel that never existed. Venues have historically had no pipeline into the corporate market. Ande gives them a platform to market to, engage with, and transact with corporate buyers at scale. Among the current partners are 1,600 hospitality venues including some of the largest and most decorated hospitality groups like Altamarea Group, Che Fico, Gracious Hospitality, JKS, The Mina Group, MML, Nobu, Riviera Dining Group, Tao Group Hospitality, Unapologetic Foods, Bacchus Management Group, Wish You Were Here, and Wolfgang Puck. Over 93,000 entertainment venues are on Ande's network today.

"Our programs are high stakes and high visibility, with our executive leadership team and key customers at the core of each event we host," said Vicky Chung, Director of Corporate Events at Netskope. "My team and I trust Ande's platform, and especially the team behind it. I have real-time visibility into what's happening across every event, and when I need something done right, I know it will be. My team is now focused on reaching the executives that matter and scaling the program vs. worrying about the logistics."

"Entertainment is every enterprise's biggest expense line that is not yet well managed. For that reason, there are financial inefficiencies and a poor experience," notes Arif Janmohamed, Venture Partner at Lightspeed Venture Partners and Co-Founder of Duration Ventures. "Ande is the connective tissue, the perfect handshake between corporations and venues. Lohit is an exceptional founder, and the size of the market opportunity is largely unbounded."

Redpoint Ventures Managing Director Alex Bard notes, "Particularly when we invest in an early-stage company, our confidence has everything to do with the founder and their ambition. Lohit has both startup DNA and the enterprise experience to solve this problem. His vision for Ande is bold and ambitious."

About Ande

Ande is the AI-native network for corporate entertainment. Over 60 enterprises, including Cloudflare, Salesforce, and McGraw Hill already book, manage, and measure every experience through Ande, moving more than $400 million a year through a network of 93,000 entertainment providers across 90+ cities. For the vendors on the other side of the transaction, Ande is the dedicated corporate channel that's never existed. Learn more at ande.ai.

releases.title: Modern Family Law Launches Two Monthly Podcasts for Families and Legal Professionals
releases.body:
The Family Brief explores issues affecting families, while The War Room: Disrupted examines the future of the legal industry

DENVER, Sept. 22, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Modern Family Law has launched two original podcasts: The Family Brief, created for individuals and families, and The War Room: Disrupted, created for attorneys and legal industry leaders. Each podcast will release one new episode per month, for a total of two new Modern Family Law podcast episodes each month.

Both podcasts grow from Modern Family Law's mission to help people start over. Through compassion, clear information, and new ideas, the firm works to make family law matters less difficult for the people experiencing them. The podcasts extend that purpose by offering useful conversations for families and encouraging changes that can improve how legal services are delivered.

Listeners can explore both podcasts and browse the full episode library in Modern Family Law's Watch & Listen podcast library.

What Are Modern Family Law's New Podcasts?

The two podcasts serve different audiences while supporting the same larger purpose: helping people start over and improving the experience of working through a family law matter.

The Family Brief is a monthly podcast about the legal, financial, personal, and everyday issues that affect families. Attorneys, therapists, financial advisors, and other professionals discuss topics such as divorce, adoption, homeownership, relationships, and family finances. Each conversation is designed to give listeners helpful information as they prepare for changes in their lives.

"We have the opportunity to connect with people who bring thoughtful perspectives and compelling experiences, and I love making those conversations accessible to our listeners," said Tiffany Kahnen, Modern Family Law Partner and Chief of Staff and co-host of The Family Brief. "What makes hosting the podcast so rewarding is creating a space for meaningful conversation that feels like sitting down together on the sofa with a cup of coffee."

The War Room: Disrupted is a monthly podcast about the forces changing the legal industry. The series brings together attorneys, founders, innovators, and legal industry leaders to discuss artificial intelligence, emerging technology, changing client expectations, and new ways of delivering legal services. These conversations explore how the profession can reduce friction and better serve people during difficult times.

"The definition of a good lawyer has completely flipped," said M. David Johnson, CEO of Modern Family Law and host of The War Room: Disrupted. "Doing things the way they have always been done is no longer enough. We created The War Room: Disrupted to bring together people who are willing to question old assumptions, share new ideas, and talk honestly about where the legal industry is headed. As the pace of change accelerates, adaptability and curiosity matter more than ever, and we want this podcast to be a place where those conversations happen."

Why Did Modern Family Law Create the Podcasts?

Modern Family Law's mission is to help people start over. That purpose shapes the firm's legal services, online resources, technology, and now its podcasts. The goal is to make family law matters easier to understand and less difficult to experience while also encouraging the legal industry to find better ways to serve clients.

The Family Brief supports that mission by helping listeners understand the issues that may affect their families, finances, and daily lives. The War Room: Disrupted looks at how new ideas, technology, and changing expectations can create a better legal experience for the people who need it.

"What I like most about these podcasts is that they don't feel like lectures. They feel like conversations you would actually want to sit in on, and each one reflects a different part of who we are as a firm," said Dean Moussalli, Director of Marketing at Modern Family Law. "Everything we do begins with our mission to help people start over. The Family Brief brings compassion and clear answers to families facing change. The War Room: Disrupted explores how innovation can make the legal process work better for the people going through it. This isn't content for content's sake. It's our mission, made audible."

Where Can Listeners Find New Episodes?

Modern Family Law plans to release one new episode of The Family Brief and one new episode of The War Room: Disrupted each month.

  • The Family Brief: Listen on Apple Podcasts, listen on Spotify, or listen on YouTube.
  • The War Room: Disrupted: Listen on Apple Podcasts,  listen on Spotify, or listen on YouTube.

About Modern Family Law

Modern Family Law is a family law firm serving clients in Colorado, California, Texas, Washington, and Georgia. Founded in 2017, the firm helps people start over by assisting with divorce, child custody, child support, property division, spousal support, and other family law matters. Modern Family Law combines experienced local attorneys, compassion, clear communication, and innovative technology to make working through a family law matter less difficult. Learn more at modernfamilylaw.com.

releases.title: QubicaAMF and ROLLER Forge Long-Term Partnership to Shape the Future of the Bowling and Family Entertainment Industry
releases.body:
QubicaAMF and ROLLER announce their partnership and introduce Conqueror ROLLER, the all-in-one management solution for bowling and multi-attraction entertainment centers, which is already live with shared customers around the globe.

LONDON, Sept. 22, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- QubicaAMF, the world's largest bowling equipment and technology provider, and ROLLER, the leading venue management platform for modern attractions, today announced a long-term strategic partnership to shape the future of family entertainment. The partnership brings together two leaders in their respective industries around a shared vision for a unified guest experience with continued investment from both companies. Together, the two partners have developed Conqueror ROLLER, an all-in-one solution already live in bowling and entertainment centers across the globe, with continued innovation planned through their shared product roadmap.

Bowling is a $10 billion global industry, with more than 100 million people bowling each year across 125 countries. Traditional bowling centers are evolving into multi-attraction entertainment destinations, and operators are increasingly managing experiences that extend far beyond the lanes. Yet the technology powering those venues often remains fragmented, with separate systems for bowling operations, reservations, and other attractions.

"The bowling industry is in the middle of a major shift. Bowling remains at the heart of the venue, but operators are rapidly building broader entertainment experiences around it," said Emanuele Govoni, CEO of QubicaAMF. "The technology powering these venues must bring bowling and other attractions together. QubicaAMF and ROLLER have formed a long-term partnership, and with a shared vision, we will continue to build what operators need to shape the next generation of family entertainment."

At the center of the partnership is the Conqueror ROLLER solution, which unifies QubicaAMF's Conqueror X bowling and lane management technology with ROLLER's venue management platform. For operators, this solves a critical problem: combining bowling and multi-attraction management to unify the guest experience while making it easier for staff to delight guests. ROLLER can now power the full guest journey across a venue's entertainment offerings, including lane management through QubicaAMF's integrated technology.

"The best technology should make a complex venue feel simple to run and seamless for guests to experience," said Luke Finn, CEO of ROLLER. "Together with QubicaAMF, we've created a solution that unifies the guest journey from the moment guests book their first game to every time they come back. This is a long-term commitment to our industry, and we will continue building what operators need next."

A unified guest experience helps venues convert more bookings, increase revenue per guest, drive repeat visits, maximize lane utilization, and operate more efficiently by combining venue and attraction management with a complete on-lane entertainment ecosystem. Joint QubicaAMF and ROLLER customers are already seeing the impact:

  • Lumos in Texas increased its share of revenue generated online by 5.5x.
  • Queens in London increased multi-activity bookings by 64%.
  • NIKITO, headquartered in Paris, went live in less than three months and saw 100% of staff prefer the new system.

Tenpin, one of the United Kingdom's largest bowling operators, with 60 venues across the country, is bringing the joint QubicaAMF and ROLLER solution across its portfolio.

"Our vision is to create one seamless experience across all of our activities," said Roy Whitmore, IT Director at Tenpin. "Unifying all of our activities with bowling is critical to achieving that goal. The joint solution from QubicaAMF and ROLLER is a major step forward in making that vision a reality, and we're excited to bring it live across our portfolio of venues."

Today's announcement is the next step in a broader partnership, with QubicaAMF and ROLLER working from a shared product roadmap to sync more of the bowling and venue experience over time. Planned capabilities will bring more of the venue operation together, including waitlist management, in-game adjustments, and unified capacity management across all attractions.

releases.title: Global PR Firm Red Banyan's Campaign Supporting the Nova Music Festival Exhibition Named Finalist in Ragan's 2026 Zenith Awards
releases.body:
Strategic Communications Campaign Brought Nova Survivors' Testimony and Exhibition's Message of Remembrance to National Media, Policymakers and Community Groups

FORT LAUDERDALE, Fla., Sept. 22, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Global PR firm Red Banyan's strategic communications campaign supporting the Nova Music Festival Exhibition has been named a finalist in the Event/Experiential category of Ragan's 2026 Zenith Awards.

The Nova Music Festival Exhibition is a powerful memorial bearing witness to the massacre that took place at the gathering in Israel on October 7, 2023. It exhibits the grounds of a festival that was devoted to music, peace and love, and the harrowing results of the attack that unfolded that day and turned a celebration into tragedy.

Visitors follow a timeline of the festival from its final hours of music and dancing into the attack itself, moving through remains salvaged from the grounds: scorched cars, bullet-riddled bathroom stalls and the personal belongings left behind. Throughout, the voices of survivors, bereaved families and returned hostages tell the story of what they lived through, with many attending the exhibition in person as witnesses. The experience ends in the healing room, a sanctuary where visitors can reflect and find solace after what they have seen. Above them, the words "We will dance again" hang as a declaration of resilience and hope.

Red Banyan secured substantive coverage in national, local, Jewish and interfaith media throughout the exhibition's runs in Washington, D.C., and Chicago, with a communications campaign developed around the victims whose lives were taken or forever changed that day. The firm guided messaging efforts grounded in firsthand accounts and forensic evidence, spearheaded media relations, prepared survivors and exhibition leaders for interviews, and supported press and VIP events, leading to sustained public attention on the exhibition's mission and the testimony it was created to preserve.

In Washington, D.C., where October 7 is often discussed through the lens of geopolitics, Red Banyan's campaign extended into public affairs and community relations efforts, with the agency engaging political, civic and religious networks to amplify the exhibition's impact. This included working with the American Israel Public Affairs Committee (AIPAC) to invite members of Congress, collaborating with the Jewish Federation of Greater Washington and coordinating efforts with various community groups. The firm also facilitated a program with the United States Holocaust Memorial Museum that brought Holocaust survivor Nat Shaffir and Nova Music Festival survivor Noa Beer together to share their testimony across generations.

"The Nova Exhibition asks people to look directly at what happened on October 7 and remember the human beings behind every headline," said Evan Nierman, Founder & CEO of Red Banyan. "Our team was trusted to carry those stories into the national conversation with accuracy, dignity and care. Ragan's recognition is deeply meaningful because it honors work rooted in truth, remembrance and the voices of survivors."

Winners of Ragan's 2026 Zenith Awards will be announced during a ceremony on November 5, held in New York City.

Recognized for Excellence in Reputation Management and Crisis Communications

Ragan's recognition adds to a series of honors for Red Banyan's work across proactive public relations campaigns, crisis communications and reputation management. In 2026, the firm earned a ranking in the Chambers Crisis & Risk Management Guide and was ranked the No. 1 boutique crisis communications firm in the U.S. by O'Dwyer's. CEO Evan Nierman also earned gold in the Best Crisis Communications Leader category at the World Communications Forum Association's Davos Communications Awards. Most recently, Guide to Florida named Red Banyan a "2026 Best of Florida" regional winner in the Business Consulting Firms category.

About Red Banyan:

Red Banyan is an award-winning strategic communications firm specializing in high-stakes reputation management. The firm advises business leaders, organizations, institutions and high-profile individuals operating in scrutinized or regulated environments where perception, trust and brand equity directly influence outcomes. Drawing on deep expertise across strategic communications and brand building, crisis communications, legal and litigation PR, government relations, media training, and online reputation management, Red Banyan delivers disciplined, strategy-led communications designed to support business growth and navigate moments that test it. Learn more at https://redbanyan.com.
