releases.title: Futuri Introduces "Automate, Augment, Hold" Framework to Help Sales Leaders Avoid an AI Trust Deficit
releases.body:
Drawing on a year of conversations with roughly 40 enterprise sales leaders, Futuri CEO Daniel Anstandig warns that automating human moments produces a bill that comes due 18 months later.

AUSTIN, Texas, Aug. 28, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Boards, investors, and AI vendors are pressing revenue organizations toward end-to-end automation, and the cost logic is hard to argue with: if a machine can do the task faster and cheaper, why not let it? Futuri's view is that the logic breaks on a distinction most automation roadmaps never make: the difference between a task and a moment. Drawing on a year of conversations with roughly 40 enterprise sales leaders working through the same question, Futuri CEO and co-founder Daniel Anstandig lays out a framework for sorting the two in "Where AI Ends and the Seller Begins."

The framework divides every step of the revenue process into three categories. Automate covers work where only the output matters and human presence adds no customer value: research, first-draft emails, CRM updates, competitive briefs, meeting summaries. Augment covers work where AI does the heavy lifting and a person makes the call. AI drafts the proposal, scores the account, and surfaces the signal; the seller refines, prioritizes, and decides on timing. Hold covers the moments where automation degrades the relationship: discovery calls, negotiations, first meetings with a new champion, recovery conversations, and the hard conversation that delivers unwelcome news. "There's a difference between automating a task and automating a moment," Anstandig writes. "The presence is the whole point. Replace the human and you haven't streamlined the moment; you've eliminated it and put something else in its place that happens to share the same calendar slot."

The cost of sorting wrong is what he calls the trust deficit, a decline that never surfaces in a dashboard, because the activity that replaced the moment still registers as activity. Customers rarely complain; they quietly disengage, and win rates soften for reasons no report explains. "This is the trust deficit, and it's the bill that comes due eighteen months after the automation mandate went out," Anstandig writes. His conclusion is that the sorting, not the software, is now the variable: "Most leaders are willing to automate. What they skip is the sorting." Two companies can run identical stacks, he argues, and "their outcomes will diverge dramatically."

The full framework, including a step-by-step exercise for auditing a live sales process, is available on Anstandig on the Future. For media companies, marketers, and AI leaders, Automate–Augment–Hold is a portable method for any customer-facing workflow, not only sales. Futuri builds on the same principle in TopLine Enterprise, which surrounds sellers with research, prioritization, and preparation while leaving discovery, negotiation, and relationship judgment with the human.

About Daniel Anstandig: Daniel Anstandig is CEO and co-founder of Futuri, where he has spent more than 16 years building AI-powered technology that helps companies transform how they sell, create content, and make decisions. He is also the founder of SparkTrade.io and holds more than 25 patents spanning AI, automation, audio, public safety, and broadcast technology.

About Futuri: Futuri is a global leader in AI technology for sales enablement, data enablement, and content automation. Founded in 2009 and headquartered in Austin, Texas, Futuri is trusted by 7,000+ companies across 22 countries. Key solutions include TopLine sales intelligence, TopicPulse real-time content trends, Content Automation, AudioAI, SpotOn, and POST. Learn more at Futurimedia.com and Futuri.ai.

NEW YORK, Aug. 28, 2026 /CNW/ -- Omnicom Media, an Omnicom (NYSE: OMC) Connected Capability, today officially launched Hearts United, a new global media agency created through the combination of its Hearts & Science and Mediahub networks.

Bringing together two high-growth challenger organizations with complementary capabilities, cultures and geographic strengths, Hearts United is built to help ambitious brands navigate a media environment where influence moves continuously across platforms, creators, communities, commerce, and AI.

"Hearts & Science helped pioneer data-driven decision-making, while Mediahub broke new ground by proving media could serve as a creative platform," says Omnicom Media CEO Florian Adamski. "In bringing them together as Hearts United, we have created a new globally scaled network built from complementary strengths, approaches and footprints, and grounded in the shared principle of putting client growth at the heart of every decision."

The new agency - which operates across 40 markets and represents approximately $9.1 billion in 2025 billings - launched following sustained growth at both organizations. Between 2021 and 2025, Hearts & Science increased its billings by 50%, while Mediahub grew 33% - momentum that has continued into 2026. As result, the new agency debuts with one of the best new business performances in the industry as tracked by the COMvergence real-time dashboards, currently ranking #1 in the US YTD in total new business (wins minus losses, including retentions), and #3 globally and in EMEA, outperforming agencies that are up to three times its size.

Four principles define the new agency's approach:

  • Outcomes-oriented: An evolving commercial model connects the agency's success with client growth, putting accountability into the operating model.
  • Predictive by design: AI is embedded into workflows and the operating model to expand capacity, strengthen human judgment and give talent more time to solve higher-value problems.
  • Ecosystem mastery: Teams plan holistically across the platforms, communities, creators, and commerce environments where attention and influence move, rather than treating channels as isolated decisions.
  • Focused and senior-led: Expert teams work as extensions of clients' organizations, reducing silos and handoffs while bringing senior guidance and diverse expertise to the work.

Like its sibling Omnicom Media agencies OMD, Initiative, PHD and UM, Hearts United will leverage the singular advantages and assets of the world's largest global media network in scale, data & technology, identity, commerce capabilities, and talent to deliver disproportionate growth for its clients.

Hearts United will be led in the U.S. by Nicole Estebanell, who previously served as CEO of Mediahub U.S., and in EMEA by Ross Jenkins, who led Mediahub across that region. Both leaders bring experience scaling high-growth businesses while maintaining the entrepreneurial cultures and client relationships that drove their success. Their counterparts in APAC and LATAM are expected to be announced in Q4.

Hearts United joins the Omnicom Media agency portfolio as the group has the best 2026 YTD total new business performance among all global media groups for 2026 – including earning more new client billings ($4.1b) than any other group - resulting from a streak of wins including Adidas, Delta, Dyson, IBM, Mark Anthony Brands, Novo Nordisk, On, and Subway.

For more information visit www.heartsunited.com.

About Hearts United

Operating across 40 markets, Omnicom Media agency Hearts United combines media, data, technology, creativity, and commerce to help brands create momentum in a world where people move continuously across platforms, creators, communities, and AI. Built around the belief that growth requires motion, Hearts United was designed to find what others overlook, turn insight into action, and make brands more attention-worthy, crave-worthy, and shop-worthy in an AI-mediated world.

As part of Omnicom Media, the world's largest global media network, Hearts United gives clients the speed, agility and entrepreneurial culture of a challenger agency, combined with Omnicom Media's unparalleled advantages in scale, data, identity, commerce capabilities, and talent. The result is a connected growth system designed to deliver disproportionate impact for ambitious brands, regardless of their size or category.

At FINN, she now leads integrated media strategy across the agency's full roster of global clients, serving five core sector specialties: health, travel, education, technology and B2B, and financial services.

As Head of Integrated Media at FINN, Sizemore is responsible for defining the strategic vision for the integrated media practice; delivering connected solutions for clients across strategy, creative, content, web, PR, SEO/GEO and SEM; driving campaign innovation through data, technology, and emerging platforms, including AI; optimizing team operations; and driving growth for the agency and its clients.

I believe in the power and clarity that seamless integration between creative and media brings," said Kim Sizemore, Head of Integrated Media at FINN Partners. A Shift in Top Industry Talent

releases.title: UP Argues the Social Media Industry Is Moving From Optional Safeguards Toward Safety by Design
releases.body:
WICHITA, Kan., Aug. 27, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Meta's agreement to pay up to $18 billion in aggregate settlements and make significant changes to Facebook and Instagram marks more than a legal turning point. According to UP, Inc., it marks the arrival of a new market category: Safe Social.

The settlement requires Meta to limit users under 18 to two hours per day across Facebook and Instagram, restrict overnight access, reduce notifications during school hours, strengthen age assurance and parental controls, limit visible "likes" and certain filters, and offer young users a non-algorithmic feed option. Several protections can become stricter if other major platforms adopt comparable terms.

The agreement came during Instagram President Adam Mosseri's testimony and before Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg was expected to testify. Meta denied wrongdoing.

"This settlement validates what families have said for years: social media should not be designed to keep people scrolling at any cost," said Nick Rotola, founder and CEO of UP, Inc. "UP began with a more fundamental question: what if safety was not a setting, but the structure of the product?"

Meta has called on TikTok and YouTube to adopt the same framework. UP believes that pressure confirms that safer defaults are becoming an industry expectation, not a discretionary feature.

But UP argues that guardrails added to an engagement-centered platform are not the same as building a platform around safety from the beginning.

UP screens creators and brands before they can publish. Its standards exclude explicit, violent, hateful, substance-promoting, predatory, and manipulative material. UP does not allow unsolicited direct messages or open comments. Its Scroll Happy® system ranks video around how it may leave a viewer feeling, while mood-based feeds provide greater control.

"Meta is being required to add guardrails around an open, engagement-driven network," Rotola said. "UP vets who can publish, curates what enters the feed, removes unsolicited direct messages, and ranks content for how it leaves a person feeling. That is the difference between safety controls and safety by design."

The risk extends beyond screen time. A 2025 Thorn study found that one in five teens surveyed had experienced sextortion. TIME has also reported allegations concerning Meta's former enforcement thresholds and recommendations connecting potentially inappropriate adults with teens. Meta disputed those allegations.

"The press is calling this social media's tobacco moment. I see it as a millstone moment: a reckoning with what happens when products built to capture attention are allowed to shape children before they are ready to defend themselves," Rotola said. "The settlement matters. But a safer version of the same incentive system is not enough. Families deserve a real alternative."

UP calls that alternative Social with Standards.

UP is available as a free download for iPhone and Android. To learn more, visit www.ScrollHappy.com or download UP through the Apple App Store and Google Play.

About UP, Inc.

UP, Inc. is the company behind UP - Scroll Happy®, a social video platform built around vetted creators, curated content, safer interaction, and user well-being. UP gives people an alternative to doomscrolling through Social with Standards.

releases.title: FlyersRights Responds to DOT Proposed Roll Back of the Full Fare Advertising Rule
releases.body:
Requests DOT Provide Actual Evidence Justifying the Change

WASHINGTON, Aug. 27, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- FlyersRights submitted comments to the U.S. Department of Transportation (DOT) in response to its Notice of Proposed Rulemaking titled "Enhancing Flexibility of Air Fare Price Advertising." The proposed rule seeks to either weaken or potentially repeal the 1984 Full Fare Advertising Rule and its 2011 amendments.

The Full Fare Rule, enacted during the Reagan Administration, requires airline advertisements to include the entire price to be paid by a passenger to the airline for a ticket, including taxes and fees. The 1984 rule and the 2011 update were issued in response to complaints of deceptive practices in airfare advertising.

In its public comments, FlyersRights opposed the proposed rulemaking, arguing that the evidence and arguments that the DOT put forward support the status quo or enhanced transparency of all other fees, including optional ancillary fees.

"The same DOT that recently killed the rule to increase transparency in ancillary fees now argues that passengers need transparency into the existence and amount of federal taxes and fees in air travel," explained Paul Hudson, President of FlyersRights. "Airlines already display these taxes and fees prominently, yet with the exception of Southwest Airlines, want to now be able to list them as prominently as, or even more prominently than, the total price."

"This proposed rule is a license for airlines to confuse, deceive, and make it more difficult for passengers to price shop," said Paul Hudson, President of FlyersRights. "Passengers need transparency in the prices on which airlines actually compete–airfare and ancillary fees–not on the mandatory taxes and federal fees that airlines do not control. The DOT, in arguing that airlines need the flexibility to display taxes and fees as prominently as the total price, would be harming passengers, competition, and the airlines that do not wish to deceive their passengers."

FlyersRights has been a long-time advocate for policies that prioritize competition, transparency, and consumer protections within the airline industry.

For more information on FlyersRights' comments and to read the full submission, visit https://www.regulations.gov/comment/DOT-OST-2025-0831-1357.

FlyersRights.org, established in 2007, is the largest airline passenger organization. It publishes a Know Your Rights guide and operates a free hotline for airline passengers at 877- FLYERS-6. releases.title: Berea College Launches "Financial Freedom Pledge," Creating a Fully Funded Degree
releases.body:
The College will cover 100% of tuition, housing, food, and fees without loans for all students

BEREA, Ky., Aug. 27, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Berea College is revolutionizing the economics of higher education through its Financial Freedom Pledge, a bold commitment that will provide every enrolled student with a fully funded degree beginning in Fall 2027. The comprehensive initiative covers 100% of tuition, housing, food, and fees without loans, allowing students to pursue their education without financial barriers.

"Every student arrives at Berea with gifts: talent, curiosity, determination, creativity, a desire to serve, and dreams for the future," said President Cheryl L. Nixon. "Our commitment is simple: when students bring us their gifts, Berea invests in their potential. The real value isn't measured in what students save. It's measured in the freedom they'll have to dream, explore, and become."

Under the initiative, Berea College will become the first college in the country to exclusively admit students with unlimited potential and limited resources while providing every student with a fully funded, comprehensive, no-loan degree. Rooted in access, affordability, and opportunity, the Financial Freedom Pledge builds upon Berea's longstanding mission by ensuring talent—not income—determines opportunity.

"At a time when many are questioning the value of higher education, we are reimagining our public good by investing even more resources and supports to ensure Berea students enroll, persist, graduate, and thrive," noted President Nixon. "I want to thank the College's visionary board for supporting an initiative that focuses on our mission and our students' success."

The announcement represents the next chapter in Berea's legacy of bold ideas. In 1892, Berea College stopped charging tuition, ensuring students would not be held back from their educational dreams because of cost. As the nation's oldest continuously tuition-free college, Berea is now expanding that commitment to fund tuition, housing, food, and fees for every student.

President Nixon shared, "At Berea, higher education is not about economics—it is about experiences. It is not about term bills—it is about transformation. It is not about costs—it is about community. It is about our enduring commitment to every student and the future they imagine for themselves."

The Financial Freedom Pledge is built on four core ideas:

  • 100% Fully Funded Degree — Berea funds tuition, housing, food, and fees.
  • 100% Full Scholarship Package — Berea funding, federal and state grants, and other scholarships combine to cover the cost of attendance without loans.
  • 100% of Students Through Graduation — If we admit you, we fully fund you for all four years.
  • 100% Financial Freedom — The greatest value isn't what students save; it's what they're free to become.

In addition to covering direct educational costs, Berea supports students with books and supplies, its nationally recognized Work College Program, a free laptop, funded internships, study-away opportunities, professional clothing support, conference funding, and wellness resources—creating a comprehensive investment in every student's success.

The Financial Freedom Pledge currently represents an estimated value of more than $285,000 over four years. Unlike traditional financial aid models that often leave students navigating loans and financial uncertainty, Berea's approach provides clarity, confidence, and opportunity from day one.

"At Berea, we don't just award financial aid—we offer financial freedom," said Luke Hodson, Senior Associate Vice President of Admissions and Financial Aid. "Students are free to choose a major because they love it, free to focus on learning instead of debt, free to pursue internships, research, leadership, service, and graduate study, and free to dream boldly about their future."

"You don't have to pay us," stated President Nixon. "You just have to pay it forward."

Free to Dream. Driven to Do.

About Berea College

Founded in 1855, Berea College was the first interracial and coeducational college in the South. Berea exclusively admits students from limited economic resources and provides every enrolled student with an exceptional liberal arts education, a distinctive Work College experience, and the opportunity to graduate prepared for lives of purpose, leadership, and service.

Recognized. Respected. Remarkable. Current Rankings and National Recognitions

  • Social Mobility and Public Service: #1 Best College for Tuition and Tax Dollars, based on social mobility and public service (Washington Monthly, 2025)
  • Affordability: #1 Best Value College and #1 Least Educational Debt College (U.S. News & World Report, 2026)
  • Access: #1 on College Access Index (New York Times, 2023)
  • Career Preparation: Recognized by Forbes Magazine as one of "15 Top Colleges for Launching Your Career" (2025)
  • Transformative Teaching: Nationally recognized excellence in student-centered teaching, #1 in Service Learning, #3 in Most Innovative Schools, #7 in Internships, and #8 in First-Year Experiences (U.S. News & World Report, 2026).
  • Overall Excellence: One of only 40 five-star colleges in the country—and the only five-star college in Kentucky—based on graduation rates, cost of attendance, and alumni salaries. (Money Magazine, 2025).

releases.body:
WEST ROXBURY, Mass., Aug. 27, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Prominently featured in The Inner Circle, Mary Jo Iozzio, PHD, STL, is acknowledged as a Pinnacle Professional of The Year for her contributions to Moral Theology and Higher Education.

Mary Jo Iozzio has established a distinguished career in theology and higher education, contributing extensively to the fields of moral theology/Christian ethics, biblical studies, and disability theology. Through her work in teaching, research, and academic scholarship, she provides thought leadership and educational guidance within theological and academic communities across the nation.

Dr. Iozzio is widely recognized for her expertise in moral theology and ethics, helping students and scholars engage with complex ethical questions through a faith informed and academically rigorous approach. Her work emphasizes the importance of ethical reflection, theological understanding, and the application of moral principles to contemporary societal issues.

Her academic journey reflects a deep commitment to theological scholarship. Dr. Iozzio earned a Doctor of Philosophy in Moral Theology from Fordham University in 1994, following a Master's degree in Moral Theology from Fordham University in 1982 and a Master's degree in Biblical Studies from Providence College in 1983. She earned the License in Theology from Boston College in 2019. She began her academic career with a Bachelor's degree in History from Penn State University in 1977.

Dr. Iozzio remains actively engaged in several leading professional organizations, including the American Academy of Religion, the Catholic Theological Society of America, and the Society of Christian Ethics. Through these affiliations, she continues to contribute to scholarly dialogue and the advancement of theological research.

Her work has been recognized with numerous honors, including the Distinguished Worldwide Humanitarian Award in 2026, the Eagle Publication Essay Award in 2025, and recognition among the Top 500 Most Influential Professionals in 2025. She also participated in the Boston College delegation to the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change at COP26 in 2021, reflecting her engagement with global ethical and environmental issues.

Looking ahead, Dr. Iozzio plans to continue her work as a professor while expanding into consulting within theology, ethics, and academic advisory services. Guided by a philosophy rooted in advancing ethical understanding and meaningful scholarship, she remains committed to contributing to both academic communities and broader societal conversations through education and research.

releases.title: Dr. Monica Parrish Trent Named Executive Director of the National Restaurant Association Educational Foundation
releases.body:
WASHINGTON, Aug. 27, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- The National Restaurant Association Educational Foundation today announced Monica Parrish Trent, PhD as the organization's next Executive Director. Dr. Trent will advance the Foundation's strong legacy while advancing its mission to empower people from all backgrounds with the training and education needed to succeed in the restaurant, foodservice, and hospitality industry.

Dr. Trent has more than 25 years of experience across higher education, workforce development, and national nonprofit leadership, focused on building pathways that connect education and training to meaningful careers and economic opportunity. Her professional journey includes faculty and leadership roles at diverse, multi-campus community colleges before moving into executive leadership in the national nonprofit sector. Throughout her career, she has led complex initiatives through distributed partner networks and built collaborations among educators, employers, funders, and community partners to translate strategy into programs that can be implemented and scaled.

Most recently, she served as Chief Program and Network Officer at Achieving the Dream (ATD), where she led national program and workforce strategy across a network of more than 300 community colleges.

"Monica is an exceptional leader who cares deeply about the power and opportunity in getting people into the right job," said Michelle Korsmo, CEO of the National Restaurant Association Educational Foundation. "Her ability to tell a powerful story around an organization's mission and developing partnerships and programs to bring it to life will benefit the Foundation as it provides experienced career exploration and workforce readiness in the restaurant industry to young people seeking these workplace entry roles." 

"The restaurant and hospitality industry creates opportunities for millions of people, and its workforce growth depends on ensuring they have clear pathways to develop the skills, credentials, and experience employers need," said Dr. Trent. "I have spent my career bringing educators, employers, and communities together to strengthen career pathways and help people move from learning to meaningful careers. I'm excited to bring that experience to the Foundation and help more people turn the skills they gain and credentials they earn into greater possibilities for advancement. Having worked in restaurants while I was a student, I saw firsthand how the industry opens doors for people from a wide spectrum of life experiences and how a job can grow into a lifelong career that supports a family and strengthens a community."

The National Restaurant Association Educational Foundation invests in individuals throughout their career journeys, equipping them to grab ahold of industry opportunities to create a better future for themselves, while building communities that foster their growth and development. With a people-first focus, the Foundation empowers the restaurant and foodservice industry to maximize its potential as America's second-largest private employer. Learn more here.

About the National Restaurant Association Educational Foundation (NRAEF): As the supporting philanthropic foundation of the National Restaurant Association, the NRAEF's charitable mission includes enhancing the industry's training and education, career development, and community engagement efforts. The NRAEF and its programs work to Attract, Empower, and Advance today's and tomorrow's restaurant and foodservice workforce. NRAEF programs include: ProStart® – a high-school career and technical education program; Restaurant Ready/HOPES – Partnering with community based organizations to provide people with skills training and job opportunities; Military – helping military servicemen and women transition their skills to restaurant and foodservice careers; Scholarships – financial assistance for students pursuing restaurant, foodservice and hospitality degrees; and the Restaurant & Hospitality Leadership Center (RHLC) – accredited apprenticeship programs designed to build the careers of service professionals. For more information on the NRAEF, visit ChooseRestaurants.org.

releases.title: Jon Batiste to Narrate American Amazon, Bringing His Signature Voice to Epic Giant Screen Documentary Featuring the South's Wildest Secrets
releases.body:
New film from Grizzly Creek Films, PBS and distributed by MacGillivray Freeman Films, opens in select IMAX and giant screen theaters starting November 13

LAGUNA BEACH, Calif., Aug. 27, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- MacGillivray Freeman Films, the world's leading independent producer and distributor of giant screen films, announced today that acclaimed musician, composer, and storyteller Jon Batiste will narrate and serve as Executive Producer on American Amazon, the sweeping new documentary from Grizzly Creek Films and The WNET Group's award-winning Nature series for PBS. The feature film is slated to premiere in select IMAX® and giant screen theaters and museums beginning November 13, 2026, and the two-part Nature mini-series will release on PBS in early 2027.

Batiste's distinctive voice and deeply expressive artistry will guide audiences through one of North America's least explored and biologically rich regions—the vast network of wetlands spanning Alabama, Florida, Georgia, Louisiana, and the Carolinas. A Louisiana native, Batiste brings a powerful emotional resonance to this immersive journey, elevating the film's celebration of nature, culture, and human connection to the ecosystem.

Four years in the making, American Amazon reveals an ancient and mysterious landscape defined by towering two-thousand-year-old cypress trees, labyrinthine flooded forests, a network of wild rivers, and an astonishing array of wildlife. From the mass migration of swallow-tailed kites—the world's only social raptor—to the elusive behaviors of American black bears in the swamp, the film uncovers a world teeming with life, discovery, and enduring surprises.

"Jon Batiste brings the American Amazon to life; his creativity, passion, and energy invite us to fall in love with this wild and mysterious place that is truly the world's best kept secret," said the film's director, writer, and co-producer Eric Bendick of Grizzly Creek Films. "His voice is a perfect match for all the drama and soul-stirring beauty of this landscape, allowing audiences to connect with the untamed spirit of the wild South."

Drawing on the filmmakers' extensive exploration in the region, American Amazon presents a remarkable collection of natural history stories—many never before captured on film. Together with Batiste's narration, the film offers an experience that is both epic in scale and deeply personal.

"Jon's ability to move between joy, wonder, and reflection makes him an ideal narrator for this story," said co-producer Thomas Winston of Grizzly Creek Films. "He brings a unique perspective that amplifies the film's message of appreciation and stewardship. American Amazon marks an exciting new chapter in our ongoing collaboration with Jon—and there's more to come."

"American Amazon shines a light on one of the most ecologically important and least understood regions in North America," said Fred Kaufman, Executive Producer of Nature. "Jon brings a rare authenticity to this story. His voice captures not only the wonder of the natural world, but also the deep cultural connection between the people, places, and wildlife that make the American South so extraordinary."

"I love introducing people to the swamp. Growing up in Louisiana, I've always felt a deep connection to the landscapes, culture, and spirit of my home," said Jon Batiste. "I think the South is sacred soil. American Amazon reveals the wild side that many people have never seen. It's a world of extraordinary beauty, mystery, and life – hiding right in our own backyard. We're celebrating the power of nature, creativity, and human connection – and this is just the beginning!"

Jon Batiste is an eight-time Grammy, Academy, and Emmy Award–winning singer, songwriter, composer, and pianist known for his genre-defying music. His 2025 album, Big Money, won the Grammy Award for Best Americana Album. In film, Batiste will next compose the score for Amazon MGM's The Thomas Crown Affair, directed by Michael B. Jordan. From 2015 to 2022, he served as bandleader and musical director of The Late Show with Stephen Colbert.

"Having worked with Jon previously on our giant screen film America's Musical Journey, I've seen firsthand the incredible artistry and range he brings to every project," said Shaun MacGillivray, President of MacGillivray Freeman Films. "He is an extraordinary talent, and his ability to connect with audiences through music and storytelling makes him the perfect voice for American Amazon."

More than a visual spectacle, American Amazon is a celebration of a fragile and irreplaceable ecosystem—and a call to action to protect this landscape – before it's too late. By sharing the region's untold stories and extraordinary biodiversity, the film aims to inspire audiences to reconnect with nature and recognize the importance of preserving these vital landscapes for future generations.

With MacGillivray Freeman Films leading distribution, American Amazon will roll out to leading science centers, museums, and giant screen theaters beginning November 2026.

About Grizzly Creek Films

Grizzly Creek Films specializes in filmmaking that marries compelling storytelling, dynamic characters, and unparalleled imagery. From their home base in Montana to locations around the world, the company produces films defined by authentic emotion, heart-pounding action, and breathtaking natural wonders.

About Nature

Since 1982, Nature has pioneered a television genre that is now widely emulated in the broadcast industry, bringing the natural world to millions of viewers. The series has won more than 800 honors from the television industry, the international wildlife film communities and environmental organizations, including 21 Emmys and three Peabodys. Nature is available for streaming concurrent with broadcast on all station-branded PBS platforms, including PBS.org and the PBS App, available on iOS, Android, Roku streaming devices, Apple TV, Android TV, Amazon Fire TV, Samsung Smart TV, Chromecast and VIZIO. Classic episodes are available on various FAST channel platforms and on PBS Passport. Nature is a production of The WNET Group.

About MacGillivray Freeman Films

MacGillivray Freeman Films is the world's foremost independent producer and distributor of original giant screen films for IMAX® and other large-format theaters. For more than 50 years, the company has been creating immersive, visually stunning films designed to educate, entertain, and inspire audiences around the globe. Its films have won numerous international awards including two Academy Award® nominations and three films inducted into the IMAX Hall of Fame, including Everest, the highest grossing giant screen documentary film of all time. MacGillivray Freeman's films are known for their artistry and celebration of science and the natural world. It is the first documentary film company to reach the one-billion-dollar benchmark for worldwide box office.

releases.title: Simon® Launches Simon Media Network™, Turning Real-World Consumer Behavior Into Measurable Business Impact
releases.body:
Simon Media Network combines Simon's premier destinations, first-party consumer intelligence and integrated marketing capabilities to connect brands with high-intent consumers.

INDIANAPOLIS, Aug. 27, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Simon®, a real estate investment trust engaged in the ownership of premier shopping, dining, entertainment and mixed-use destinations, today announced the launch of Simon Media Network™, a next-generation commerce media platform that helps brands reach high-intent consumers across Simon's portfolio of more than 200 destinations.

Simon Media Network extends the company's ability to connect brands with consumers where they already gather, discover, and spend time. With billions of visits worldwide and over $100 billion in commerce generated across Simon's portfolio of premier retail destinations, Simon Media Network creates one of the richest real-world signals of consumer behavior.

As consumer attention becomes increasingly fragmented across channels and marketers demand greater accountability, Simon Media Network offers a differentiated approach to commerce media. Unlike traditional retail media networks that are built around purchases from a single retailer, Simon Media Network provides advertisers with a broader view of consumer behavior across an ecosystem of shopping, dining, entertainment, and lifestyle experiences. This enables brands to understand not only what consumers buy, but where they spend time, what captures their attention, and how those behaviors translate into measurable business outcomes.

"Today's marketers need more than impressions. They need partners who can prove a campaign actually moved someone to visit, engage and buy," said Jared Blechman, Chief Revenue Officer at Simon. "Simon is where consumers discover brands in the real world. Simon Media Network builds on that foundation, transforming those interactions into intelligence that helps brands better understand, reach and engage consumers." 

Through Simon Media Network, advertisers can activate campaigns across Simon's integrated marketing ecosystem, including high-impact digital displays throughout Simon destinations, experiential activations, ShopSimon.com®, the Simon+® loyalty program, and Simon-owned social and digital channels, as well as off-platform media environments. Campaigns can be executed nationally, regionally, by market, or at individual properties, giving brands flexibility to align campaigns with specific business objectives while maintaining consistent measurement across channels.

Powered by Simon's first-party consumer intelligence, Simon Media Network provides advertisers with transparent, verified insights into campaign performance including visitation, transactions, and consumer engagement. By combining audience insights, activation, and closed-loop attribution, Simon enables brands to build more meaningful consumer connections and demonstrate an incremental return on advertising spend.

"What makes Simon Media Network attractive is our ability to bring together brands, consumers and experiences in places where real life happens. Every day, millions of people come to Simon destinations to shop, discover something new, spend time with family and friends, and create lasting memories," said Lee Sterling, Chief Marketing Officer at Simon. "Simon Media Network gives marketers an opportunity to reach those audiences, be part of those moments and understand the impact those connections create."

For more information about Simon Media Network, visit business.simon.com/media.

About Simon 

Simon® is a real estate investment trust engaged in the ownership of premier shopping, dining, entertainment and mixed-use destinations and an S&P 100 company (Simon Property Group, NYSE: SPG). Our properties across North America, Europe and Asia provide community gathering places for millions of people every day and generate billions in annual sales.

releases.body:
SUWANEE, Ga., Aug. 27, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- YFORE officially inaugurated its new 62,225 sq. ft. American Headquarters in Suwanee, Georgia. Integrating R&D, manufacturing, procurement, sales, and delivery, the facility brings agile engineering and resilient local supply chains directly to local automotive partners.

Rooted Locally, Empowering Global Mobility

Local officials, global OEM partners, and supply chain leaders joined the executive leadership and team of YFORE Technology to celebrate this strategic milestone.

"Becoming the most trusted partner for intelligent vehicle clients is YFORE's core mission, and establishing our facilities in Georgia brings that commitment to life," said Leo Liu, CEO of YFORE. "Driven by rising OEM demand for localized, resilient supply chains, this investment embodies our 'Global Footprint, Local Excellence' strategy. By pairing global scale with dedicated on-site teams, we deliver true door-to-door responsiveness—ensuring agile co-development and flawless delivery right at our customers' doorsteps."

Alex Warner, President of the Forsyth County Chamber, welcomed the investment, emphasizing its impact on high-skilled jobs and regional growth: "Today is not just an opening—it's YFORE becoming part of the Forsyth County family."

First US-Made Digital Key Rollout & Tech Showcase

Marking the capabilities of mass production, YFORE rolled out its first US-built Digital Key unit and showcased its core product portfolios:

  • Intelligent Mirror: Leveraging its pioneer standing in digital vision and proven mass production on 60+ vehicle models globally, YFORE showcased its comprehensive lineup spanning Interior Digital Mirrors, Auto-Dimming Mirrors, and Exterior Side Mirrors. Most notably, the global debut of the Multifunctional Digital Mirror takes center stage by seamlessly integrating DMS/OMS sensing and intelligent interactions, drastically streamlining cabin wiring and overhead space into a centralized hub for full-domain perception.
  • Intelligent Access: With mass production across 50+ global models, YFORE provides a complete "Car-Cloud-Phone/Watch" digital key solution supporting BLE, UWB, and NFC protocols across intelligent devices, NFC, and KeyFobs. Complemented by door handle sensors and a pioneering anti-pinch system, YFORE offers automakers a seamless, end-to-end smart vehicle entry ecosystem.
  • Intelligent Sensing: Unveiled for the first time globally, YFORE's ODMS In-Cabin Full-Coverage Sensing System fuses smart mirror optics with radar sensing, eliminating blind spots to ensure full-cabin precision monitoring and top-tier E-NCAP compliance. Supported by advanced UWB multi-function convergence, the architecture unlocks kick sensors, low-power sentry mode, and in-cabin life detection with zero extra hardware, delivering a comprehensive, multi-scenario sensing ecosystem.

Afterward, guests toured the advanced SMT and automated digital key production lines and engaged in hands-on product experiences, praising the seamless responsiveness and in-cabin performance.

releases.body:
New solutions help brands build awareness, reach distinctive DIY audiences and connect media investment to measurable business outcomes

OAK BROOK, Ill., Aug. 27, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- RedVest Media, Ace Hardware's retail media network, today announced a slate of measurement enhancements, audience solutions, social and influencer capabilities, and commerce-media innovations at its inaugural 2027 Upfront. Together, the advancements are designed to help brands build stronger connections with Ace customers across the full journey, from inspiration and discovery through purchase and long-term growth.

The announcements advance RedVest Media's evolution as The Helpful Network, pairing Ace's distinctive customer relationships, locally rooted store model and home-improvement expertise with media solutions that are more measurable, more actionable and more relevant to the moments that matter. The inaugural event was supported by DoorDash, Pacvue, Epsilon and In-Store Marketplace, whose partnerships help power the continued evolution of RedVest Media's commerce, measurement, audience and activation capabilities.

"We are expanding RedVest Media thoughtfully in the areas advertisers value most and in ways that lean into the uniqueness of Ace. Our focus is providing even more robust measurement, richer audience intelligence and more ways to activate across the customer journey," said Molly Hjelm, Corporate Vice President and Head of RedVest Media at Ace Hardware. "We're particularly thrilled to announce significant partnerships in Social and Influencer, which will help our vendors engage the Ace customer via trusted, authentic perspectives. Our newly announced DoorDash partnership will help advertisers drive discovery and engage new customers through the DoorDash platform."

More robust measurement and actionable insights

RedVest Media is expanding its measurement suite to give advertisers a clearer view of both immediate campaign performance and broader business impact. Enhancements include incrementality measurement for offsite media, new-to-brand reporting and new ways to share insights and analysis. The expanded approach is designed to help brands better understand the business impact of their media investment, identify what's driving growth and uncover opportunities to optimize future campaigns.

Social and Influencer capabilities officially launch

RedVest Media is officially launching social amplification and influencer marketing capabilities. Social amplification enables brands to extend existing social creative into additional media environments while adding RedVest Media audience capabilities and closed-loop measurement. Through Influential, brands will also be able to work with trusted, Ace-vetted creators to bring products and project ideas to life, reaching customers earlier in moments of inspiration and consideration.

DoorDash partnership creates a new commerce-media touchpoint

Through a new DoorDash advertising capability, Ace vendors can engage customers directly within the Ace Hardware storefront on DoorDash. Sponsored Ads and Sponsored Brands formats are designed to help brands increase visibility and influence purchase decisions while customers are actively building an order. A proud Upfront sponsor, DoorDash is helping extend the RedVest Media ecosystem into on-demand commerce, creating new opportunities for brands to drive visibility and sales in high-intent shopping moments.

A new audience library reflects the distinctiveness of the Ace customer

RedVest Media is building an audience library designed to connect brands with Ace's distinctive base of DIYers, handy homeowners and customers focused on maintaining and preserving their homes. While RedVest has always leveraged first-party data for its targeting, an audience library gives advertisers even more connectivity to custom customer cohorts aligned to their objectives.

Innovation built for home improvement, local relevance and the Ace model

RedVest Media also announced capabilities that lean into the unique dynamics of the home-improvement category, Ace's locally owned store model and the role Ace retailers play in their communities.

  • Weather-Triggered Programmatic Advertising: activates campaigns based on local weather conditions, helping brands deliver timely messages when weather creates a relevant project, product or household need.
  • RetailerReach: gives eligible vendors new ways to reach Ace and Emery Jensen retailers through retailer-facing banners, emails and educational content, helping brands build consideration and support distribution in partnership with merchandising.
  • Category Driver Campaigns: are multi-brand media packages with shared creative aligned to relevant seasonal moments and merchant departmental objectives. These campaigns are eligible for pooled investment across multiple relevant brands, allowing participating brands to get more reach and channels for their investment than if they were to execute their own campaign.

Together, these launches create a more connected RedVest Media ecosystem, one that combines the scale and convenience of digital commerce with the relevance of local communities, distinctive home-improvement audiences and measurement designed to guide smarter investment.

"For more than 100 years, Ace has helped customers care for the homes and communities they value most," said Kim Lefko, Chief Marketing Officer at Ace Hardware. "We've built our reputation by being The Helpful Place and by offering highly desired national brands. Our retail media network reflects that. RedVest Media is a brand-building tool that puts the power of more than 80 million Ace Rewards members, over 5,300 store locations, and Ace's hyper-local relevance in the hands of our vendor community. It's been incredibly exciting to see how rapidly brands have leaned in, using these tools to earn attention and drive growth."

The announced capabilities are available now, and the audience library will continue to develop over calendar year 2027. Some capabilities may require an investment or commitment threshold.

About Ace Hardware

Ace Hardware is the largest hardware cooperative in the world, serving more than 8,950 locally owned and operated stores around the globe, while providing the best products, services, and operating methods to almost 5,300 Ace retail stores in the United States. Ace Hardware's family of brands includes Ace Hardware, Emery Jensen Distribution, and independent retailers worldwide. Headquartered in Oak Brook, Ill., Ace operates an expansive network of U.S. distribution centers, along with international capabilities in Ningbo, China. Since 1924, Ace has been a part of local communities, known as the place with the helpful hardware folks. For more information, visit acehardware.com or newsroom.acehardware.com.

releases.body:
September 17 Global Day of Learning will bring together marketing leaders from General Motors, Mastercard, LEGO, Duolingo, SAS, and others for practical training on AI agents, synthetic audiences, measurement and the future of marketing work

Key Takeaways

  • The ANA Global Day of Learning returns September 17, 2026, bringing marketers together for a full day focused on The Future of Marketing Work and the skills needed as AI reshapes the profession.
  • Leaders and experts from General Motors, Mastercard, The LEGO Group, Duolingo, SAS, eos Products, and others will address AI, changing consumer behavior, and new ways of working.
  • The program includes training in AI agents and custom GPTs, synthetic audiences, cross-media measurement, co-creation, and future-proofing marketer relevance.

NEW YORK, Aug. 28, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- As artificial intelligence rapidly changes how marketing work gets done, the Association of National Advertisers (ANA) is calling on the industry to put down the day-to-day work for one day and focus on building the skills marketers will need next.

On Thursday, September 17, 2026, the ANA will host its annual Global Day of Learning, a full day of live master classes, workshops, and conversations built around this year's theme, "The Future of Marketing Work."

The initiative is driven by the ANA Global CMO Growth Council and organized around priorities identified by marketing leaders from around the world.

"AI isn't simply giving marketers another set of tools. It's forcing us to reconsider what skills matter, where human judgment creates the most value, and how the marketing organization itself needs to evolve," said Nick Primola, Group Executive Vice President at the ANA and leader of the Global CMO Growth Council. "Global Day of Learning is our opportunity to collectively push pause on the work immediately in front of us and power up for what's coming next. The goal isn't to predict the future of marketing. It's to give marketers practical ways to prepare for it."

Why is the ANA asking marketers to "push pause"?

Global Day of Learning is built around what the ANA calls "PTO — Personal Time ON": dedicated time to step away from immediate deadlines and focus on learning and skill-building.

This year's "Push Pause and Power Up" call to action reflects the ANA's belief that keeping pace with AI and other industry changes requires marketers to invest in their own capabilities, not just new technology.

Who is speaking at the 2026 ANA Global Day of Learning?

Featured speakers and sessions include:

  • Raja Rajamannar, former Chief Marketing and Communications Officer at Mastercard, on the emerging era of "Quantum Marketing."
  • Shenan Reed, Global Chief Media Officer at General Motors, on the future of cross-media measurement as audiences and media investment fragment across platforms and AI-driven channels.
  • Julia Goldin, Chief Product and Marketing Officer at The LEGO Group.
  • Rahul Chopra, Vice President at Duolingo, and Eric Fulwiler, Co-Founder and CEO of Rival, on building challenger brands at scale.
  • Jennifer Chase, Chief Marketing Officer and Executive Vice President at SAS, on AI, technology, and B2B brand growth.
  • Soyoung Kang, President of eos Products, and creator and entrepreneur Funmi Monet, on the evolution of creator marketing from transactional endorsements toward deeper brand-creator co-creation.
  • Rishad Tobaccowala, Co-Founder of The Athena Project, on future-proofing marketer relevance.

The program will also include hands-on AI training from Cord Silverstein, CEO of IntegrateAI, who will teach participants to build and deploy Custom GPTs and AI agents using ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot and Gemini.

What is the ANA Global Day of Learning?

The ANA Global Day of Learning is an annual industry-wide initiative designed to give marketing professionals dedicated time for education, professional development, and skills-building.

Over the past three years, more than 20,000 marketing professionals and students from more than 100 countries have participated, learning from senior marketers and subject matter experts from across the industry.

The program is a cornerstone of the ANA's investment in developing the marketing profession and is aligned with the ANA Industry Growth Agenda and the priorities identified by the ANA Global CMO Growth Council.

CHICAGO, Aug. 27, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- ImpactFactory.ai today announced the release of Version 1.2, adding the ability for businesses to create and place advertising in ChatGPT directly alongside their existing social media campaigns.

The new capability represents a major expansion of ImpactFactory.ai's publishing and media placement tools. A business can create a piece of content once, select where it wants that content to appear — including Facebook, Instagram, X and other social platforms — and now add ChatGPT as an advertising destination.

But the opportunity goes beyond simply adding another platform. ChatGPT advertising gives businesses the potential to reach consumers at the moment they need what the business provides.

Traditional advertising often depends on memory. A consumer sees an ad today and the advertiser hopes they remember the business days or weeks later when they actually need the product or service. Conversational AI creates a fundamentally different opportunity: reaching consumers while they are actively expressing that need.

For example, someone might ask ChatGPT, "Where is a good Mediterranean restaurant near me?" Alongside the response, an eligible user could be shown a clearly identified sponsored placement from a local Mediterranean restaurant.

ImpactFactory makes this particularly powerful for local businesses by allowing advertisers to target specific ZIP codes or define a geographic radius around their business. A restaurant, dentist, realtor, plumber or other local business can focus its advertising on the communities it actually serves.

"This is a revolutionary breakthrough for small business marketing," said Dr. Duane Varan, CEO and Founder of ImpactFactory.ai. "Conversational AI is rapidly becoming a new gateway between consumers and the marketplace. For the first time, we're giving local businesses a simple way to put themselves right at that gateway. I believe this will fundamentally change how businesses connect with customers."

The new ChatGPT capability builds on ImpactFactory.ai's broader vision of providing a complete digital marketing agency in a box.

ImpactFactory brings together the tools businesses need to understand their market and competitors, build their brand, create and improve websites, produce marketing content, publish to social media, conduct email campaigns, create advertising, place media and optimize marketing performance — all within one integrated AI-powered platform.

"We're bringing big-brand marketing capabilities to small businesses at a budget they can afford," Varan added. "A local business shouldn't need a Fortune 500 marketing department to take advantage of the newest technologies. ImpactFactory gives them one place to create, target, place and optimize their marketing — and now that includes one of the most important new advertising environments to emerge in years."

KINGSTON, ON, Aug. 27, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Keynote speaker, facilitator, and JUNO Award–nominated singer-songwriter Peter Katz has been inducted into the National Speakers Association's (NSA) CPAE® Speaker Hall of Fame (only the fifth Canadian speaker in the award's history to receive the honour).

The Council of Peers Award for Excellence (CPAE®) is awarded by peers through a rigorous evaluation process that examines a speaker's integrity, message, delivery, and body of work over a career, and is reserved for those who have reached the top of the profession. Past honourees include Jim Rohn, Colin Powell, and Zig Ziglar.

Katz received the award at the NSA's annual conference awards banquet on July 27, 2026, in Austin, Texas, surrounded by family, dear friends, and colleagues.

Today, Peter is a trusted partner to Fortune 500 companies, leading healthcare systems, major associations, and all levels of government, all of whom turn to him to help clarify what matters most, recognize it in everyday actions, and celebrate it in ways that fuel connection and performance.

MEET PETER

Peter Katz is a Hall of Fame Keynote Speaker and a JUNO Award– and Canadian Screen Award–nominated singer-songwriter, and xchange Approach certified facilitator. He's built his career as an expert in helping teams recognize, value, and celebrate their individual and collective impacts. His interactive Celebrate What Matters™ Keynote Concerts feature songs and stories of resiliency, authenticity, and unexpected joy that ignite connection, foster belonging, and create momentum.

Katz is the founder of Heartstrings Songwriting Retreats, which allows aspiring songwriters of all experience levels to realize their lifelong dream of writing and recording their own song. He's also the co-founder of The Conscious Leaders Quest, an immersive five-day retreat in Costa Rica that invites a holistic approach to mind, body, and business, equipping leaders to do the vital inner work that transforms the way they lead.

GRATITUDE

Katz is quick to credit the honour to a process, not a performance. "This award is a recognition and celebration of a process," he said in his acceptance speech. "The process of seeing human beings and honouring the privilege of serving them with great care. That is what I have loved doing my whole life, as a songwriter, speaker and facilitator: shining a light on people's goodness and brilliance and then celebrating it as a way to inspire others."

He thanked the National Speakers Association and the community of peers who championed him along the way, along with the team at Speakers Spotlight who believed in him from the beginning. He reserved his warmest thanks for his family — including his partner, Taes, and his mother, Catherine, who were in the room for the induction.

Peter is particularly honoured to be inducted alongside his remarkable colleagues Manley Feinberg, Jessica Pettitt, Anton Gunn, and Allison Shapira.

releases.title: Gen Z Trusts AI Companies, Influencers and Social Media Least Among 14 Types of Organizations Tested, New Rival Technologies Study Shows
releases.body:
Social media is Gen Z's top source for news, yet just 33% trust social media platforms, while trust in influencers stands at 31% and AI companies at 24%

VANCOUVER, BC, Aug. 27, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- AI companies, influencers and social media platforms ranked lowest for trust among 14 types of organizations tested in a new Rival Technologies study of 903 Gen Z consumers across the United States and Canada.

AI companies ranked lowest, with just 24% of respondents expressing trust and 73% expressing distrust, followed by influencers at 31% trust and social media platforms at 33%. The findings are particularly notable given how much Gen Z relies on these platforms and technologies in daily life. Social media, for example, is this generation's top news source, used by 62% of respondents.

Healthcare institutions stood apart, with 79% of Gen Z expressing trust and 31% saying they trust them completely. Trust in most of the other types of organizations tested, including banks, government, traditional news media, food brands and streaming services, fell between the high levels reported for healthcare institutions and the low levels reported for AI companies, influencers and social media platforms.

Top three organizations trusted by Gen Z:

  • Healthcare institutions and hospitals — 79%
  • Hospitality companies (hotels, Airbnb) — 65%
  • Government institutions — 64%

Organizations least trusted by Gen Z:

  • Social media platforms — 33%
  • Influencers — 31%
  • AI tech companies — 24%

Other findings from the study include:

  • Canada is a tougher trust market than the United States. Canadian Gen Zers trust AI companies at less than half the American rate (14% versus 33%), and are far more skeptical of influencers (20% versus 40%) and social platforms (23% versus 43%).
  • Legacy news still holds up. Despite getting most of their news from social feeds, 61% of Gen Z trust established news organizations like The New York Times or The Boston Globe (in the U.S.) or The Globe & Mail (in Canada), nearly double the trust they place in the social platforms carrying that news (33%).
  • Low trust in these categories was consistent across age groups and countries. AI companies, influencers and social media platforms ranked at the bottom across every age group tested and in both the United States and Canada.

"Our research shows that Gen Z trust is fragile, nuanced, and rarely given by default," said Paula Catoira, chief marketing officer at Rival Group."You don't win it with reach, you earn it through relationship. That means meeting these young consumers where they are, and in research, a mobile-first, conversational approach lets them share what they really think in a way that feels natural to them."

The study was conducted with 903 Gen Z participants (ages 18 to 29) across the United States and Canada using Rival's AI-accelerated, mobile-first, conversational research platform, with participants sourced from the company's proprietary panel. It was fielded from late July to early August 2026.

Several solutions from Rival help brands track Gen Z sentiment and attitudes over time.  Emerging Consumer Index tracks Gen Z and millennial consumers across the U.S. and Canada through a continuous research stream, with new data collected every two weeks. Rival Insight Communities give brands access to real-time insights from their most important audiences, including Gen Z.

It encourages viewers to reconsider what they believe—and why. View the trailer HERE

UFOs and God is unique with its controversial perspective—that the growing number of UFO sightings and encounters may not be extraterrestrial in origin, but part of a supernatural reality long described in the Bible.

Lise Romanoff, CEO and Managing Director of Vision Films says, "The wide range of interviews in this film from astronomers and military experts to theologians and individuals who have had abduction experiences, make this a thought-provoking new look at UFOs and the spiritual world."

"We're asked many times 'How does this phenomenon affect the church? But that's the wrong question," says film host and co-director Wes Llewellyn. "The question we need to be asking is 'How does this spiritual and Biblical phenomenon affect the world? As filmmakers, we hope we have provided some solid answers to this important question."  

Co-Director Amanda Llewellyn continues, "This summer, Spielberg's film Disclosure Day was touted as a movie that 'will change how you look at God.' Is God who He says He is? Is the Bible reliable? It implies that these so-called 'alien beings' are the solution to our problems, but are they? After seeing our documentary and given our research, including my own personal experience, you can decide for yourself."

Derrick Warfel, the film's executive producer and ThM graduate from Dallas Seminary, adds, "People are being told these are visitors from other planets—advanced beings to help humanity transition to the next level of human evolution. When examining the evidence alongside Scripture, you see it's simply part of an ancient, invisible war continuing since the creation of mankind." 

Warfel is releasing a companion book with the same name that expands on the film's themes in much greater detail and documentation. From Forefront Books, distributed by Simon and Schuster, and available at Barnes & Noble, it helps readers understand the phenomenon through Biblical teaching and examples.

Co-director Amanda Llewellyn will be publishing her autobiography of her childhood experiences with unknown entities in a book titled "Amanda vs The Aliens" this fall.

UFOs and God will be available September 11, 2026, on major streaming platforms including Amazon, iTunes/AppleTV, GooglePlay, and most cable platforms across the US and Canada.

For more information, visit: https://www.ufosandgod.com

releases.body:
Partnership leverages BioHorizons' commercial network to broaden availability of Xtant's allogeneic growth factor technology, OsteoFactor Pro™, which BioHorizons will private brand as Prolifica™

BELGRADE, Mont., Aug. 27, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Xtant Medical Holdings, Inc. (NYSE American: XTNT), a global medical technology company focused on surgical solutions for the treatment of spinal, orthopedic, and wound care disorders, announced an exclusive partnership with BioHorizons (a Henry Schein, Inc. company), whereby BioHorizons will distribute Xtant's allogeneic growth factor technology under the private brand Prolifica™ through its commercial network.

The agreement establishes BioHorizons as the exclusive distributor of Xtant's allogeneic growth factor technology into the dental and oral-maxillofacial procedure markets in the United States and Canada, expanding access to the advanced allograft technology for clinicians served by the BioHorizons commercial organization. The partnership reflects a long-term strategic relationship between the two companies, combining Xtant's regenerative medicine development and manufacturing capabilities with BioHorizons' established commercial reach and customer relationships. Both companies expect the collaboration to create a durable channel for expanding access to Prolifica™ and to serve as a foundation for continued collaboration between the organizations.

Sean Browne, President and CEO of Xtant Medical, stated, "This exclusive partnership brings together Xtant's expertise in regenerative biologics with BioHorizons' trusted commercial organization, positioning both companies to deliver meaningful value to clinicians and the patients they serve. We look forward to a productive, long-standing collaboration."

Steve Boggan, President and CEO of BioHorizons, stated, "Prolifica™ is a strong complement to our regenerative portfolio, and this partnership allows us to bring advanced allogeneic growth factors to more of the clinicians who rely on us. We look forward to a long-term collaboration that benefits both organizations and, most importantly, the patients we collectively serve."

Prolifica™ is a naturally occurring blend of allogeneic growth factors, stabilized by native human collagen and delivered in their intrinsic structure, concentration, and composition. Processed to preserve the natural biphasic release of proteins, this advanced allograft supports bone healing and regeneration across a range of clinical applications.

Prolifica™ is now accessible to clinicians through BioHorizons' commercial network.

About Xtant Medical Holdings, Inc.

Xtant Medical's mission of honoring the gift of donation so that our patients can live as full and complete a life as possible, is the driving force behind our company. Xtant Medical Holdings, Inc. (www.xtantmedical.com) is a global medical technology company focused on the design, development, and commercialization of a comprehensive portfolio of orthobiologics serving the chronic and surgical wound care and sports medicine markets, as well as spinal implant systems. Xtant people are dedicated and talented, operating with the highest integrity to serve our customers.

releases.title: IQST - IQSTEL Partners with IDILIO TV to Reach a Potential Global Audience of 630 Million Spanish Speakers and Build a Multimillion-Dollar Digital Entertainment Business
releases.body:
• IDILIO TV produces original vertical "microdramas" built for the phone — one-to-three-minute episodes spanning romance, thriller, suspense, mystery, crime, and revenge — with a catalog of more than 49 original series and 2,450 short-form episodes in Spanish and roughly two to four new series added each month

  • According to IDILIO TV, the platform has surpassed 2 million downloads, with distribution across more than 120 countries, more than 400,000 social-media followers, and native applications on iOS and Android

  • IDILIO TV Founded in Colombia by Stanford-educated attorney Gabriela Tafur and MIT-trained technologist Esteban Ramírez, IDILIO TV is backed by a16z Speedrun, Goodwater Capital, WndrCo, and Nubank founder David Vélez

NEW YORK, Aug. 27, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- IQSTEL Inc. (NASDAQ: IQST) ("IQSTEL" or the "Company"), a multinational technology company providing telecommunications, fintech, AI-powered communications, cybersecurity, content, and digital infrastructure services, today announced that its subsidiary IQSTEL Digital (www.iqsteldigital.com) has entered into a strategic distribution partnership with IDILIO TV (www.idilio.tv/en), a Colombian mobile entertainment platform specializing in short-form vertical microdramas.

The partnership pairs IDILIO TV's content library, audience traction, and mobile technology with IQSTEL's telecommunications infrastructure and mobile-operator relationships, with the objective of building a recurring-revenue digital entertainment business serving Spanish-speaking audiences worldwide.

Why This Partnership, and Why Now

Short-form vertical drama — commonly called "microdrama" — is among the fastest-growing categories in digital entertainment. The format originated in China and, according to industry reporting, generated approximately $11 billion in global revenue in 2024, growing roughly 35% that year following a 268% increase in 2023. Chinese-language platforms are reported to account for roughly 83% of that revenue, leaving Spanish-language content — addressing more than 630 million speakers worldwide — comparatively underserved. (according to industry reports)

IDILIO TV was built to serve that gap with original Latin American content rather than dubbed imports. IQSTEL brings the distribution layer: commercial relationships with more than 600 telecom operators across 21 countries, and the billing and integration infrastructure required to place a consumer digital service inside a mobile operator's subscriber offering.

"IDILIO TV brings a proven product, compelling content, technology, and audience engagement. IQSTEL brings the operator relationships and distribution infrastructure needed to scale it. That combination can transform a successful digital product into a global recurring revenue business." said Leandro Iglesias, President and CEO of IQSTEL.

How the Distribution Model Works

IQSTEL Digital intends to distribute IDILIO TV through participating mobile operators using several complementary monetization paths:

  • Direct-carrier billing, under which a subscriber's charges appear on an existing mobile bill, removing the payment-card friction that limits digital subscription adoption in many Latin American and emerging markets.
  • Standalone and bundled subscriptions, in which operators package the service with existing data or entertainment plans as a differentiator.

Unlike a one-time content licensing transaction, this model is designed to generate revenue monthly for as long as subscribers remain active. Each new mobile-operator agreement can provide access to an additional subscriber base; as distribution expands, subscriber growth can support additional content, marketing, and geographic expansion.

IQSTEL's commercial telecommunications relationships extend across an ecosystem of operators whose combined networks serve an estimated 2.3 billion end users. This figure describes the aggregate reach of IQSTEL's operator relationships and is not a projection of potential subscribers for this service.

"Every new operator opens a door to another potential subscriber base, and every retained subscriber can contribute recurring revenue," Iglesias said. "Rather than building a global distribution network from the ground up, we intend to activate the relationships and infrastructure already present across IQSTEL's platform."

An Operating Platform with Institutional Backing

IDILIO TV launched its iOS and Android applications in late 2025 and has scaled rapidly. According to IDILIO TV, the platform has achieved:

  • More than 2 million downloads
  • Distribution across more than 120 countries and more than 400,000 social-media followers.
  • A catalog of 49+ original series and 2,450+ short-form episodes, in Spanish, English, and Portuguese.
  • Production of approximately two to four new series per month.

In June 2026, IDILIO TV announced the close of a $5 million seed financing led by a16z Speedrun, the Andreessen Horowitz accelerator focused on media and entertainment, with participation from Goodwater Capital, WndrCo — the investment firm co-founded by media executive Jeffrey Katzenberg — and David Vélez, founder of Nubank, investing individually.

Episodes generally run between one and three minutes and span romance, thriller, suspense, mystery, crime, and revenge — genres suited to mobile viewing and serialized engagement. The company produces content using a data-driven development process, testing series concepts with audiences before committing to full production.

"Microdramas are changing how audiences discover entertainment," said Jorge Becerra, CEO of IQSTEL Digital. "The format is mobile-native, highly engaging, and ideally suited for telecommunications distribution. IDILIO TV already has the content and audience. IQSTEL can provide the commercial channels needed to pursue much greater scale."

Leadership and Creative Origin

IDILIO TV was co-founded by Chief Executive Officer Gabriela Tafur, a Stanford-educated attorney, and Chief Technology Officer Esteban Ramírez, who holds an MBA and a master's degree in computer science from MIT.

The platform draws on Colombia's long track record in producing and exporting dramas and telenovelas. With creative influences from Colombia, Miami, and Mexico, its stories combine Latin American cultural specificity with themes that travel — love, ambition, betrayal, revenge, and redemption. Latin American and Colombian communities are well established across the United States, Europe, and Asia, and their cultural and linguistic ties create a natural international audience for authentic Spanish-language entertainment.

"Colombia has already proven that its stories can travel," Becerra said. "IDILIO TV brings that creative legacy into a mobile-first, globally scalable format."

"Our stories are rooted in Latin America, but the emotions are universal," said Gabriela Tafur, CEO and Co-Founder of IDILIO TV. "IQSTEL Digital provides the telecommunications relationships and infrastructure needed to reach Spanish-speaking audiences wherever they live. Together, we have a real opportunity to build a scalable and sustainable global entertainment business."

Creating Value Across the Ecosystem

  • Mobile operators gain a differentiated digital service designed to support subscriber acquisition, engagement, and retention, and a new billing-based revenue share.
  • Subscribers gain convenient access to culturally relevant, mobile-first entertainment, payable through an existing mobile account.
  • IDILIO TV gains international distribution and new subscriber-acquisition channels without building operator relationships market by market.
  • IQSTEL gains the opportunity to build a scalable recurring revenue stream with potential EBITDA contribution, consistent with its strategy of monetizing higher-margin digital services across its existing carrier network.

Financial Context and Outlook

IQSTEL reported preliminary net revenue of approximately $207 million for the first six months of 2026, compared to approximately $130 million in the same period of 2025. The Company has stated a fiscal year 2026 revenue target of $430 million and has described a strategic focus on expanding EBITDA through higher-margin digital services.

"For years we invested in building a global telecommunications platform — 21 countries, more than 600 operator relationships, and the billing and integration infrastructure that connects them," said Leandro Iglesias, President and CEO of IQSTEL. "This partnership is exactly how we intend to monetize that network. We are not building new distribution here; we are placing a digital service into channels that already exist and already carry traffic every day. If we execute, that is what turns infrastructure we have already built into recurring, higher-margin.."

Subject to operator agreements, technical integrations, pricing, subscriber adoption, and market execution, IQSTEL believes the partnership represents a meaningful recurring revenue opportunity with the potential to contribute to EBITDA growth over time. No mobile-operator distribution agreements have been executed in connection with this partnership as of the date of this release, and there can be no assurance that any such agreement will be entered into or that the partnership will generate revenue.

About IDILIO TV

IDILIO TV is a mobile-first entertainment platform producing premium vertical microdramas for Spanish-speaking audiences worldwide. Founded in Colombia and led by CEO and Co-Founder Gabriela Tafur and CTO and Co-Founder Esteban Ramírez, IDILIO TV combines Latin American storytelling with proprietary mobile technology and a mix of subscription, virtual-currency, advertising, and brand-partnership monetization. According to the company, IDILIO TV has surpassed 2 million downloads, and distribution across more than 120 countries, with a catalog of more than 49 original series. For more information, visit www.idilio.tv/en.

About IQSTEL Inc.

IQSTEL Inc. (NASDAQ: IQST) is a global telecommunications and technology company operating through two core business divisions: Telecom and Digital Services. The Telecom Division is the foundation of IQSTEL's global platform, operating across 24 countries with more than 600 telecommunications carrier interconnections and delivering international voice, SMS, messaging, and connectivity solutions to some of the world's largest telecom operators and enterprise customers. Through these customer relationships, IQSTEL's platform has the potential to reach approximately 2.3 billion end users worldwide. Building on this global infrastructure and commercial reach, the Digital Services Division is focused on higher-margin technology solutions across Artificial Intelligence, Intelligent Communications, Cybersecurity, Fintech, Digital Health, Enterprise Automation, and Content Services. Built through nearly two decades of organic growth and strategic acquisitions, IQSTEL is leveraging the scale and reach of its Telecom business to accelerate the growth of Digital Services and drive its next phase of revenue and Adjusted EBITDA expansion.
